About This Job

As a member of the Quality Engineering team, the Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) designs, develops, and maintains scalable test software and automation frameworks that validate Axos core banking capabilities across Web UI, APIs, databases, mobile applications, and integrated services. The SDET applies software engineering practices to improve testability, reliability, and delivery speed throughout the software development lifecycle. This role partners closely with Product, Development, DevOps, Project, and Production Support teams to define quality strategies, prevent defects, and deliver secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Works as part of an Agile cross-functional team to define the test strategy, acceptance criteria, and automation approach for new features and enhancements.
  • Designs, develops, reviews, and maintains reliable automated tests and reusable test components using sound software engineering principles.
  • Builds and evolves automation frameworks, test utilities, data-management solutions, and service mocks that support Web UI, API, database, integration, and mobile testing.
  • Integrates automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and establishes fast, actionable quality feedback at appropriate stages of delivery.
  • Reviews requirements, architecture, technical designs, and code changes to identify risks, improve testability, and prevent defects early.
  • Develops effective functional, integration, contract, regression, and end-to-end tests based on product and technical risk.
  • Investigates test failures and production defects using logs, queries, traces, and other diagnostic data; documents findings and partners with engineers through resolution.
  • Improves automation reliability, execution time, maintainability, observability, and coverage while reducing flaky tests and redundant manual validation.
  • Contributes to coding standards, peer reviews, technical documentation, and engineering practices for quality-related code and tooling.
  • Uses quality metrics and defect trends to identify systemic risks and recommend improvements to product design, development, testing, and release processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in software development, quality engineering, or test automation, including ownership of production-grade automated test solutions.
  • Strong programming skills in JavaScript or TypeScript; experience with an additional language such as Java, C#, or Python is preferred.
  • Experience designing or extending test automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium WebDriver, Appium, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience testing REST APIs and distributed integrations, including authentication, data validation, error handling, and service contracts.
  • Proficiency in writing and troubleshooting SQL queries in Oracle and/or Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Experience integrating automated tests with source control, build systems, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of software design, object-oriented or modular programming, data structures, debugging, and code-review practices.
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery, the software development lifecycle, test levels, risk-based testing, and defect-prevention practices.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks and influence quality decisions across teams.

Additional Qualifications

  • Financial services, fintech, or consumer banking experience, including familiarity with security, privacy, auditability, and regulatory expectations.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, containerized environments, service virtualization, messaging systems, or microservice architectures.
  • Experience with performance, accessibility, security, resilience, or reliability testing.
  • Experience using observability and diagnostic tools for logs, metrics, traces, and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience with low-code/no-code automation tools and the judgment to select code-based or low-code approaches appropriately.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor peers, champion engineering standards, and drive continuous improvement across teams.

Key Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Applies an engineering mindset to quality by building maintainable solutions, designing for testability, and addressing root causes rather than relying on repetitive manual validation.
  • Demonstrates strong coding, debugging, systems-thinking, and problem-solving skills across user interfaces, services, databases, and integrated platforms.
  • Balances test depth, execution speed, maintainability, and business risk when selecting automation approaches.
  • Takes ownership of quality outcomes, proactively identifies risks, and constructively challenges requirements, designs, and release decisions when evidence warrants it.
  • Collaborates effectively with engineers and non-technical stakeholders while communicating defects, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly.
  • Plans, prioritizes, and delivers independently in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to build software that makes network operations safe, scalable, and boring — even as we launch new data centers and expand fast. This is not a “write scripts for configs” role: you’ll build the tooling and services that sit between the network core (switches/ports/VLANs, traffic processors) and the cloud platform on top, using open source where it fits and building the missing pieces where it doesn’t.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Build and maintain services and tooling that automate the network lifecycle: day-0 provisioning, day-N changes, drift detection, and operational verification

• Make network changes safe and transparent: CI/CD workflows, diff/review tooling, staged rollouts/rollbacks, audit trails, and guardrails

• Develop observability systems that scale across many sites: telemetry pipelines, signal quality, and tooling that shortens incident investigations

• Close “last mile” gaps between the network and the platform: integrate source-of-truth data, expose APIs, and build reliable automation around it

• Collaborate closely with network engineers and SREs to turn real operational pain into product-quality tooling

We expect you to have:

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent practical background)

• Strong coding skills and ownership mindset: you can ship and operate reliable services

• Proficiency in Go or readiness to switch; Python is also welcome (other languages can be useful for OSS debugging/fixes)

• You don’t have to be Network expert but we expect you to have interest in infrastructure and/or network

It will be an added bonus if you have:

• Background in networking (ex-network engineer, CCNP/education, DC networking exposure) or strong interest and proven ability to learn fast

• Experience building automation/infra tooling: CI/CD, IaC, testing/staging environments, or “network-as-code” style workflows

• Low-level networking / datapath experience: eBPF/XDP, DPDK, kernel networking, traffic processing systems

• Experience designing high-load services and observability platforms (metrics/logs/traces, alerting, regression detection)

• Contributions to open source or experience extending/debugging OSS components in production environments

We expect Engineers to:

• Manage large-scale projects involving multiple stakeholders

• Break down complex tasks and guide both their own work and that of more junior colleagues

• Be experts in specific technologies and write high-quality code that can serve as a reference

• Assess task priority and focus on high-impact work, avoiding low-value efforts

• Have strong architectural thinking and contribute to system design

• Be involved in hiring and actively contribute to interviews

• Be willing to share knowledge and mentor others

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What’s it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving – Bold thinking – Constant growth – Meaningful impact – Trust and real ownership – Opportunity to shape the future of AI 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. 

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

An overview of this role

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Source Code Experience team within GitLab’s Create stage. You’ll help make everyday source code workflows clear, reliable, and efficient for people working across GitLab projects. As artificial intelligence agents increasingly write and manage code alongside people, you’ll build backend capabilities and interfaces that support trustworthy collaboration between people and agents.

You’ll work in one of GitLab’s oldest and most complex product areas, using Ruby and GraphQL to improve critical source code experiences across GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. The Source Code group is responsible for the backend and frontend aspects of the product categories within Source Code. With support from experienced team members, you’ll help maintain high reliability through performance and structured query language tuning, caching, rate limiting, testing, observability, and resiliency. You’ll collaborate with product management, product design, testing, security, user experience research, technical writing, Gitaly, Code Review, and other Source Code teams to deliver reliable and performant systems.

Learn more about the Create:Source Code teams in the GitLab Handbook.

What you’ll do

• Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby and GraphQL.

• Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.

• Design and maintain backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic that support intuitive source code workflows.

• Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.

• Use artificial intelligence agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.

• Write maintainable code that follows GitLab’s standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.

• Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.

• Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.

What you’ll bring

• Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.

• An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.

• Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems.

• Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.

• Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo.

• Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.

• The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.

About the team

We work on a complex product area that serves GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. You’ll work closely with Code Review, Gitaly, and other Source Code teams.

We welcome candidates with different levels and types of experience. Many successful candidates don’t meet every requirement. If you’re excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiting team to assess your application.

About the Role

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer to lead technical direction across GitLab’s Core DevOps services, the systems the majority of our users touch every day. Distinguished Engineers are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the most senior level of technical leadership within and across divisions at the company.

Core DevOps builds continuous Integration, continuous deployment, planning, and source control experiences. These are among the most mature, highest traffic, and most deeply interconnected systems at GitLab. They carry years of accumulated architectural decisions, they sit in the critical path of our customers’ own delivery pipelines, and they are being reshaped by the shift toward AI native development. The job is to raise their quality, converge them onto a coherent go-forward architecture, and retire accumulated risk, all without interrupting the millions of users and Fortune 100 organizations who depend on them.

GitLab is pursuing a set of company-wide engineering goals: large gains in developer productivity, measurably higher quality in what we ship, and engineering practices reshaped around AI and agentic workflows. Core DevOps is where much of that strategy has to land, because these are the services our own engineers and our customers depend on daily. In this role you will bring that strategy into Core DevOps in a form that works for long lived production systems, and carry what you learn here back out to the rest of engineering.

What You’ll Do

• Set and continuously refine the go forward technical direction for CI, CD, Plan, and source code experiences, aligned against the horizontal architectural initiatives.

• Work directly with the VP of Engineering as her technical counterpart on planning, technical investment, and where the group’s engineering effort should go.

• Translate GitLab’s company-wide productivity, quality, and AI native engineering goals into concrete technical direction for Core DevOps, and turn into iterable roadmaps, partnering broadly across the org.

• Define what good means in measurable terms for these services, including availability, latency at p95 and p99, pipeline success rate, test reliability, data correctness, and defect escape rate, then hold designs and implementations to it.

• Maintain a clear and current picture of systemic technical risk across the group, including single points of failure, unowned critical paths, brittle coupling between CI/CD and Plan, scaling limits, and past decisions that now constrain the roadmap. Drive a prioritized plan to retire it.

• Lead the hardest design decisions hands on, writing code, prototypes, and proofs of concept where a design argument needs evidence behind it.

• Drive convergence on shared patterns, libraries, and paved paths, reducing how many different ways the same problem gets solved across the group.

• Design migration paths that let large, long lived systems change underneath users without breaking them, using incremental cutover, dual run, measurable rollback, and deprecation with clear timelines.

• Adopt the platform capabilities coming from GitLab’s AI organization and the company’s productivity initiatives into Core DevOps, feed this group’s requirements back into them, and help prove what works on systems of this scale and maturity.

• Serve as the escalation point for complex or contested technical decisions across the group, including those where no single team owns the outcome.

• Review significant designs and merge requests in the group’s critical paths, and use review to teach rather than only to gate.

• Ensure designs hold across GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, and respect multi-tenant, compliance, and data governance boundaries in each.

• Partner with Infrastructure, Security, and SRE so Core DevOps services are observable and debuggable, and so failure modes degrade gracefully instead of cascading.

• Make architectural constraints and opportunities clear to Product in roadmap terms, so that technical investment and product ambition get planned together instead of traded off late.

• Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let teams across the group make aligned decisions independently.

• Grow Principal and Staff Engineers across Core DevOps, raise the bar on design rigor and technical writing, and contribute to the technical hiring bar for senior individual contributors.

• Participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com, and complete Interview Training to participate in hiring as a technical interviewer or panel member.

• Proven track record of leading hands-on technical experimentation, including defining evaluation frameworks, running benchmarks, and translating findings into scalable architecture decisions.

• Strong background in scalable, multi-tenant distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience.

• Ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization with excellent written and asynchronous communication skills.

We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer, Developer Tooling and Containers to work on a new open-source developer experience tool. We are rethinking typical developer workflows, trying to preserve what people love about traditional Linux while enabling people to work better in immutable distro environments, as well as with remote cloud resources. You’ll join to work on a product that is deeply and securely integrated with Ubuntu desktop, modern IDEs, and SDKs from publishers like NVIDIA, Intel, AMD and others. Location: This team is based in the APAC region, these remote roles can be filled from anywhere in APAC time zones.

• Design the user experience of new capabilities in the tool

• Write high-quality code to create new features

• Obsess with correctness and robustness of your work for diverse use cases

• Go the extra mile in making sure the software you create addresses a well-defined problem

• Think carefully through implementation strategy from the perspective of performance, quality and security

• Work with teams both inside and outside of Canonical

What we are looking for in you

• You have professional software development experience using Go, Python, C, or C++

• You know Linux system-level fundamentals, for example, cgroups and namespaces

• Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

• Experience with AI/ML and/or CUDA/OpenVINO

• Knowledge of system and language package managers internals

Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

• We’re taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.

• We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.

• We’re designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we’re building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn’t only autonomous…it’s also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Become a Quality Engineer for Bloomreach!

The Data Pipeline team is a backend-focused engineering team that cares deeply about quality and reliability. We believe in autonomy, we trust data, and we own what we ship end-to-end. We move our customers’ data in and out of Bloomreach Engagement reliably and at a high rate:

• Our clients feed their visitors’ behavior through real-time tracking to our platform. The data then can be analyzed and used for marketing automation. We process tens of thousands of requests per second.

• Imports are critical for our clients to utilize our platform to the fullest. We import millions of rows of data and continuously improve the throughput and reliability of our imports and integrations with other data storages.

• We are also responsible for exporting data from our platform to Google’s BigQuery using Google’s DataFlows, PySpark and Apache Beam, allowing data access by our clients.

• We run and support our services in production, handling high-volume traffic using Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes.

Every one of these flows is something our customers rely on being correct, at scale. That is the terrain your testing and automation will cover.

You won’t be doing this alone: you’ll join an experienced Senior Quality Engineer already on the team, so you’ll have a buddy to ramp up with, bounce ideas off, and share the quality mission with from day one. We work remotely first (from Central & Eastern Europe), but we are more than happy to meet you in our nice offices in Bratislava, Brno or Prague. And if you are interested in who will be your engineering manager, check out Adam’s LinkedIn.

Intrigued? Read on 🙂 …

What challenge awaits you?

As a Quality Engineer in Data Pipeline, you own quality for systems that move huge volumes of customers’ data in real time, at scale, across many integrations. This is a backend, data-heavy world: a tracking API on one side, an internal message format and multiple storages on the other, with Kafka, GCP and Kubernetes in between. Guaranteeing quality here means understanding how data flows end-to-end and where it can go wrong.

We need you to bring engineering rigor to that quality. Concretely, you will:

• Own end-to-end and integration testing. Complex data pipelines can behave correctly component by component yet still surprise you end-to-end. You design the tests that validate real behavior across components, so we can ship changes to high-scale integrations with confidence.

• Build automation that runs repeatedly in CI. Turn testing into automated integration and end-to-end suites (e.g. Robot Framework, API tests) wired into the deployment pipeline, giving engineers fast, reliable feedback on every change.

• Go deep in the imports domain. Imports are a rich, well-defined area with plenty to reason about. You’ll build deep context so you can proactively tell the team what to test, how, and why, and where the edge cases hide.

• Shift left. Be part of grooming and design from day one, thinking about test cases and failure modes while features are being shaped rather than after the fact.

• Strengthen the pipeline core too. Beyond imports, help raise quality across the Data Pipeline core as you grow context.

• Partner with the developers. Quality is a shared responsibility: developers own their in-source tests and you add the outside-in automation layer and perspective. You make the whole team better at testing, not the place work gets handed off to.

Your responsibilities

• Design and own black-box, API-level and integration/end-to-end test automation for Data Pipeline services, primarily in the imports domain.

• Build and maintain automated test suites in CI/CD (GitLab) that gate deployments and catch regressions across components.

• Read Go/Python pipeline code well enough to find holes and design meaningful test cases – you don’t need to ship features, you need to understand the system.

• Drive test strategy in grooming and design reviews – test types on the ticket, acceptance criteria, edge cases, failure modes.

• Pair with our current Data Pipeline QA to spread automation and code-adjacent testing practices across the team.

• Use telemetry and reproduction to turn production incidents into durable, automated regression tests.

Our tech stack

• Languages: Python (primary), Go (enough to read pipeline code)

• Test automation: Robot Framework (API/integration and Browser-based E2E), CI-driven suites in GitLab, with ReportPortal / Allure reporting

• Platform you’ll test against: Apache Kafka, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, BigQuery, MongoDB, Redis

• CI/CD & tooling: GitLab, Jira, Confluence

• AI coding agents: Cursor, Claude Code, …

• … and much more 🙂

Your qualifications

Must have

• You write test automation in code – integration and API tests in CI, in Python / Go or a similar language.

• You can read backend/pipeline code (Go or Python) well enough to find gaps and reason about where a change can break something else. Useful QA sees the cross-component failure the feature author might missed.

• You are comfortable owning black-box, API and integration/end-to-end automation – the outside-in layer. (In-source unit and in-repo integration tests remain with the feature developers.)

• You want to work primarily in code and automation. If you are coming from a mostly manual testing background, that is fine – as long as you are excited to make automation your main craft, because that is where this role lives.

• You are comfortable in grooming and design from day one – a shift-left mindset, defining test types and cases on the ticket before code is written.

• You can learn and adapt – essential when navigating a large codebase and a data domain that mixes tracking, imports, and multiple storages.

• You know how to be effective in a remote-first environment.

• Fluent use of AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI, or similar) as part of your daily workflow.

Strongly preferred

• Prior backend exposure (an internship or role where you wrote code, or worked under a senior who set up proper testing/automation workflows) – it makes the pipeline world far less of a black box.

Investigate application access issues, authentication failures, and SSL certificate problems.
Integrate Zscaler logs with Splunk or other SIEM tools.

Walk me through what happens, step by step, from a laptop opening a browser to the page rendering, with Client Connector installed and SSL inspection enabled.

When would you choose a GRE tunnel over IPSec, or a PAC file over Client Connector?
Describe the largest ZIA environment you have worked in — seat count, number of locations, and what you personally owned versus what the team owned.
Have you migrated off a legacy proxy? What surprised you?

Firewall Experience: What hands-on experience do you have with Palo Alto or other next-generation firewalls? Explain how you troubleshoot firewall rules, NAT, routing, and IPsec connectivity.
End-to-End Security Ownership: Describe a security issue you independently resolved involving Zscaler, firewalls, network traffic, and log analysis..

We are looking for an experienced C# / WPF Developer Support & Maintenance Engineer to join our engineering team. The role focuses on troubleshooting, maintaining, and resolving technical issues in an established Agent Desktop application used in the Contact Center industry.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in C# and WPF desktop application development, debugging complex codebases, root cause analysis, and delivering reliable code fixes. Experience debugging and troubleshooting complex or unfamiliar codebases.

Experience with unit testing frameworks such as NUnit or xUnit.
Proficiency in Git or other source control systems.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
Experience handling technical issues, defect investigation, and structured ticket management.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to collaborate with globally distributed teams and work with overlapping European or North American time zones when required.

Experience in application support, sustaining engineering, or software maintenance.
Exposure to Contact Center applications or enterprise desktop applications.

Experience collaborating with international development teams.

We are looking for a technically strong and detail-oriented developer who can independently investigate complex software issues, understand existing code, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

Candidates with experience in C# / WPF application maintenance, production support, debugging, and defect resolution will be preferred.

Job Description
Accounting Operations includes accounting operations roles involved in overseeing the day-to-day financial transactions with accuracy and in compliance with regulations, accounting principals and standards. Covers cost accounting (allocating and analyzing direct and indirect costs, actual vs. budgeted cost variance analysis, etc.), and budget accounting (developing and monitoring annual revenue/expense budgets for the purpose of controlling funds and measuring operating results). Department: Projects / Engineering

Job Title: MEP Engineer (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) Industry: Real Estate / Construction Experience: 58 years Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a relevant engineering qualification.

Job Summary

The MEP Engineer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, supervising, and monitoring mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works across construction projects. The role ensures that all MEP installations comply with approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project timelines.

Key Responsibilities

1. MEP Planning and Coordination

Review MEP drawings, layouts, specifications, and technical documents.
Coordinate MEP works with civil, structural, architectural, and interior teams.
Identify and resolve drawing discrepancies and site coordination issues.
Ensure proper integration of MEP services with overall project requirements.

2. Site Execution and Supervision

Supervise the installation and execution of MEP systems at project sites.
Monitor electrical wiring, lighting, power distribution, plumbing, drainage, HVAC, and fire-fighting works, as applicable.
Ensure work is executed according to approved drawings and specifications.
Monitor daily progress and ensure adherence to project schedules.
Coordinate with subcontractors, consultants, vendors, and site teams.

3. Quality Control and Safety

Inspect MEP installations to ensure compliance with quality standards.
Conduct inspections and coordinate testing and commissioning activities.
Ensure proper workmanship and compliance with applicable codes and safety requirements.
Identify defects, coordinate corrective actions, and minimize rework.

4. Material and Cost Management

Prepare material requirements, quantity estimates, and BOQs.
Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure timely availability of materials.
Monitor material consumption and minimize wastage.
Verify contractor bills, measurements, and work completion details, as assigned.
Support budget monitoring and cost-control activities.

5. Testing and Commissioning

Coordinate testing and commissioning of MEP systems.
Ensure proper functioning of installed equipment and services.
Maintain inspection reports, test records, and commissioning documentation.
Support snag rectification and final project handover.

6. Reporting and Documentation

Prepare daily and weekly progress reports.
Maintain site inspection records, checklists, and technical documentation.
Report delays, technical issues, and material requirements to the Project Manager.
Ensure updated drawings and as-built documentation are maintained.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of MEP systems and construction practices.
Ability to read and interpret MEP drawings and technical specifications.
Knowledge of AutoCAD and MS Office.
Understanding of BOQ preparation, quantity estimation, and material planning.
Strong site coordination and contractor management skills.
Good communication, problem-solving, and reporting abilities.
Ability to manage multiple activities and meet project deadlines.

1. Incident Management Oversight (20%)

Monitor and coordinate the lifecycle of major and high-priority incidents to ensure timely resolution.
Facilitate incident triage, escalation, and communication across IT teams and stakeholders.
Ensure adherence to SLAs and drive restoration of service in line with business priorities.
Review incident trends and identify recurring issues requiring further analysis.

2. Problem Management Coordination (15%)

Lead or support root cause analysis activities for recurring or critical incidents.
Ensure known errors are documented and workarounds are communicated effectively.
Track problem records through to resolution and validate permanent fixes.
Identify systemic issues and recommend preventative measures.

3. Change Management Governance (20%)

Coordinate and facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
Review and assess change requests for completeness, risk, and business impact.
Ensure proper approval workflows and compliance to change policies.
Monitor change execution and manage post-implementation review activities.

4. Release Management Coordination (15%)

Oversee scheduling and coordination of releases across environments.
Ensure alignment between change and release processes.
Validate readiness of releases including testing, back-out plans, and communications.
Monitor release deployments and track success metrics.

5. ITSM Process Integration and Governance (10%)

Ensure alignment and integration across Incident, Problem, Change, and Release processes.
Maintain process documentation, standards, and procedures.
Monitor compliance to Service Management best practices and internal policies.
Identify gaps and inconsistencies across processes.

6. Reporting and Performance Management (10%)

Develop and analyze KPIs and metrics across all ITSM processes.
Produce regular reports on service performance, trends, and improvement opportunities.
Provide insights and recommendations to management and stakeholders.
Support data-driven decision making.

7. Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) (10%)

Identify opportunities for process optimization and efficiency improvements.
Lead or contribute to CSI initiatives across ITSM disciplines.
Implement best practices and drive maturity improvements.
Collaborate with teams to enhance service quality and reduce risk.

8. Stakeholder Communication and Coordination

Act as a point of contact between IT and business stakeholders for ITSM-related matters.
Communicate changes, incidents, and releases effectively to impacted users.
Facilitate alignment across technical teams, service desk, and leadership.

Database Automation & Logic: Design and implement automated database workflows, event-driven processes, and server-side automation using PL/pgSQL functions, procedures, and triggers.

Collaboration: Partner with backend engineers, system leads, and product stakeholders to transform business rules into scalable database contracts and production-ready solutions.

Experience: Minimum 1.5+ years of hands-on professional experience as a Database Engineer or Database Developer focusing primarily on PostgreSQL.

Advanced Function & Automation Skills: Proven ability to build business logic and automated routines directly inside the database using PL/pgSQL functions, procedures, and triggers.
Schema Design Mastery: Deep understanding of relational database design, data modeling, ER diagrams, normalization, and constraint configurations (Foreign Keys, Unique Checks, Indexes).
Advanced SQL Proficiency: Strong hands-on ability with complex SQL, including window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), dynamic SQL, and subqueries.
Self-Driven & Adaptive: Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to take full ownership of tasks with minimal supervision.

Job description


Project Role : Custom Software Engineer


Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.


Must have skills : SAP BTP Datasphere


Good to have skills : NA
Minimum
3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary
AI Powered Tech Talent
Build AI native, data centric products on SAP BTP Datasphere by combining strong enterprise data warehousing and semantic modeling expertise with agentic AI architectures (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). The focus is to move beyond dashboards into intelligent data experiencesdata agents, conversational analytics, and grounded insightsbuilt on governed Datasphere models and integrated enterprise sources.
SAP Datasphere is positioned as a data warehousing solution with integration capabilities.
Core Responsibilities
1) AI Native Data Product Engineering (on Datasphere)
Design and implement governed data products using Datasphere concepts such as Spaces and shareable models/views, enabling teams to explore, transform, and share curated datasets across domains.
Build semantic models that are fit for both analytics and AI consumption (clear entity definitions, measures, hierarchies, lineage-friendly design).
2) Retrieval + Grounding (RAG) over Enterprise Data
Create grounded AI experiences by connecting LLM applications to Datasphere s curated models and enterprise sources (SAP and non SAP), ensuring responses are traceable to governed data.
Engineer retrieval strategies that respect domain boundaries (spaces), freshness needs, and access controls, so AI outputs remain reliable and compliant.
3) Hybrid Modernization & Migration (BW bridge patterns)
Enable transition paths from legacy warehouse investments by leveraging approaches such as reusing SAP BW models and skills with Datasphere / BW bridge, supporting phased cloud modernization.
4) Lakehouse style Layering & Data Quality by Design
Implement layered design patterns (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold) to land raw data, cleanse/validate, and publish analytics ready modelswhile maintaining clear rules for what s exposed for consumption.
Embed quality controls, validation checks, and reproducible transformations as part of the delivery lifecycle.
5) Agentic Orchestration & Tooling
Build data agents that can plan, call tools (query/metadata/lineage), retrieve context, and generate answers with citationsbacked by deterministic checks and fallback behaviors.
Implement prompt templates, tool schemas, and safe action boundaries for enterprise-grade usage.
6) Evaluation, Observability & Responsible AI
Establish offline/online evaluation loops (golden questions, regression suites, behavior tests) for conversational analytics and data agents.
Add telemetry for AI interactions (latency, grounding rate, failure modes) to improve reliability and cost efficiency.
7) Integration & Collaboration
Partner closely with business, data governance, and platform teams to align data products with real decisions and operational workflows.
Drive reusable patterns and accelerators for repeatable delivery across domains.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP BTP Datasphere: data modeling, spaces, sharing patterns, enterprise semantic design.
Strong data warehousing fundamentals and ability to translate business domains into governed analytical models.
Hands-on building with LLMs + RAG (retrieval, grounding, prompt/tool design, evaluation).
Solid software engineering fundamentals: testability, CI/CD mindset, reliable integrations.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Migration/modernization experience leveraging BW bridge style transition patterns.
Layered architecture implementation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) for scalable analytics delivery.
Familiarity with vector search / embedding pipelines (when integrating external AI retrieval components).

What This Role Does Not Center On
Training foundation models from scratch (the emphasis is on building agentic apps and governed retrieval on enterprise data).
AI assisted only delivery this role owns the AI behavior (grounding, evaluation, safety) end to end.

Value Delivered
Faster path from data to decision through conversational + agentic analytics grounded in governed Datasphere models.
Scalable modernization of hybrid data estates via patterns like BW bridge.
Higher trust AI outputs by implementing layered quality + evaluation loops.

Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required

Job description
At NI IP Routing SW, we believe in fostering a flat and non-hierarchical work environment. We are obsessed about delivering high-quality products and ensure the utmost level of excellence in everything we do. We are a passionate bunch and strive to be technological leaders in our industry. You will be integral to a close-knit team to engineer best-in-class products for the most critical networks data centers for web/hyper-scalers, telcos and enterprises (including AI fabrics), and communication service provider networks.
We are looking for SW engineers who wish to be a part of developing and evolving the current and next generation of routers that form the core of anything internet. These routers are at the heart of Nokias IP product offerings, from data centers (including AI fabrics) to providing strong, resilient low latency and dependable IP backhaul for service providers and mission critical networks. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with one of the best engineering teams in the industry. We value your expertise and offer an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. There are more customers we want to win, more networks to penetrate, more technologies to enable and more applications to support. We want to make smaller products, and we want to make bigger products. We want to build products based on newer standards and newer ASICS in the market.
You will play a critical role in designing and implementing high-performance data path solutions on both custom and merchant silicon. You will be responsible for writing efficient and modular code that is well-tested and robust, ensuring that it meets the high standards required for the most critical networks. Your role will involve working on advanced packet forwarding techniques in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VxLANs. You will also contribute into Traffic Management technologies - QoS (Policers, Schedulers, Shapers), ACLs, TCAM Management, and Packet Extractions to CPU. DCN2026.
HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
Design and implementation: You will gain deep expertise in designing and implementing datapath solutions on both custom and merchant silicon.
Advanced packet forwarding: Develop your skills in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VXLANs, and QoS technologies such as Policers, Schedulers, and ACLs.
DPDK and performance optimization: You''ll be working with DPDK and similar technologies to maximize performance for high-throughput systems.
Virtualized environments: Expand your knowledge in working with virtualized Linux environments such as KVM and Dockers.
Team collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management and software testers, to deliver customer-driven solutions.
Robust and modular code: Focus on writing modular, maintainable code that is well unit-tested, improving your coding skills and best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor''s degree with 3-10 years of Experience.
Proven experience in packet forwarding technologies (IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VXLANs).
Experience with QoS technologies (Policers, Schedulers, ACLs) and TCAM management.
Hands-on experience with DPDK for high-performance packet processing.
Proficiency in C/C++ programming, with a focus on networking solutions.
Contributions to SONiC or other open-source networking projects (desirable).
Methodical problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Experience working in virtualized Linux environments (e.g., KVM, Docker, etc.).
Passion for networking technologies and high-performance systems.

Job description

Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)
Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler
Implement and improve optimizations in Falcons middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime
Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64
Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions
Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense
What Youll Bring (Experience, Skills)
2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering
Strong C++ design and coding skills
Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations
Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another
Very Nice to Have
Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8
Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler
Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals
MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

We are looking for a skilled Systems Engineer to develop, maintain, and optimize a cross-platform endpoint agent for Windows, macOS, and Linux. The role focuses on building reliable, secure, and lightweight system-level software, including capabilities for desktop application blocking and endpoint control.

The ideal candidate will have strong systems programming fundamentals, proficiency in Rust or equivalent experience in C++/Go, and practical knowledge of operating system mechanisms for monitoring and controlling application execution. The candidate should be comfortable working with asynchronous programming, OS-level APIs, process management, and performance optimization.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain a lightweight endpoint agent for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Implement desktop application blocking and endpoint control capabilities using appropriate operating system APIs and security mechanisms.
Develop efficient asynchronous components using Rust and Tokio.
Work with OS-level application monitoring and enforcement mechanisms, including macOS Endpoint Security Framework (ESF), Linux fanotify, or Windows minifilters.
Build and maintain cross-platform components while accounting for operating system-specific behavior and security requirements.
Monitor process execution and implement reliable application identification and enforcement workflows.
Optimize CPU usage, memory consumption, startup time, and overall agent performance.
Write clean, safe, maintainable code with a strong focus on memory safety, reliability, and minimal resource usage.
Debug complex system-level issues involving processes, permissions, operating system APIs, and application lifecycle events.
Develop unit tests and integration tests to validate endpoint agent functionality across supported platforms.
Collaborate with backend, product, and QA teams to integrate endpoint functionality with broader application workflows.
Maintain technical documentation and contribute to code reviews and engineering best practices.



Must-Have Technical Skills

Systems Programming: 2+ years of professional experience in systems programming, preferably using Rust. Strong C++ or Go experience is also acceptable.
Rust Programming: Understanding of ownership, borrowing, memory safety, error handling, and efficient resource management, or the ability to demonstrate equivalent systems programming expertise in C++/Go.
Asynchronous Programming: Practical experience with async programming; Tokio experience is preferred for Rust-based development.
Operating System Internals: Hands-on experience with at least one of the following:
macOS Endpoint Security Framework (ESF)
Linux fanotify
Windows filesystem minifilters
Cross-Platform Development: Experience developing, debugging, or maintaining software across multiple operating systems.
Performance Optimization: Ability to build lightweight applications with low memory and CPU consumption.
Code Quality: Strong focus on clean, safe, reliable, and maintainable code.



Desired Candidate Profile

2+ years of experience in systems programming or low-level software development.
Strong understanding of operating system processes, application execution, permissions, and system APIs.
Experience developing endpoint agents, security agents, process monitors, application control tools, or similar system-level software.
Familiarity with operating system security models and mechanisms for monitoring or restricting application execution.
Experience debugging platform-specific issues and handling differences between Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Knowledge of concurrency, synchronization, resource management, and error handling.
Ability to write efficient code with a small memory footprint and minimal system overhead.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Job description

About BotSpace

BotSpace builds AI agents for e-commerce brands. They help brands sell more and handle customer support across their website, WhatsApp, Instagram and other channels. We work with fast-growing D2C and Shopify brands and are building an AI-native platform for sales, support and customer engagement.

The role

This is a customer role for an engineer. You'll own a group of BotSpace customers from the day they sign: get them live, learn how their business runs, find what stops them getting value from BotSpace and solve it. Sometimes that's configuration. Sometimes it's a script or an integration with the rest of their stack. Sometimes it's a bug you've narrowed down so well that our engineers can fix it the same day.

Elsewhere this job is called a forward-deployed engineer, implementation engineer or technical account manager. It isn't a pure development role: most of your week is spent with customers, and the code you write is in service of them.

What you'll do

Onboard new brands: WhatsApp Business API setup, Meta verification and message templates, Shopify and other integrations, their first automations and their AI agent
Own the relationship with your accounts on calls, WhatsApp and email, and review with them regularly what's working and what isn't
Debug customer issues end to end: read the logs, check API responses and webhooks, reproduce the problem, then fix it or give engineering a bug report they can act on
Build what a customer needs on top of the product: API and webhook integrations, small scripts, data imports, custom flows
Notice early when an account is at risk, and when one is ready to do more with us
Bring patterns back to the product team: repeat issues, missing features, rough edges in onboarding
Write the docs and playbooks that help the next customer go live faster

What we're looking for

A software engineer by training: B.E. or B.Tech in computer science or IT, MCA, or real hands-on coding experience
2 or more years in a customer-facing technical role at a software company: technical support, application support, implementation, solutions or customer success engineering
You can read code and write some: JavaScript or Python scripts, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, SQL or MongoDB queries
You debug methodically and can explain what broke to a non-technical founder in plain words
Clear spoken and written English, comfortable on calls with founders and operations teams
You follow through. When a customer is waiting on something, they hear from you before they have to ask

A major plus

Hands-on time with the WhatsApp Business API, Meta Business Manager or a messaging platform such as Gupshup, Twilio, Wati or Interakt
Shopify: the admin, apps, webhooks and how D2C brands run their stores
Helpdesk and CRM tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Gorgias or HubSpot
You've set up or tuned an LLM-based product: prompts, knowledge bases, AI agents
A stint as a developer before you moved into support or implementation

How success is measured

New customers go live quickly and actually use what they bought
The accounts you own renew and grow
Problems get fixed at the root, so the same issue doesn't come back
Engineering can act on your bug reports without a follow-up call

Why join BotSpace

You'll sit between our customers and our engineering team and work closely with the founders. You'll see how hundreds of brands use the product day to day, and what you learn goes straight into what we build next.

If you're an engineer who likes solving real problems for real customers more than closing tickets, we'd love to hear from you.

How to apply

Apply on our careers site: https://careers.bot.space/customer-success-engineer/apply?src=naukri

It takes about five minutes: a short form with your LinkedIn profile and a few questions. We read every application and reply within a week.

Job description

Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)
Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler
Implement and improve optimizations in Falcons middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime
Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64
Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions
Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense
What Youll Bring (Experience, Skills)
2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering
Strong C++ design and coding skills
Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations
Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another
Very Nice to Have
Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8
Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler
Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals
MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on expertise in Python and SQL, deep knowledge of modern data engineering practices, and the ability to independently architect and deliver data solutions on cloud platforms, with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred.




Key Responsibilities:




Data Pipeline Development

Design, build, and maintain scalable batch and real-time data pipelines using ETL/ELT patterns.
Ingest and integrate structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from diverse sources, including APIs, databases, files, and event streams.
Implement incremental loading, change data capture (CDC), and idempotent pipeline design.
Implement CDC pipelines using Datastream to replicate data from operational databases into BigQuery.
Build batch and streaming pipelines with Apache Beam on Dataflow, using Pub/Sub for event ingestion.

Data Modeling and Architecture

Design and optimize data models (dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, Data Vault where relevant) for analytics and reporting.
Build and manage data warehouses and lakehouses following the Medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers), ideally on BigQuery and Cloud Storage.
Design BigQuery datasets using partitioning, clustering, materialized views, and authorized views for performance and secure sharing.
Work with modern table formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg (including BigLake), or Apache Hudi.
Contribute to data platform architecture, technology selection, and design decisions.

Orchestration and Transformation

Orchestrate workflows using tools such as Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow), Dagster, Prefect, or other cloud-native schedulers.
Use Cloud Workflows, Cloud Scheduler, and Cloud Functions or Cloud Run for lightweight, event-driven orchestration.
Develop modular, tested, and version-controlled transformations using dbt, Dataform, or similar frameworks.

Data Quality, Governance, and Reliability

Implement data validation, testing, and quality checks using tools such as Great Expectations, dbt tests, Soda, or Dataplex data quality.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize pipelines for performance, cost, and reliability. Ensure data consistency, lineage, availability, and adherence to security, privacy, and governance standards.
Implement GCP security and governance controls, including IAM, row-level and column-level security in BigQuery, policy tags, and VPC Service Controls.
Implement data observability, alerting, and SLA tracking for critical pipelines using Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring.

Cloud and DataOps

Build and manage data solutions on cloud platforms, preferably GCP, using services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Run. Equivalent experience on AWS (Glue, Redshift, S3) or Azure (Data Factory, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric) is also considered.
Apply DataOps practices including version control, CI/CD, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code.
Manage GCP data infrastructure with Terraform, Cloud Build, and Artifact Registry.
Manage secrets and credentials securely using Secret Manager.
Optimize storage and compute usage to control cloud costs, including BigQuery slot, partitioning, and clustering strategies.

Collaboration and Ownership

Partner with analytics, BI, AI/ML, and software engineering teams to deliver data that meets business needs.
Support AI/ML initiatives by building feature pipelines and preparing data for model training, RAG, and vector-based applications (e.g., Vertex AI, BigQuery ML). Translate business and technical requirements into well-designed data solutions independently.
Contribute to testing, deployment, code reviews, and technical documentation. Identify and drive opportunities for automation and process improvement.

Required Skills:

3+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering.
Strong proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, CTEs, query optimization, and performance tuning.
Proven experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines in production. Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing concepts, and database design.
Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, Firestore, Bigtable).
Experience processing large and complex datasets efficiently.
Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform and its data services; GCP experience is preferred.
Strong hands-on BigQuery experience, including query optimization, cost management, and schema design (preferred).
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Good communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Good to Have:

Production experience on GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer), especially for candidates at the upper end of the experience range.
Experience with Apache Beam SDK (Python or Java) for Dataflow pipelines.
Experience with Apache Spark / PySpark for distributed data processing, including on Dataproc.
Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Microsoft Fabric.
Hands-on experience with dbt or Dataform for data transformation.
Experience with Airflow, Dagster, or similar orchestration tools.
Experience with streaming technologies such as Google Pub/Sub, Apache Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Apache Flink, AWS Kinesis, or Azure Event Hubs.
Familiarity with GCP databases such as Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Spanner, or Bigtable.
Experience with Cloud Data Fusion or Analytics Hub.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes (GKE preferred), and CI/CD pipelines (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
Familiarity with data catalog and governance tools (Dataplex, Unity Catalog, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Microsoft Purview, DataHub).
Exposure to AI/ML data pipelines, feature stores, or vector databases, including Vertex AI Pipelines, Vertex AI Feature Store, or Vertex AI Vector Search.
Experience with BI tools such as Looker (including LookML), Power BI, or Tableau.
Relevant certifications, with Google Professional Data Engineer preferred (AWS Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer, Databricks, or Snowflake also valued).



Educational Qualifications:

Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).



What We're Looking For:

In-depth technical knowledge, strong hands-on experience, and the ability to independently design and deliver data engineering solutions end to end.
Candidates who can clearly explain the data solutions they have built, including the architecture, technologies used, design trade-offs, challenges faced, and how they addressed performance, reliability, data quality, and scalability.
For experienced candidates, a proven track record of delivering production data platforms on GCP will be given preference.
A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and a commitment to building trustworthy data systems.

Job description

About us:

Trinity Mobile App Labs motto is to Help businesses go mobile.

Trinity Mobile Lab is a Software Company engaged in developing end-to-end web and mobile based solutions serving Android and iOS platforms since 2013. As an expert mobile solution developer, the company architects web and mobile solutions and applications that help businesses grow primarily start-ups looking to build a tech-enabled business, medium and large brands looking for innovative mobile solutions to meet their business requirements. The company offers a full spectrum of IT application services such as doing need-gap analysis, concept development, digital marketing, design, development, and offering customised application-based IT support services.

Founded by Ayush Agarwal in 2013, he cites that the focus of Trinity is to understand the challenges being faced by the customers in todays hyper-competitive scenario, their dynamic requirements and then offering them innovative mobile solutions based on the cutting-edge technology and process automation which can help them to succeed and delight their customers.




About the Product:

Soul Home is a spatial analysis platform that captures a users home in 3D via LiDAR (iPhone Pro), ARCore depth (certified Android), or guided photo capture (fallback tier) — and runs the resulting spatial model through a deterministic rule engine built on classical Vastu Shastra and Feng Shui doctrine. The 3D capture layer you will own is the foundation of the entire product: every downstream analysis depends on an accurate, correctly oriented model of the user’s space.





Core Responsibilities

Test the LiDAR (iOS), ARCore depth (Android), and photo/panorama fallback capture flows across a range of real devices and room conditions (low light, textureless walls, small/large rooms, reflective surfaces)
Validate the end-to-end upload lifecycle: capture queue processing status success/failure/retry, as seen by the mobile client
Perform functional, regression, exploratory, and usability testing on new app builds
Identify device-specific and OS-version-specific bugs (iOS LiDAR-capable vs non-LiDAR devices; Android ARCore-supported vs unsupported devices)
Verify object-detection overlays and placement (YOLO-based, 76-object catalog) render correctly in the app
Test API integration between the mobile app and the backend reconstruction service (job status, retries, error states)
Document and track bugs with clear repro steps, logs, screen recordings, and device/OS metadata
Validate UI/UX against design specs, including onboarding and capture-guidance flows for the fallback tier
Participate in sprint planning and release readiness reviews; sign off on builds before release
Maintain a device/OS test matrix and a growing regression suite as new capture tiers and features ship



Must-Have Skills

2+ years of experience in mobile QA/testing (iOS and/or Android), ideally including AR, camera, or sensor-heavy apps
Strong understanding of functional, regression, exploratory, and edge-case testing for hardware-dependent features (LiDAR, ARCore, camera)
Experience testing async/background flows (uploads, job status polling, retries) and validating correct behavior on failure/timeout
Familiarity with bug tracking tools (Jira, Linear, or similar) and writing clear, reproducible bug reports
Comfortable reading mobile logs (Xcode console / Android Studio logcat) to help diagnose scan or upload failures
Basic API testing skills (Postman or similar) to validate the mobile-backend contract
Access to or experience testing on a range of physical devices (not just simulators/emulators LiDAR and ARCore behavior doesn't reliably emulate)
Strong attention to detail; comfortable being the person who says "this scan looks geometrically wrong" even without a formal spec for what "right" looks like



Good-to-Have Skills

Experience testing AR/VR or 3D-capture apps specifically (Polycam, Matterport, RoomPlan-based apps, etc.)
Familiarity with panorama/360 capture and equirectangular image quirks
Basic scripting (Python/JavaScript) for light test automation
Experience with device farms (BrowserStack, Firebase Test Lab) for OS/device coverage
Understanding of how floor plans, meshes, or spatial models are typically validated for correctness
Prior QA experience on real-estate, interior design, or spatial-mapping products



To Apply

Apply here and additionally send your resume along with a short note on a mobile app you've tested that involved camera, sensor, or AR functionality, and what made testing it hard.

Job description

About the Company

Repaix Automation & Services is an industrial automation and electrical engineering company based in Raipur, serving industries across Chhattisgarh and Central India.

We are engaged in VFDs & Drives, PLC/HMI, Industrial Automation, Electrical Panels, Switchgear, Power Quality Solutions, and Industrial Automation Services. We work with industrial customers for product sales, technical support, retrofit projects, maintenance and automation solutions.

We are looking for an experienced Sales Engineer who can independently develop industrial customers, understand technical requirements and generate business for automation and electrical products.

Key Responsibilities

Develop new industrial customers and maintain relationships with existing customers.
Generate enquiries and business opportunities for VFDs, PLC/HMI, Electrical Panels, Switchgear and Industrial Automation products.
Visit industries, understand application requirements and provide suitable technical solutions.
Promote products such as AC Drives/VFDs, PLC, HMI, MCC/PCC/VFD Panels, MCCB, ACB, MCB, Contactors, OLR, ATS and other industrial electrical products.
Identify opportunities for VFD replacement, retrofit, automation upgradation, panel modification and energy-saving solutions.
Prepare technical/commercial offers in coordination with the engineering and sales team.
Follow up with customers for quotations, negotiations, purchase orders and payments.
Coordinate with the service/engineering team for site visits, troubleshooting, commissioning and after-sales support.
Develop business through OEMs, manufacturing industries, EPC contractors, panel builders and system integrators.
Maintain regular customer visits and prepare sales reports, enquiry status and follow-up reports.
Achieve monthly and yearly sales targets.
Travel within Raipur, Chhattisgarh and nearby industrial areas as required.

Preferred Technical Knowledge

Candidates should have good practical understanding of:

AC Drives / VFD selection, applications and basic troubleshooting
PLC & HMI
Industrial Automation
MCC / PCC / VFD / APFC Panels
MCCB / ACB / MCB / Contactor / OLR / ATS / Changeover
Motors and basic industrial electrical systems
Basic understanding of control panels and electrical drawings
Industrial communication and automation applications will be an added advantage

Candidate Profile

Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or related field.
2–6 years of experience in industrial technical sales.
Experience in VFD / PLC / automation / electrical panels / switchgear sales preferred.
Should be comfortable with industrial customer visits and technical discussions.
Strong communication, negotiation and follow-up skills.
Should have a result-oriented approach and ability to generate business independently.
Willingness to travel within Chhattisgarh and nearby industrial locations.
Candidates with experience in VFD/Drive, automation product distribution, panel sales or electrical industrial product sales will be preferred.

What We Offer

Fixed salary + performance-based incentives.
Petrol/travel allowance as per company policy.
Opportunity to work with multiple industrial automation and electrical product lines.
Exposure to industrial automation projects, VFD applications, electrical panels and service activities.
Growth opportunity based on performance and business development capability.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is not only a quotation/follow-up salesperson, but can understand the customer's application, identify the requirement, suggest the right technical solution and convert the opportunity into business.

Job description

JOB DESCRIPTION:




TAC Security is looking for a highly skilled Security Engineer OSCP Certified with strong hands-on expertise in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, application security, network security, and offensive security.

The Security Engineer will be responsible for identifying, validating, and demonstrating security vulnerabilities across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, networks, cloud environments, and infrastructure. The role requires a strong offensive-security mindset, practical exploitation skills, and the ability to provide actionable remediation guidance to clients and internal teams.




Key Responsibilities




1. Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing

Perform end-to-end Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) across applications and infrastructure.
Conduct manual penetration testing rather than relying solely on automated scanning tools.
Identify, validate, exploit, and document security vulnerabilities.
Perform network and infrastructure penetration testing across internal and external environments.
Conduct security testing of web applications, APIs, mobile applications, and cloud-based environments.
Perform vulnerability verification and retesting after remediation.
Evaluate vulnerabilities based on technical severity, exploitability, and potential business impact.

2. Web Application & API Security

Perform advanced web application penetration testing aligned with OWASP Top 10 and relevant testing methodologies.
Test for vulnerabilities including SQL Injection, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, authentication and authorization weaknesses, insecure deserialization, file-upload vulnerabilities, business-logic flaws, and security misconfigurations.
Conduct API security assessments covering REST and other API architectures.
Identify complex authorization, authentication, session-management, and business-logic vulnerabilities.

3. Network & Infrastructure Security

Conduct external and internal network penetration testing.
Perform network enumeration, service discovery, vulnerability analysis, exploitation, and privilege escalation.
Assess Windows and Linux environments for security weaknesses.
Conduct Active Directory security assessments and identify privilege-escalation and lateral-movement opportunities.
Evaluate firewall configurations, exposed services, network segmentation, and infrastructure security controls.

4. Offensive Security & Exploitation

Apply OSCP-level penetration-testing techniques in real-world environments.
Perform manual exploitation, privilege escalation, pivoting, lateral movement, and post-exploitation activities within approved scopes.
Develop or modify scripts and proof-of-concept exploits when required.
Use offensive-security techniques responsibly and strictly within authorized testing environments.
Maintain detailed evidence and attack paths throughout engagements.

5. Security Tools & Technologies

Hands-on experience with tools such as:

Burp Suite Professional
Nmap
Metasploit
Nessus
Kali Linux
Wireshark
BloodHound
Impacket
SQLMap
Nikto
Gobuster/Ffuf
Hydra
John the Ripper/Hashcat

Candidates should understand the underlying techniques and be capable of performing manual validation rather than depending exclusively on tools.

6. Reporting & Remediation

Prepare detailed and professional penetration-testing reports containing vulnerability descriptions, severity, evidence, proof of concept, business impact, and remediation recommendations.
Assign severity using appropriate methodologies such as CVSS.
Conduct technical walkthroughs with customers, developers, security teams, and management.
Work closely with engineering teams to explain vulnerabilities and recommend practical remediation.
Perform remediation validation and closure testing.

7. Research & Continuous Improvement

Stay updated on emerging vulnerabilities, CVEs, exploitation techniques, attack methodologies, and cybersecurity threats.
Research new offensive-security techniques and tools.
Contribute to internal security methodologies, testing checklists, knowledge bases, automation, and security research.
Participate in internal knowledge-sharing and technical training sessions.



Required Qualifications



Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) certification is mandatory.
3–7+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, VAPT, offensive security, or application security.
Strong practical knowledge of:
Web Application Penetration Testing
API Security Testing
Network Penetration Testing
Active Directory Security
Linux & Windows Privilege Escalation
Vulnerability Assessment
Exploitation & Post-Exploitation
OWASP Top 10
CVSS
Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, firewalls, VPNs, proxies, authentication protocols, and network architectures.
Ability to write basic automation/exploitation scripts using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.



Preferred Qualifications




Additional certifications such as OSWE, OSEP, CRTP/CRTE, PNPT, GPEN, GWAPT, CEH, or eJPT would be advantageous.

Experience in one or more of the following would also be valuable: cloud penetration testing across AWS/Azure/GCP, mobile application security, source-code review, DevSecOps/AppSec, red teaming, threat modeling, or secure-code review.
