Career Area: Technology, Digital and Data
Caterpillar s Cat Technology team is seeking a Perception Developer to design, develop, and deploy perception software for autonomous and semi-autonomous machines used in construction. The role focuses on multi-sensor perception, computer vision, 3D point-cloud processing, sensor fusion, and production-quality software for safety-critical, resource-constrained platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong C++/Python development skills with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and validating perception algorithms from prototype through field deployment.


Responsibilities

Design and implement perception algorithms for object and personnel detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, terrain understanding, localization, mapping, and obstacle assessment.
Develop camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU processing pipelines, including calibration, synchronization, sensor fusion, and uncertainty handling.
Translate research concepts and state-of-the-art models into robust, maintainable, production-quality C++ and Python software.
Optimize algorithms and neural-network inference for embedded CPU/GPU platforms using profiling, CUDA, TensorRT, and related acceleration technologies.
Build automated evaluation workflows, datasets, simulation scenarios, and test tools to measure accuracy, latency, robustness, and safety performance.
Debug and resolve perception issues using recorded data, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and field-machine testing.
Collaborate with systems, autonomy, controls, embedded software, validation, and safety teams to define interfaces and deliver integrated machine capabilities.
Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, and continuous improvement of software engineering practices.


Required Qualifications

Bachelor s or master s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python, with experience developing and debugging software on Linux.
Practical experience with computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, point-cloud processing, or robotic perception.
Experience with one or more perception tasks such as detection, segmentation, classification, tracking, localization, mapping, or sensor fusion.
Working knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow and common perception libraries such as OpenCV, PCL, Eigen, or similar tools.
Understanding of camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU sensor characteristics, calibration, coordinate systems, and data quality considerations.
Experience with ROS/ROS 2, DDS, Git, unit testing, continuous integration, and software documentation practices.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work across research and product-development teams.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience deploying perception models on embedded or edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, DRIVE, or comparable hardware.
Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, model quantization, profiling, and real-time performance optimization.
Knowledge of SLAM, visual or LiDAR odometry, Kalman filtering, probabilistic estimation, and graph-based spatial data structures.
Experience developing perception systems for autonomous vehicles, ADAS, mobile robots, mining, construction, or off-highway equipment.
Experience with simulation, synthetic data, dataset curation, annotation workflows, MLOps, or field validation.
Publications, patents, or demonstrated implementation of state-of-the-art perception methods are an advantage.

Experience: 23 Years
Department: Engineering / Cloud & Infrastructure

Work Location: Mahadevapura, Bengaluru Onsite

About the Role
Ramxora Private Limited is looking for a DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with 23 years of hands-on experience in AWS Cloud Infrastructure, deployment automation, CI/CD, cloud security, monitoring, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
The primary focus of this role is to design, provision, configure, deploy, monitor, secure, troubleshoot, and maintain AWS infrastructure and production environments end-to-end.
The candidate will work closely with Development, QA, Security, and Product teams to ensure applications are deployed reliably, securely, and efficiently across development, staging, and production environments.
The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of AWS services, Linux, networking, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, security, and production support.

Key Responsibilities
1. AWS Cloud Infrastructure Primary Responsibility


Design, deploy, configure, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure for development, staging, and production environments.
Provision and manage AWS services based on application and infrastructure requirements.
Work extensively with:
EC2
VPC
IAM
S3
RDS
ECS / EKS
Elastic Load Balancer (ALB/NLB)
Auto Scaling Groups
Route 53
CloudFront
CloudWatch
ECR
Lambda
SNS / SQS
Secrets Manager / Parameter Store
AWS Certificate Manager


Configure production-ready infrastructure with appropriate availability, scalability, security, and performance.
Manage AWS accounts, regions, availability zones, resources, and environments.
Implement appropriate resource tagging, access controls, and operational standards.
Monitor AWS resource utilization and identify infrastructure bottlenecks.


2. End-to-End Application Deployment
The engineer will be responsible for managing the complete deployment lifecycle from source code to production.
Deployment Responsibilities


Understand application architecture and deployment requirements.
Configure infrastructure required to host applications.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
Connect source-code repositories with automated build and deployment systems.
Configure application build processes.
Build Docker images where applicable.
Push container images to Amazon ECR.
Deploy applications to:
EC2
ECS
EKS
Other AWS compute environments as required.


Configure load balancers, target groups, listeners, security groups, DNS, SSL certificates, and routing.
Manage environment-specific configurations.
Implement secrets and environment-variable management securely.
Perform application deployments across:
Development
QA
Staging
Production


Implement deployment validation and health checks.
Troubleshoot failed deployments and application startup issues.
Maintain rollback procedures.
Support zero-downtime or low-downtime deployment strategies wherever applicable.
Maintain deployment documentation and runbooks.

Candidate should be able to explain an end-to-end deployment such as:
Developer commits code Git repository CI pipeline Build Test Docker Image ECR Deployment AWS Infrastructure Load Balancer DNS Application Monitoring Alerts Production Support

Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines.
Automate application build, testing, packaging, and deployment processes.
Work with tools such as:
Jenkins
GitHub Actions
GitLab CI/CD
AWS CodePipeline / CodeBuild

Implement automated deployment workflows.
Configure build agents/runners.

Troubleshoot pipeline failures, build failures, deployment failures, and environment issues.

Variables
Modules
Resources
Outputs

Understand public vs. private infrastructure architecture.

Manage Docker containers and images.
Configure application containers for different environments.
Push and manage images in Amazon ECR.
Troubleshoot container startup, networking, resource, and configuration issues.

Optimize container image size and build performance.
Implement secure container practices.

Knowledge of Kubernetes / Amazon EKS is an advantage.

Deployments
Services

Health Checks

Notifications

Develop meaningful dashboards for production systems.

Apply SRE principles to production infrastructure.
Monitor system availability, reliability, and performance.
Define and monitor appropriate:
SLIs
SLOs
SLAs


Identify recurring incidents and infrastructure problems.
Perform root cause analysis (RCA).
Implement permanent fixes instead of repeatedly applying temporary workarounds.
Improve system reliability and reduce operational risk.

Create and maintain operational runbooks.
Improve automation to reduce manual operational tasks.
Support capacity planning and infrastructure scaling.
Participate in post-incident reviews.

Provide infrastructure and deployment support for production applications.
Monitor production environments and respond to alerts.
Troubleshoot application and infrastructure failures.
Analyze logs, metrics, network connectivity, and system resources.
Identify root causes of incidents.
Coordinate with developers and QA teams during production issues.
Handle deployment failures and rollback requirements.
Resolve infrastructure-related production issues within defined priorities.
Document incidents, root causes, and permanent resolutions.
Participate in on-call / critical production support when required.

Alert Identify affected service Check infrastructure Check application Check logs Check network Identify root cause Apply fix Validate Monitor Document RCA

Design infrastructure for availability and scalability.
Understand AWS Availability Zones and regional architecture.
Configure Auto Scaling where required.
Work with Load Balancers and health checks.
Implement scalable application infrastructure.
Identify single points of failure.
Support horizontal and vertical scaling.

S3 versioning
Backup policies


Support disaster recovery procedures.

Bitbucket

Automate repetitive infrastructure and operational tasks.
Write scripts using:
Bash
Python


Automate deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting activities.
Develop scripts for log analysis, system checks, AWS operations, and operational workflows.
Use AWS CLI effectively.

Monitor AWS infrastructure costs and resource utilization.
Identify unused or underutilized resources.
Understand AWS pricing fundamentals.
Support cost optimization initiatives.
Review:
EC2 utilization
EBS volumes
NAT Gateway usage

RDS resources

Job description

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Product Security Engineer to secure enterprise applications and AI-powered products across multiple engineering teams and repositories.

In this role, you will identify and validate real-world vulnerabilities through manual security testing, source-code analysis, threat modeling, and AI red teaming. You will work directly with engineering teams to prioritize risks, drive remediation, and verify fixes across fast-moving development environments.

You will also help strengthen the security of AI-powered applications and agents by identifying emerging risks such as prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, insecure tool execution, and authorization bypasses.

This is an opportunity for a security engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, going beyond automated scanners, and building practical security controls that scale across products.

Key Responsibilities

Perform hands-on security assessments across enterprise applications, APIs, AI-powered products, and multiple code repositories.

Discover, exploit, validate, and document vulnerabilities through manual testing, source-code review, and security tools.

Assess web applications and APIs for authentication and authorization weaknesses, business logic flaws, injection vulnerabilities, and other OWASP Top 10 risks.

Test AI/LLM applications and agents for direct and indirect prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, insecure tool execution, excessive permissions, and access-control bypasses.

Conduct threat modeling, architecture reviews, and attack-path analysis to identify security gaps before they reach production.

Assess cloud environments, IAM policies, containers, Kubernetes workloads, and CI/CD pipelines for security weaknesses.

Prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability, business impact, exposure, and potential consequences—not just scanner severity scores.

Partner with engineering teams to explain findings, recommend practical fixes, resolve remediation blockers, and verify fixes through retesting.

Integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle using SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, and automated security gates.

Develop repeatable security testing approaches, automation, and remediation practices that scale across products and engineering teams.

Communicate technical findings, business risks, and remediation priorities clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

2 years of relevant experience in Application Security, Product Security, Application Security Engineering, or Offensive Security.

Strong hands-on experience in web application and API security testing, including manually discovering, exploiting, and validating vulnerabilities.

Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorization flaws, IDOR/BOLA, business logic vulnerabilities, and common web/API attack paths.

Practical experience using Burp Suite Professional or OWASP ZAP for security testing.

Experience with source-code security reviews, root-cause analysis, threat modeling, and remediation validation.

Hands-on exposure to AI/LLM application security testing, including prompt injection, data leakage, or insecure AI agent/tool execution.

Familiarity with cloud security, IAM, containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD security practices.

Experience working with application security tools such as SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets detection.

Ability to assess security risks independently, distinguish exploitable vulnerabilities from low-impact findings, and recommend actionable remediation.

Demonstrated ownership of security findings from discovery and validation through remediation, retesting, and closure.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.

Job description: Software Development Engineer – HMI Android App
Location: Yelahanka, Bangalore 


About the Role

We are looking for an SDE  to join our Vehicle Software team and independently deliver Android-based HMI features for automotive and electric vehicle platforms. You will own features from design through integration and release, strengthen application reliability, and work across vehicle, platform and connected-service interfaces.

What You'll Do

Design, develop and maintain production Android HMI applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

Own complete features across dashboards, charging, vehicle controls, notifications and connected experiences.

Design reusable UI components, ViewModels and repositories with clear boundaries and testable interfaces.

Integrate CAN signals and vehicle commands through platform APIs, including acknowledgements and error handling.

Manage concurrent vehicle, network and user events using Coroutines, Flow and lifecycle-aware state management.

Implement reliable transitions across key-on/off, riding, charging, OTA and shutdown states, including warning priorities.

Integrate APIs and relevant Bluetooth, navigation or OTA modules; handle service interruptions and recovery.

Investigate crashes, ANRs, memory leaks and rendering issues; improve startup time and responsiveness on HMI hardware.

Write automated tests, review code, guide junior engineers and support build and release readiness.

Work with design, platform, firmware, mobile, backend and QA teams to resolve integration and field issues.

Required Skills

1–6 years of professional Android application development experience, with independent feature ownership.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related engineering discipline.

Strong proficiency in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and modern Android development practices.

Strong knowledge of Android SDK, lifecycle, permissions, receivers and interaction with system services.

Hands-on experience with MVVM or MVI, repository patterns and dependency injection using Koin or equivalent tools.

Strong understanding of Coroutines, Flow, StateFlow, SharedFlow, cancellation, thread safety and resource cleanup.

Experience with REST APIs, JSON, local persistence, network failure handling and data synchronization.

Familiarity with CAN communication and vehicle signals, plus practical experience with automotive or connected-device interfaces.

Hands-on debugging with Android Studio, ADB, Logcat and profiling tools; strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Experience writing unit/UI tests, reviewing code and following Git-based development workflows.

Working knowledge of Gradle, build flavors, signing, R8/ProGuard and production quality requirements.

Good to Have

Depth in BLE GATT, bonding and reconnection, including Android/iOS notification and media integration.

Experience with Mappls or other navigation SDKs, GPS/GNSS and map lifecycle management.

Exposure to privileged Android apps, custom system services, Binder/AIDL or AOSP integration.

Experience with OTA preconditions and update-agent coordination, or vehicle variant configuration.

Familiarity with Macrobenchmark, LeakCanary, Crashlytics, CI/CD, secure storage or multimedia optimization.

What We're Looking For

Strong problem-solving and analytical ability.

Good understanding of Android fundamentals beyond UI development.

Ability to take ownership of assigned features and deliver them with appropriate engineering guidance.

Ability to understand requirements and translate them into maintainable technical solutions.

Willingness to participate actively in design discussions and code reviews.

Ability to collaborate effectively with product, design, backend, QA, and other engineering teams.

Curiosity to learn new technologies, platforms, and domain concepts.

Focus on writing clean, maintainable, testable, and scalable code.

Tech Stack

Core:
Core: Kotlin Jetpack Compose Android SDK MVVM Coroutines Flow REST APIs Git

Supporting:
Koin Ktor DataStore CAN APIs BLE Mappls Media3 Firebase JUnit Gradle

Role Summary
A senior-level Systems Administrator with deep expertise in enterprise Windows Server and VMware vSphere environments, including advanced virtualization platforms such as VMware vSAN, NSX-T, and Site Recovery Manager. The preferred candidate must hold atleast 1 Windows Or VMware certifications, demonstrate proficiency in scripting/automation tools, and possess working knowledge of AWS for supporting hybrid cloud workloads. AWS certification is preferred but not mandatory.

Key Responsibilities
L2/L3 Operations
Perform deep RCA for major incidents including memory dumps, VMware ESXTOP analysis, and performance profiling
Participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) submissions and execution of critical infrastructure changes
Define and refine operational runbooks for the team
Manage and execute change requests following ITIL change management processes
Coordinate and lead scheduled maintenance windows for Windows and VMware infrastructure
Proactively identify recurring issues and propose permanent resolutions or optimized workarounds
Escalate complex issues to L3/senior engineers following the defined escalation matrix
Windows Server Administration
Participate in Windows Server lifecycle management - OS upgrades, P2V migrations to VMware, and server decommissioning
Administer Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 across physical and virtual environments
Manage Active Directory including GPO configuration, OU administration, Sites & Services, and replication troubleshooting
Configure and troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, and IPAM services

Troubleshoot VM connectivity, snapshot consolidation, and datastore space issues

PKI/Certificate Services - SSL/TLS certificate management basics

VMware PowerCLI - basic to intermediate VM management scripts
Bash - basic scripting for cross-platform tasks
Git - version control for scripts and configuration files
Monitoring & ITSM

ServiceNow / Jira - ITSM ticket management, change advisory, and problem management AWS Cloud (Preferred - Not Mandatory)
EC2 (Windows AMIs) - instance management and Windows workload hosting

IAM - roles and policies for Windows workloads
CloudWatch - basic monitoring and log management

Strong communication and documentation skills - technical and executive-level
Strategic mindset for identifying automation and efficiency improvements
Coaching and mentoring capability for developing junior engineers

Microsoft Certified:Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800 & AZ-801) - REQUIRED

AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate - Advantageous

About the Role

We are looking for a QA Engineer to help build and maintain a strong quality assurance process across Kazams technology ecosystem. You will be responsible for designing and executing automated and manual testing for our React Native mobile applications, Svelte web applications, and Node.js/Go backend services. This is an opportunity for a hands-on QA professional who enjoys working closely with developers and product teams, identifying issues early, improving test coverage, and contributing to a high-quality product.




Key Responsibilities

Test Planning & Execution



Design and execute test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and test scripts across web, mobile, API, and integration layers.

Automation Testing

functionality, usability, and compatibility.

EV / IoT & OCPP Testing

Validate charger-to-cloud communication, charging sessions, transaction flows, and system responses.
Test different OCPP-related scenarios, including connectivity issues, charger status changes, transaction failures, and edge cases.
Collaborate with engineering teams to identify and troubleshoot issues related to connected hardware and IoT systems.

CI/CD & Quality Processes

Integrate and execute automated test suites as part of CI/CD pipelines.
Work with tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.
Help ensure that software releases meet defined quality standards before deployment.
Contribute to improving QA processes, documentation, and testing practices.

Collaboration

Experience

2-5 years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Assurance.

Strong programming/scripting skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java.

Good to Have

Experience in EV charging, IoT, connected devices, or energy management platforms.

Detail-oriented with a strong focus on product quality.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Willingness to learn new technologies and understand complex product and technical workflows.

You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real-time inference.
Collaborate & Innovate: Work within a multi-disciplinary team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, prototype new approaches, and provide expert guidance on the art of the possible with GCP and modern data engineering.

Storage AI Engineer
This role has been designed as Hybrid with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
In the HPE Hybrid Cloud , we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what s next for you.
Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled Storage AI Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and safety of our AI-powered products. The ideal candidate has a strong testing mindset, experience with software quality processes, and a passion for evaluating AI systems, including large language models (LLMs), recommendation systems, and intelligent automation features.
As a QA Engineer on our AI product team, you will design and execute testing strategies for both traditional software features and AI-specific behaviors such as model accuracy, hallucination detection, prompt reliability, safety, bias, performance, and user trust. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to validate product quality from concept to production.
This role is ideal for engineers with strong software development fundamentals and a passion for Generative AI technologies.
What You ll do
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and execute test plans for AI-driven products and features
Evaluate model behavior across real-world scenarios, edge cases, and adversarial inputs
Test prompt flows, agent behaviors, recommendations, summarization, search, classification, and generative outputs
Identify and document issues related to hallucinations, inaccurate outputs, bias, unsafe content, latency, and poor user experience
Build automated test frameworks for regression testing and continuous quality assurance
Conduct manual exploratory testing for new AI features and workflows
Create evaluation metrics and quality rubrics for AI product performance
Collaborate with ML engineers and product teams to define success criteria for AI features
Monitor production issues, analyze root causes, and drive quality improvements
Maintain test documentation, defect tracking, and reporting to stakeholders
Partner with cross-functional teams to improve product quality and release readiness
What You Need to Bring
Required Skills
2-4 years of software QA, quality engineering, or related roles
Basic understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, and RAG.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, and cloud environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to learn and work with emerging AI technologies.
Strong understanding of QA methodologies, testing lifecycle, and defect management
Experience with test case design, exploratory testing, and regression testing
Hands-on experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Postman, or similar
Familiarity with API testing, DB and backend validation
Ability to think critically about edge cases and user behavior
Excellent communication and documentation skills
Experience with bug tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar
Preferred Qualifications
Experience testing AI, ML, or GenAI applications
Knowledge of LLM evaluation techniques, prompt testing, RAG systems, or model benchmarking
Familiarity with Python, JavaScript, or automation scripting
Understanding of metrics such as precision, recall, latency, user satisfaction, and error rates
AI observability and evaluation tools.

Guidewire is searching for a smart, proactive, and results-oriented Software Engineer to build sophisticated solutions for the property & casualty insurance industrys complex business domain and make our industry-leading products even better. The product development team is looking for an enthusiastic engineer who is passionate about building high-quality software with a phenomenal team and improving the customer experience for millions of people who use our products every day.

Guidewire provides outstanding software for the second-largest financial services industry in the world: insurance. We deliver the core applications that Property and Casualty (P/C) insurers use to build their products, sell policies, settle claims, and bill their customers. The SaaS solutions delivered via Guidewire Cloud enable our customers to rapidly innovate and drive measurable value. Guidewire Cloud is powered by the highly resilient Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud infrastructure, with SLAs backed by experienced Guidewire teams and SaaS-certified partners spanning application management, system administration, security and compliance, upgrades, QA testing, health checks, and other services.

The successful candidate will work on the entire technology stack, from the core persistence layer through to the Web Application front ends. Our teams are lean, empowered, and collaborative. You must be a self-starter and able to perform independently while working alongside intelligent colleagues whove checked their egos at the door in a team environment, communicating effectively with everyone. Weve built a strong culture, and were looking for engineers who can help us maintain it.

Job Requirements

Successful software engineers at Guidewire typically have:

Enjoy working collaboratively in an empowered, small, cross-functional team
Experience working in an agile and fast paced development environment (e.g. TDD, BDD, Agile, pair programming, etc.)
A passion for code quality demonstrated by thorough testing
A desire to be hands-on in designing and writing code
Curiosity and internal motivation to constantly improve
Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment
Excellent communication skills, comfort level to speak their mind and defend ideas based on merit, yet humility and hunger to learn from others.
Qualifications

Key qualifications include experience with:

2-4 years of experience in enterprise software development
Proficiency in Core Java and solid understanding of JavaScript / HTML5 / CSS.
Experience with a market leading client-side framework (e.g. React, Angular) is plus.
Familiarity with Continuous Delivery, Continuous Integration, Unit/Integration Testing, etc
Object-Oriented Design using SOLID and Hexagonal design principles
Experience building secure software and knowledge of security practices
Experience working with Open-Source frameworks (e.g. Spring, Jersey, Drools, others)
Understanding of relational database persistence (e.g. MySQL, Oracle). Familiarity with NoSQL databases (e.g. MongoDB, CouchDB) is a plus
Agile development practices
Experience with REST or gRPC based APIs
Cloud Services (e.g. AWS/GCP/Azure)
A typical candidate has a Computer Science degree or equivalent

Role Overview

Were looking for a Video Producer who can take complete ownership of end-to-end video production for performance marketing, lead generation, brand awareness, and pre-sales campaigns. This role demands a strong blend of creative thinking, production execution, and operational efficiency.

You will be responsible for translating marketing objectives into high-performing video assets—delivered at speed, scale, and quality.

Take complete ownership of video/ad projects from brief to final delivery
Understand campaign objectives (performance, lead gen, awareness) and align video output accordingly
Ensure timely delivery with high production and storytelling standards

Break down scripts and concepts into actionable production plans
Plan shoots including location, casting, props, schedules, and crew requirements

Production Coordinators

Marketing & Performance Teams

Stay updated with trends in ad creatives, short-form content, and digital storytelling

3–6+ years of experience in video production, preferably in ads or digital content
Strong understanding of performance marketing creatives and video funnels
Hands-on experience in managing end-to-end video production workflows
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines
Strong storytelling, visual sense, and attention to detail
Excellent communication and team collaboration skills

Good to Have

Experience in EdTech or D2C performance marketing
Understanding of platform-specific content (Meta, YouTube, Instagram, etc.)
Basic knowledge of editing/motion tools (Premiere Pro, After Effects)
Experience working with high-volume content pipelines

What Success Looks Like

Consistently delivering high-performing video ads
Efficient turnaround time across multiple projects
Strong coordination across teams with minimal friction
High ownership with minimal supervision

-Basic exposure to ASPICE, ISO 26262, AUTOSAR concepts, software quality checks, and model verification guidelines will be an added advantage.

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative and collaborative Sales & Presales Enablement Content Developer to join our Revenue Enablement team. In this role, you will design and develop impactful enablement content and learning experiences that help sellers, solutions engineers, and partners build the knowledge and skills needed to drive customer outcomes and business success.

Working closely with subject matter experts, product marketing, sales leaders, presales leaders, and enablement partners, you will transform complex information into clear, engaging, and actionable learning experiences. You will leverage modern content development tools, AI technologies, and enablement platforms to create scalable training programs, job aids, videos, eLearning, communications, and reinforcement assets that support business priorities and go-to-market initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines instructional design fundamentals, content development expertise, curiosity about AI, and a passion for creating learner-centered experiences.

Job Requirements

Design and Develop Enablement Content

Create learning assets and enablement materials for sales, solutions engineering, and partner audiences.
Develop eLearning, videos, job aids, playbooks, guides, presentations, knowledge articles, and reinforcement activities.
Translate technical, product, and business information into clear and engaging learning experiences.

Build Multi-Modal Learning Experiences

Develop instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, self-paced, and microlearning solutions.
Support learning journeys that combine multiple modalities to improve learner engagement and retention.
Create assets that help learners apply knowledge within their day-to-day workflows.

Leverage AI to Accelerate Content Creation

Use AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot and other approved technologies to streamline research, content creation, asset development, and production workflows.
Experiment with new approaches that improve development efficiency and learner experience.

Partner with Stakeholders

Collaborate with subject matter experts, product marketing teams, sales leaders, presales leaders, and partner enablement stakeholders to identify learning needs and define content requirements.
Participate in project planning, content reviews, and stakeholder feedback sessions.

Manage Content and Learning Platforms

Publish and maintain content within enablement and learning platforms such as Mindtickle, Seismic, learning management systems, and knowledge repositories.
Help ensure content remains accurate, current, and aligned with business priorities.
Experience

Experience

5+ years of experience in instructional design, learning development, content development, sales enablement, or a related field.
Experience supporting sales, presales, technical, partner, or customer-facing audiences is preferred.

Content Development Skills

Demonstrated ability to create engaging learning content using adult learning principles and instructional design best practices.
Experience developing a variety of deliverables including eLearning, videos, presentations, job aids, guides, and digital learning assets.

AI Fluency

Experience using AI-powered tools to support content creation, editing, research, or multimedia development.
Interest in applying emerging technologies to improve learning and enablement outcomes.

Learning Technology Skills

Experience with content authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Rise, Camtasia, Vyond, Synthesia, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with learning management systems, sales readiness platforms, and content management tools.

Communication and Collaboration

Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.
Strong attention to detail and project management skills.

Support Major Enablement Initiatives

Experience Contributing to launches, sales readiness programs, onboarding experiences, quarterly enablement priorities, and company-wide events.
Assisting in developing assets for virtual and in-person learning experiences. 
Preferred Qualification
Experience with sales, presales enablement or partner enablement programs.
Familiarity with platforms such as Mindtickle, Seismic, Highspot, Salesforce or similar technologies.
Exposure to B2B technology, cloud, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI, or enterprise software industries.
Knowledge of sales methodologies such as MEDDICC, MEDDPICC, Challenger, or SPIN is a plus.
Why you'll love this role

You will play a key role in helping sellers, solutions engineers, and partners succeed by creating learning experiences that have real business impact. You'll work with modern AI tools, collaborate with experts across the company, and contribute to high-visibility initiatives while growing your expertise in enablement, learning design, and content development. This role offers the opportunity to build a diverse portfolio of learning experiences while helping shape how people learn and perform in a rapidly evolving technology environment.

Job Description: 
Role Overview

We are looking for an IT & Security Administrator with 57 years of hands-on experience across systems administration, network administration, and IT security. The role will manage and secure our IT infrastructure, maintain reliable connectivity, support employees, and strengthen security controls across endpoints, servers, cloud services, and networks.The ideal candidate should be comfortable troubleshooting issues across multiple layers of the IT environment and taking ownership from diagnosis through resolution.




Key ResponsibilitiesSystems and IT Administration

Security Administration

Administer endpoint protection, EDR/XDR, email security, secure web access, and remote access solutions.
Manage MFA, role-based access, privileged access, and periodic access reviews.
Monitor security alerts, investigate suspicious activity, and coordinate incident containment and recovery.
Identify vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses, prioritize remediation, and track closure.
Implement system and network hardening, secure configurations, and patch management practices.
Support security audits by maintaining evidence, reviewing controls, and addressing findings.
Help employees adopt secure practices through guidance and security awareness activities.

57 years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure administration, covering both systems and networks.
Strong hands-on knowledge of Windows administration and working knowledge of Linux.
Experience administering Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID.
Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs, and wireless networking.
Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls, endpoint security tools, and security monitoring.
Experience managing identity, MFA, user permissions, and device security policies.
Familiarity with virtualization, backup platforms, and cloud infrastructure such as AWS or Azure.
Ability to troubleshoot issues systematically, assess operational impact, and verify resolution.
Clear communication, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.
Willingness to support planned maintenance and critical incidents outside standard working hours when required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with platforms such as Fortinet, Zscaler, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Intune, or equivalent solutions.
Experience with PowerShell, Bash, or other scripting tools for routine administration and automation.
Familiarity with SIEM tools, vulnerability management, Zero Trust access, and incident response processes.
Exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar security control frameworks.
Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft, Fortinet, AWS, or Azure certifications.

What Success Looks Like

Reliable systems and network connectivity with timely issue resolution.
Consistent patching, secure device configurations, and verified backup recovery.
Accurate asset records and timely onboarding, offboarding, and access reviews.
Prompt investigation of security alerts and closure of identified vulnerabilities.
Clear documentation and effective support for employees and business teams.

Job Description
Power Platform & Dataverse Developer / Administrator Digital Practice
Position Summary
The Power Platform & Dataverse Developer / Administrator is responsible for designing, building, administering, and supporting business solutions on Microsoft Power Platform and Dataverse for a large, high-volume customer service and contact center environment. The role owns Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, and Power BI solutions end to end, and keeps the Dataverse platform secure, healthy, well-governed, and cost-efficient.
The role works closely with Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Azure integration, data, and telephony teams. Working knowledge of these adjacent areas is expected so the engineer can collaborate effectively, troubleshoot across boundaries, and support end-to-end customer interactions; deep specialist ownership of telephony and data platforms sits with the respective teams.
Key Responsibilities
Power Platform Development


Design, build, and maintain Canvas and Model-driven Power Apps, including custom pages, forms, views, and business rules.
Develop and support Power Automate cloud flows for business processes, approvals, notifications, and system integrations, with proper error handling and retry patterns.
Build and maintain Copilot Studio agents, topics, and actions, including support for IVR and self-service experiences in collaboration with the contact center team.
Build API-based integrations using custom connectors, Dataverse Web API, and Azure Logic Apps / Function Apps where required.
Extend the platform using Power Fx, JavaScript client scripting, plug-ins (C#), and PCF components where low-code is not sufficient.
Develop and maintain Power BI reports and datasets built on Dataverse data.


Dataverse Administration


Design and administer Dataverse data models: tables, relationships, columns, choices, and alternate keys.
Manage security roles, business units, teams, field-level security, and user access in line with least-privilege principles.
Configure and maintain environments, environment variables, connection references, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies.
Support data quality, bulk data operations, duplicate detection, and auditing.
Support operational troubleshooting, incident resolution, and root-cause analysis for platform and solution issues.


Platform Governance, Monitoring & Cost


Monitor Power Platform environment health, Dataverse storage and capacity consumption, API limits, and Copilot Credits usage.
Track licensing, permissions, and platform-related costs; recommend optimizations.
Use the Power Platform Admin Center, CoE Starter Kit, and Application Insights for monitoring and actionable diagnostics.
Follow change management processes and coordinate changes across Dev, Test, UAT, and Production environments.


Application Lifecycle Management (ALM)


Manage managed / unmanaged solutions, solution layering, and versioning.
Implement and maintain deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or Power Platform Pipelines.
Ensure source control, code reviews, and Solution Checker compliance for all deliverables.


Collaboration & Adjacent Areas (Working Knowledge)


Support Dynamics 365 Customer Service configuration on Dataverse, such as queues, routing rules, workstreams, and agent experiences, with the Dynamics / contact center team.
Coordinate with Azure, telephony, and vendor teams on IVR-to-agent handoff, caller context passing, and integration issues.
Support Microsoft Fabric Link for Dataverse and downstream reporting needs in partnership with the data team.
Document solution architecture, integration contracts, runbooks, deployment procedures, and recovery steps.
Communicate clearly with business users, technical teams, and stakeholders; translate requirements into technical designs.

Position Summary:

Onity Group Inc. seeks a visionary technologist and AI leader to drive Innovation using emerging technologies and deliver on the digital transformation journey. Reporting to the CIO, this role is critical in shaping the technology landscape and ensuring that innovative technological solutions support our business strategies and enhance operational efficiency, customer engagement, and market competitiveness. The focus of this role will be on the experimentation, pilot, and deployment of AI/Digital tools & technologies such as Generative AI, Computer Vision, RPA, chatbots, and customer digital journeys in Servicing & Lending.

Job Functions and Responsibilities:

Develop and execute a comprehensive technology architecture, digital, and AI strategy that aligns with the companys business objectives and supports a best-in-class operating model.
Own the enterprise AI technology stack, architecture framework, and roadmap, ensuring scalability, resiliency, security, and business alignment.
Lead AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives across the organization, embedding technology into core business processes to improve speed, quality, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
Continuously assess the current technology architecture and partner with executive leadership to ensure technology investments are aligned with business priorities, growth objectives, and operational needs.
Identify, evaluate, and adopt emerging technologies and industry trends that can enhance business operations, reduce cost, improve customer and employee experience, and create competitive advantage.
Leverage AI, automation, and digital technologies to design and implement business applications that improve cost per loan, borrower experience, cycle times, productivity, and overall operational performance.
Bring deep expertise in AI architecture, robotic process automation, generative AI, computer vision/OCR models, machine learning models, conversational AI, and chatbot technologies.
Lead the design and build-out of modern AI architectures, including scalable platforms, APIs, automation layers, data integration patterns, and AI-enabled business capabilities.
Build strong coalitions across the enterprise by engaging key stakeholders, including business leaders, clients, partners, and vendors, to identify technology needs, prioritize opportunities, and drive adoption.
Quickly understand internal client processes, current technology ecosystems, operational pain points, and industry best practices to shape practical, high-value solutions.
Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on AI adoption and measurable business impact.
Conduct enterprise roadshows, workshops, and education sessions to increase awareness of emerging technologies and promote practical use cases across the organization.
Organize hackathons and innovation challenges to identify high-impact AI solutions and accelerate deployment of winning ideas into production.
Coach, influence, and partner with business leaders to maximize the value of technology, improve digital maturity, and drive sustained transformation across the enterprise.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.
20+ years of experience in IT, with a strong background in AI Technologies.
Experience in Fintech, Financial services or lending technology an added plus.
Good understanding of US mortgages (lending processes and the technology stack used in the mortgage industry, including AI solutions in processes, optical character recognition solutions, and customer-facing and point-of-sale applications) an added plus.
Proven history of successfully leading large-scale IT projects and teams in a transparent, collaborative, global environment.
Aggressive focus on strategy, execution, and results.
Exceptional communicator who tells an effective story and aligns stakeholders to it.
Tools such as Python, RPA tools such as Uipath, AWS Bedrock, other deep learning models, UI/UX technologies.

Leadership Attributes:

Integrity – always do the right thing.
Judgment – effectively deal with the gray.
Transparency – open and honest communication; early escalation; no hidden agendas.
Respect – treat others with dignity and be respectful.
Resiliency – tolerate dynamic conditions without undue frustration.
Pragmatic – stay calm, act with focus and purpose, even when facing challenge and uncertainty.
Passion – demonstrate positive excitement and conviction for what you do and needs to get done.
Ownership – take responsibility for your span.
Self-Motivation – personal drive to achieve, commitment to personal / organizational goals, initiative to act on opportunities and challenges, and optimism in the face of setbacks.
Hunger – willing to throw head, heart, and hands into the job.
Humility – do not have to be the smartest person in the room, give credit to others, willing to do any job to help the organization or team succeed.
Desire to Win – super competitive yet understand that the competition is outside the organization.
Empathy – the ability to put yourself in your customers shoes, understand and address apprehensions.
Independent Thinker – analytical, the ability to make sense of things based on one’s experiences and observations; not flustered by criticism or challenges and willing to stand for convictions.
Intellectual Curiosity – passion for continuous learning and understanding “why.”

Job description

SQL Database Administrator (DBA)

EXL (NASDAQ:EXLS) is a leading operations management and analytics company that helps businesses enhance growth and profitability in the face of relentless competition and continuous disruption. Using our proprietary, award-winning Business EXLerator Framework, which integrates analytics, automation, benchmarking, BPO, consulting, industry best practices and technology platforms, we look deeper to help companies improve global operations, enhance data-driven insights, increase customer satisfaction, and manage risk and compliance. EXL serves the insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, utilities, travel, transportation and logistics industries. Headquartered in New York, New York, EXL has more than 24,000 professionals in locations throughout the United States, Europe, Asia (primarily India and Philippines), Latin America, Australia and South Africa.
EXL Analytics provides data-driven, action-oriented solutions to business problems through statistical data mining, cutting edge analytics techniques and a consultative approach. Leveraging proprietary methodology and best-of-breed technology, EXL Analytics takes an industry-specific approach to transform our clients decision making and embed analytics more deeply into their business processes. Our global footprint of nearly 2,000 data scientists and analysts assist client organizations with complex risk minimization methods, advanced marketing, pricing and CRM strategies, internal cost analysis, and cost and resource optimization within the organization. EXL Analytics serves the insurance, healthcare, banking, capital markets, utilities, retail and e-commerce, travel, transportation and logistics industries.

Please visit www.exlservice.com for more information about EXL Analytics.


Role & Responsibilities:



Install, configure, upgrade, and patch Microsoft SQL Server instances across development, test, and production environments that support insurance policy, claims, billing, and analytics workloads.
Monitor database health, availability, and performance using native tools and monitoring platforms, and proactively resolve issues before they affect business users or downstream reporting.
Tune queries, indexes, statistics, and execution plans, and partner with developers and data engineers to optimize stored procedures, ETL jobs, and BI data models.
Design, implement, and regularly test backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery solutions (such as Always On Availability Groups, log shipping, and failover clustering) to meet agreed RPO and RTO targets.
Manage database security, including role-based access control, encryption, auditing, and masking of sensitive policyholder and claimant data, in line with client, regulatory, and EXL information security standards.
Support migration and modernization initiatives, including moving SQL Server workloads to Azure SQL, Managed Instance, or other cloud data platforms, and onboarding data to the enterprise data platform.
Automate routine administration, deployment, and monitoring tasks using T-SQL, PowerShell, and CI/CD pipelines, and maintain version-controlled database change management practices.
Own incident, problem, and change management for database services, perform root cause analysis, and provide clear updates to technical and business stakeholders during escalations.
Maintain accurate documentation, runbooks, and data dictionaries, and contribute to data governance activities such as ownership, lineage, and data quality controls.
Collaborate with BI developers, data engineers, and architects on report rationalization and data product delivery, and mentor junior DBAs.


Candidate Profile:



Immediate Joiners only- those who can join in October.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (Required).
7+ years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server (2016 or later) in enterprise production environments (Required).
Strong expertise in performance tuning, indexing strategies, execution plan analysis, and troubleshooting blocking, deadlocks, and resource contention (Required).
Proven experience with backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery configurations, including Always On Availability Groups and clustering (Required).
Proficiency in T-SQL and PowerShell scripting for automation, monitoring, and deployment (Required).
Working knowledge of database security, encryption, auditing, and compliance requirements for sensitive personal and financial data (Required).
Experience with SSIS, SSRS, or SSAS and with supporting BI and reporting platforms such as Power BI or Tableau (Preferred).
Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or other cloud data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks, including migration projects (Preferred).
Familiarity with property and casualty insurance data domains such as policy, claims, billing, and underwriting, and with insurance regulatory expectations (Strongly preferred).
Exposure to data governance, metadata management, and data quality practices, and to ITIL-based incident, problem, and change processes (Preferred).
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical audiences (Required).
Ability to work in an offshore delivery model with overlap with U.S. business hours and to participate in on-call rotations as needed (Required).


What we offer:


EXL Analytics offers an exciting, fast paced and innovative environment, which brings together a group of sharp and entrepreneurial professionals who are eager to influence business decisions. From your very first day, you get an opportunity to work closely with highly experienced, world class analytics consultants.
You can expect to learn many aspects of businesses that our clients engage in. You will also learn effective teamwork and time-management skills - key aspects for personal and professional growth
Analytics requires different skill sets at different levels within the organization. At EXL Analytics, we invest heavily in training you in all aspects of analytics as well as in leading analytical tools and techniques.
We provide guidance/ coaching to every employee through our mentoring program wherein every junior level employee is assigned a senior level professional as advisors.
Sky is the limit for our team members. The unique experiences gathered at EXL Analytics sets the stage for further growth and development in our company and beyond.


Interested candidates also directly send their resume to sonal.bajpai@exlservice.com

Job Description: Quality Assurance Engineer

We are seeking a proactive, quality-focused QA Engineer to join our engineering organization. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the high quality and reliability of our applications through automated testing, early shift-left involvement, and strong cross-functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

Job description

Duties and Responsibilities

Azure Boards and process customization (core of the role)

     Create and maintain inherited processes (from Agile, Scrum, Basic or CMMI) and manage which projects use which process.
     Customize work item types, fields, picklists, forms, layouts, states, state categories, transitions, rules, reason values and backlog levels.
     Implement team-specific workflows, for example adding states such as Ready for QA, Ready for UAT, Ready for Pre-Prod and Ready for Prod to the Bug workflow, and align board columns and swimlanes to them.
     Design and manage work item hierarchies across portfolios, epics, features, user stories, tasks, defects, risks, issues, decisions, milestones and other approved work item types.
     Configure Areas, Iterations, team backlogs, sprint settings, Delivery Plans, queries, charts, dashboards and notifications.
     Perform impact analysis and regression validation before changing shared processes or production projects, and consolidate duplicate or drifting processes.

Organization and tenant governance

     Administer Azure DevOps organizations, projects and teams in line with enterprise standards, including organization ownership, Project Collection Administrators and naming conventions.
     Govern organization creation using Microsoft Entra tenant policies (e.g., restricting who can create new Azure DevOps organizations) and manage the Microsoft Entra connection for each organization.
     Handle ownership transfer and recovery of organizations when an owner or administrator leaves, including working with Microsoft support where required.
     Manage organization policies such as external guest access, third-party application access via OAuth, SSH authentication, public projects and limiting user visibility (project-scoped users).
     Govern Personal Access Tokens (PATs): enforce tenant PAT policies (maximum lifespan, full-scope and global PAT restrictions), plan the move away from global PATs, and adopt service principals, managed identities and workload identity federation where possible.
     Manage access levels and licensing (Stakeholder, Basic, Basic + Test Plans, Visual Studio subscribers), billing through the linked Azure subscription, group rules and periodic license optimization.

Security, access and compliance

     Configure users, teams, Microsoft Entra ID groups, Azure DevOps security groups, access levels and role-based permissions using least-privilege principles.
     Provide controlled access for external contractors and partners (B2B guest access, Stakeholder access, project-scoped visibility, read-only security groups) without over-provisioning.
     Maintain controlled administrator groups, access reviews and separation of duties.
     Support audit and compliance through Azure DevOps audit logs and audit streaming, traceable approvals, change records, access evidence and configuration documentation.

Data migration, bulk operations and reporting

     Plan and execute bulk work item creation, updates, imports, exports and corrections using CSV import, Excel (Azure DevOps Office Integration), REST APIs or approved migration tools.
     Validate data quality after imports or configuration changes, including required fields, state mappings, parent-child links, assignments, history and reporting consistency.
     Support repository and project migrations (e.g., between organizations or from Azure DevOps to GitHub using GitHub Enterprise Importer), including mapping organizations, projects and repositories.
     Build dashboards, Analytics Views, OData queries and Power BI-ready data structures for program status, milestones, risks, dependencies, backlog health and delivery reporting.

Automation, integrations and support

     Develop administrative automation and validation scripts using PowerShell, Python, Azure DevOps REST APIs or the Azure DevOps CLI.
     Support integrations between Azure DevOps and approved enterprise tools (Power BI, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, ServiceNow) and troubleshoot authentication, permissions, synchronization and reporting issues.
     Provide day-to-day platform support, triage incidents and service requests, perform root-cause analysis and coordinate escalations with Microsoft or internal platform teams.
     Create and maintain configuration specifications, runbooks, SOPs, knowledge articles, training materials and release notes.
     Provide onboarding, office hours and practical guidance to project managers, product owners, analysts and delivery teams on effective use of Azure Boards.
     Deliver changes within established change-control and release-management processes; prioritize competing requests and work independently.

Must-Have Skills (Non-Negotiable)

Candidates must have hands-on, recent experience with every item below. Training or theoretical knowledge alone is not enough.

     Inherited process customization: creating inherited processes and customizing work item types, fields, states, rules, forms and backlog levels.
     Azure Boards administration: Areas, Iterations, teams, backlogs, boards, queries, dashboards and Delivery Plans for multiple projects.
     Organization governance: organization settings and policies, ownership, Microsoft Entra connection and tenant policies, and PAT policies.
     Security and access: Azure DevOps security groups, permissions inheritance, access levels and licensing, Microsoft Entra groups, and external/guest user access.
     Bulk work item operations: CSV/Excel import and update, data mapping and post-load validation.
     Reporting: queries, dashboards, Analytics Views and Power BI integration.
     Scripting: PowerShell or Python with the Azure DevOps REST API for administration and automation.
     Experience: 6+ years in IT and 3+ years of Azure DevOps administration supporting enterprise-scale project or portfolio management (Agile, Scrum, Kanban, waterfall or hybrid).

Good-to-Have Skills

     Process-template consolidation, inherited-process governance, project onboarding and controlled configuration releases.
     Azure DevOps to GitHub migrations (GitHub Enterprise Importer) or cross-organization migrations.
     Working knowledge of Git repositories, branch policies, YAML pipelines, environments and approval checks, sufficient to support project-level administration and coordinate with engineering teams.
     Azure Artifacts feed administration (feeds, views, upstream sources, permissions).
     Experience in regulated, audited or controls-driven environments.
     Microsoft certifications such as AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert) or AZ-104 (Azure Administrator).
     B.A. or B.S. in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Duties and Responsibilities :

Administer Azure DevOps organizations, projects, teams, and project-level configurations in accordance with enterprise standards.
Configure and maintain inherited process templates, work item types, fields, forms, states, transitions, rules, reason values, and backlog behavior.
Design and manage work item hierarchies and relationships across portfolios, epics, features, user stories, tasks, defects, risks, issues, decisions, milestones, and other approved work item types.
Configure and maintain Areas, Iterations, team backlogs, sprint settings, delivery plans, queries, charts, dashboards, and notifications.
Partner with business and program stakeholders to evaluate configuration requests, identify platform constraints, recommend sustainable options, and implement approved changes.
Perform impact analysis and regression validation before deploying changes to shared process templates or production projects.
Plan and execute bulk work item creation, updates, imports, exports, and data corrections using supported Azure DevOps features, Excel integration, CSV, REST APIs, or approved migration utilities.
Validate data quality after imports or configuration changes, including required fields, state mappings, parent-child relationships, links, assignments, history, and reporting consistency.
Configure and administer users, teams, Microsoft Entra ID groups, security groups, access levels, and role-based permissions using least-privilege principles.
Maintain project and permission standards, including controlled administrator groups, naming conventions, access reviews, and separation of duties.
Support governance, audit, and compliance requirements by maintaining traceable approvals, change records, access evidence, configuration documentation, and operational procedures.
Develop and maintain dashboards, Analytics Views, queries, and Power BI-ready data structures for program status, milestones, risks, dependencies, backlog health, and delivery reporting.
Support integrations between Azure DevOps and approved enterprise tools, and troubleshoot authentication, permissions, data synchronization, and reporting issues.
Develop administrative automation and validation scripts using PowerShell, Azure DevOps REST APIs, or similar approved technologies.
Provide day-to-day platform support, triage incidents and service requests, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate escalations with Microsoft or internal platform teams when needed.
Create and maintain configuration specifications, runbooks, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, training materials, and release notes.
Provide onboarding, office-hours support, and practical guidance to project managers, product owners, analysts, and delivery teams on effective use of Azure Boards.
Monitor platform usage and configuration consistency and proactively identify opportunities to simplify administration, reduce manual effort, and improve user experience.
Operate independently, prioritize competing requests, and deliver configuration changes within established change-control and release-management processes.

Skills and Experience :

6+ years of IT experience, including enterprise application administration, DevOps or application lifecycle management, platform support, or related disciplines.
3+ years of hands-on Azure DevOps administration experience, with strong emphasis on Azure Boards and project administration.
Demonstrated expertise customizing inherited processes, work item types, fields, forms, states, rules, reason values, backlog levels, Areas, and Iterations.
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps permissions, teams, security groups, access levels, Microsoft Entra ID integration, and least-privilege administration.
Experience supporting enterprise-scale project or portfolio management use cases, including Agile, Scrum, Kanban, waterfall, or hybrid delivery methods.
Experience with work item imports, exports, migration, mapping, reconciliation, and post-load data validation.
Working knowledge of Azure DevOps REST APIs and scripting using PowerShell, Python, or similar languages for administration and automation.
Experience developing Azure DevOps queries, dashboards, Analytics Views, and reporting integrations such as Power BI.
Understanding of Azure DevOps audit logs, change control, access reviews, segregation of duties, data retention, and audit-evidence requirements.
Ability to analyze complex configuration requests, explain product constraints, and recommend maintainable solutions without unnecessary customization.
Strong troubleshooting, technical documentation, organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills.
Strong partnership, facilitation, and communication skills, including the ability to coordinate with technical and business stakeholders at multiple levels.
Ability to work independently with limited direction in a fast-paced environment and provide guidance to less experienced administrators and users.
B.A. or B.S. in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience :

Experience supporting Azure DevOps environments used primarily for enterprise work management and portfolio reporting.
Experience with process-template consolidation, inherited-process governance, project onboarding, and controlled configuration releases.
Experience integrating Azure DevOps data with Power BI, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, ServiceNow, or other approved enterprise platforms.
Working knowledge of Git repositories, branch policies, pipelines, and release concepts sufficient to support project-level administration and coordinate with engineering platform teams.
Experience supporting regulated, audited, or controls-driven environments.

About us and the role

At DS Stream, we help global enterprises move beyond AI pilots and build AI at scale. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions across Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Data Science, Generative AI, Agentic AI and AI Platform Engineering.




We work with organizations across CPG, Retail, Manufacturing, Telecom, Financial Services and Healthcare, helping them build AI Factories, modern data platforms and production-ready AI solutions.




We are looking for experienced Backend/AI Engineers to join our growing Team in India.




Role Overview

As an AI Engineer at DS Stream, you will bridge the gap between traditional data science and modern AI applications. Leveraging your strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, and data engineering, you will design, train, and deploy ML models while integrating GenAI capabilities into existing data pipelines. You will be responsible for the full ML lifecycle - from experimentation and model development to production deployment and monitoring - ensuring our AI solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.




Key Responsibilities

Design and operate AI-driven pipelines that automatically ingest, analyze, and classify operational incidents and tickets.
Leverage LLMs with structured prompt logic and few-shot prompting (using historically similar tickets) to deliver consistent, scalable triage replacing manual classification and accelerating resolution.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and contribute to scaling AI capabilities across projects.
Drive tasks independently with minimal supervision.



Required Skills

4+ years of hands-on experience in GenAI/Machine Learning/Data Science with strong background in Python.
Proficiency in deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or Tensorflow preferred).
Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational/vector databases
Solid understanding of ML fundamentals (supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering).
Practical experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph or LlamaIndex).
Understanding of GenAI integration patterns and LLM APIs.
Experience building and deploying ML models to production.
Hands-on exposure to at least one cloud ML platform (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI, Databricks).
Familiarity with software engineering best practices (GitHub, CI/CD, testing, code review).
Understanding of workflow orchestration (Airflow, Kubeflow).



Nice to Have

Strong foundation in statistics and mathematics (linear algebra, probability, optimization).
Experience with Spark (PySpark, Databricks).
Open-source contributions to AI or data projects.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

A day in the life of an Infoscion

As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment

You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs

Job description

Technical Skills Required :

SQL Server administration (2016 2025, Windows Server): installation and configuration to a standard baseline (memory, MAXDOP, tempdb, instant file initialisation, service accounts), cumulative-update patching, SQL Agent jobs, Database Mail and alerts.
High availability & DR: Always On Availability Groups (synchronous / asynchronous commit, listener, readable secondaries, automatic and forced failover), Windows Server Failover Clustering with quorum / file-share or cloud witness, Failover Cluster Instances and log shipping; planned failovers and DR drills.
Backup & recovery: full / differential / log backup strategy (e.g. Ola Hallengren or SQL Agent), point-in-time restore (STOPAT),CHECKSUM / VERIFYONLY, scheduled restore tests, DBCC CHECKDB and corruption handling, RPO / RTO definition and validation.
Performance tuning: execution plans, Query Store (plan regression, plan forcing), DMVs, wait statistics, Extended Events, indexing and statistics, blocking / deadlock analysis, tempdb contention, transaction-log growth troubleshooting.
Migrations & upgrades: version upgrades, server / storage / datastore moves, AG database file moves, side-by-side migrations with minimal downtime and rollback plans.
Archiving & purging: retention design, batch purging, table partitioning with partition switching (sliding window), automated retention jobs.
Security & hardening: logins, roles and least privilege, TDE / TLS, SQL Server Audit, surface-area reduction, quarterly access reviews, closure of VAPT / audit findings.
Automation & monitoring: advanced T-SQL, PowerShell (dbatools preferred); monitoring and alerting dashboards (e.g. Grafana) for health, AG status, backups, disk growth and slow queries.
Excellent advantage: MySQL (GTID replication, InnoDB Cluster, XtraBackup) and / or PostgreSQL (streaming replication, Patroni, pgBackRest) administration; Linux basics; cross-engine migration (e.g. SQL Server to PostgreSQL).

About the Role:-




We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy LLM-powered applications and autonomous agentic AI systems. You will work closely with product, data, and engineering teams to turn foundation models into reliable, scalable, production-grade solutions.

Design and build applications on top of Large Language Models (open-source and proprietary, such as GPT, Claude, Llama, Mistral, and Gemini).

Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs via APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, or similar).
Practical experience with Agentic AI concepts: tool/function calling, ReAct-style reasoning, multi-agent orchestration, and memory management.
Working knowledge of RAG architecture and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or pgvector).
Experience with prompt engineering and evaluation of LLM outputs (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, or custom metrics).
Familiarity with REST API development, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Solid understanding of NLP fundamentals, embeddings, and transformer architectures.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly.

Log Analytics
ELK Stack / ElasticSearch
Power BI dashboards

Ansible

Python
Bash
PowerShell

Operations teams

Job description

About Elchemy




Elchemy is a tech-enabled, cross-border specialty chemicals distribution platform helping companies across the US and Europe source high-quality chemical raw materials from trusted manufacturers across Southeast Asia and beyond. We operate at the intersection of discovery, quality assurance, and fulfillment, simplifying what has traditionally been a fragmented and opaque procurement process. By combining deep industry expertise with a technology-first approach, we enable faster sourcing, greater reliability, and scalable global supply chains for our customers.

In just 4 years of operations, Elchemy has scaled rapidly, serving customers in over 55 countries and building active partnerships with 200+ suppliers across more than 15 manufacturing geographies. Our platform supports a wide range of specialty chemical applications, helping businesses access the right materials with confidence and speed. Our vision is to build the worlds largest global specialty chemicals distributor, reimagining the industry through technology-led discovery, seamless fulfillment, and data-driven decision-making.

Elchemy is backed by marquee investors and has raised over $7.5 million to date. Our team brings together alumni from IITs, IIMs, and NITs, along with professionals who have built and scaled startups and worked across global multinational organizations. We are here to fundamentally transform the $800B specialty chemicals industry - making it more transparent, efficient, and globally connected through new-age technology.





Roles and Responsibilities




Design and develop backend architectures to support robust, scalable, and secure web applications and systems with a focus on backend development using Django.
Design, implement and maintain high quality RESTful APIs to support seamless communication between frontend, backend and other services.
Design, implement, and maintain database schemas. Ensure the integrity, performance, and security of data.
Ensure the scalability and reliability of our backend infrastructure on AWS. Ensure reliable management of infrastructure on cloud aiming for 0 downtime of systems.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, while adhering to best practices and industry standards. Develop and maintain documentation for our backend systems, APIs, and data models.
Conduct high quality code reviews and provide feedback to other team members to ensure best practices are adhered to.
Take ownership of the development, testing, and deployment of web applications. Break down high-level business problems into smaller chunks and build systems.
Work closely with the frontend development team, product managers, and designers to plan new features and optimize existing ones.
Constantly aim to improve performance and optimize systems by identifying bottlenecks and resolving them for increased efficiency.
Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies such as LLMs, and implement them as and when required




Skills and Qualifications




Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field.
5+ years of experience in full-stack web development, with a focus on backend development.
Strong proficiency in Python and Django, including experience with Django Rest Framework.
Experience working with SQL/PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, querying, and optimization.
Proficiency in AWS services such as EC2, RDS, S3, and Lambda.
Familiarity of integrations with third party services and open source frameworks
Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns.
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.
Familiarity with LLM frameworks such as Langchain, OpenAI, Anthropic, LLaMa is a plus.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

business domains.

platforms.
