Job description

Job Title

Pre-Sales Consultant SAP Testing




Employer Description

A fast-growing AI-led enterprise test automation platform company serving global digital transformation clients.




Role Purpose

We are seeking a high-impact Pre-Sales Consultant SAP Testing with strong SAP techno-functional expertise, customer-facing solutioning capability, and a deep understanding of SAP business processes, automation strategy, and AI-led testing innovation.

This role is positioned at the intersection of SAP transformation advisory, test strategy design, solution engineering, demo storytelling, and enterprise deal progression. The selected professional will work closely with sales, product, engineering, customer success, and enterprise client stakeholders to shape technically credible, commercially compelling SAP testing solutions.

The role requires a professional who can understand complex SAP landscapes, identify testing gaps, design structured testing strategies, present solution demonstrations, support RFP/RFI responses, run proof-of-concept engagements, and influence customer confidence across S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Fiori/UI5, API, integration, and regression testing environments.




Key Responsibilities




1. Customer Discovery and SAP Landscape Assessment

• Assess current SAP landscapes, including ECC, S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Fiori/UI5, and integrated enterprise systems.

• Understand SAP business processes across modules such as SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, and related functional areas.

• Identify current testing challenges across manual testing, automation coverage, regression cycles, integration validation, and release readiness.

• Evaluate pain points related to test maintenance, test data, execution planning, business process coverage, and cross-module dependencies.

• Translate discovery outcomes into structured solution opportunities and customer-facing recommendations.




2. SAP Test Strategy and Solution Architecture

• Design end-to-end test strategies for S/4HANA migration programs, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective transition scenarios.

• Build testing approaches for RISE with SAP programs, Fiori modernization, SAP steady-state operations, and ongoing transformation initiatives.

• Create structured test blueprints covering business process mapping, regression suite design, impact-based testing, and risk-based prioritization.

• Define testing scope across functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, API testing, data migration validation, and interface validation.

• Consider cross-module dependencies, release cycles, upgrade readiness, and industry-specific SAP process complexity.




3. Demo Engineering and Technical Presentation

• Prepare and deliver customer-specific demos for SAP UI5/Fiori workflow testing.

• Demonstrate testing approaches for SAP OData services, RFCs, BAPIs, APIs, IDocs, CPI, and PI/PO integrations.

• Explain how modern SAP testing reduces release risk, improves reliability, shortens testing cycles, and supports quarterly upgrade readiness.

• Present automation concepts clearly for SAP functional teams, QA leaders, Basis teams, enterprise architects, and business stakeholders.

• Use storytelling, structured narratives, and proof points to communicate solution value during pre-sales engagements.




4. Proposal, RFP, and Solution Documentation

• Prepare technical proposals, RFP responses, RFI responses, and customer-facing solution documents.

• Support security and compliance questionnaires with technically accurate, role-relevant input.

• Create high-level architecture diagrams, solution outlines, testing strategy documents, and estimation models.

• Develop test effort and complexity estimates based on SAP scope, modules, interfaces, transformation stage, and regression requirements.

• Tailor SAP testing strategies for industry contexts such as manufacturing, BFSI, retail, and other enterprise environments.




5. Customer Engagement and Deal Progression

• Work with Sales Directors to build compelling SAP testing narratives and customer-specific value propositions.

• Lead validation workshops with SAP functional consultants, QA teams, Basis teams, enterprise architects, and transformation stakeholders.

• Address customer objections around methodology, automation strategy, integration reliability, migration readiness, and testing governance.

• Define success criteria for proof-of-concept engagements and validation workshops.

• Run PoCs aligned to real customer business processes, SAP modules, integration flows, and technical environments.

• Support deal progression through technical credibility, structured solutioning, and stakeholder confidence-building.




Required Qualifications and Experience

• 810 years of experience in SAP functional consulting, ABAP development leadership, SAP project delivery, SAP solutioning, or SAP techno-functional consulting.

• Strong exposure to SAP projects in consulting, project management, technical delivery, implementation, migration, or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Hands-on understanding of SAP S/4HANA migration approaches, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective transition.

• Working knowledge of RISE with SAP architecture and enterprise SAP transformation models.

• Experience with SAP modules such as SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, or similar business process areas.

• Participation in at least one S/4HANA or RISE transformation project in a primary functional, technical, or consulting role.

• Strong communication skills, executive presence, demo capability, and solution storytelling ability.




Preferred Qualifications and Experience

• Experience in pre-sales, solution engineering, SAP advisory, SAP QA consulting, or customer-facing technical roles.

• Lead contributor experience in SAP implementation programs, especially in FI, SD, or MM domains.

• Exposure to SAP test automation, SAP QA, regression testing, impact-based testing, or structured testing frameworks.

• Background modernizing SAP testing from manual or recorder-driven approaches to structured automation frameworks.

• Experience supporting proposals, RFPs, technical presentations, solution workshops, PoCs, or enterprise deal cycles.




Required Technical and Functional Expertise

• SAP S/4HANA transformation and migration testing.

• RISE with SAP architecture and testing implications.

• SAP functional process knowledge across SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, or related modules.

• SAP UI5 and Fiori testing.

• SAP OData services, RFCs, BAPIs, IDocs, and interface flows.

• CPI and PI/PO integration environments.

• Functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, and data migration validation.

• Test case design, test data services, execution lists, regression suite planning, and risk-based testing practices.

• Business process coverage mapping and cross-module dependency analysis.

• Customer-facing solution architecture and technical storytelling.




Required Professional Competencies

• Ability to lead structured customer discovery discussions.

• Strong analytical ability to assess SAP testing gaps and transformation risks.

• Capability to design practical, enterprise-ready SAP testing strategies.

• Clear communication across technical and business stakeholders.

• Strong presentation, demo, objection-handling, and workshop facilitation skills.

• Ability to partner effectively with sales, product, engineering, and client-facing teams.

• Strong documentation discipline for proposals, RFPs, architecture diagrams, and solution notes.

• High ownership orientation and ability to drive technical deal progression.




Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is an SAP techno-functional professional with strong consulting maturity, enterprise communication skills, and the ability to translate SAP transformation challenges into structured testing solutions. The person should be comfortable discussing SAP business processes with functional teams, integration complexity with technical stakeholders, testing strategy with QA leaders, and business outcomes with senior decision-makers.

A strong fit would be someone who has contributed meaningfully to SAP implementation, migration, or transformation programs and now seeks a customer-facing pre-sales role combining SAP expertise, testing strategy, automation advisory, AI-led innovation, and enterprise solution consulting.

Job Title: Data Engineer (Azure & Databricks)
Experience Required:4 5 Years
About the Role
We are looking for a motivated and detail oriented Data Engineer to join our growing analytics team. In this role, you will work closely with Lead Data Engineers and Architects to develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using modern cloud technologies.
You will get hands on experience building our Enterprise Data Warehouse and Lakehouse solutions using Python, Databricks, and Microsoft Azure. This is an excellent opportunity for an emerging data professional to grow their skills in cloud data engineering and distributed computing.
Key Responsibilities

. Pipeline Development: Build, test, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines to move data from various sources into our Azure Data Lake and Data Warehouse.
. Coding & Transformation: Write clean, efficient PySpark and Python code in Azure Databricks to clean, transform, and aggregate data.
. Data Integration: Utilize Azure Data Factory (ADF) to orchestrate data movement and schedule automated workflows.
. SQL Development: Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, analysis, and creating views for downstream reporting tools.
. Monitoring & Support: Monitor daily batch jobs, troubleshoot failed pipelines, and resolve data quality issues in a timely manner.
. Collaboration: Work alongside senior engineers to understand architectural designs, participate in code reviews, and learn enterprise best practices for data engineering.
. Documentation: Maintain clear technical documentation for data pipelines, data dictionaries, and operational runbooks.

Required Skills & Qualifications

. Experience: 4 5 years of hands on experience in Data Engineering, ETL development, or Data Analytics.
. Python Programming: Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation (e.g., using Pandas) and scripting.
. SQL Mastery: Solid understanding of relational databases and the ability to write complex SQL queries, joins, and aggregations.
. Big Data / Databricks: Hands on experience with Apache Spark (PySpark or Spark SQL) and familiarity with the Databricks environment.
. Azure Cloud: Exposure to the Azure data ecosystem, specifically working with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2) and creating pipelines in Azure Data Factory (ADF).
. Data Warehousing Concepts: Good foundational understanding of Data Warehousing principles (Star schema, facts, and dimensions).
. Version Control: Experience using Git for source code version control.

Preferred/Bonus Skills

. Understanding of Delta Lake concepts (Time travel, ACID transactions).
. Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and deploying code using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
. Prior experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
. Certifications: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP 900) or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate.

Job Title: SAP Security Testing Consultant

Position: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer
Experience: 4-9 Years
Category: Cybersecurity / SAP Security
Work Mode: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 days WFH)
Primary Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad
Employment Type: Full Time
Certification Required: CEH

Role Summary

We are seeking a skilled SAP Security Testing professional to support security assessment and testing activities across SAP applications and related technologies. The role involves understanding SAP non-functional and security requirements, assessing application architecture, developing security testing strategies, conducting penetration testing and vulnerability assessments, and supporting clients with remediation recommendations.

The candidate will also contribute to security testing automation, DevSecOps integration, cloud security testing, security audits, and Proofs of Concept (PoCs) for emerging security tools and technologies. The role requires strong ownership, client interaction, technical expertise, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


Your future duties and responsibilities:

Participate in requirement-gathering calls and understand SAP NFRs and security testing requirements.
Understand system architecture, application components, integrations, and associated security considerations.
Conduct SAP Proofs of Concept (PoCs) for new security tools and technologies.
Prepare and present security test plans, including recommendations on appropriate testing methodologies for SAP applications.
Create and execute SAP security test cases based on identified security testing requirements and services.
Develop expertise in manual source code review and gain proficiency in Checkmarx or similar SAST/code review tools.
Conduct manual penetration testing of SAP applications using tools such as Burp Suite and OWASP ZAP.
Demonstrate strong understanding of OWASP Top 10 for web, API, and mobile application penetration testing.
Conduct vulnerability scanning and vulnerability management activities, including assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with relevant teams.
Lead vulnerability assessment activities and prepare detailed remediation assessments and recommendations.
Conduct security audits with a strong understanding of NIST security controls and frameworks.
Develop and execute security testing practices for cloud technologies.
Automate security testing services by integrating security activities into SSDLC, CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
Identify and validate false positives and prepare detailed security assessment reports, including vulnerability counts, severity, impact, and remediation recommendations.
Take ownership of assigned activities and ensure timely completion with minimal supervision.
Own end-to-end project delivery, including daily status updates, weekly reporting, client communication, and report walkthroughs.
Collaborate effectively with application, infrastructure, cloud, development, and other security teams.
Demonstrate the ability to manage and deliver multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and timelines.


Required qualifications to be successful in this role:

Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Experience
3+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, Application Security, SAP Security Testing, Vulnerability Assessment, or Penetration Testing.
Hands-on experience in SAP application security testing and assessment.
Experience in security testing across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, and/or cloud environments.
Experience preparing security test plans, test cases, vulnerability reports, and remediation recommendations.
Experience working with multiple stakeholders and managing security testing activities independently.

Technical Skills
Strong understanding of SAP security and SAP application architecture.
Hands-on experience with manual penetration testing and application security testing.
Proficiency with Burp Suite and OWASP ZAP (Zed Attack Proxy).
Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, including web and API security testing.
Knowledge of mobile application security testing.
Experience with manual code review and SAST tools such as Checkmarx or equivalent.
Experience with vulnerability scanning and vulnerability management.
Strong understanding of NIST security controls and security audit practices.
Knowledge of cloud security testing across platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Understanding of SSDLC, CI/CD, and DevSecOps security practices.
Ability to automate security testing and integrate security controls into development pipelines.
Strong capability to analyze vulnerabilities, validate false positives, assess risk, and provide remediation recommendations.
Good technical documentation and security reporting skills.

Required Certification
Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) certification is mandatory.

Preferred Skills
Experience conducting security testing for complex SAP landscapes and enterprise applications.
Exposure to SAP security tools and technologies.
Knowledge of additional penetration testing and vulnerability assessment tools.
Experience with DevSecOps and security automation.
Knowledge of cloud security frameworks and controls.
Understanding of security standards and frameworks such as NIST, OWASP, and SSDLC.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver within defined timelines.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Strong client-facing skills, including the ability to present findings and conduct security report walkthroughs.

Job Summary

Senior Software Engineer II - Full Stack
Location: India Remote


Role Overview

The Senior Software Engineer II will work closely with the Engineering Manager, Architect, Product Manager and team to understand both stated and unstated needs, own a domain or technical system long-term, and autonomously deliver ongoing business impact through larger, multi-quarter initiatives.
The role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and enhancing applications for First American. These applications are typically web-based and are developed in accordance with established coding standards and guidelines using a continuous Build-Integrate-Test approach within an Agile environment.
The Senior Software Engineer II will serve as a recognized domain technical authority-using deep business knowledge and strong engineering practices to improve functionality, performance, reliability, and maintainability while shaping technical direction and elevating team outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

Autonomously deliver ongoing business impact for the team, product capability, or technical system-leading larger, multi-quarter initiatives across the full SDLC from design through launch and rollout.
Own a domain or technical system long-term; serve as a recognized domain expert and drive customer impact through technical direction and durable improvements.
Make independent technical decisions for the team under open-ended requirements; partner with the Architect and Product Manager on roadmaps, trade-offs, and pragmatic solutions.
Partner with the Engineering Manager, Architect, and Product Manager on long-term goals; identify when work is not moving the needle and redirect focus toward measurable outcomes.
Lead one to two important projects concurrently; divide work for independent team execution and anticipate risks proactively.
Define and maintain project plans for larger initiatives; establish milestones, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
Define domain-level standards, patterns, and operational practices; steward elimination of tech debt, toil, and security issues across team-owned systems.
Lead high-quality code reviews that coach others and elevate review culture; simplify team-owned systems and build tools or documentation others adopt.
Design architecture and infrastructure patterns the team follows; make spike and MVP decisions and rally the team on scale, reliability, simplicity, and cost trade-offs.
Serve as a primary driver on production issues and post-mortems; define and monitor SLAs/SLOs where applicable and deliver durable operational fixes, including scale improvements.
Think systematically about evolution of production infrastructure, integrations, and cross-system dependencies across the domain.
Drive cross-team coordination and stakeholder communication; eliminate systemic toil and simplify systems at the domain level.
Mentor engineers across teams; contribute to hiring and partner with the Engineering Manager on team culture and psychological safety.
Improve how the team measures, communicates, and delivers customer impact; challenge inefficiency and drive continuous improvement.


Competencies

Probes to understand stated and unstated stakeholder needs; partners as a trusted domain advisor and shapes technical direction with Product and Architecture.
Monitors team and own deliverables against performance, time, budget, and quality standards; escalates risks early and redirects low-impact work.
Makes independent technical judgments in open-ended requirements; drives the greatest customer impact through business-aware decisions.
Identifies when self or team results are not moving the needle; works with the Engineering Manager to improve how impact is measured and communicated.
Defines solutions and practices that level up the team; stewards code quality, operational excellence, and pragmatic improvement across the domain.
Takes initiative to grow technical and leadership skills; shares learnings openly and leads by example under ambiguity.
Promotes productive conflict, disagree-and-commit, and constructive dialogue across teams and stakeholders.
Adapts effectively across cultures and unfamiliar situations; demonstrates urgency and composure on critical deliverables.
Unblocks others and eliminates toil through pragmatic technical insight, system simplification, and durable fixes.
Leads problem decomposition and decision-making with incomplete information; balances trade-offs across simplicity, performance, reliability, and cost.
Demonstrates excellent verbal, written, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills.
Uses AI tools (cursor/ claude/ pi) and agentic coding assistants effectively; guides adoption of practical patterns across the team and domain.


Technical Skills

An ideal candidate should have knowledge of and hands-on experience with the following technologies:


Required

Microsoft technologies: C# (.NET Core, .NET Framework), TypeScript, NestJS, and Node.js
Microservices and event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka or other event processing services
Modern UI frameworks: React.js or Angular
Cloud platforms (AWS preferred): EC2, S3, Lambda, EFS, ECS, EKS, API Gateway, SQS, IAM, VPC
Relational databases (MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, DocumentDB)
Docker and Kubernetes
CI/CD tools: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, YAML, PowerShell
Observability tools: Splunk, ELK Stack, DataDog
Testing strategies: Unit Testing, Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), Test-Driven Development (TDD)
RESTful APIs ; OpenAPI/Swagger , API design, and API versioning
Git -based source-code management, branching strategies, and code review leadership
Jira and Agile/Scrum practices


Nice to have

Knowledge of Python
Knowledge of data analytics tools such as Databricks
AWS or Azure Developer certification


Educational Qualifications

Graduate or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Job description



Role Summary

The AI/ML Engineer will develop, train, fine-tune, optimise and deploy machine learning, deep learning and large language models for text, document, image and speech applications. The role requires depth in modern model architectures and training methods, rigorous evaluation, and the engineering discipline to deliver models that are efficient, reliable and secure in production.




Educational Qualification

B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.S. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Electronics or a related discipline (Must have)
Advanced degree (M.Tech./M.S./Ph.D.) or published work in machine learning, NLP, computer vision or speech is highly desirable
Certifications are not mandatory; demonstrated work, as listed under Minimum Evidence at Screening, shall carry greater weight
Candidates from non-traditional backgrounds with strong verifiable work (published models, competition results or significant open-source contributions) will be considered in lieu of formal qualification



Experience

4+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML models (6+ years preferred); minimum 3 years training or fine-tuning deep learning models that were deployed in production
Demonstrable end-to-end delivery of at least two models, from data preparation through training, evaluation, optimisation and deployment, with measured outcomes
Demonstrable hands-on experience fine-tuning LLMs or other foundation models on domain data (supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning or preference optimisation), with documented evaluation against a baseline
Practical experience in at least two of the following: NLP and LLM applications, computer vision, document AI and OCR, speech recognition or synthesis, and predictive models on structured data
Experience optimising and serving models on GPUs to meet production latency and throughput targets
Experience in regulated sectors or with Indian-language data is a plus



Key Responsibilities




Model Development & Training

Develop, train and fine-tune machine learning and deep learning models for use cases such as text classification, summarisation, entity extraction, document understanding, image matching, object detection and speech recognition
Select architectures and pre-trained models suited to the task, the data and the deployment constraints, starting from strong baselines and preferring transfer learning to training from scratch
Build training data pipelines covering preprocessing, feature engineering, data augmentation and synthetic data where appropriate, with versioned datasets
Run reproducible, tracked experiments, including hyperparameter tuning, and perform systematic error analysis to improve accuracy, robustness and latency

LLM Adaptation & Applications

Fine-tune open-weight LLMs and embedding models through supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA), preference optimisation (DPO) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (GRPO and its variants), where these outperform prompting
Distil larger models into smaller, cost-efficient models suitable for production
Build retrieval-augmented and agentic systems with sound retrieval design, structured outputs and tool calling, integrated across commercial, cloud and self-hosted model providers through an abstraction layer
Engineer the context supplied to models (retrieved content, memory, tool outputs and instructions), and set reasoning and token budgets for reasoning models against cost and latency targets
Choose between prompting, retrieval, fine-tuning and smaller specialised models based on accuracy, cost, latency and data-governance requirements, and document the rationale

Computer Vision, Document & Speech AI

Develop document-understanding pipelines combining OCR, layout analysis and vision-language models for forms, scanned documents and handwritten records
Develop and fine-tune vision models for classification, detection, segmentation and image similarity, including embedding-based matching
Develop and fine-tune speech recognition and synthesis models, including for Indian languages and code-mixed speech

Inference Optimisation & Serving

Optimise models through quantisation (including FP8 and FP4 formats), pruning, distillation and compilation (ONNX, TensorRT), and apply serving optimisations such as continuous batching, prefix caching and speculative decoding
Benchmark accuracy, latency, throughput, memory and cost per request on CPU and GPU against defined service-level targets
Deploy models with production serving frameworks, including autoscaling, versioning and rollback, in coordination with the MLOps team
Monitor deployed models for accuracy drift, latency, GPU utilisation and cost, and feed production failures back into training and evaluation data

Evaluation & Quality

Define task-appropriate metrics (such as F1, AUC, BLEU, chrF, ROUGE, WER, CER and mAP), and build golden datasets, benchmarks and regression suites that run as release gates
Evaluate LLM and retrieval systems for groundedness, hallucination and retrieval quality, using LLM-based evaluation calibrated against human labels
Evaluate agentic systems on trajectories, tool-call correctness and task completion, and diagnose failures from execution traces
Conduct subgroup analysis across languages, demographics, document types and acoustic conditions, and work with QA on acceptance thresholds

Responsible AI, Safety & Privacy

Apply guardrails and test models for prompt injection, jailbreaks, leakage of personal data and unsafe outputs, in coordination with AI safety specialists
Measure and mitigate performance disparities across cohorts, and document models through model cards, dataset documentation and evaluation records
Apply anonymisation and data minimisation in training and inference in compliance with applicable data protection law, and verify the licences of models and datasets used

Collaboration & Mentoring

Work with data scientists, data engineers, MLOps and application teams to integrate models into production applications through well-defined APIs
Critically assess emerging models and research for practical value, review the work of junior engineers, and review model deliverables from external vendors




Technical Competencies

Programming: Python (expert level); SQL; Git; C++ or Rust for performance-critical components (desirable)
Deep Learning Frameworks: PyTorch (primary), JAX or TensorFlow; Hugging Face Transformers, Datasets and Accelerate
Model Architectures: transformers, mixture-of-experts and reasoning models; CNNs and vision transformers; conformer-based speech models; embedding and contrastive models
LLM Training & Adaptation: Hugging Face TRL and PEFT, Unsloth or Axolotl; verl or OpenRLHF for reinforcement learning; supervised fine-tuning, LoRA and QLoRA, DPO, GRPO and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards; distillation and synthetic data generation
GPU & Distributed Training: mixed-precision training, FlashAttention, working knowledge of CUDA and GPU profiling; PyTorch FSDP or DeepSpeed for multi-GPU training (desirable)
Inference Optimisation & Serving: quantisation (GPTQ, AWQ, FP8 or NVFP4); continuous batching, prefix caching and speculative decoding (such as EAGLE-3); vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or NVIDIA Triton Inference Server; ONNX Runtime; llama.cpp for CPU and edge deployment
Vision, Document & Speech: OpenCV; detection and segmentation models; vision-language models for document parsing (such as PaddleOCR-VL, Docling or the Qwen-VL family); speech recognition (IndicConformer, Whisper or newer open models) and speech synthesis
Indic Language AI: AI4Bharat models (IndicConformer, IndicTrans2, IndicBERT, Indic Parler-TTS), Sarvam models and Bhashini services; handling of code-mixed and transliterated text
LLM Applications & Agents: retrieval-augmented generation with hybrid search and re-ranking; vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Milvus or Weaviate); LangGraph or LlamaIndex; Model Context Protocol (MCP); context engineering; multi-provider integration through gateways such as LiteLLM
Evaluation: task-specific metrics; lm-evaluation-harness, RAGAS, DeepEval, promptfoo or Inspect; agent trajectory and tool-use evaluation; human evaluation and inter-annotator agreement
MLOps & Platforms: MLflow or Weights & Biases, DVC and model registries; Docker and Kubernetes; Ray (desirable); AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning or Google Vertex AI; Langfuse or Arize Phoenix for LLM tracing
AI Safety & Privacy: guardrail frameworks (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard), red-teaming tools (garak or PyRIT), anonymisation and working knowledge of differential privacy

Job description

Role Focus: Full-stack Python engineering with strong practical use of AI coding tools to accelerate analysis, development, testing, documentation and delivery - while maintaining code quality, security and human review.




Roles and Responsibilities

Be part of the Operational Excellence team, working on internal operations and client-facing technology projects.
Design, build, debug and maintain production-ready full-stack applications and automation solutions.
Work with internal teams and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Demonstrate strong logical aptitude, independent research capability and structured problem-solving.
Create and maintain clear technical documentation, solution designs, deployment notes and user documentation.
Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering speed, quality and consistency without compromising security, maintainability or validation.



Experience & Core Requirements

At least 5+ years of hands-on software development / coding experience, with strong Python and full-stack development expertise.
Proven experience owning applications from requirement analysis and solution design through development, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review, validate and improve both human-written and AI-generated code before production use.



Backend Development (Python / Django)

Design, develop and maintain scalable backend applications using Python, Django and Django REST Framework (DRF).
Build secure, reliable and efficient RESTful APIs and integrations for web applications and automation workflows.
Implement business logic, data models, database schemas, authentication, authorization and role-based access control.
Optimize application performance, API response times and database queries.
Write modular, reusable, testable and maintainable code following engineering best practices.



Frontend Development

Develop responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with practical experience in a modern framework such as React, Vue or Angular where applicable.
Integrate frontend components with backend APIs and handle validation, error states and user workflows.
Ensure cross-browser compatibility, accessibility considerations and mobile responsiveness.
Improve UI/UX based on user feedback, business needs and design guidelines.



AI-Assisted Software Development - Critical Requirement

Hands-on ability to use modern AI coding assistants / LLM-based development tools as part of day-to-day engineering work (for example, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent enterprise-approved tools).
Use AI effectively for code generation, refactoring, debugging, root-cause analysis, test-case generation, API integration, SQL/query assistance, documentation and rapid prototyping.
Write clear prompts and provide the right technical context so AI tools produce useful, maintainable and project-specific outputs.
Critically review AI-generated code for correctness, architecture, performance, security, edge cases, licensing concerns and maintainability; never treat generated code as automatically production-ready.
Use AI to accelerate delivery while retaining engineering ownership: understand the code, validate assumptions, run tests and be able to troubleshoot the solution without depending on AI.
Apply secure AI usage practices: do not expose credentials, client confidential data, production data or restricted source code to unapproved AI services; follow organizational AI/data-governance policies.
Identify repetitive development activities where AI or automation can reduce manual effort and improve developer productivity.
Keep up with practical developments in AI-assisted software engineering and evaluate new tools based on measurable engineering value rather than tool familiarity alone.



Database Management

Design and manage relational databases using PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server or SQLite as appropriate.
Write optimized SQL queries and use Django ORM effectively.
Perform database migrations, validation, data integrity checks and performance tuning.



DevOps & Deployment

Deploy and support Django/Python applications on enterprise servers, VPS/cloud environments or approved internal infrastructure.
Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing and deployment.
Use source control (Git) and disciplined branching, pull-request and code-review practices.
Monitor application health, logs, failures and performance, and support production troubleshooting.



Testing, Debugging & Code Quality

Write unit tests, integration tests, API tests and appropriate end-to-end tests.
Debug and resolve application issues efficiently using logs, traces, profiling and structured root-cause analysis.
Use AI-generated tests or debugging suggestions as accelerators, while independently validating coverage, correctness and edge cases.
Maintain code quality through reviews, static analysis, linting, dependency management and clear coding standards.



Security & Compliance

Implement web-application security best practices, including protection against CSRF, XSS, SQL injection, insecure authentication and common OWASP risks.
Handle sensitive and client data securely and comply with applicable organizational data-protection and information-security standards.
Protect secrets, API keys and credentials using approved secret-management practices.
Perform regular dependency/security reviews and remediate identified vulnerabilities.
Ensure use of AI tools complies with company/client security, confidentiality, intellectual-property and data-handling requirements.



Collaboration & Documentation

Collaborate with product/project managers, business stakeholders, designers, QA and infrastructure teams.
Participate in code reviews, solution reviews and agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
Document code, APIs, architecture, deployment procedures and key technical decisions.
Explain technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mentor team members and promote responsible, effective use of AI-assisted development practices.



People Skills and Other Personality Traits

Self-motivated and continuously willing to learn new technologies, frameworks and AI-enabled development methods.
High degree of creativity, curiosity and problem-solving ability.
Good time, priority and task management with a strong delivery mindset.
Ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, clients and cross-functional stakeholders.
Comfortable taking ownership, challenging AI output when necessary and making sound engineering decisions.



Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

Experience building solutions that integrate with external APIs, enterprise applications or workflow automation platforms.
Experience with Docker, cloud services, asynchronous/background processing, caching and observability tools.
Exposure to LLM APIs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings/vector databases, AI agents or AI-enabled application features is an advantage.
Experience establishing reusable prompts, coding standards or AI-assisted engineering workflows for development teams is an advantage.



What We Will Assess During Hiring

Python/Django and API engineering depth, database knowledge and full-stack problem-solving.
Ability to understand an existing codebase, debug issues and produce clean, production-quality changes.
Practical AI-assisted coding capability: how the candidate uses AI to accelerate work, verifies generated output and handles security/privacy constraints.
Ability to explain the reasoning, trade-offs and architecture behind code - including code initially suggested by an AI tool.
End-to-end ownership, communication and ability to convert business requirements into working solutions.



Shifts: EMEA-hybrid (5 days working)

Location: Mumbai/Pune/Chandigarh

Summary
As a Senior AWS Glue Data Engineer / AWS Glue Architect, you will design, develop, and implement enterprise-scale ETL and data integration solutions using AWS Glue and AWS cloud-native data services. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in AWS Glue ETL development, PySpark programming, AWS Lambda, IAM security, VPC networking, and serverless data engineering architectures.
The engineer will build scalable data pipelines, metadata-driven frameworks, and cloud-native integration solutions using AWS Glue, Glue Data Catalog, Lambda, S3, Athena, Redshift, Step Functions, EventBridge, and other AWS services. The role involves data ingestion, transformation, performance optimization, security implementation, monitoring, and production support following AWS best practices.

Roles & Responsibilities
1.Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-scale ETL pipelines using AWS Glue.
2.Develop and optimize AWS Glue Spark jobs using PySpark for large-scale data processing.
3.Create and manage AWS Glue components including Jobs, Crawlers, Data Catalog, Workflows, Triggers, Connections, and Job Bookmarks.
4.Build metadata-driven ETL frameworks using AWS Glue Data Catalog and configuration-based processing approaches.
5.Develop data ingestion and transformation pipelines from multiple sources including databases, APIs, files, and cloud platforms.
6.Integrate AWS Glue with AWS services including Lambda, S3, Athena, Redshift, Step Functions, EventBridge, and SQS.
7.Develop AWS Lambda functions for data processing, automation, event-driven workflows, and Glue job orchestration.
8.Configure and manage AWS IAM Roles, Policies, Permissions, and Security Controls for Glue jobs and AWS services.
9.Design and configure AWS VPC components including VPC endpoints, subnets, security groups, route tables, and network connectivity for AWS Glue workloads.
10.Configure AWS Glue connections for databases using JDBC connectivity.
11.Implement secure data integration solutions using JDBC, REST APIs, SFTP, and event-driven architectures.
12.Perform AWS Glue job tuning using Spark optimization techniques, partitioning, compression, caching, and performance best practices.
13.Implement data quality checks, validation frameworks, error handling, and reconciliation processes.
14.Monitor and troubleshoot AWS Glue jobs using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudWatch Logs, and AWS monitoring services.
15.Implement CI/CD pipelines for AWS Glue deployments using Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or AWS CodeBuild.
16.Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using AWS CloudFormation or AWS CDK.
17.Support production incidents, troubleshooting, performance issues, and operational improvements.
18.Collaborate with data architects, data engineers, application teams, and business stakeholders to deliver AWS data solutions.
19.Mentor team members on AWS Glue development standards, PySpark optimization, and AWS data engineering best practices.

Professional & Technical Skills
1.Strong hands-on experience with AWS Glue for ETL development, data integration, and data pipeline implementation.
2.Strong programming skills in Python, PySpark, and SQL for data transformation and processing.
3.Experience with AWS services including Lambda, S3, Athena, Redshift, Step Functions, and EventBridge.
4.Strong knowledge of AWS IAM Roles, Policies, Security Configuration, and VPC setup for secure data solutions.
5.Experience designing and optimizing AWS Glue ETL pipelines, Spark jobs, and data processing workflows.
6.Good understanding of Data Lake architecture, AWS Data Catalog, metadata management, and data governance.
7.Experience with CI/CD, Git, Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation/Terraform), Agile, and DevOps practices.

Additional Information
1.The candidate should have a minimum of 10 years of experience in AWS Glue.
2.This position is based at the Hyderabad office.
3.A minimum of 15 years of full-time education is required.

Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the worlds technology.


What We Offer


Location:
Bangalore,IND
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. Were committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our .
About the Role
Join Applied Materials as a PAM & Secrets Management Engineer to lead privileged access management and secrets management initiatives across our global enterprise infrastructure. You''ll architect and operate enterprise-scale PAM solutions (CyberArk) and HashiCorp Vault, working at the intersection of security, DevOps, and cloud platforms to protect critical systems and enable secure development.
Key Responsibilities
Privileged Access Management (PAM)
Design, implement, and manage enterprise PAM solutions at scale (500+ concurrent sessions, 2K+ daily logins, 2.5K+ targets)
Operate and maintain CyberArk self-hosted environment lead evaluation of alternatives (Delinea, BeyondTrust, CyberArk Privilege Cloud)
Architect privileged session management (PSM) for RDP, SSH with native client support and passwordless credential injection
Implement automated account discovery and onboarding workflows (Windows local, AD, Linux/Unix accounts)
Configure session recording, monitoring, and alerting for compliance and security
Troubleshoot and resolve PAM infrastructure stability issues (eliminating outages)
Secrets Management
Architect and operate HashiCorp Vault Enterprise at scale across multi-cloud environments
Implement Vault secrets engines: KV v2, Dynamic Secrets (LDAP, Azure, databases), PKI, Transit Encryption
Design and deploy Vault authentication methods: OIDC/JWT, Kubernetes, AppRole, AWS IAM, Azure AD
Configure Vault policies and namespaces for multi-tenant secret isolation
Integrate Vault with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) for secure secret injection
Implement Vault Agent and sidecar injectors for application secret delivery
Configure Vault auto-unseal with cloud KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP Cloud KMS)
Manage Vault high availability, disaster recovery, and performance tuning
Implement secret rotation automation for databases, cloud credentials, and API keys
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with CI/CD, Network, Cloud, and Platform teams to integrate PAM/SM controls
Lead incident response for privileged access breaches and secrets exposure events
Conduct security assessments and ensure compliance with SOX, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001
Automate PAM and Secret Management workflows using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible
Required Qualifications
Privileged Access Management (PAM) Expertise:
5+ years hands-on experience with enterprise PAM solutions at scale (10,000+ employees or global infrastructure)
Deep experience with privileged session management: RDP, SSH session recording, monitoring, and credential injection
Strong understanding of account lifecycle management: discovery, onboarding, rotation for Windows local, AD, Linux/Unix accounts
Experience with PAM platforms: CyberArk (PAS, PVWA, CPM, PSM) or equivalent (BeyondTrust, Delinea, Arcon)
Knowledge of least privilege principles and privilege elevation workflows
Experience integrating PAM with approval workflows (ServiceNow, ITSM tools)
Understanding of session isolation, credential vaulting, and password/SSH key rotation
Familiarity with PAM architecture: high availability, disaster recovery, horizontal scaling
Secrets Management Expertise:
3+ years hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault in production environments
Deep knowledge of Vault secrets engines: KV (v1/v2), Dynamic Secrets (databases, AWS, Azure), PKI, Transit, SSH, TOTP
Experience with Vault authentication methods: Kubernetes, AppRole, OIDC/JWT, AWS IAM, Azure AD, LDAP, TLS Certificates
Strong understanding of Vault policies, namespaces, and entity/identity management
Experience with Vault Agent, sidecar injectors, and application integration patterns
Knowledge of Vault operations: auto-unseal (HSM), replication (DR/Performance), backup/restore, upgrades
Experience integrating Vault with CI/CD pipelines for dynamic secret injection
Understanding of secret zero problem and secure secret bootstrap mechanisms
Technical & Cloud Skills:
Multi-cloud secrets management: AWS Secrets Manager/IAM, Azure Key Vault/Managed Identity, GCP Secret Manager
Experience with Kubernetes: Vault sidecar injection, CSI secret driver, external secrets operator
Proficiency in scripting and automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go (preferred)
Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform, Ansible (Vault configuration automation)
Understanding of PKI fundamentals: certificate lifecycle, CA hierarchies, mTLS, certificate-based authentication
Experience with Directory services: Active Directory, LDAP (for PAM/Vault integration)
Collaboration & Communication Skills:
Proven track record working with DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud, and Network teams
Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Ability to lead cross-functional PAM/SM initiatives and provide technical mentorship
Experience in incident response for privileged access and secret exposure events
Preferred Qualifications (Advantages)
CyberArk Certified: CyberArk Defender, Sentry, or Trustee certifications
Hands-on experience in Delinea Secret Server, BeyondTrust, Arcon, CyberArk Privilege Cloud
Experience with account discovery automation and policy-based onboarding at scale
HashiCorp Certified: Vault Associate or Vault Professional certification
Deep knowledge of Vault database secrets engine: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, MSSQL, Oracle dynamic credentials
Hands-on with Vault Transit engine: encryption-as-a-service, key derivation, convergent encryption
Experience with Vault SSH secrets engine: signed SSH certificates, OTP SSH, CA-based SSH access
Experience with Vault KMIP secrets engine for legacy application encryption key management
Experience with Vault monitoring: metrics (Prometheus), logging, audit logs, performance tuning
Certifications & Education:
Bachelor''s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field
Professional certifications: CyberArk CDE/Sentry, HashiCorp Vault Associate/Professional, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH
Cloud certifications: AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, GCP Security Engineer
Compliance & Architecture:
Deep knowledge of compliance frameworks: SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA
Experience with zero-trust architecture and secrets management in zero-trust models
Understanding of threat modeling for privileged access and secret exposure risks

Job description

Provide L3 operational support for clients cloud security, with primary accountability for Azure-native security controls and Prisma Cloud. The role will strengthen Zero Trust adoption, security posture management, vulnerability remediation, threat monitoring, incident response, automation, and compliance across cloud-hosted infrastructure, platforms, containers, and applications. AWS-native security services will be supported as a secondary capability.

Key Responsibilities

Support Zero Trust security architecture and execute preventive, detective, and corrective controls across cloud-hosted infrastructure, platforms, containers, and applications.
Monitor, assess, and report the security posture of cloud-native IaaS, PaaS, CaaS, and SaaS environments, including Nucleus.
Manage security findings and perform end-to-end vulnerability management, including identification, assessment, risk-based prioritisation, tracking, remediation, validation, and closure using Prisma Cloud.
Coordinate vulnerability management activities with application, infrastructure, platform, security, and business stakeholders, including exception handling, remediation planning, ageing reviews, and compliance reporting.
Conduct container image and Kubernetes security assessments, vulnerability scanning, remediation, configuration hardening, and validation for CaaS platforms.
Execute cloud infrastructure security assessments and configuration reviews against client’s security standards and applicable cloud-provider Well-Architected Framework guidance.
Develop, maintain, test, and execute security automation using Infrastructure as Code, CROC scripts, and remediation scripts to improve operational efficiency and reduce security risk.
Support application security activities, including vulnerability assessments, security reviews, remediation coordination, secure configuration validation, and closure evidence.
Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts, events, and threats through enterprise and cloud-native security monitoring platforms; escalate material risks in accordance with agreed procedures.
Support security incident response activities, including analysis, containment, recovery, evidence collection, root-cause analysis, and corrective action tracking.
Perform periodic access reviews and enforce identity, authentication, authorisation, and privileged-access controls aligned with Zero Trust principles.
Support audit, regulatory, compliance, and security governance requirements through evidence collection, control validation, reporting, and remediation tracking.
Create and maintain security operational documentation, standard operating procedures, remediation runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical support records.
Provide L3 troubleshooting, technical guidance, problem management, and escalations for complex cloud security issues; contribute to post-incident reviews and continual service improvement.

Required Technical Skills

Mandatory

Strong hands-on experience with Azure-native security services, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, Microsoft Entra ID, Privileged Identity Management, Azure Key Vault, Network Security Groups, Azure Firewall, Web Application Firewall, and Azure Monitor / Log Analytics.
Strong hands-on experience with Prisma Cloud for cloud security posture management, workload protection, vulnerability management, policy configuration, alert investigation, compliance reporting, and remediation tracking.
Practical knowledge of Zero Trust, cloud security architecture, identity and access management, network security, data protection, logging, monitoring, and incident response.
Experience securing containers and Kubernetes platforms, including image scanning, runtime findings, configuration assessment, secrets management, and hardening.
Experience performing cloud security assessments and configuration reviews using cloud-provider Well-Architected Framework security guidance.
Proficiency in at least two of the following scripting languages: Python, Bash, and PowerShell.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code and security automation; ability to review or develop remediation scripts and reusable controls.
Experience working with ITSM and ticketing platforms for incident, request, problem, change, vulnerability, and knowledge management.

Secondary

Working knowledge of AWS-native security services, such as AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, Inspector, Config, IAM, KMS, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, Macie, Network Firewall, and Web Application Firewall.
Ability to assess AWS security findings, support remediation, and interpret AWS-native security and compliance alerts.

Experience and Qualifications

Relevant experience in cloud security operations, engineering, or L3 support within a large enterprise environment.
Demonstrated experience managing high-priority security findings, complex technical incidents, stakeholder escalations, and remediation dependencies.
Good understanding of security governance, risk management, audit evidence, regulatory obligations, and control compliance.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Preferred Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate or equivalent Azure administration certification.
Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate or equivalent cloud security certification.
AWS Certified Solutions Architect or SysOps Administrator certification.
AWS Certified Security - Specialty.
Prisma Cloud, CNAPP, Kubernetes, or other relevant cloud-native security certification.

Soft Skills

Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain security risk, remediation actions, and operational impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong documentation discipline with the ability to create accurate runbooks, knowledge articles, incident records, and compliance evidence.
Effective stakeholder management, ownership, leadership, and coordination across distributed global teams.
Analytical problem-solving, attention to detail, sound judgement, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a security operations environment.
Proactive mindset focused on automation, risk reduction, service reliability, and continual improvement.

Success Measures

Timely triage, prioritisation, remediation, validation, and closure of cloud security findings.
Improved compliance with client’s security standards and reduced recurrence of security misconfigurations.
Accurate incident handling, root-cause analysis, operational reporting, and audit evidence.
Increased use of automated controls and remediation scripts to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
Clear ownership, stakeholder communication, and high-quality knowledge documentation.Role & responsibilities

Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the worlds technology.


What We Offer


Location:
Bangalore,IND
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. Were committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our .
Role Summary


The New Product Manufacturing Engineer II Senior supports new product introduction and sustaining engineering activities for medium-complexity assemblies and product structures. Working with moderate guidance, this role develops and releases product BOMs, manages engineering changes, creates manufacturing documentation, supports managed builds, and resolves manufacturing and configuration issues.

The engineer collaborates with Engineering, Product Lifecycle Management, Manufacturing, Sourcing, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and other cross-functional teams to ensure product configuration accuracy, manufacturing readiness, and effective implementation of engineering changes.


Key Responsibilities



Create and release new, alternate, and replacement part numbers in TCE/Core+ and applicable lifecycle management systems.



Maintain part attributes, specifications, effectivity, supporting documentation, and product configuration integrity.



Develop, implement, and maintain BOMs for medium-complexity assemblies and product structures.



Serve as the NPME focal point for BOM-related changes and ensure accuracy across released configurations.



Execute engineering change activities, including ECOs, NSRs, ESWs, Config ESWs, OCRs, ILTRs, SPSs, and CCB actions.



Create and validate configuration kits, option packages, and supporting documentation in partnership with PLM.



Develop and validate Operation Method Sheets and other manufacturing build and test documentation.



Support 3D virtual product analysis, Master Layout, Digital Mock-Up, and design reviews.



Provide Design for Excellence feedback to improve manufacturability, quality, cost, serviceability, and cycle time.



Analyze excess, no-demand, and potentially obsolete inventory exposure resulting from BOM, option, and OBS changes.



Support OBS impact analysis, manufacturing implementation planning, and product structure updates.



Lead managed builds for assigned assemblies or modules and support manufacturing readiness.



Drive root cause and corrective action activities related to BOM, configuration, documentation, and implementation issues.



Provide technical support and training to internal manufacturing teams, contract manufacturers, and suppliers.



Document product issues, improvement opportunities, corrective actions, and lessons learned.



Provide informal technical and process guidance to new team members.



Perform other duties as assigned.



EXPERIENCE : 7 to 10 years



Required Skills and Competencies



Bill of Materials and product structure management



Part number creation and engineering release processes



Engineering change control and configuration management



New product introduction and manufacturing readiness



Manufacturing build and test documentation



Managed Build execution and floor support



Root cause analysis and manufacturing issue resolution



Design for Excellence and early product development engagement



Inventory impact and implementation analysis



Basic knowledge of CAD, Digital Mock-Up, and virtual build processes



Project coordination and cross-functional collaboration



Clear written and verbal communication skills



Ability to analyze straightforward technical issues using established procedures, experience, and judgment




Leadership and Impact



Works independently on assigned responsibilities with moderate guidance.



Leads defined manufacturing, change implementation, managed build, and issue-resolution activities.



Provides informal guidance to new team members without direct supervisory responsibility.



Influences the quality and accuracy of personal deliverables and contributes to the effectiveness of the broader team.



Escalates technical, schedule, configuration, and implementation risks when additional support is required.

Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information


Impact
Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies


Interpersonal Skills

Job description

What you will do

Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.
Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers.
Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.
Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes.
Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas.
Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses.
Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations.
Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.
Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis.

Must-have qualifications

1. Technical

5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company.
Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as Java, C++, C#, Python, etc.
Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code.
Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems.
Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.

2. Behavioral

Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
Willingness to challenge assumptions.
Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.
Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.
Strong ownership of difficult investigations

Job description

Role & responsibilities

The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of all electrical systems and equipment within the factory premises. This includes HT/LT power distribution infrastructure, CNC and PLC-based machine controls, industrial ovens, DG sets, APFC panels, and all associated electrical utilities. The role demands a hands-on professional capable of ensuring maximum uptime, safety, and energy efficiency across the plant.





Preferred candidate profile




1. HT Line & Power Distribution

Oversee the operation and maintenance of HT (High Tension) electrical incoming supply, including HT breakers, CTs, PTs, metering panels, and protection relays.
Ensure compliance with State Electricity Board regulations and liaise with authorities for HT line-related matters, shutdowns, and inspections.
Coordinate annual preventive maintenance and testing of HT equipment including relay testing, insulation resistance, and oil filtration.

2. Transformer Maintenance

Manage routine maintenance and condition monitoring of power transformers, including oil level checks, BDV testing, winding resistance, and temperature monitoring.
Plan and execute annual transformer maintenance schedules and ensure availability of critical spares such as bushings, gaskets, and breather silica gel.
Maintain transformer protection systems including Buchholz relay, OTI/WTI, PRV, and surge arrestors.

3. MCC, PCC & APFC Panels

Ensure reliable operation of Main MCC (Motor Control Centre), PCC (Power Control Centre), and sub-distribution panels.
Carry out periodic inspection, thermography, busbar torquing, and maintenance of all LT panels.
Maintain APFC (Automatic Power Factor Correction) panels to keep power factor above 0.99 and minimise penalty from the electricity board.
Monitor and replace capacitor banks, contactors, and APFC relay controllers as per maintenance schedules.

4. DG Set Operation & Maintenance

Ensure DG sets are maintained in ready-to-start condition for seamless power backup during grid failures.
Manage DG AMC contracts, fuel monitoring, load bank testing, and AMF (Auto Mains Failure) panel functionality.
Maintain synchronisation panels where multiple DG sets are installed.

5. CNC & PLC Based Machine Maintenance

Troubleshoot and maintain electrical systems of CNC machines, including servo drives, spindle drives, VFDs, encoders, proximity sensors, and limit switches.
Diagnose and rectify faults in PLC-based automation systems, including I/O modules, communication networks (Profibus, Profinet, Modbus), and HMI interfaces.
Maintain and backup PLC programs and CNC parameters; coordinate with OEM service engineers during major breakdowns and retrofits.
Ensure proper grounding, shielding, and EMC compliance of CNC and PLC installations.

6. Industrial Oven Maintenance

Maintain electrical systems of industrial ovens, including heating elements, thyristor / SCR controllers, PID temperature controllers, and thermocouples/RTDs.
Ensure proper functioning of safety interlocks, over-temperature protection, and alarm systems on all oven installations.
Troubleshoot control panel issues including contactors, timers, and solid-state relays used in oven heating circuits.

7. Preventive & Predictive Maintenance

Develop, implement, and continuously improve the Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedule for all electrical assets.
Deploy predictive maintenance techniques such as IR thermography, insulation resistance testing, vibration analysis for motors, and power quality analysis.
Maintain a comprehensive equipment history log and use CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management System) for tracking work orders, spares, and downtime.

8. Safety, Compliance & Energy Management

Ensure strict compliance with Electrical Safety rules, IS standards, IE Act, and CEA regulations applicable to HT installations.
Implement and enforce LOTO (Lock out Tag Out) procedures, work permit systems, and arc flash safety protocols.
Conduct periodic earth resistance testing, lightning protection audits, and insulation checks.
Drive energy conservation initiatives, monitor energy KPIs (kWh/unit of production), and identify opportunities for demand-side management.
Coordinate with the Electrical Inspector and statutory authorities for periodic inspections, licence renewals, and compliance certifications.

9. Team Management & Coordination

Lead and supervise a team of electricians and electrical technicians; assign daily tasks, monitor performance, and ensure skill development.
Coordinate with production, quality, and other departments for planned shutdowns and maintenance windows.
Manage electrical spare parts inventory and procurement in coordination with the stores and purchase departments.

Prepare and maintain electrical SLDs (Single Line Diagrams), panel schedules, cable schedules, and equipment documentation.

Job description

Role Overview

A mid-sized SaaS product organization develops AI-powered, codeless test automation for banking and retail clients. This mid-senior role is for a consultant who delivered hands-on SAP functional implementation work before moving into SAP testing and automation. The consultant reports through a matrixed product and delivery structure, partnering with engineering, quality, business and client-facing teams and engaging senior leadership as needed. Implementation knowledge should inform test coverage, defect analysis, automation design and reliable release decisions.




Role location: Bengaluru (South).




Key Responsibilities

Analyse business processes in the assigned SAP functional module or modules, clarify approved requirements and identify the controls and transactions that testing must protect.
Translate implementation knowledge, process flows and functional specifications into traceable acceptance criteria and realistic test scenarios for business-critical workflows.
Review SAP configuration against agreed requirements and explain the functional implications of changes, dependencies and exceptions to delivery stakeholders.
Plan risk-based functional, system integration, user acceptance, smoke, regression and end-to-end test coverage across enhancements, rollouts and releases.
Prepare test data and expected results that reflect master data, transactional dependencies, permissions and downstream process outcomes.
Execute test cycles, retain clear evidence, record actual outcomes and distinguish configuration defects from data, interface and automation issues.
Develop, customize and debug JavaScript-based automated SAP tests and reusable components for stable, high-value regression scenarios.
Convert suitable manual scenarios into maintainable automated checks without losing business intent, assertions or requirements traceability.
Validate interfaces and cross-functional hand-offs with business users, ABAP developers, quality engineers and integration teams.
Document defects with reproducible steps, business impact, priority, supporting evidence and explicit retest and closure criteria.
Maintain regression assets, script reviews, version control, execution schedules, coverage records and release-readiness evidence.
Communicate risks, coverage gaps, defect trends and release recommendations; support cutover, go-live and post-production validation when relevant.



Required Qualifications

A bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, is required. Candidates must demonstrate direct SAP functional implementation contribution before their testing career, sound business-process knowledge and working JavaScript proficiency for automation. No certification is mandatory.




Required Experience

A minimum of 5 years of directly relevant SAP functional experience is required; 5–10 years is the preferred range. The candidate must have worked hands-on on at least one SAP implementation before moving into SAP testing or automation, with attributable functional responsibilities such as requirements analysis, functional specifications, configuration validation, integration or cutover and go-live support. Testing-only tenure, even across SAP projects, does not satisfy the implementation requirement. Subsequent ownership of structured SAP functional, system integration, user acceptance and regression testing is required. Experience in banking or retail enterprise programs is useful but not mandatory.




Technical and Functional Skills

Depth in at least one SAP functional module and the related business processes, master data, transactions, configuration and cross-functional dependencies is essential. The role requires requirements mapping, functional specification documents (FSDs), configuration validation, test design, requirements traceability, test data, defect lifecycle management and release evidence. Candidates must write, adapt and debug JavaScript ES6+ automation scripts, use reusable components and maintain SAP regression coverage in a JavaScript-based framework or a comparable codeless or code-assisted platform. Working knowledge of web interfaces, HTML, CSS, DOM behaviour, REST APIs and JSON supports integration validation. Collaboration with ABAP teams is necessary; ABAP development ownership is not required.




Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies

Explain business-process risks clearly to users, engineers, quality teams and delivery leaders. Show analytical discipline, careful evidence handling, practical prioritization and the ability to isolate the cause of a failed process or automated check. Take ownership of follow-through from test design to defect closure while working constructively in a cross-functional, matrixed team.




Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications

End-to-end implementation experience from discovery through stabilization, exposure to more than one SAP module or enterprise integration pattern, and work in banking or retail environments strengthen an application. Relevant SAP, testing or automation certifications, reusable automation design, API-assisted validation and experience with codeless or code-assisted tools are valuable.




Professional Tenure and Background

A strong profile shows a clear progression from SAP functional implementation into testing and automation, with increasing responsibility for business outcomes. Experience may come from consulting firms, enterprise technology providers, product teams or complex client-side SAP programs. Candidates should distinguish work they personally owned from team deliverables and be able to explain verifiable improvements in process reliability, coverage, defect resolution or regression execution. Employer brand alone is not a substitute for direct implementation evidence.




Compensation and Benefits

Compensation is considered in relation to directly relevant experience, skill depth, role complexity, interview evidence, current compensation, market demand and internal parity. Benefit details and applicable employment terms will be shared during the selection process.




Application Instructions

Send a resume naming this role to careers@execvera.com, by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp at 9071197415. Detail your SAP implementation project, module, functional deliverables, later testing scope, JavaScript automation, measurable outcomes, notice period and availability.

Nybsys designs and deploys LTE/5G RAN, small cell, and IoT connectivity solutions, built on FPGA- and SoC-based RF and baseband platforms. The Dhaka engineering team supports hardware development, bring-up, and field performance work across this product line.

We're looking for a mid-level FPGA Engineer to join a RF project. Interface FPGA logic with baseband SoC and RF transceiver subsystems
Collaborate with PCB/hardware design and RF teams on the pin mapping, and signal integrity
Develop and maintain test benches, verification plans, and bring-up/validation documentation
Support New Product Introduction (NPI) test coverage and production validation for FPGA-Board functionality
Participate in design reviews; provide technical input on interface architecture and timing budgets
Package and escalate hardware/firmware defects with structured evidence (logs, waveforms, register dumps)
