Job Responsibilities / Description:
Job Context
JIBON is a climate-resilience project implemented by FIVDB supported by Plan International Bangladesh in the flood- and flash-flood-prone haor areas of Sunamganj. The project aims to build climate-resilient communities, climate-adaptive livelihoods and stronger community and government preparedness. A major part of the project is climate-resilient infrastructure and WASH in cluster villages, including:
Women-friendly and flood-resilient community water networks, with community water management committees
Household latrine network with septic tanks in cluster villages
Raising of earthen cluster-village plinths to reduce flood vulnerability
Rehabilitation of flood-resilient, child-friendly houses using durable local materials
Repair/maintenance of protective community infrastructure based on RRAP priorities, jointly with the Union Parishad
Solar-light access roads connecting households to markets and services
Build Back Safer training for local masons/carpenters, and training and tool kits for local WASH technicians
The duration of the project is up to June 30, 2027, and the job is contractual for the project period.
Major Duties and Responsibilities
A. Site Assessment and Feasibility
Carry out technical site assessments for all planned schemes (water networks, latrines, floating latrines, plinth raising, houses, roads and community infrastructure) together with communities, DMCs and the Union Parishad.
Record site data such as highest flood level (HFL), soil condition, groundwater and arsenic/iron situation, land ownership, access, and seasonal workability in haor areas.
Prepare site assessment reports with photos, GPS points, sketches and recommendations, and share them with the Project Coordinator.
B. Design, Estimation and Procurement Support
Prepare or adapt technical designs, drawings, specifications and BoQs/cost estimates following DPHE, LGED and WASH Sector standards, with plinths and facilities raised above HFL.
Make sure designs are women-friendly, child-friendly and disability-accessible (ramps, handrails, lighting, privacy, menstrual hygiene facilities).
Obtain approval of designs and estimates from the Project Coordinator and Plan International, and required permission/clearance from DPHE, LGED and the Union Parishad.
Prepare technical specifications, take part in tender/quotation evaluation, and check the quality of materials on delivery.
C. Construction Supervision and Quality Monitoring
Supervise all construction work regularly on site; make sure work follows the approved design, BoQ, specification and timeline.
Material testing (bricks, cement, sand, rods), concrete mix and curing, compaction of earth fill, tube well drilling and bore log, platform and pipe work, and water quality testing (arsenic, iron, E. coli) before use.
Keep site order books, measurement books, daily work logs and material registers; check and certify contractor bills based on actual measurement.
Make sure occupational health and safety, safeguarding and environmental standards are followed at all sites; stop or correct sub-standard work.
Plan the construction calendar around the haor dry season and flash-flood risk; flag delays and risks early and propose solutions.
Mobilize community contribution and involve UP/DMC members and community committees in monitoring.
D. Completion, Handover and Sustainability
Conduct final inspection and functionality testing; prepare completion reports and as-built drawings for every scheme.
Form and orient community water management committees and caretakers on operation and maintenance (O&M), and set up simple O&M and user-fee systems.
Facilitate Build Back Safer training for local masons/carpenters and training for local WASH technicians, including distribution of tool kits.
E. Documentation, Reporting and Sharing
Prepare and share assessment, design, BoQ, approvals, measurement and bills, test results, photos (before/during/after), completion and handover papers.
Maintain a scheme database (location, GPS, beneficiaries disaggregated by sex, age and disability, cost, status) in coordination with the MEAL Officer.
F. Coordination, Capacity Building and Cross-cutting
Coordinate with DPHE, LGED, Union Parishad, Upazila DMC, DRRO and other stakeholders; attend relevant coordination meetings.
Give technical guidance and on-the-job coaching to Field Facilitators and other project staff.
Support emergency response (rapid assessment, safe water, emergency WASH repairs) during floods/flash floods as needed.
Follow FIVDB and Plan International policies on safeguarding, child protection, PSEA, gender equality, anti-fraud and accountability (CFRM).
Carry out any other relevant tasks assigned by the supervisor.

At least 5 years
The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO

Diploma in Civil
Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised polytechnic institute.

Additional Requirements:
Age At least 30 years

At least 1–2 years of experience working in haor, flood-prone or similar hard-to-reach contexts (Sunamganj/Sylhet region preferred).

Job Responsibilities / Description:
About Us
Plug & Solve (plugandsolve.com) is a small US software product studio. We build, launch and run our own apps, published on the Google Workspace Marketplace. We are now extending that portfolio to the Atlassian Marketplace with apps built on the Forge platform, and we are launching a developer staff augmentation service alongside it.
The Role
We are hiring one full-stack developer to own the technical side of both parts of the business, long term.
When you are booked with a client, you work on that client's projects as part of their team. Our clients are mainly software companies in Germany and elsewhere in Europe. When you are not booked, you work on our own Marketplace apps. That means there is always meaningful work, you are never idle between client bookings, and you get variety: real client products alongside our own product line. Client work runs during the client's business hours, which means your working week follows theirs: Monday to Friday, with Saturday and Sunday off, and Friday a working day. No night shifts, and your Friday Jummah prayer time is protected.
This is not a short term project. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with a product business and take genuine ownership of what they build.
Hours And Start Date
Five days a week, 40 hours. When you are not placed with a client, your working times are flexible. When you are placed with a client, you keep an overlap of at least four hours with the client's core hours every working day. No night shifts. We would like to fill the role as soon as possible.
What You Will Be Working On
On our own products:
Building apps for the Atlassian Marketplace on the Forge platform
Owning the full development lifecycle, from spec to deployment to post launch iteration
Building Custom UI components in React that run inside Jira and Confluence
Writing backend logic in Node.js and TypeScript using Forge resolvers and Forge storage
Integrating with the Jira REST API, the Confluence REST API and external services such as LLM APIs and webhooks
Maintaining and iterating on our live products based on real user feedback
On client work (staff augmentation):
Delivering development work for client projects when booked, as part of the client's team
Communicating clearly and professionally with the client on progress, blockers and timelines
Across both, we expect you to flag problems early rather than going quiet.

Location:

Duration of the Position:
Initially for one year with the possibility of annual renewal up to the project period.
Background of the project
Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF), an apex development organization focusing on holistic and integrated approaches, was established by the Government of Bangladesh in May 1990 for sustainable poverty reduction through employment generation. PKSF has been implementing projects and programs in diversified sectors including sustainable enterprise, training and education, agriculture, climate change and disaster, and so on. PKSF works with more than 15 million households through its 200 partner organizations. Many development partners, such as the World Bank, DFID, EU, ADB, IFAD, GIZ, GCF, and Adaptation Fund (AF), are working with PKSF. Please visit http://www.pksf.org.bd for details.
PKSF has been accredited to the Green Climate Fund (GCF), the only dedicated and largest climate change finance window, established under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), in 2013. The GCF has approved the ECCCP-Drought project in fact that Bangladesh faces an unpredictable drought hazard due to inadequate and uneven rainfall that affects the timing of the onset and end of the monsoon season. The northwestern Barind region/districts of Bangladesh suffer the most from droughts. Climate change is changing the nature of droughts in Barind by increasing temperature and variations in precipitation. During droughts, almost all-natural surface water sources evaporate, leaving none for drinking, sanitation, or agriculture. The human cost is measured in a greater incidence of disease, especially among children, and lack of nutrition due to crop failure, increased poverty, and reduced development potential.
Objective of the project
The main objective of the project is to increase the resilience of climate-vulnerable communities in drought-prone areas of Bangladesh. This objective is expected to be achieved by implementing activities covering three main components: i) improved institutional and technical capacities to address climate change-induced drought, ii) increased availability of surface and groundwater for irrigation and drinking, and iii) drought-resilient livelihoods created through sustainable agricultural production.
Resource Integration Center (RIC) was established as a non-government organization in 1981; however registered with Govt. regulatory authority in 1982. RIC developed a traditional focus on rural sector development, particularly targeting women. Since that time, through innovation, dedication, and hard work, RIC has been able to progress and diversify to become a national-level NGO active across the country and in many development areas.
RIC’s operations cover 407 upazilas under 54 districts, through 422 branches, with its “Finance for Socio-Economic Empowerment (microcredit) Program for the rural & urban poor, especially women and elderly people of society, to support micro-investment opportunities in income-generating activities for achieving their sustainable livelihood.
RIC is going to implement the GCF & PKSF-funded ECCCP-Drought project at Gomastapur Upazila of Chapainawabganj District and Mohonpur Upazila of Rajshahi Sadar District. For implementing the project, Extended Community Climate Change Project – Drought of RIC is seeking qualified candidates for the position of “Technical Officer (Engineer)” in its Project Management Unit (PMU) of the ECCCP-Drought project.

Job Responsibilities / Description:
Job Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented
5-Axis CNC Turn-Mill Machine Operator & Programmer
to join our manufacturing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for set-up, programming, operation, precision quality control, tool management, and basic troubleshooting of complex 5-axis turn-mill machinery.
Key Responsibilities
1. Machine Setup
Set up 5-axis CNC turn-mill machines according to engineering drawings and setup sheets.
Install and accurately align chucks, collets, fixtures, and work-holding devices.
Load and set cutting tools, inserts, drills, boring bars, and auxiliary tooling.
Establish precise tool geometry, wear offsets, and perform workpiece alignment/runout checks.
2. Program Operation
Load, verify, and simulate/dry-run CNC programs prior to machining.
Make minor program adjustments and offset corrections as needed.
Safely restart machines after tool changes, mid-process interruptions, or program stops.
3. Machine Operation
Efficiently load and unload raw materials and finished components.
Execute multi-axis turning, facing, boring, threading, drilling, and milling operations.
Continuously monitor spindle load, cutting conditions, coolant flow, and chip evacuation.
Dynamically adjust speeds, feeds, and tool offsets to optimize machining efficiency.
4. Quality Control & Inspection
Read and interpret complex engineering drawings, dimensional tolerances, and GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing).
Perform first-off and ongoing production component inspections.
Proficiently use measuring tools including vernier calipers, micrometers, bore gauges, height gauges, and dial indicators.
Apply offset corrections proactively to ensure parts remain within specified tolerances.
5. Tool Management
Monitor tool wear throughout production runs.
Replace, index, and reset inserts and worn cutters.
Select appropriate tooling tailored to specific workpiece materials and operations.
Maintain accurate tool-life and usage records where required.
6. Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Identify and resolve issues such as dimensional variations, poor surface finishes, tool breakage, excessive chatter, and coolant/chip flow problems.
Implement immediate corrective actions for minor issues and escalate major machine or programming failures to the production supervisor or programmer.
7. Maintenance & Housekeeping
Check and maintain lubrication levels, coolant concentration, and system pressure.
Clean chips and clear work areas following standard
5S
protocols and safety standards.
Perform routine preventive machine maintenance.

title: Data Engineer - Level 2
description:
Position Summary

The Data Engineer 2 builds and operates the pipelines and datasets that the business runs on. This is a hands-on delivery role: the engineer owns pipelines end to end (ingestion, transformation, publishing, monitoring, and support) and is expected to contribute to design decisions above the level of an individual job, particularly in orchestration, data lineage, and how curated data is modeled and exposed to downstream consumers.

Beyond conventional ETL, this role builds the curated, well-described datasets that analytics tools and AI systems consume. A successful candidate can explain not only how to move data, but why a given storage format, partition layout, or table design is the right one, and what breaks downstream when it is wrong.




Responsibilities

·        Build and maintain batch, incremental, and near-real-time pipelines that extract from transactional databases, SaaS and internal APIs, file feeds, and event streams, and load to databases, data lakes, and data warehouses.

·        Implement change data capture (CDC) on high-volume source tables, handling schema drift, late-arriving and out-of-order records, soft deletes, and replays.

·        Write idempotent, restartable jobs: re-running a pipeline for a given partition or window produces the same result without duplicating or losing rows.

·        Apply the correct load pattern for the volume and business need, whether full refresh, watermark-based incremental, merge/upsert, or slowly changing dimension (Type 1 and Type 2), and justify the choice.

·        Write and tune complex SQL: window functions, multi-CTE transformations, set operations. Read the query plan and address the actual cause of slowness (scan volume, distribution skew, spill to disk, poor join order) rather than adding hardware.

·        Apply business rules and integration logic in a testable, documented layer rather than embedded in ad-hoc scripts.

·        Designing the orchestration layer, task dependencies, and observability. Responsibilities include implementing backfill mechanisms, managing failure strategies, and creating thorough documentation.

·        Modeling data for consumption with clear definitions of grain, keys, and measures, alongside an understanding of columnar storage mechanics like Parquet and ORC. Responsibilities include applying physical design principles for columnar warehouses, managing file layouts in object storage, and working with non-transactional stores while evaluating and defending the appropriate storage solution for various workloads.

·        Designing automated lineage capture at table and column levels, ensuring that documentation stays current with orchestration and transformation changes. Responsibilities include maintaining dataset catalogs with essential details, performing impact analysis before schema changes, and implementing data quality gates to prevent erroneous data from being published. Additionally, focuses on supporting auditability and reproducibility while applying least-privilege access and data retention rules.

·        Thorough testing before code promotion, including unit tests and validation against source counts, along with ensuring the target environment is ready for initial data loads. Providing production support for pipelines, managing failures with a focus on root causes, participating in an on-call rotation for incidents, and working within a Git-based workflow with peer reviews. Additionally, comprehensive documentation is essential to ensure that datasets and pipelines can be operated by others without assistance.

·        Translating business questions from various stakeholders into clear data requirements while suggesting alternative solutions when appropriate. Responsibilities include participating in design and code reviews to address concerns regarding maintainability, cost, and data accuracy, as well as mentoring Level 1 engineers in SQL, pipeline patterns, and debugging techniques.

·        Provide production support for the pipelines you own: triage and root-cause failures, communicate impact and ETA to affected consumers, then eliminate the class of failure rather than only the instance.




Required Qualifications

·        Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

·        At least 3 years building and operating production data pipelines (not solely analytics or reporting work).

·        Strong Python at production quality: modular code, error handling, logging, configuration, and tests, well beyond one-off scripts.

·        Advanced SQL, including window functions, multi-step CTE transformations, and set operations; able to read an execution plan and explain why a query is slow and what to change.

·        Hands-on AWS data services: S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift, plus at least one of DMS, Kinesis, EMR, Step Functions, or Athena.

·        Demonstrable understanding of columnar storage and columnar analytical databases: file formats, encoding and compression, partitioning and pruning, and their effect on query cost.

·        Experience loading and querying non-transactional stores, including a data lake on object storage; able to explain how lake and warehouse workloads differ.

·        Production experience with at least one orchestration framework, and the ability to reason about workflow design, dependencies, idempotency, retries, and backfills rather than only clicking through a UI.

·        Data modeling ability: dimensional and/or wide-table designs, grain and key definition, and slowly changing dimensions.

·        Data quality as routine practice: automated tests and reconciliation as part of delivery, not an afterthought.

·        Experience with Git branching, pull requests, and CI-based deployment.

·        Clear written and verbal communication. Able to document a dataset so that someone who did not build it can use it correctly, and able to explain a data issue to a non-technical stakeholder.

·        Ability to analyze broad, ambiguous data needs and decompose them into deliverable work.




Preferred Qualifications

·        Open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Hudi) and lakehouse architecture in production.

·        A transformation framework with built-in testing, documentation, and lineage, such as dbt.

·        Asset-based or flow-based orchestration (Dagster, Prefect) in addition to AWS-native workflow services.

·        Lineage and catalog tooling: AWS Glue Data Catalog, OpenLineage/Marquez, DataHub, OpenMetadata, Amundsen, Collibra, or Alation.

·        Streaming and CDC at scale: Kinesis, Kafka/MSK, Debezium, or equivalent, including exactly-once and ordering concerns.

·        Distributed query and processing engine tuning: Spark, Trino, or Athena.

·        Exposure to serving data to LLMs or AI agents, such as MCP servers, semantic layers, text-to-SQL, or retrieval and vector stores, plus awareness of the failure modes (ambiguous columns, unbounded scans, leaked sensitive fields, stale context).

·        Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK) and containerized workloads.

·        Cost awareness and optimization: attributing and reducing storage, scan, and compute cost.

·        Familiarity with the downstream BI layer and how modeling decisions constrain it.

·        Domain exposure to e-commerce, print or custom manufacturing, or high-volume order data: orders, SKUs and product configuration, pricing, fulfillment, and marketing attribution.

We are seeking a highly technical Senior Web Application Penetration Testing Engineer to perform deep offensive security testing of complex web applications and APIs. This is a hands-on role focused on identifying vulnerabilities that conventional automated testing frequently misses, including business-logic flaws, authorization bypasses, privilege escalation paths, API abuse, and multi-step attack chains. A major component of the role is the practical use of approved offensive AI technologies to augment penetration testing. The engineer will apply AI-assisted techniques to accelerate reconnaissance and application analysis, develop and prioritize vulnerability hypotheses, identify promising attack paths, correlate findings, and improve the depth and coverage of expert-led manual testing.

Key responsibilities

Perform full-scope penetration testing of customer-facing and internal web applications, APIs, and supporting services

Conduct threat modeling and analyze application architecture, trust boundaries, authentication mechanisms, authorization models, APIs, data flows, and critical business workflows

Perform deep manual security testing that goes well beyond automated scanners and standard vulnerability checklists

Identify and exploit complex vulnerabilities, including broken access control, IDOR/BOLA/BFLA, authentication and session weaknesses, business-logic abuse, injection, API authorization failures, privilege escalation, server-side validation failures, and multi-step attack chains

Develop reproducible proofs-of-concept that clearly demonstrate technical and business impact

Test with multiple identities, roles, privilege levels, and workflow states to expose authorization and process-control weaknesses

Leverage approved offensive AI technologies and LLM-based security tooling throughout the penetration-testing lifecycle

Use AI to assist with reconnaissance, attack-surface analysis, endpoint and API analysis, test-case generation, vulnerability hypothesis development, and attack-path identification

Independently validate AI-generated findings and construct reproducible proofs-of-concept before reporting them

Produce high-quality reports with executive summaries, technical analysis, clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, risk context, and actionable remediation guidance

Requirements:

5+ years of hands-on application security or penetration-testing experience, with substantial experience testing web applications and APIs

Advanced understanding of HTTP, browsers, authentication, authorization, session management, REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and modern web architectures

Demonstrated ability to discover business-logic and authorization vulnerabilities through manual analysis rather than relying primarily on scanners

Advanced hands-on experience with Burp Suite Professional and related offensive-security tooling

Strong knowledge of the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide, OWASP Top 10, and OWASP API Security Top 10

Ability to manually analyze and manipulate HTTP/API requests, parameters, tokens, headers, cookies, payloads, and application state

Ability to develop scripts or lightweight tooling in Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, Bash, or an equivalent language

Demonstrated hands-on experience using LLMs or AI-assisted security technologies in offensive-security workflows

Ability to combine AI reasoning with expert manual penetration testing rather than treating AI output as authoritative

Strong technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex exploitation paths to technical and executive audiences

title: Mid-Level Full Stack Developer
description:
About the role

You'll build client websites from the frontend through to the CMS and Laravel API, then help deploy and maintain them on AWS. You should already be comfortable delivering working features and looking after a live application, with code review and collaboration as part of the job.

₱40,000 to ₱45,000 depending on what you bring, plus ₱2,850 a month in non-taxable allowances — rice, uniform and laundry — and a meal allowance for days you're in the office. Four days in Salcedo Village, Fridays from home.

Our clients include banks, insurers, hospitals, airports and listed companies: Aboitiz Land, InLife Benefits, St. Luke's, Mactan-Cebu Airport, RCBC and Robinsons. Their teams notice the details, from how a page matches the design to whether it loads quickly and works properly on a phone.

Projects follow a consistent process: build the frontend page by page, add the CMS so the client can update the content, and connect the Laravel API. Your work goes through code review before it ships, and you'll take part in reviewing other people's work too.

AWS experience matters here because some of our websites run on servers we manage ourselves. You should be able to deploy an application to EC2 or Lightsail, work with Linux over SSH, check logs, handle domains and HTTPS certificates, and explain how you would restore a backup or roll back a failed deployment. A certificate is welcome, but what matters is what you've actually operated.

This is a hands-on development role. You'll own the features and routine deployment work assigned to you, document changes, and raise issues early when they affect security, availability or the wider system. Major architecture changes and serious incidents need coordination with the team.

We use AI coding assistants day to day. They're useful tools, and you're still responsible for understanding, testing and reviewing the code you deliver. It's a small team: your work is visible, client feedback reaches you directly, and you'll be asked what you think. Launch weeks can be busy; quieter weeks give you room to improve the work and learn.

Send us examples of websites you've built, and tell us about one you've deployed or maintained on AWS. Be clear about which parts you personally handled.

What you'll do

Build responsive client pages in Nuxt and Vue with Tailwind, following Figma files or approved designs.

Build CMS modules and Laravel APIs, including models, migrations, authentication and MySQL data structures.

Connect frontend pages to CMS content and APIs, with working loading, empty and error states.

Deploy and maintain assigned websites on AWS EC2 or Lightsail, following the project's deployment process.

Handle routine Linux, web-server, domain, HTTPS certificate and environment configuration tasks.

Maintain backups, verify recovery steps, and prepare a rollback before changes that could affect a live site.

Investigate application and server logs, resolve routine issues, and escalate serious incidents promptly.

Work in Git branches, open pull requests, participate in code review and document changes.

Test across desktop, tablet and mobile, check basic accessibility and performance, and verify reported fixes on the live site.

What we're looking for

Around 2–4 years of relevant web-development experience, with shipped work you can show us and discuss.

Practical Vue 3 experience, including the Composition API and script setup, plus Nuxt and an understanding of server-side rendering.

Laravel and PHP experience covering routes, controllers, Eloquent, migrations, authentication and REST APIs.

MySQL skills: designing tables, writing joins and investigating slow queries.

Tailwind CSS and solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, with responsive work based on an actual design.

Hands-on experience personally deploying and maintaining a live website on AWS EC2 or Lightsail. Please describe your contribution; a certification or an AWS entry in a skills list alone is not enough.

Comfortable using Linux over SSH and working with Nginx, domains, HTTPS certificates and application environment settings.

Understanding of access permissions, backups, restores and deployment rollbacks, with an example of a problem you've diagnosed.

Git, pull requests and a habit of testing your work before calling it done.

Able to work from our Salcedo Village office four days a week.

Nice to have

Nuxt 4 and experience building client-editable CMS modules.

Automated tests and deployment pipelines.

AWS S3, RDS or CloudWatch experience relevant to websites you've operated.

Performance work such as Core Web Vitals, image loading and bundle size.

Technical SEO and basic accessibility testing.

Effective use of AI coding assistants, with careful review of generated code.

Experience discussing requirements or resolving issues directly

How to apply

Visit us at www.designbluemanila.com.




Benefits:

Additional leave

Company Christmas gift

Opportunities for promotion

Paid training

Promotion to permanent employee

Staff meals provided




Work Location: In person

Keep pages fast and accessible

What we’re looking for

Fresh grad up to around 2 years of experience. We care more about live sites or projects you can show us than a long CV (work, freelance, internship or personal all count)

Vue 3 with the Composition API and script setup

Some Nuxt, and an idea of how server-side rendering changes things

Tailwind CSS, plus enough plain CSS to fix what Tailwind can’t

Layouts that hold up between breakpoints, not just at them

Comfortable with Figma: you pull real spacing and type values instead of eyeballing

Git day to day: branches, pull requests, fixing your own merge conflicts

Willing to work from our Salcedo Village office 4 days a week (Fridays at home)

Bonus points

Nuxt 4

You’ve used AI tools like Claude, Copilot or Cursor on real work and can tell when the code they give you is wrong

GSAP or ScrollTrigger

REST APIs, including loading, empty and error states

Design systems or tokens

What to expect

It’s a small team, so your work gets seen early and you’ll get responsibility sooner than you would at a big company. Every page gets a code review before it ships, and that includes the seniors. It’s where most of the learning happens. Launch weeks run long and some weeks are quiet. We’ll ask what you think about a design in meetings, and we mean it.

What we offer

₱24,000 – ₱30,000 per month, depending on what you bring

13th month pay

Paid leaves

Hybrid setup: 4 days in our Salcedo Village office, Fridays from home

Real mentorship from people who’ll show you how it’s done

How to apply

Send us your CV and links to something you’ve built. A live site or project tells us way more than a polished CV.

title: AI-First Product Builder (Full Time, Remote, GMT+1 hours)
description:
Evergreen Apps builds subscription apps, quiz funnels, digital products and ecommerce stores for US customers. We’re a global team and we build almost everything with AI: the funnels, the copy, the creatives, the courses, the products themselves. We’re looking for one sharp, hungry person to work with our management team across all of it.

A quick word on what “product” means here. With AI, one person can now take a product from idea to live: research the market, write the copy, design the pages, build the funnel, create the course content, make the images and video, and get it in front of customers. That’s the job. You won’t be handed a narrow lane. You’ll be building full products and courses end to end, AI first, and improving them once they’re live.

We’re not hiring on years of experience. We care whether you’re smart, learn fast, write well and already use AI as a real tool rather than a chat window. If you’ve got those, we’ll teach you the rest, and we pay for the brains, not the CV. Whether you’re a year out of university or a few years into your career, if this sounds like you, apply.

What you’ll do

Day to day you’ll be building products and funnels with AI tools and no-code builders: quizzes, landing pages, checkout and paywall pages, course content and members areas. You’ll write and edit the copy that goes into them: ads, landing pages, emails and in-product text. You’ll research competitor products and ads and turn what you find into briefs and tests. You’ll write and improve prompts for the AI tools we use (Claude, ChatGPT, image and video generators) and keep a library of what works. You’ll also coordinate with external partners, including briefing outside call centers on the campaigns we’re running and checking their results.

And you’ll help the management team day to day: keeping projects organized, following up with contractors, and getting things shipped. Every day is different from the last. One day you’re building a quiz funnel, the next you’re writing a course module, the next you’re testing a checkout page.

Who this is for

You write excellent English, clearly and fast. You know the basics of copywriting: what a hook, an offer and a call to action are, and why one version converts and another doesn’t. You’ve done something commercial before, whether that’s sales, customer-facing work, a side business, a startup or a marketing role. We care more about what you’ve actually done than what it was called.

You have real hands-on experience with AI beyond asking it questions. You’ve built or automated something with it and you can show us. If you’ve worked with AI agents, that’s a huge plus, because a lot of your day will be spent briefing, checking and steering them.

You learn fast and like being taught. You’re organized and self-driven, comfortable juggling several projects in a week, and you don’t need a task list to stay busy. Bonus points for experience with quiz funnels, Shopify, Meta or Google ads, or tools like Lovable, Base44 or Figma.

Details

Full time and fully remote, but you work on GMT+1 hours. Starting salary is ₱70,000 per month (around $1,200 USD), with increases as you take on more. This is a long-term role, and if you do well there’s room to own a product yourself.

How to apply

Send us three things:

A short note on why this role fits you, in your own words, no templates

One product, funnel, landing page or piece of copy you’re proud of (a link or screenshot), plus the most useful thing you’ve built or automated with AI

A quick Loom video (one to two minutes) where you just introduce yourself. Nothing fancy, we just want to hear you talk.

title: System Administrator
description:
Systems Administrator




Job Description

The Systems Administrator is responsible for maintaining, monitoring, and supporting the organization's IT systems and infrastructure to ensure the availability, security, reliability, and performance of business-critical services. This role manages servers, operating systems, user accounts, network devices, security tools, hardware, software, backups, and cloud infrastructure.

The Systems Administrator works closely with internal IT teams, help desk personnel, external vendors, and other stakeholders to troubleshoot technical issues, implement infrastructure improvements, support IT projects, and ensure the smooth operation and transition of new systems and enhancements into production.

Key Responsibilities

1. Systems and Infrastructure Administration

Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot servers, operating systems, desktop and laptop computers, printers, and other IT equipment.

Manage user accounts, groups, security permissions, Active Directory, Group Policy, and print services.

Monitor system performance, resource utilization, event logs, warnings, and errors to ensure systems operate efficiently.

Maintain and support network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, LAN, WAN, internet connectivity, intranet, and network segments.

Apply operating system patches, software updates, and security configurations in accordance with established policies and procedures.

2. Server Administration and Monitoring

Perform routine server administration, maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting activities.

Monitor data center and server health using existing management and monitoring tools.

Investigate and resolve hardware, software, operating system, and system performance issues.

Assist in building, configuring, testing, deploying, and maintaining physical and virtual servers.

Monitor system resources and ensure infrastructure components work together reliably.

3. Technical Support and Incident Management

Provide technical support to the help desk and other IT teams in identifying and resolving system-related issues.

Perform root cause analysis and troubleshoot incidents affecting servers, applications, networks, and other IT services.

Respond to infrastructure alerts and hardware issues, escalating complex problems to appropriate technical teams or vendors.

Support business-critical systems and minimize service disruptions through proactive monitoring and preventive maintenance.

Document incidents, troubleshooting procedures, and resolutions for future reference.

4. Backup, Recovery, and Security

Perform routine and scheduled audits of IT systems, configurations, and backup procedures.

Monitor backup operations and verify the successful completion of scheduled backups.

Assist with disaster recovery, data restoration, and remote replication activities.

Implement security updates, access controls, and system hardening measures to protect IT resources.

Maintain compliance with internal IT policies, security requirements, and operational procedures.

5. Cloud and Virtualization Administration

Support cloud infrastructure and services, preferably using Amazon Web Services (AWS).

Assist in managing virtual machines, server resources, storage volumes, and infrastructure configurations.

Support virtualization platforms and troubleshoot issues involving distributed systems, storage, connectivity, and replication.

Monitor system capacity and performance and recommend improvements to infrastructure reliability and efficiency.

Assist with infrastructure deployment, migration, and integration activities as required.

6. IT Projects and Service Transition

Participate in IT projects, system upgrades, infrastructure enhancements, and technology initiatives.

Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to communicate project progress, technical activities, risks, and outcomes.

Prepare, maintain, and update Service Transition documentation to guide Technical Operations teams in supporting newly implemented systems and enhancements.

Ensure systems are properly tested, documented, and transitioned into operational support.

Identify opportunities to improve system administration processes, automate routine tasks, and enhance IT service delivery.

Required Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Proven experience in systems administration, IT operations, server administration, or a related IT role.

Knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux operating systems.

Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, user and group management, and security permissions.

Working knowledge of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, routers, switches, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.

Familiarity with enterprise backup and recovery procedures, virtualization, and system performance monitoring tools.

Knowledge of server provisioning, storage volume management, remote replication, and distributed systems troubleshooting.

Familiarity with cloud computing platforms, preferably AWS.

Knowledge of programming or scripting languages for system administration and automation is an advantage.

Understanding of HTTP traffic, content delivery networks (CDNs), caching, and application integration is an advantage.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Relevant certifications in Microsoft technologies, AWS, networking, virtualization, or systems administration.

Experience supporting enterprise IT environments and business-critical systems.

Familiarity with IT service management practices, incident management, change management, and service transition procedures.

Experience with infrastructure implementation, system migrations, upgrades, and operational improvements.

title: AI Automation & DevOps Developer (12-month Contract)
description:
If you've ever looked at a repetitive process and thought, "Surely we can automate this instead of making someone do it 400 times a month," you're probably our kind of person.

First Focus is looking for an experienced AI Automation & DevOps Developer to join our Technology team in Manila.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just get excited about AI, but knows how to turn it into useful, reliable solutions. You'll build AI-powered applications, intelligent automations and internal tools that make a genuine difference to how our business operates.

You'll also use modern AI development tools to work smarter, experiment with new approaches and help us figure out where AI genuinely adds value.

Because while we're enthusiastic about AI, we're slightly less enthusiastic about building a chatbot for something that could have been solved with a sensible SQL query.




A little about Us

We're Australia's #1 MSP (Cloudtango, 9 years running), with over 500 staff across 4 countries.

We've grown consistently for more than 15 years, and we're continuing to invest in software development, automation and artificial intelligence to improve how we work and support our clients.

We believe in hiring smart, capable people, giving them the tools and support they need, and actually listening when they suggest a better way of doing something.

One of our values that fits this role particularly well is Live Curiously. We encourage people to ask why, challenge existing processes and experiment with new ideas.

You'll also see plenty of Keep it Simple, because the best automation is usually the one that solves a real problem without creating five new ones.

Learn more about First Focus and our values at https://www.firstfocus.com.au/about-us/.




What you'll be doing

You'll work across AI development, automation, software engineering and DevOps, helping turn ideas into practical solutions that improve business operations.

Your day might include:

Building AI-powered applications, intelligent assistants, agents and automated workflows

Using AI coding assistants and development tools to design, build, test and improve software

Exploring AI models, platforms and technologies to identify the best solutions for different business challenges

Integrating AI models with internal applications, databases, business systems and APIs

Developing solutions using generative AI, large language models (LLMs) and natural-language processing

Building AI-assisted tools that improve knowledge management, service delivery and decision-making

Designing, developing and maintaining internal applications and services

Writing automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, Bash or PHP

Automating repetitive operational and administrative processes

Creating integrations between applications, databases and RESTful APIs

Working with SQL Server, MySQL and NoSQL databases

Supporting DevOps practices including automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, deployments and monitoring

Using Git for version control, collaboration and code reviews

Applying appropriate security, privacy, governance and human oversight to AI solutions

Testing and monitoring solutions to make sure they're reliable, useful and delivering real business value

You'll also work with developers, engineers, project managers and other teams to identify opportunities for improvement.

We want someone who's comfortable experimenting, but equally comfortable recognising when an idea isn't worth pursuing.

Sometimes the smartest use of AI is knowing when not to use AI.




What we're looking for

We're looking for a practical, technically capable developer who enjoys solving problems and turning ideas into working solutions.

You'll ideally bring:

Commercial experience in software development, automation or DevOps

Hands-on experience using AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle

Experience developing or implementing AI-enabled applications or business solutions

A solid understanding of generative AI, large language models, prompting and AI-assisted development

Strong scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, Bash or PHP

Experience developing integrations using RESTful APIs

Good database knowledge, including SQL and technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL or NoSQL

Practical experience using Git and collaborative development workflows

An understanding of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments

Experience automating processes across multiple applications and systems

Familiarity with YAML and configuration-driven automation

Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

The ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt as AI tools continue to evolve

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

A collaborative mindset and willingness to share ideas and knowledge

Most importantly, you'll be someone who takes ownership and focuses on delivering useful outcomes.

We're not looking for someone who can simply list every AI tool released in the past six months. Although, admittedly, that would be an impressive memory exercise.




Even better if you have...

Experience with any of the following would be a bonus:

GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Claude or Gemini

Excellent English communication skills, able to explain technical concepts clearly to different audiences.

Building AI agents, intelligent assistants or multi-step AI workflows

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings or vector databases

AI orchestration frameworks and development platforms

Testing, evaluating and monitoring AI model outputs

Responsible AI practices, including privacy, security and governance

Working within an MSP or technology services environment

IT service management or professional services automation platforms

Advanced PowerShell scripting

Cloud platforms and infrastructure-as-code tools

Containers and modern application deployment

Robotic process automation

Open-source frameworks

Microsoft 365, Azure or SharePoint

You don't need to tick every box. AI is moving quickly enough that anyone claiming to know absolutely everything is probably due for a software update themselves.




Why you'll enjoy working with us

You'll have the opportunity to work on real business challenges, experiment with emerging technology and see the impact of the solutions you create.

We're not interested in AI projects that exist purely to make a presentation look impressive.

We want practical improvements that save time, reduce manual effort, improve service delivery and make people's working lives easier.

You'll benefit from:

Hybrid working arrangements, subject to the agreed contract terms

Opportunities to work with modern AI tools and emerging technologies

Exposure to AI development, automation, software engineering and DevOps

Collaboration with experienced developers, engineers and technology professionals

Opportunities to experiment, contribute ideas and influence how First Focus adopts AI

A supportive team that values curiosity, collaboration and continuous improvement

The opportunity to build solutions used across an international business

We also believe in Never Stop Growing, so curiosity, learning and professional development are part of how we work.




Where you'll be working

This role is based in Metro Manila, with a hybrid working arrangement.

Our offices are located at:

Ortigas Office 29th Floor, Robinsons Cyberscape Gamma, Topaz Road, Ortigas, Pasig City, Metro Manila, Philippines

Alabang Office 26th Floor, Axis Tower One Building, Filinvest Ave, Alabang, Muntinlupa

And yes, hybrid working means you can avoid the daily Manila traffic adventure on some days. We consider that a perfectly respectable use of technology.




Sound like your kind of role?

If you enjoy building software, experimenting with AI, automating repetitive work and finding smarter ways to solve real problems, we'd like to hear from you.

We're looking for someone who can combine technical skills with curiosity, good judgement and a genuine desire to make things better.

You don't need to know every framework or have experience with every AI model. If you've built useful solutions, understand the fundamentals and enjoy learning what's next, send us your application.




Neurodiversity: First Focus welcomes applications from Neurodiverse candidates. We recommend & appreciate disclosure along with the application so that a copy of our Neurodiversity Statement can be provided outlining the flexible options we can offer to best showcase your skills.

AI in Recruitment: We use AI-assisted recruitment tools to support application review. These tools do not make hiring decisions. All applications are handled by our recruitment team in compliance with the Philippine Data Privacy Act.

title: WFH QA Engineer - Desktop Applications (Windows & MacOS)
description:
Overview

Our client is looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer - Desktop Applications (Windows & MacOS) to perform manual functional testing for .NET-based productivity applications that bring agentic AI into everyday work and creative workflows. In this role, you will split your testing focus roughly evenly between Windows and macOS, covering both Intel and Apple Silicon hardware. You will author structured test plans, report defects with high precision, and work closely with product and engineering teams to ensure cross-platform reliability. Additionally, you will leverage AI coding agents like Claude Code and OpenAI Codex to refine test cases, investigate bugs, and streamline your testing tasks. This remote position offers the opportunity to directly shape product quality within a collaborative, globally distributed environment.

Schedule:

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, Pasadena

Responsibilities

Perform manual functional testing of desktop applications on Windows 10/11 and macOS, including Intel and Apple Silicon hardware.

Develop test plans and cases from product specifications, UI walkthroughs, and exploratory testing.

Maintain structured CSV or spreadsheet test plans with clear descriptions, reproduction steps, expected results, and pass/fail criteria.

Refine AI-generated test plans by removing duplication, adding edge cases, improving expected outcomes, and organizing cases for effective execution.

Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex to explore codebases, develop and refine test cases, investigate defects, and automate repetitive QA work.

Document bugs with precise reproduction steps, severity classifications, screenshots, and relevant logs; collaborate with engineers on triage and resolution.

Clone repositories, switch branches, pull and build specific commits, and manage issues and merge requests in GitLab.

Test complex desktop interactions, including multi-window workflows, drag-and-drop, modal dialogs, system tray and menu bar behavior, and installation flows.

Validate platform-specific behavior, including Windows Shell Extensions, registry interactions, NSIS installers, macOS .app bundles, Info.plist file associations, and native title-bar behavior.

Test Microsoft 365 integrations, including Outlook Classic and modern Outlook.

Communicate testing progress, defects, and clarification requests through Microsoft Teams and GitLab.

Requirements

At least 2 years of manual functional testing experience with desktop applications.

Hands-on testing experience on both Windows and macOS.

Access to Windows 10/11 machines and both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs for cross-platform verification. (Applicant must have Windows and macOS)


A minimum of 16 GB of system memory (RAM) on both macOS and Windows devices.
For macOS devices, an Apple Silicon (ARM-based) processor is required.

Experience authoring detailed, structured test plans and test cases in CSV or spreadsheet formats.

Practical, day-to-day experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex for QA-related work.

Ability to critically review and substantially improve AI-generated test plans rather than relying on them without validation.

Working knowledge of Git, including cloning repositories, switching branches, pulling changes, and building specific commits.

Familiarity with GitLab issues and merge requests.

Ability to produce clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps, severity, screenshots, and logs.

title: Software Engineer III (Perl/Python | Data Engineering)
description:
About the Job

The FactSet Engineering team is composed of highly talented and motivated individuals primarily selected from top-tier technical programs around the world. We believe this approach fosters the continual introduction of new technologies and ideas, which has been critical to our success. Our engineers believe that a key to their, and FactSet's, success is creating a loose team environment in which everyone can contribute individually, yet at the same time cultivate a community where engineers can depend on each other for help, learning, and development.

The Software Engineering group is focused on creating and maintaining financial applications and database systems as well as building the backend support that allows our systems to run effectively. As part of the team, you will work closely with other departments within the company to ensure that FactSet's products and technologies are responsive to the changing needs of the investment community.




Symbology Direct Feeds – Group Description

Symbology Direct Feeds maintains update systems for various content sets at FactSet. The team processes feed files that are translated into symbols used to gather information such as corporate actions, listing availability, and name changes. The primary areas of focus include products such as FactSet ID, Fixed Income, Options, and Futures. Data produced by the team is consumed across different FactSet applications including Workstation, FactSet Web, and Excel via APIs. The team also develops and maintains Symbology Editors that internal teams use to view and manage data through a comprehensive GUI.

As the financial technology landscape continues to evolve rapidly — particularly with the growing influence of AI-driven workflows and tooling — our team is equally committed to staying ahead of these changes. We are looking for engineers who are not only strong in our core technical stack but are also curious, adaptable, and eager to explore and integrate emerging technologies into our day-to-day engineering practices.




Role Overview

FactSet is searching for Software Engineers with strong programming skills and a solid understanding of object-oriented concepts. The engineer will focus on creating and maintaining efficient data update processes in the form of ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines, as well as producing timely reports reflecting data changes from update processes. They will collaborate with various stakeholders — including product developers, internal teams, and clients — to deliver accurate, transformed data loaded from data feed acquisitions. Responsibilities also include developing web tools that uphold the integrity of the data we manage. Candidates will work alongside other Symbology teams based in the US and London on product integration and enhancements.




Work Schedule & On-Call Responsibilities

Given the global nature of our operations, this role requires a degree of schedule flexibility to ensure effective collaboration with our counterparts in the US and London. The following working arrangements apply:

Shift Hours: The engineer will be required to start their shift between 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM Philippine Standard Time (PST). This shift structure is designed to create meaningful overlap with our teams abroad and ensure continuity of communication and collaboration across time zones.

Work Arrangement: This role follows a Hybrid setup, requiring engineers to be onsite at the Manila office 2 days per week, with the remaining 3 days worked remotely.

Specific onsite days will be coordinated with the team and may be adjusted based on business needs, sprint ceremonies, or key project milestones.

Candidates must have a reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment for their work-from-home days to ensure uninterrupted productivity and availability during on-call rotations.

On-Call Coverage: The engineer will participate in an on-call rotation on a daily basis, covering Manila business hours from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PHT. During on-call shifts, the engineer is expected to monitor systems, respond to alerts, and triage any data or pipeline issues that may arise in a timely manner.

Candidates who are comfortable working in a globally distributed team environment and can manage their time effectively across overlapping time zones will thrive in this role.




Core Job Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or equivalent

3–5 years of industry experience (for experienced hires)

Advanced proficiency in Perl and Python — these are the primary languages used by the team and are considered non-negotiable requirements

Strong working knowledge of SQL Server for database design, querying, and performance optimization

Solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns

Experience leading or contributing to large-scale projects and products

Proven ability to work effectively in an Agile environment

Strong communication skills — written and verbal

A collaborative team-player mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving

Comfortable with on-call responsibilities and able to respond promptly and calmly under pressure during system incidents or data anomalies




Nice-to-Have Skills & Emerging Technology Competencies

We recognize that the technology landscape is shifting quickly, especially with the rise of AI-assisted development and cloud-native architectures. While not required, the following competencies are highly desirable and will set strong candidates apart:

Web Development

Experience building or consuming REST APIs (e.g., Flask, FastAPI, or similar frameworks)

Frontend development experience (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js) is a welcomed bonus, particularly for candidates interested in contributing to our internal GUI tools

Cybersecurity Awareness

Familiarity with secure coding practices and principles (e.g., OWASP guidelines)

Understanding of data security, access control, and compliance considerations within financial data environments

Experience with vulnerability scanning tools or security-aware CI/CD pipelines

AWS Cloud Services

Hands-on experience with AWS products such as Lambda, S3, RDS, EC2, or similar services

Familiarity with cloud-native development patterns and infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform)

AI-Assisted Development & Tooling

Demonstrated experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI code completion tools to improve development efficiency

Practical experience using Anthropic Claude or similar large language model (LLM) tools for tasks such as code review, documentation, data analysis, or rapid prototyping

General comfort working in AI-augmented workflows — we expect this to become an increasingly important part of how our team operates, and we value engineers who embrace this shift thoughtfully and responsibly




Why Join Us

FactSet continues to invest in its people and technology. Joining the Symbology Direct Feeds team means you will be working on data that powers real financial decisions across the globe, while being given the opportunity to grow your skill set in a rapidly evolving technical environment. Whether your strengths lie in building robust data pipelines, designing secure APIs, or leveraging AI tools to work smarter — there is a place for you here.




FactSet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment.

title: Software Developer | AI, Automation & Internal Tools
description:
Build Technology That Makes a Difference

Are you a developer who enjoys building things from scratch, solving complex problems and finding better ways to work?

Yoonet is seeking a Software Developer to support an independent, locally owned allied health organization in New Zealand. The organization provides physiotherapy, occupational therapy, psychology, and community rehabilitation services under a range of government and private contracts.

Technology is central to its plans for growth and improving care delivery. As the business's first dedicated developer, you'll work directly with the owners and clinical directors, with the autonomy to turn ideas into practical solutions without unnecessary layers of approval.

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to take ownership of what they build, contribute ideas and help shape the future of technology within a growing healthcare business.

What You'll Build

1. A Central Clinical Tool

Your first major project will be developing a central workspace that clinicians can use throughout their day. This tool will connect with existing systems and use AI to help clinicians:

Prepare clinical notes more efficiently.

Process reports and documentation.

Access client statistics and track outcomes over time.

Manage follow-ups and ongoing tasks.

Automate routine clinical workflows.

Use internal data to support better care and decision-making.

2. Browser-Based Tools and AI Enhancements

The organisation uses several browser-based practice management systems. You'll develop Chrome extensions and other enhancements to introduce functionality such as:

AI-assisted clinical documentation.

Treatment pathway support.

Automated report processing.

Customised features for different government and private healthcare contracts.

3. Business Automation and System Integration

Beyond clinical tools, you'll identify opportunities to improve processes across the wider business, including finance, HR and customer service. This may involve connecting existing systems, automating repetitive tasks and improving reporting and information flow.

Your Responsibilities

Design, build, test, deploy and maintain internal applications and tools.

Take ownership of projects from initial discussions through to implementation and continuous improvement.

Integrate AI capabilities, APIs, databases and existing business systems.

Identify opportunities to automate workflows and improve operational efficiency.

Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues and maintain reliable solutions.

Work directly with business owners and clinical directors to understand needs and recommend practical solutions.

Document systems and processes to support ongoing maintenance and future development.

Prioritise data security, privacy and reliability when working with sensitive health information.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is comfortable working independently, learning new technologies and taking responsibility for the quality and outcomes of their work.

You'll ideally bring:

Experience in software development, application development or systems engineering.

The ability to build and deliver applications or automation solutions from concept to deployment.

Familiarity with APIs, databases, system integrations and cloud-based environments.

Experience with AI integration or AI-assisted development tools.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

The ability to work from high-level requirements and determine practical ways to implement them.

Clear communication skills and confidence working directly with non-technical stakeholders.

A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and commitment to building reliable systems.

Experience with Chrome extensions, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Bedrock or healthcare systems would be advantageous.

You don't need to know every tool in the client's environment. We're interested in your ability to learn quickly, work through unfamiliar challenges and deliver solutions that hold up in real-world use.

The Technology Environment

You'll work with a combination of internally developed systems, cloud infrastructure and AI tools, including:

Microsoft Azure, hosted in a New Zealand environment.

Amazon Bedrock for AI processing involving sensitive health data.

Browser-based and desktop practice management systems.

AI coding and agent tools, including Claude, Codex, Grok and Hermes Agent.

Internal databases, integrations and automation workflows.

Why Join This Opportunity?

Take ownership. Be the first dedicated developer and have a direct influence on the organisation's technology direction.

Work closely with decision-makers. Collaborate directly with the owners and clinical directors, with room to recommend improvements and shape solutions.

Build meaningful products. Your work will support clinicians, streamline healthcare processes and contribute to better service delivery and client outcomes.

Explore AI and automation. Work on practical applications of AI in a healthcare environment, alongside existing systems and workflows.

Grow for the long term. Become part of the team, build relationships with the people using your tools and expand your responsibilities as the business grows.

How to Apply

If you're a hands-on developer who enjoys building, experimenting, solving problems and taking ownership of the end result, we'd like to hear from you.

Please submit your updated CV and, where available, examples of applications, integrations or automation projects you've worked on.

Apply through Yoonet's careers page:

https://app.yoonet.io/job_listings

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Project Based | Front-End Web Developer
description:
Project-Based Front-End Web Developer

Remote – Philippines | Independent Contractor | Project Budget: AUD $2,000, subject to discussion




At Smart Suites, we have built more than just vacation stays—we create seamless and memorable guest experiences.

We manage more than 100 short-term rental accommodations across Rocklea, Sunnybank, Acacia Ridge, Kuraby, and other locations in Queensland, Australia. Everything we do is guided by our values of Customer Obsession, Ownership, Curiosity, Humility, Efficiency, and Teamwork—COCHET.

We are now ready to transform our online presence, and we are looking for an experienced Project-Based Front-End Web Developer to help bring that vision to life.




The Mission

Our current website is hosted on Lodgify’s proprietary platform. We are moving to WordPress to create a faster, more flexible, user-friendly, and scalable website that better represents the Smart Suites brand.

This is more than a basic website transfer.

You will help reshape how guests discover our properties, explore their accommodation options, and complete their bookings online. You will be responsible for rebuilding the website in WordPress, integrating the Mews booking widget, preserving our SEO performance, configuring website forms and email delivery, and supporting the website through testing, deployment, and handover.

The finished website must be visually polished, mobile-responsive, secure, search-engine optimized, and easy for our internal team to manage.


What You’ll Be Responsible For

Website Migration and WordPress Development

Lead the migration of the Smart Suites website from Lodgify to WordPress.

Rebuild existing pages, content, navigation, and functionality.

Customize WordPress using Elementor or another approved page-building solution.

Create reusable templates and components that can support future properties, landing pages, and marketing campaigns.

Minimize downtime during migration and launch.

Front-End Development

Develop and enhance pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other appropriate front-end technologies.

Translate approved designs and content into functional, visually consistent web pages.

Ensure the website is fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Ensure compatibility with Chrome, Safari, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox.

Resolve layout, functionality, and performance issues identified during testing.

Mews Booking Integration

Integrate and configure the Mews booking widget or booking engine.

Ensure a smooth guest journey from property discovery to booking completion.

Test the booking experience across devices and browsers.

Troubleshoot integration errors, script conflicts, tracking problems, and display issues.

Coordinate with Smart Suites and Mews support when required.

Forms, Email, and SMTP Setup

Build and configure contact, enquiry, newsletter sign-up, and lead-capture forms.

Set up SMTP or another reliable email delivery service.

Configure automated confirmations, internal notifications, and spam protection.

Test all forms and email workflows before launch.

Ensure form submissions are handled securely.

SEO Migration

Audit the current website’s URLs, titles, metadata, headings, images, and indexable pages.

Preserve existing URLs wherever practical.

Implement 301 redirects for pages with changed URLs.

Transfer page titles, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, and other SEO elements.

Generate and submit an updated XML sitemap.

Review robots.txt and website indexing settings.

Configure Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, or existing tracking tools where applicable.

Identify and resolve broken links, redirect errors, missing pages, and post-launch indexing issues.

Performance, Security, and Accessibility

Optimize images, scripts, stylesheets, caching, and page-loading performance.

Apply appropriate WordPress security and performance practices.

Improve mobile usability and Core Web Vitals.

Apply basic accessibility practices, including proper headings, image alt text, readable contrast, form labels, and keyboard-friendly navigation.

Avoid unnecessary plugins and scripts that could affect speed, security, or maintainability.

Hosting, DNS, and Deployment

Assist with or manage deployment to the approved hosting environment.

Configure the domain, DNS records, SSL certificate, and CDN services such as Cloudflare.

Support the transition from Lodgify to the new live WordPress website.

Conduct post-launch checks for booking functionality, forms, links, redirects, analytics, responsiveness, and security.

Testing and Handover

Conduct functional, responsive, cross-browser, performance, and user acceptance testing.

Maintain a record of issues identified and fixes completed.

Provide documentation covering page editing, website administration, plugins, forms, backups, and basic troubleshooting.

Provide a complete list of plugins, integrations, licences, credentials, and third-party services used.

Conduct a handover session with the Smart Suites team.

Provide an agreed post-launch support period for migration-related defects.




What Success Looks Like

By the end of the project, Smart Suites will have:

A fully functional WordPress website.

A responsive experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

A properly integrated and tested Mews booking widget.

Working enquiry and sign-up forms with reliable SMTP email delivery.

Preserved SEO value through correct redirects, metadata, and sitemap configuration.

A secure and optimized hosting environment.

Verified analytics and tracking.

Clear website administration and technical documentation.

No critical broken links, booking errors, or major display issues.

A website that has been formally tested, handed over, and approved by Smart Suites.




What We’re Looking For

Required Experience

At least 2–4 years of professional web development experience.

Strong experience building and maintaining WordPress websites.

Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive front-end development.

Experience using Elementor or a similar WordPress page builder.

Demonstrated experience migrating websites between platforms or content management systems.

Knowledge of technical and on-page SEO migration.

Experience integrating APIs, embedded scripts, booking widgets, payment tools, or other third-party services.

Experience setting up website forms, SMTP services, and email notifications.

Familiarity with hosting, DNS records, SSL certificates, and CDN services.

Strong troubleshooting skills across WordPress themes, plugins, scripts, and browsers.

Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work independently against agreed milestones.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

Previous work on hospitality, hotel, serviced apartment, vacation rental, travel, or accommodation websites.

Familiarity with Mews, Lodgify, or similar property management and booking platforms.

Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

Understanding of Core Web Vitals and website accessibility practices.

Experience working with Australian businesses or offshore teams.

Nice to Have

Experience configuring web servers and hosting environments.

Knowledge of server security, backups, recovery, caching, and monitoring.

Experience creating staging environments and managing controlled production deployments.

Familiarity with Cloudflare performance and security settings.

Basic PHP or custom WordPress theme development experience.




Project Details

Job Type: Independent Contractor – Project-Based
Location: Remote – Philippines
Project Budget: AUD $2,000, subject to discussion
Working Hours: Flexible. Smart Suites operates between 5:00 AM and 10:00 PM Philippine time, and availability will be required for agreed meetings, testing, coordination, and deployment activities.
Reports To: Project Lead / Management Team

How to Apply

Please submit the following:

Your updated résumé or professional profile.

A portfolio of relevant WordPress and front-end development projects.

At least two examples of website migrations or third-party integrations.

A brief explanation of how you would approach migrating a website from Lodgify to WordPress.

Your estimated project timeline and availability.

Your proposed project rate.

Details of any expected plugin, hosting, software, or licence costs.

Your recommended post-launch warranty or support period.

Portfolio required: Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate your ability to create websites that are visually polished, technically reliable, mobile-responsive, and optimized for performance.

If you enjoy combining strong front-end development with practical problem-solving and want to help transform the online booking experience of a growing Australian hospitality business, we would like to hear from you.
