title: Field Software Engineer, Capture Operations
description:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

In addition to our core business, Workstream is home to a small, fast-moving Robotics team focused on advancing the next generation of artificial intelligence and robotics. We partner with a leading AI and robotics company to produce high-quality, large-scale egocentric (first-person) video datasets that help train advanced AI models.

Grow With Us

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our growing Robotics Data Collections team. This role will keep the footage flowing, from a stuck upload at a capture site to the dashboard screen the operations team reads every morning.

Your users are real people a few metres away: the operators and contributors recording every day. When something breaks, it's their hours, their pay, and their patience on the line, and this role exists to care about that deeply. You'll see your users face to face at capture sites, hear them in the support channels, and build with them in mind.

Every day, capture sites record hours of footage that must land safely in the cloud. When it doesn't (a stuck upload, an unreadable card, an app refusing to finish, hours that don't add up), you are the engineer who finds out why, unblocks it without losing data, and then improves the software so it explains itself next time. The work spans every surface the operation touches: a desktop app site staff use to offload and upload footage, a phone app contributors record with, web dashboards and reports, and the physical devices themselves. You'll build on some of these surfaces and debug on all of them.

You are also the engineering voice site staff hear every day. Our operations run on Slack, across time zones. Operators post a screenshot of an error and ask what it means and what to press next. The core engineering team wakes up hours later and reads what you wrote to understand what happened in the field. This role lives in that conversation, translating between confused screenshots and root causes, in both directions.

This is an AI-first job. The operation is scaling faster than any team could answer tickets one at a time, so we don't. You'll use AI agents as a daily multiplier: to write diagnostics while you're still reading the error, to investigate many stuck uploads at once, to draft the guide while you fix the cause.

This role will start as a contractor position, with a high likelihood of transitioning to a full-time role after three months, depending on business needs and performance.

What it's like

Small, fast-moving team; your work shows up in the operation the same week.

A mix of support conversations, focused software days, and field days at capture sites.

AI agents are a first-class part of how the whole team works. You'll work directly with the

Day In The Life

Product engineering (40%)

Build features in the desktop and mobile apps. Ship improvements to the desktop app site staff run every day (offloading cards, uploading, seeing what landed) and the phone app contributors record with: better flows, clearer states, fewer ways to get stuck.

Build the dashboards and reports the operation runs on. Hours and progress reports, upload accounting, status screens: make the numbers trustworthy and the words on screen say what's actually happening.

Write software every week, with AI as your leverage, across the desktop app (Electron), the phone app (React Native), web dashboards (React/TypeScript), and Python services and tooling. You'll routinely have AI agents write and iterate on diagnostics, tests, and features with you.

Field support & debugging (35%)

Run the daily support loop. Be the first responder in our support channels when site staff hit upload, app, or device problems; answer in plain language, unblock them fast, and follow through until it's resolved, not just explained.

Diagnose and unblock the upload path. When footage is stuck between a capture card and the cloud, trace where and why (device, card, app, network, cloud), get it moving again safely, and make sure nothing is lost or double-counted along the way.

Scaling the operation (15%)

Solve classes of problems, not instances. Every question the ops team has to ask an engineer twice is a gap; turn recurring ones into self-serve screens, clearer error messages, AI-powered diagnostics, and guides operators reuse. Your goal is that the operation can grow without support growing with it.

Devices & hardware (10%)

Be hands-on with devices when the problem is physical. Use AI-written tests to check why a camera or battery isn't behaving, open a device to inspect it, and swap parts like cameras and buttons. No soldering. You'll also help put beta hardware in operators' hands and report what breaks.

Who You Are

Deep care for the user. The operators and contributors using what you build are people you'll know by name; their lost hour bothers you until it's found, and "works on my machine" isn't done.

Flexible, fast, and scrappy. You'd rather ship a working fix today and improve it tomorrow than design the perfect one next week; you're comfortable when this month's job looks different from last month's.

A willing debugger and problem-solver. You can follow data through a pipeline with many stages, form hypotheses, write quick tests (with AI's help), and follow the evidence rather than guessing, wherever the problem lives.

AI-leverage mindset. You already use AI tools well and they multiply you; when problems repeat, your instinct is to build something that solves the whole class rather than working through them one by one. You treat the challenges of a scaling team and operation as the fun part, not the fine print.

Strong communicator, concretely. With site operators and contributors, you answer "what does this error mean?" with what it means and what to press right now, in plain words, and you write step-by-step guides a non-technical person can follow on the first try. With the operations team and core engineers, you write down what you saw and tried, pick up a thread someone left overnight, ask good questions, and keep a problem moving across time zones until it's solved.

A collaborator across teams. You stay patient on the fifth "it's still not working," and people finish a conversation with you knowing exactly what to do next.

Care for data integrity. In our world, a lost or double-counted recording is someone's unpaid hours; you treat that seriously.

Self-directed. You'll often be the only engineer on site, supported by a remote team in other time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

Solid software fundamentals: working Python, comfort in Linux (services, logs, networking), and the ability to build app UIs

Strength in at least one of web (React/TypeScript), desktop (Electron), or mobile (React Native), and the willingness to become productive across all three and debug anything

Daily, effective use of AI coding tools and agents

Clear written English for remote, asynchronous work 

Located in Metro Manila, and able to travel to capture locations regularly

Nice To Have

Experience shipping Electron or React Native apps to real users

Experience in a support-adjacent engineering role: field engineering, solutions engineering, IT for operations teams

Hardware tinkering: Raspberry Pi and single-board computers, cameras, taking devices apart; 3D printing for jigs and mounts

Familiarity with cloud storage, upload pipelines, SQL/Postgres, or fleet/IoT management

Know More About Workstream

title: MSP IT Systems Engineer
description:
We will reach out to you via the email address provided in your resume should you qualify for the next steps of your application.

﻿﻿Work Arrangement: Permanent Work-from-Home

Work Shift: Night shift


Position Overview:

Resolve helpdesk tickets and if unable – to escalate to Tier 2 technicians, owning diagnosis, client communication and follow-through to resolution.

Report to the manager and strengthen Tier 1 capability through clear handoffs, troubleshooting guidance and reusable documentation.




Tasks and Responsibilities:

1. Take ownership of Tier 1 tickets; review impact, symptoms, evidence and previous troubleshooting before choosing next steps.

2. Prioritize assigned tickets by business impact and SLA; keep clients and keep team informed of progress, blockers and next actions.

3. Resolve complex Windows endpoint, Microsoft 365 Apps, printer, mobile-access and remote-connectivity issues.

4. Diagnose Exchange Online mail flow, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive issues beyond routine Tier 1 checks.

5. Troubleshoot Entra ID sign-in, MFA, licensing and permissions; carry out approved Microsoft 365 administration and access changes.

6. Investigate AD DS, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy and server/file-access issues where deployed; coordinate with vendors as needed.

7. Resolve Meraki/UniFi network, Wi-Fi and VPN incidents; collect evidence and escalate issues outside approved authority.

8. Triage Datto RMM / NinjaOne, Datto backup and Defender alerts; coordinate security incidents with Blackpoint Cyber.

9. Investigate defined Azure service issues using logs and runbooks; refer advanced infrastructure or architecture issues to the designated senior technical resource.

10. Maintain accurate Autotask records and Hudu runbooks; explain resolutions to Tier 1 and coach on repeatable diagnostic steps.

11. Identify recurring faults, verify fixes with users and route unresolved high-risk incidents with a complete technical handoff.

12. Assist with approved maintenance, restore checks or occasional migrations as assigned.

 

Scope: A designated senior technical resource approves high impact changes and handles issues beyond Level 2 authority. Migration leadership is not a core requirement.




REQUIREMENTS:

Demonstrated MSP Level 1.5-2 across multiple clients; can explain diagnosis, evidence, resolution and follow-through. Must have at least 1-2 years prior MSP Helpdesk Experience

Practical Microsoft 365 troubleshooting across Exchange Online, Entra ID, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, including identity, MFA, mail flow and permissions.

Strong Windows endpoint, AD DS, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, TCP/IP and VPN troubleshooting fundamentals.

Hands-on PSA, RMM and remote-support experience; accurate ticket notes, time entries, prioritization and client updates.

Sound judgment about security, change approval and when to seek senior help; gathers useful logs and reproductions before escalating.

Clear spoken and written English, reliable ownership, patient support for Tier 1 technicians and an ability to explain the fix. Migration experience is not required.




NICE TO HAVE:

Familiarity with Autotask, Hudu, Datto RMM/NinjaOne, Datto backup, Meraki/UniFi, Blackpoint Cyber and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint; equivalent tools are acceptable.

Azure VM, network, access and backup troubleshooting; Intune, Autopilot, Conditional Access and hybrid identity experience.

NinjaOne transition experience, including agent deployment, policy mapping, patching and alert validation.

PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, root-cause analysis, mentoring and relevant current Microsoft credentials or equivalent practical ability.

Occasional project support: SkyKick mailbox migrations and ForensiT profile migrations, with approved plans, validation and escalation. These are secondary strengths, not screening gates.


Benefits:

21 Days Paid Time Off (PTO) Annually + 1 Additional PTO per successful year of tenure (up to five (5) years

HMO coverage for employees +1 FREE dependent on the first day of employment
+1 additional FREE dependent per successful year of tenure (up to five (5) years)

Tenure Incentive Program*

Receive additional premium for working at night

Referral Bonus of up to Php20,000.00*

ALL government mandated benefits

*Terms and conditions apply

title: Market Risk Time Series Engineer
description:
Job description

Why Mizuho

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.

Its the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who share the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest banks in the world.




We are seeking a hands-on Market Risk Time Series Engineer with 8-12 years of experience to support, enhance, and maintain the Market Risk Time Series platform. This role is focused on delivering business and regulatory change through application enhancements, bug fixes, operational improvements, and technical modernization initiatives.

The successful candidate will possess strong technical expertise in Python, SQL, and Microsoft SQL Server, along with proven experience developing and supporting enterprise-scale data platforms. The role requires an individual who can work independently, troubleshoot complex issues, analyze large datasets, and deliver robust solutions in a production environment.




The Market Risk Time Series platform is responsible for sourcing, managing, and maintaining historical market data and risk factor time series across spot rates, curves, spreads, and volatility surfaces. The platform supports workflow-driven construction methodologies, proxy and backfill capabilities, shock generation, returns calculations, and data quality controls used in VaR, SVaR, stress testing, and risk capital calculations.




The candidate will work closely with Historical Market Data, Market Risk, Risk Analytics, Quantitative Analytics, and Technology teams to deliver high-quality solutions supporting critical risk management processes.




Key Responsibilities:



Deliver application enhancements, bug fixes, and technology improvements for the Market Risk Time Series platform.
Develop, test, deploy, and support Python-based services and data processing components.
Design and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and database solutions within Microsoft SQL Server.
Investigate and resolve production incidents, data issues, and system performance bottlenecks.
Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions to improve platform stability.
Collaborate with business users, Market Risk teams, and quantitative analysts to understand requirements and deliver technical solutions.
Support onboarding and maintenance of market data and risk factor time series across multiple asset classes.
Improve data quality, monitoring, controls, and operational processes across the platform.
Contribute to automation initiatives aimed at reducing manual intervention and improving operational efficiency.
Participate in code reviews, testing, release management, and production support activities.
Work with scheduling and orchestration tools to ensure reliable execution of platform processes.
Follow SDLC, development standards, documentation standards, and change management processes.



Required Skills:




Core Skills



Strong hands-on programming expertise in Python.
Extensive experience developing, testing, troubleshooting, and supporting Python applications in production environments.
Strong expertise in SQL with experience writing and optimizing complex queries, stored procedures, and database objects.
Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server.
Experience working with enterprise-scale data-intensive applications.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Experience working within formal SDLC and release management processes.
Good understanding of software engineering best practices, code quality, and testing methodologies.



Desirable Skills



Exposure to SSIS and ETL development.
Experience with job scheduling tools such as Autosys, Control-M, Tidal, or similar platforms.
Experience with Databricks, PySpark, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, or Azure Data Lake.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.



Domain Knowledge (Preferred)



Understanding of Market Risk concepts and risk data management.
Exposure to historical market data management and risk factor time series.
Knowledge of VaR, Stressed VaR, stress testing, and risk reporting processes.
Understanding of financial instruments, curves, spreads, volatility surfaces, and market data lifecycle.
Experience working within investment banking or capital markets environments.



Key Competencies:



Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Strong ownership and accountability for delivery and production stability.
Excellent troubleshooting and investigative skills.
Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Collaborative mindset with the ability to engage effectively with business and technology stakeholders.



Qualifications:



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
8-12 years of software development and enterprise application experience.
Proven experience delivering and supporting mission-critical data platforms in production environments.

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the worlds leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuhos international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

Strong programming skills in Python and modern C++ (C++17 or later).

title: Mobile Automation Tester
description:
Job description

Role: SDET- Mobile Automation Test Engineer

Location: Pune

Experience: 4-8 years

Notice Period- 0-30 Days




About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on SDET to own quality for our mobile banking and payments apps across Android and iOS. You will work inside a cross-functional squad with developers, product owners, and designers. You will build and maintain mobile automation, drive testing across the full test lifecycle, and help us ship secure, reliable financial features at speed.




Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain scalable mobile automation frameworks using WebdriverIO or Playwright with Appium and TypeScript.
Automate functional, regression, and smoke suites for Android and iOS apps, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
Write API tests to validate backend services that power the mobile app, including payments, onboarding, and account flows.
Participate in every STLC phase: requirement analysis, test planning, test design, execution, defect reporting, and test closure.
Review user stories and acceptance criteria early in the sprint to catch gaps, edge cases, and testability issues.
Log, track, triage, and retest defects in Jira with clear reproduction steps, severity, priority, and evidence.
Maintain test cases, test runs, and traceability in TestRail or an equivalent test management tool.
Run tests on real devices and cloud device farms, and analyse failures across OS versions and device models.
Report quality metrics such as automation coverage, pass rates, flaky tests, and defect trends to the squad.
Collaborate with developers on unit and integration test coverage, and promote a shift-left quality mindset.



Must Have

4+ years of hands-on experience in test automation, with at least 2 years on mobile app automation.
Appium: strong experience automating Android and iOS apps (native and/or hybrid).
WebdriverIO or Playwright: hands-on experience using either as the automation framework.
TypeScript / JavaScript (Node.js): strong programming skills, including async/await, OOP, and clean code practices.
Framework design: experience with Page Object Model or a similar pattern, reusable components, and config-driven execution.
STLC: solid understanding of the test lifecycle, test design techniques (boundary value, equivalence partitioning, decision tables), and test types (functional, regression, smoke, sanity).
Defect management: proven experience writing clear bug reports, defining severity vs. priority, running triage, and owning the defect lifecycle.
Jira & test management: working knowledge of Jira for stories and defects, and TestRail (or Zephyr, Xray, qTest) for test case management.
API testing: experience with a code-based tool (Axios, SuperTest, or similar) and familiarity with Postman.
Git & CI/CD: experience running automation in pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
Mobile testing know-how: gestures, permissions, interruptions, network conditions, app install/upgrade, and device fragmentation.
Agile: experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
Communication: clear written and verbal communication in English.



Nice to Have

Fintech or banking domain experience, such as payments, wallets, KYC/onboarding, card management, or transaction flows.
Fintech quality awareness: data accuracy, transaction integrity, audit trails, and regulatory compliance.
Cloud device farms such as LambdaTest, BrowserStack, or Sauce Labs.
Test runners & reporting: Mocha or Jest, and reporting tools like Allure.
Mobile performance testing: app launch time, memory, battery, and network usage.
Tool integration: pushing CI test results into TestRail via APIs.
Debugging tools: Android Studio, Xcode, ADB, and device logs.
SQL for backend data validation.
Contract testing / mocking: Pact, WireMock, MSW, or similar.
AI-assisted testing tools for test generation, self-healing locators, or failure analysis.



What We Offer

Ownership of quality for a high-impact fintech product
A modern automation stack and room to shape testing practices

Job description

Position: Sitecore Content Hub Developer

Location: Pan India

Total Exp: 5 to 9 Years




About the Job




The Sitecore Content Hub Developer is a member of a cross-functional Agile squad responsible for implementing and supporting enterprise Content Hub solutions (DAM/MAM, PIM/CCM, content modelling and distribution). This developer communicates effectively across teams, translates business requirements into Content Hub models and integrations, and applies strong engineering practices (clean code, security, scalable architecture). The ideal candidate combines hands-on Content Hub experience (Content Hub Assets/Models/Workflows), integration experience with Stream and Connect, and strong API/.NET development skills.

Your Responsibilities

Collaborate with product owners, designers, and engineers to understand requirements, design Content Hub solutions, and implement specifications.
Design and implement Content Hub data models, taxonomies, life cycles, workflows, renditions, and metadata schemas to support editorial and marketing requirements.
Build and extend Sitecore Content Hub using the Content Hub SDK, REST, and GraphQL APIs, CLI, and configuration tooling.
Implement and support Content Hub Stream solutions for event-driven processing, automated asset pipelines, and real-time integrations.
Implement and maintain Content Hub Connect integrations and connectors (Sitecore XP/XM, CMS, PIM, commerce, MDM, DAM, external storage/CDN, CRM/ERP).
Build secure, robust integrations using Connectors, webhooks, message queues, and middleware (Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, etc.).
Develop custom modules, custom plugins, and server-side logic using C#/.NET and the Content Hub SDK.
Architect APIs and integration patterns (REST/GraphQL) for third-party systems and front ends to ingest, discover, and deliver content and assets.
Lead migration and ingestion activities for large asset libraries (bulk import, mapping, metadata enrichment, validation).
Collaborate with frontend teams to ensure optimized asset delivery (renditions, responsive images, caching, CDN).
Apply quality and non-functional requirements: scalability, performance, security (OWASP), and availability.
Create and maintain documentation for solution designs, deployment runbooks, integration guides, and migration plans.
Mentor and coach junior engineers through design reviews and code reviews, share best practices for Content Hub development.

Identify risks early, propose mitigations and contribute technical leadership to the squad.

Skills and Expertise

5+ years of software development experience for enterprise applications (object-oriented design, distributed systems, web services).
3+ years of hands-on experience with Sitecore Content Hub (modeling, assets, workflows, metadata, renditions).
Demonstrable experience implementing Content Hub Stream (event processing, asset pipelines) and Content Hub Connect (connectors/integrations).
Strong development skills in C# / .NET, ASP.NET Web API / MVC, and experience using the Content Hub SDK and CLI.
Solid experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and designing integration patterns.
Experience with content and asset migration tools and techniques (bulk import, mapping, ETL).
Familiarity with content modeling concepts: entities, relationships, taxonomies, vocabularies, and lifecycle/workflow design.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and modern front-end build tooling to collaborate with front-end teams.
Experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure), CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins), containerization (Docker), and infrastructure as code.
Working knowledge of relational databases (Microsoft SQL Server) and search/index technologies.
Experience with source control (Git, TFS) and Agile development practices (Scrum).
Excellent communication skills and demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

Experience integrating Content Hub with Sitecore XP/XM, Sitecore Experience Edge, or Sitecore Headless solutions (JSS).
Experience with CDNs, cloud object storage (S3/Azure Blob), image/video processing pipelines, and transcode services.
Familiarity with message brokers and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
Experience with enterprise connector ecosystems (Salesforce, SAP, Adobe, commercetools, or similar).
Experience with automated testing frameworks, performance tuning, and profiling for asset-heavy workloads.
Prior exposure to Adobe / other DAMs and migration experience into Sitecore Content Hub.
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Personal Attributes

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; pragmatic and solution-oriented.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; adept at explaining technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Self-starter who can work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced Agile environment.
Passion for building robust, maintainable systems and improving developer experience.

description:
Job description

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and vision-driven Senior AI/ML Developer to lead our machine learning engineering initiatives and design scalable, production-ready AI solutions. In this role, you will bridge technical architecture, hands-on development, and team leadershipdriving end-to-end Machine Learning lifecycles from rapid prototyping and fine-tuning to containerized cloud deployment and monitoring.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Architect, design, and implement end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines and microservices for production workloads.
Lead the adoption of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and OCR/Document Intelligence frameworks (e.g., Qwen VL, Gemma variants, PyMuPDF, Docling, OpenCV).
Standardize core engineering workflows including model quantization, LoRA/PEFT fine-tuning, and multi-adapter serving architectures using vLLM, llama.cpp, and Hugging Face Transformers.

Cloud Infrastructure & MLOps

Design and manage scalable AWS cloud infrastructure leveraging SageMaker, Lambda, ECS Fargate, S3, ECR, and SQS.

Team Management & Delivery

Lead and mentor an engineering team , conducting code reviews, technical planning, and sprint delivery.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders, product managers, and executive leadership to translate business objectives into high-impact AI capability roadmaps.
Define technical standards, design patterns, and best practices across model evaluation, security, latency optimization, and cost governance.

Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering and AI/ML experience, with demonstrated hands-on leadership as an Architect or Team Lead.

Languages: Python (PyTorch, FastAPI, NumPy, Pandas, PIL)

In this role, you will plan and execute manual and automated testing across web pages, components, forms, content workflows, APIs, integrations, and releases. You will work closely with developers, content authors, product owners, designers, and delivery partners to identify defects early, expand automated test coverage, and deliver reliable, secure, and user-friendly digital experiences across browsers, devices, and environments.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Sitecore AI websites, features, components, forms, content updates, integrations, and releases.
Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, end-to-end, cross-browser, responsive, accessibility, performance, and visual testing across supported environments.
Build, maintain, and improve automated tests for critical website journeys, reusable components, APIs, and regression scenarios using modern web test automation frameworks.
Validate Sitecore AI authoring experiences, page and component configuration, content publishing, personalization, search, forms, analytics tagging, consent behavior, and third-party integrations.
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and review results to support release readiness and rapid defect detection.
Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, screenshots or logs, severity, and business impact; verify fixes through retesting and regression testing.
Partner with developers, designers, content teams, and product owners to clarify acceptance criteria, identify test risks, and improve testability early in the delivery lifecycle.
Create and maintain reusable automation utilities, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and reporting that improve test reliability and reduce manual effort.
Track test execution, automation coverage, defect trends, escaped defects, and release quality metrics, and communicate findings and risks clearly to stakeholders.
Contribute to quality standards, test documentation, peer reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of website testing practices.
Requirements
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
At least 4 years of experience in software quality assurance, with hands-on responsibility for testing websites or web applications in enterprise environments.
Strong knowledge of QA methods, the software development lifecycle, test design techniques, defect management, risk-based testing, and release validation.
Hands-on experience creating and maintaining web test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, or equivalent technologies.
Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript and working knowledge of another scripting or programming language such as Python, Java, or C#.
Experience testing modern websites and web applications, including responsive layouts, reusable components, navigation, search, forms, content publishing, APIs, and third-party integrations.
Experience with API testing tools and techniques, including request validation, response validation, authentication, error handling, and integration scenarios.
Experience with Git-based workflows, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, automated test execution, test reporting, and quality gates.
Ability to use browser developer tools, logs, network traces, and test evidence to isolate and communicate website defects effectively.
Experience validating cross-browser and cross-device behavior, accessibility, performance, security-related requirements, analytics tagging, and production readiness.
Ability to write clear test cases, automation code, defect reports, test summaries, and release-quality recommendations.
Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross-functional delivery environment.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, review test assets, troubleshoot failures, and share testing and automation knowledge with team members.
Nice to Have
Hands-on testing experience with Sitecore AI, Sitecore XM Cloud, Experience Edge, or another composable digital experience platform.
Experience testing React and Next.js websites deployed through Vercel, Microsoft Azure, or another cloud platform.

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
Job description



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design, build, and maintain responsive front-end components using Lit (or equivalent modern component frameworks), including work that crosses Shadow DOM boundaries.

Develop and extend backend services written in server-side ES5 JavaScript, alongside newer TypeScript and Python services.

Build and consume REST APIs, including authentication and role-based access control (Basic Auth, OAuth, JWT).

Model and query relational data, with attention to schema design, joins, and query performance.

Contribute to AI agent services built on LangGraph, including graph design, state management, and checkpointing.

Extend and debug Python/FastAPI services with typed, async code and Pydantic models.

Write and maintain end-to-end and API tests with Playwright (or Cypress/Selenium), including per-role permission checks.

Participate in code review, Git branching/rebasing at team scale, and diagnosing GitHub Actions workflow failures.

Bring up, debug, and operate local environments using Docker Compose.

Use AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) responsibly scoping tasks clearly, reviewing generated output critically, and owning the final result.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

HRMS Experience is Must

FRONTEND

JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript — strong in both.

HTML and CSS/SCSS, including responsive layout and how styling crosses a Shadow DOM boundary.

A modern component framework — Lit ideally, or solid React experience; what matters most is thinking in components, props, and state.

Web components — custom elements, Shadow DOM, reactive properties (direct experience is a plus, not a gate).

Browser fundamentals — ES modules, fetch, DevTools, and basic CSP debugging.




BACKEND

Server-side JavaScript in ES5 — prototype-based classes, no async/await; this is the largest body of code in the codebase.

REST APIs — building and consuming them, with authentication.

Relational data modelling — tables, references, joins, and query performance.

Access control — roles and permissions, Basic Auth / OAuth / JWT; a first-class concern in these applications.




AI AGENT SERVICES

LangGraph — our agent services are built on it: graphs, state, and checkpointing. LangChain or a comparable orchestration library transfers; what matters is having built something agentic, not just called a model.

Python with FastAPI — typed, async, Pydantic models; enough to extend and debug a service, not necessarily own the whole stack.

LLM application basics — prompts, tool calling, structured output, and handling cases where the model returns something unusable.

AWS Bedrock — we call Claude models through it; Anthropic or OpenAI API experience transfers.




TESTING & DELIVERY

Playwright (or Cypress / Selenium) — writing both API and end-to-end tests, including per-role permission checks.

Git at team scale — branches, rebasing, PR review, and resolving real conflicts.

GitHub Actions — enough to read a workflow and diagnose a failure.

Docker Compose — bring up and debug a local stack (up, logs, exec); no Dockerfile authoring needed.




WORKING WITH CLAUDE

Has used an AI coding agent on real work — Claude Code or similar.

Reviews what it writes — can describe a time it was confidently wrong and how they caught it.

Scopes and contextualizes tasks rather than asking for whole features in one go.

Owns the output — can explain and defend every line they submit.




NICE TO HAVE

AngularJS 1.x — our Lit components mount inside AngularJS portal widgets; optional, but rare and hard to teach, so a real bonus. (Not the same as modern Angular.)

ServiceNow — scoped apps, Service Portal, Glide APIs, Fluent SDK.

Python for deployment and provisioning scripts.

Postgres, Redis, OpenSearch; RAG or agent-evaluation experience.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Job description

About us:ConveGenius is an AI-native education infrastructure company transforming how governments, enterprises, and social institutions deliver learning and governance outcomes at population scale. Operating across B2G and B2B segments, the company partners with state governments, CSR funders, philanthropies, and social enterprises to build intelligent education ecosystems that are both impactful and commercially sustainable.At its core, ConveGenius runs two synergistic business lines:



SwiftAI the intelligence and automation layer that powers citizen engagement, governance efficiency, and real-time decision-making for governments and institutions.
SwiftSchool the learning infrastructure layer that integrates adaptive learning, digital classrooms, and analytics to drive measurable student and system outcomes.



This dual-engine model enables ConveGenius to serve as the technology backbone for education reform — connecting classrooms, communities, and command centres through a unified AI-powered framework. Unlike traditional edtech companies that deliver content, ConveGenius builds infrastructure — platforms that integrate deeply into public delivery systems while enabling private and philanthropic partners to scale their missions with measurable results.
With operations across 22+ Indian states and partnerships with multilaterals, CSR alliances, and government departments, ConveGenius has established itself as a partner-friendly enterprise trusted for aligning policy priorities with social and financial returns. Supported by institutional investors and guided by a double bottom line philosophy, the company consistently delivers impact at scale and profitability with purpose.
As ConveGenius enters its next phase of growth, it is shaping the future of AI-led public education infrastructure — where technology, partnerships, and governance intelligence converge to redefine how nations learn and thrive.


Learn more about us: https://linktr.ee/convegenius11


About the Role:We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to be embedded directly with clients — part engineer, part product partner, part trusted advisor. You will own the arc of a client engagement end-to-end: understanding the business problem, shaping the solution, building it, and making sure it actually delivers value once it ships.
This role suits someone who is a strong full-stack engineer first, but who is energized by being close to users and stakeholders rather than insulated from them. You will frequently be the only technical voice in the room, translating ambiguous business needs into concrete software, and translating technical realities back into language the client can act on. Equal parts shipping code, asking the right questions, and building the kind of relationship that makes clients want to keep working with you.
AI-assisted development is part of our standard workflow. Candidates should have hands-on experience with tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude Code.


Key Responsibilities:


Engineering & Delivery

• Build fullstack web applications using React/TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, with responsive interfaces that work across desktop and mobile

• Design and implement APIs, database schemas, and frontend architectures suitable for production use

• Design, develop, and deploy AI agents to automate workflows and enhance product capabilities using frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, or OpenAI Agents SDK

• Debug and resolve issues across the full stack, including in production environments• Write clean, tested, and well-documented code


Product Thinking

• Run discovery with clients to uncover the underlying problem — not just the feature they asked for — and translate it into a clear solution shape

• Scope work into shippable increments, make trade-offs between scope, time, and quality, and communicate those trade-offs transparently

• Maintain a working roadmap for each engagement and keep priorities aligned as the picture evolves

• Define success metrics with the client and track whether what you ship is actually moving them

• Push back constructively when a request doesn't serve the user or the business, and propose better alternatives


Client & Relationship Management

• Be the primary technical point of contact for the engagement — running working sessions, demos, and status updates with confidence

• Build trust with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership at the client

• Set and manage expectations proactively — surface risks early, communicate slippage honestly, and celebrate wins concretely

• Spot opportunities to deepen the engagement and flag them to the wider team

• Leave every interaction with the client feeling that the engagement is in good hands


Requirements Must Have

• 3-6 years of experience building and shipping production web applications across the full stack

• Strong proficiency in React.js (TypeScript, hooks, modern patterns)

• Solid backend experience with Node.js (Express, Fastify, or similar)

• Working proficiency in PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimization, migrations

• Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs

• Active use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) in professional work, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated output

• Demonstrated product instinct — comfort scoping ambiguous problems, prioritizing ruthlessly, and making sensible build-vs-defer calls without a PM holding your hand

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of working directly with clients or business stakeholders

• High ownership — you treat the client's outcome as your own and follow through without being chased


Good to Have

• Experience building or integrating AI agents (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar frameworks)

• Prior experience in a client-facing, consulting, or forward-deployed engineering role

• Experience leading discovery workshops, writing PRDs or solution proposals, or running stakeholder demos

• Experience with third-party system integrations (ERPs, payment gateways, OAuth/SSO)

• Data migration experience — cleaning, transforming, and loading data from varied sources• Familiarity with message queues

• Exposure to account growth, renewals, or scoping follow-on work with existing clients


What We Offer and Why You Should Join ConveGenius
At ConveGenius, we create an environment where purpose meets growth. You will be part of a mission driven organization that is transforming how learning reaches children across India, especially at scale and where it matters most.

Work with a diverse and passionate team spread across India, bringing together people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and expertise.
Be part of an organization with a strong on ground presence across more than two thirds of India, giving you exposure to large scale, real world impact.
Play a meaningful role in strengthening the education ecosystem and contributing directly to learning outcomes for millions of children.
Gain experience working at the intersection of education, technology, and public systems, building skills that are highly relevant and future focused.
Work in a culture that values ownership, learning, and collaboration, with space to take initiative and grow professionally.
Enjoy stability and peace of mind with employee friendly benefits, including health insurance coverage and other supportive policies.
If you are driven by purpose, enjoy solving complex problems, and want your work to create visible impact, ConveGenius offers a place to grow while making a difference.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Job description

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to manage, automate, monitor, and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with AWS services, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration, scripting, networking, monitoring, and production support.


The candidate should demonstrate strong troubleshooting, critical-thinking, proactive planning, and problem-solving skills, with a focus on improving system reliability and operational efficiency.


Key Responsibilities

Manage, maintain, and troubleshoot AWS cloud infrastructure and production environments.
Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, and Packer.
Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git, and pipeline scripting.
Write Python and Bash/Shell scripts to automate routine operations, deployments, health checks, and incident response.
Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, logs, and alerts using CloudWatch and relevant AWS monitoring services.
Troubleshoot Linux systems, network connectivity, DNS, SSH/SFTP, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/UDP, DHCP, and WebSocket-related issues.
Manage cloud security, access controls, secrets, vulnerability remediation, and auditing using AWS security services.
Handle production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement corrective actions, and proactively improve system reliability.
Maintain infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, backups, disaster recovery procedures, and effective shift handovers.
Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to improve automation, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.
Demonstrate strong ownership, critical thinking, proactive planning, and the ability to troubleshoot issues independently.



Required Technical Skills

Cloud Platforms and AWS Services

Hands-on experience with AWS EC2, RDS, ECS, ECR, VPC, S3, CloudFront, Step Functions, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager (SSM), CloudWatch, EventBridge, Lambda, Inspector, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, DynamoDB, API Gateway, Route 53, ElastiCache, SNS, Cognito, and IAM.
Familiarity with Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID) and identity/access management.

Infrastructure as Code and Automation

Terraform, Ansible, and Packer.
Infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and automation best practices.

CI/CD and Version Control

Jenkins, Git, pipeline development, deployment automation, and troubleshooting pipeline failures.

Scripting and Operating Systems

Python and Bash/Shell scripting.
Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including log analysis, process management, permissions, services, and system performance.

Networking

Practical understanding of SSH, SFTP, DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, DHCP, TCP, UDP, and WebSockets.
Knowledge of VPC networking, subnets, routing, security groups, network ACLs, and connectivity troubleshooting.

Monitoring, Security, and Reliability

Cloud monitoring, alerting, log analysis, incident management, root cause analysis, access control, and vulnerability remediation.
Understanding of high availability, backups, disaster recovery, and production reliability practices.



Experience and Qualifications

3-6 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure Engineering, or Production Support.
Hands-on experience managing AWS infrastructure and supporting production environments.
Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Git, Linux, and scripting.
Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, deployment, and application connectivity issues.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and manage critical incidents.



Behavioral Competencies and Shift Requirements

Strong critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and troubleshooting abilities.
Proactive planning, risk identification, and continuous improvement mindset.
Good communication, collaboration, and incident coordination skills.
Ability to work under pressure and take ownership of production issues.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts, primarily night shifts, with occasional morning shifts.
Ability to perform effective shift handovers and provide timely production support.



Preferred Qualifications

AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator - Associate.
Experience with containerized workloads, cloud security, disaster recovery, and infrastructure cost optimization.
Familiarity with SRE practices, including SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and automation to reduce manual operational effort.

About us:

Trinity Mobile App Labs motto is to Help businesses go mobile.

About the Product:

Soul Home is a spatial analysis platform that captures a users home in 3D via LiDAR (iPhone Pro), ARCore depth (certified Android), or guided photo capture (fallback tier) and runs the resulting spatial model through a deterministic rule engine built on classical Vastu Shastra and Feng Shui doctrine. The 3D capture layer you will own is the foundation of the entire product: every downstream analysis depends on an accurate, correctly oriented model of the users space.




Role Overview:

You will design and build the native 3D capture experience on both iOS and Android, plus the cross-platform app shell that hosts it. This is not an “AR filters” role. It is a spatial computing role: room-scale scanning, mesh generation, coordinate systems, compass-anchored orientation, and structured export of walls, doors, windows, and objects into a format a rule engine can consume.




Core Responsibilities

Build the iOS LiDAR capture tier using ARKit scene reconstruction and Apple RoomPlan, producing parametric room models (walls, openings, dimensions) and USDZ/glTF exports
Build the Android ARCore capture tier using the Depth API / Raw Depth API, accumulating depth frames into usable meshes, with capture UX that adapts to widely varying device depth quality
Implement magnetic/true north binding so every captured model carries reliable absolute orientation (this is a hard product requirement — directional analysis fails without it)
Design the guided capture UX for both tiers: coverage feedback, tracking-loss recovery, rescan flows, room-size limits, multi-room stitching
Build the app shell (Flutter or React Native, or native twins — you will help make this call) with native modules bridging to the AR capture layers
Define the scan artifact contract (mesh + parametric layout + orientation metadata + detected-object anchors) handed to the backend processing pipeline
Handle offline-first capture with deferred upload; ship and maintain both apps through Play Store and App Store release cycles



Must-Have Skills




Mobile & Languages

4+ years mobile development with strong Swift AND Kotlin (we will test both)
Xcode and Android Studio proficiency, including profiling tools (Instruments, Android Profiler)
Native module / platform channel bridging from Flutter or React Native
Full store deployment experience on both platforms: signing, provisioning, review cycles, staged rollouts



AR & 3D (the core of this role)

Shipped at least one production app using ARKit or ARCore beyond marker/plane demos — depth, meshing, or scene reconstruction
Solid 3D math fundamentals: transforms, quaternions, coordinate spaces, projection
Clear working understanding of meshes vs point clouds and when each applies
Hands-on with RealityKit/SceneKit (iOS) and Filament or SceneView (Android)
3D formats: glTF/GLB, USDZ, OBJ, PLY — including conversion and export pipelines
Camera, IMU, and magnetometer sensor APIs; practical understanding of compass calibration and magnetic declination



Engineering Practice

Git, code review discipline, and CI/CD for mobile (Fastlane, GitHub Actions, or equivalent)
REST/JSON API integration, background upload, and offline-first data handling
Ability to write and work from formal specs (our modules are spec-documented before implementation)
Clear written and verbal communication in English; comfortable working directly with a founder as sole domain authority



Good-to-Have Skills

Apple RoomPlan experience, including its multi-room and room-size limitations
On-device mesh processing (Metal or NDK), mesh decimation, plane fitting
Experience integrating object detection output (e.g., YOLO) into spatial coordinates
SLAM/VIO conceptual depth: drift, relocalization, anchor stability, loop closure
Familiarity with device fragmentation strategy for ARCore-certified hardware in the Indian market
Flutter or React Native app-shell architecture at production scale
Unity or Unreal AR experience (useful background, though this role is native-first)
Basic Python for scripting scan-validation and format-conversion tooling
Experience with WebSocket or push-based job-status patterns
Prior work on measurement, scanning, real-estate, or interior-design apps
Accessibility and localization experience (the wider product ships in 12 languages)



To Apply

You must apply to this job post and additionally send CV + links to shipped apps + a short note on the most technically difficult AR/3D problem you have personally solved at - yashika@makeourhome.ai

You will join the AkzoNobels Advanced Analytics team, working at the heart of a global manufacturing environment. Your mission: accelerate world-class end-to-end supply chain performance by delivering scalable, secure, and high-impact AI/data products on our Azure cloud platform.

E2E Reporting & Decision Intelligence**

Master Data Quality & Automation**

6. Governance, Security & Responsible AI

- Define and track **model KPIs** (accuracy, stability, bias checks, latency, uptime, business outcome metrics).




Regards,

title: Power BI SDET / Test Automation Engineer
description:
Job description

Role Summary

We are looking for a Power BI SDET who combines strong manual testing fundamentals with a growing automation and AI-assisted quality engineering practice. You will own the quality of Power BI semantic models, reports, and data pipelines for lululemon's retail analytics, making sure the numbers business users rely on are accurate, performant, and trusted.

You will also help shape how the team uses Microsoft Copilot (Power BI and Fabric) and agentic AI to validate reports, generate test assets, and speed up regression cycles, while testing the AI-driven experiences themselves.

Key Responsibilities

Manual and functional testing (core of the role)

Design and execute test plans, cases, and exploratory sessions for Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
Validate DAX measures, calculated columns, KPIs, and business logic against source systems and business definitions (sell-through, units per transaction, inventory turns, comp sales, margin, and similar).
Perform data reconciliation between source systems (ERP, POS, e-commerce, warehouse) and the reporting layer.
Test row-level security (RLS) and object-level security by persona, such as store manager, regional lead, merchandiser, and executive.
Test slicers, drill-through, bookmarks, cross-filtering, tooltips, and visual behavior across browsers, devices, and the Power BI mobile app.
Validate refresh behavior (scheduled and incremental), gateway connectivity, and data freshness.
Log, triage, and track defects in Azure DevOps or Jira, with clear repro steps and business impact.
Run UAT with business stakeholders and sign off on release readiness.

Test automation

Build automated data validation and regression suites using SQL, Python, and/or PySpark.
Automate semantic model testing with DAX queries, Tabular Editor and Best Practice Analyzer rules, and the XMLA endpoint.
Integrate automated checks into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) with Power BI deployment pipelines and Git-based source control (PBIP / TMDL).
Automate UI and report smoke tests where practical (Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent).
Establish performance baselines using Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, and Fabric capacity metrics.

AI-infused quality engineering

Copilot: Use Copilot in Power BI / Fabric to accelerate test design, DAX review, measure explanation, and report summaries, and independently verify its outputs.
Testing AI outputs: Test Copilot-generated content (narratives, DAX suggestions, Q&A responses) for accuracy, hallucination, consistency, and security/data-exposure risks.
Agentic AI: Apply agentic patterns, such as agents that generate test cases from requirements, run reconciliation checks, triage failures, or draft defect reports, with a human in the loop.
Guardrails: Help define guardrails, evaluation criteria, and acceptance thresholds for AI-assisted analytics features.
Responsible AI: Document responsible-AI practices for testing, including data privacy, prompt and output logging, and bias checks.

Collaboration

Work with BI developers, data engineers, product owners, and lululemon business stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Contribute to test strategy, definition of done, and quality gates for the analytics platform.
Mentor junior testers on moving from manual to automated and AI-assisted approaches.

Required Qualifications

5+ years in software or data testing, with substantial hands-on manual testing experience (functional, regression, exploratory, UAT).
Practical experience testing Power BI reports and semantic models, including DAX, RLS, and refresh/deployment behavior.
Strong SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation.
Solid understanding of data warehousing and BI concepts (star schema, ETL/ELT, dimensions and facts, slowly changing dimensions).
Experience with defect and test management tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, or Xray).

title: Data Scientist
description:
Job description
What you will do
• Improve the quality of search results, so that the most relevant jobs appear at the top.
• Work out what a user actually means when they type a search — the role, the locality, the experience
level, the pay they expect — even when the query is a few words typed in Hindi, Hinglish or a regional
language, with spelling that follows how the word sounds.
• Make distance a first-class part of ranking. For most of our roles, a job close to home is a fundamentally
better result than a well-matched one across the city.
• Keep results genuine and current — filled or low-quality listings ranked highly are a bad user experience,
so quality and freshness are part of the model, not an afterthought.
• Build and improve recommendation models that suggest relevant jobs to jobseekers and relevant
candidates to recruiters.
• Decide how "good" is measured, and prove your changes helped by running experiments on live traffic.
• Work with very large volumes of user activity data to build the inputs your models need.
• Partner with product managers and engineers to take models live, and present results clearly to both
technical and non-technical audiences.
What we are looking for
• 4–6 years of hands-on machine learning experience.
• At least 2 of those years spent on search result ranking, recommendations, or personalisation — for a live
product with real users. Academic projects, competitions, and internal prototypes do not count towards
this.
• Strong programming in Python and strong SQL.
• Experience handling very large datasets using tools such as Spark, PySpark, or Hive.
• Practical experience with the machine learning techniques used for ranking and recommendations.
• Experience designing and running A/B tests, and the ability to say clearly what your change did to a
business number.
• Experience working with text data — matching what a user is looking for against what a job description
says. Experience with Indian-language or transliterated text is a strong plus.
• The ability to explain a technical trade-off in simple language to a product manager or business
stakeholder.
Nice to have
• Experience with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, Solr, or OpenSearch, or with large-scale
similarity search.
• Experience with deep learning approaches to recommendations and retrieval.
• Experience in a two-sided marketplace, where both sides of the platform have to be kept happy.
• Practical use of large language models to support search and relevance work.
• Experience with production ML tooling such as Airflow, MLflow, or feature stores

Youll also own the operations queue. You decide what matters most, act on it, and follow up until its closed.
What youll do
Make deployments fast and automatic. Build GitHub Actions pipelines that take a merged PR to production in minutes. No manual server steps, and a one-click rollback.
Gate every release on tests. Run unit, integration and smoke tests, plus lint and security scans, inside the pipeline. A failing test blocks the deploy, and a failed health check rolls it back automatically.
Run Kubernetes on EKS. Own our EKS clusters, Helm charts and ArgoCD GitOps flow. Lead the move of the API, workers and cron jobs from EC2, PM2 and ECS onto EKS with zero downtime.
Integrate other providers. Deploy and connect services across AWS and managed providers such as ClickHouse Cloud, MongoDB, Redis, and our messaging and payment vendors. Handle networking, private connectivity, secrets and IP allowlists.
Follow best practices. Infrastructure as code for everything, least-privilege IAM, OIDC instead of long-lived keys, separate dev, staging and production environments, and documented runbooks.
Scale the system. Tune autoscaling for pods, nodes, ECS tasks, Lambda concurrency and SQS-driven workers, so we absorb traffic spikes without paying for idle capacity.
Own backups and recovery. Set backup policies for MongoDB, ClickHouse, S3 and cluster state. Define recovery time and recovery point targets, and run restore drills on a schedule so backups are proven, not assumed.
Cut AWS cost. Track spend by service and environment, right-size instances, use Savings Plans and Spot where safe, set S3 lifecycle rules and log retention, remove idle resources, and report monthly savings in numbers.
Monitor and alert. Build Datadog and CloudWatch dashboards and alerts for latency, error rates, queue depth, consumer lag and disk, each with an owner and a runbook.
Prioritise and follow through. Triage the DevOps backlog and incoming alerts by impact, act on the highest-priority items first, and follow up with each owner until the fix ships and the postmortem actions are closed.
Our current setup
We run a mix of models today, and part of your job is to simplify it.
Area What we run today Where were heading CI/CD GitHub Actions with AWS OIDC roles, approver-restricted production deploys, Slack notifications Tests and scans gate every deploy, with automatic rollback API servers EC2 Auto Scaling groups with Node.js and PM2, deployed over SSM, with AMI and instance refreshes EKS Containers Docker images in ECR; ECS Fargate for background workers (campaigns, imports, crons, segment analysis) EKS, with ECS only where its simpler Kubernetes EKS with Helm charts and ArgoCD GitOps from a separate infra repo All long-running services Serverless AWS Lambda via Serverless Framework; Kinesis Data Streams, SQS, EventBridge Scheduler Keep, with IaC and cost limits Data MongoDB, ClickHouse Cloud, Redis, S3 Tested backups, restore drills, lifecycle rules Config and secrets AWS SSM Parameter Store Centralised secrets with rotation Observability Datadog APM and logs, CloudWatch metrics and alarms, Slack alerts Service-level objectives (SLOs) with owned alerts and runbooks


How youll prioritise
Youll run the DevOps queue against clear priority levels. Every item has an owner, a next step and a follow-up date until its closed.
Priority Example First response Follow-up until closed P0: outage or data at risk API down, failed deploy in production, a backup missing, a security exposure Within 15 minutes, any hour Fix now, update stakeholders every 30 minutes, postmortem within 2 working days P1: degraded service High error rate, queue backlog growing, consumer lag, disk above 85% Within 1 hour Fix the same day, then a root-cause ticket with an owner P2: risk or waste Cost spike, noisy alert, slow pipeline, flaky deploy test, an unpatched image Within 1 working day Planned into the current sprint, with a weekly status check P3: improvement Automation, documentation, tooling upgrades Weekly triage Ranked in the backlog by impact against effort


Each week youll share a short ops report: open P0 and P1 items, their owners, the overdue items, cost against the previous month, and what you closed.
What you bring
3+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering , running production workloads on AWS that customers depend on.
Kubernetes on EKS in production. Deployments, HPA and cluster or node autoscaling (Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler), ingress, IRSA or Pod Identity, resource limits, and upgrading a cluster without downtime.
Helm and GitOps. Youve written and maintained Helm charts and run ArgoCD or Flux, with promotion from dev to staging to production.
CI/CD pipelines. GitHub Actions (or GitLab CI or Jenkins) with test gates, Docker image builds, caching, environment approvals, and blue-green, canary or rolling releases with automatic rollback.
Infrastructure as code. Terraform, CDK or CloudFormation for real environments, with state management and reviewed plans before apply.
AWS breadth. VPC networking, IAM, EC2 and Auto Scaling, ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, Kinesis, CloudWatch, SSM and Secrets Manager, Route 53 and load balancers.
Backups and disaster recovery. Youve set up backups and actually restored from them, and you can explain the recovery time and recovery point you achieved.
AWS cost optimisation. Youve cut a real AWS bill and can show the numbers, using Cost Explorer, tags, right-sizing, Savings Plans, Spot and lifecycle policies.
Monitoring and on-call. Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana or CloudWatch. You build dashboards, write alerts that dont cry wolf, and lead incidents calmly.
Linux and scripting. Strong Bash, plus Python or Node.js for automation.
Ownership and follow-through. You prioritise by impact, chase blockers across teams, and close the loop in writing.
AI-assisted operations
Youll use Claude Code to write pipelines and IaC, debug incidents and automate routine checks. We want someone who has already used it safely on infrastructure work.
How we expect you to use it:
Plan before apply. The agent proposes a change, you read the diff and the plan, and the change ships through a PR and GitOps, never straight to production.
Least privilege for agents too. Read-only AWS and cluster access by default, no credentials in prompts, and audit logs on.
Verify, dont trust. A pipeline is fixed when it passes on a real run, and a backup is good when a restore succeeds.
Codify the runbooks. Turn repeated incident steps into project skills and CLAUDE.md notes so the next person resolves it faster.
Nice to have
Kubernetes on other providers (GKE, AKS) or a multi-cloud setup
A migration you led from EC2 or ECS to EKS without downtime
Running or backing up stateful data services: MongoDB (replica sets, Atlas), ClickHouse, Redis
Event-driven systems in production: Kinesis shard scaling, SQS dead-letter queues, Lambda concurrency limits
Policy and security tooling: OPA/Kyverno, Trivy or ECR image scanning, AWS GuardDuty, Security Hub
FinOps practice: tag-based cost allocation, budgets and anomaly alerts, Kubecost
AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer Professional) or CKA/CKAD
Claude Code skills, hooks or automation youve built for infrastructure work

Monitor applications, read logs, debug production issues and fix them quickly.

Write clean, maintainable, tested code and take part in code reviews.
Use Git properly branching, merge requests and meaningful commits.
Break down requirements into tasks, estimate effort and deliver on time.
Write basic technical documentation for features, APIs and deployments.



If you're passionate about full stack role and available for a full-time commitment, wed love to hear from you.




To apply, please share your resume and availability to monisa@flipkoins.com




Note: We need to fill this position urgently. So preference will be given for immediate joiners

Full-time, on-site at VIJAYA KRISHNA TOWERS, Madhava Reddy Colony, Gachibowli, Hyderabad- 500032.

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid – 3 days/week in-office)




About the Company:

We are an AI-native product engineering partner helping startups and enterprise software companies build, scale, and operate intelligent software products, with deep expertise in AI/ML, RAG systems, agentic workflows, and large-scale data engineering. We operate as a true extension of our clients across B2B/B2C SaaS, Conversational AI, HealthTech, IoT, ESG/Energy, and Data Engineering.




About the Role:

We're looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer who works directly with customer product, engineering, and operations teams to discover problems, design solutions, write production-quality code, build integrations, and drive deployment of Conversational AI and customer experience applications. You'll own outcomes end-to-end — from problem discovery through production deployment — on one client engagement at a time, combining strong Java backend engineering with growing Python-based AI engineering capability.




What You Will Do:

Partner directly with customer product, engineering, operations, and CX teams to translate workflows and pain points into working solutions, APIs, data models, and integration contracts.
Build and maintain backend services and integrations using Java and Spring Boot.
Build AI/LLM capabilities in Python, including agent workflows, tool/API calling, evaluation, guardrails, and MLOps support.

Prototype quickly, validate with customers, iterate on real usage, and own technical troubleshooting and escalations.
Travel to client sites as needed to support discovery and deployment.




What We're Looking For:

4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience delivering customer-facing enterprise software into production.
Strong Java backend competency (Spring Boot, REST APIs, dependency injection, testing, service design) — this is the primary non-negotiable skill.
Solid working knowledge of Python with a genuine willingness to build deeper AI/LLM engineering expertise on the job.
Hands-on Conversational AI experience — conversation state, context handling, fallback, escalation, production measurement.
Experience building APIs and enterprise integrations, including authentication, webhooks, retries, idempotency, and event-driven patterns.
Strong debugging and production-readiness skills across testing, observability, performance, and secure data handling.
Ability to lead technical discovery independently, handle ambiguity, and own outcomes from problem definition through deployment.
Working knowledge of cloud architecture; AWS experience preferred.
Willingness to travel for client engagements and work 3 days/week from the Bengaluru office.

Youll work in Agile teams on financial, analytical, and innovation-driven data productsdriving performance optimization, new development, and platform operations.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop big data solutions using Apache Spark, Hadoop, and cloud-native tools
Write efficient batch and stream processing pipelines in Python and/or Scala
Maintain and optimize data workflows and performance across large data volumes
Manage source control, versioning, and deployments using Git, Jenkins, and other DevOps tools
Conduct performance tuning, system monitoring, and issue resolution
Collaborate with architects, analysts, and business stakeholders to align technical delivery with use cases
Work with Cloudera Hadoop and manage activities like node configuration, file system maintenance, and backups
Follow best practices across software development, code quality, and agile ceremonies
Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and mentoring junior developers
Support and enhance production environments, including disaster recovery planning



Qualifications and Skills




Core Skills

610 years of experience in big data development and operations
Strong programming expertise in Python and/or Scala
Hands-on with Apache Spark, Hadoop, Cloudera, Hive, and HDFS
Proficiency with SQL, NoSQL, Oracle, and scheduling tools (e.g., Autosys)
Experience in performance tuning, troubleshooting, and distributed systems
Familiarity with Git, Jenkins, Ansible, and agile delivery models



Nice to Have

Java development background
Financial domain experience
Knowledge of cloud data solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD practices
Cloudera Hadoop Admin certification (for hybrid roles involving infra)
Hands-on development in fast-paced environments
Led small teams or initiatives within distributed systems projects
Supported large-scale production platforms
Strong communicator who can work across business and engineering teams



Why Join Us

At Ness, you will work with diverse, talented professionals who are dedicated to making an impact through technology. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to applyeven if you dont meet every requirement, wed love to connect with you if this role excites you. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates each team members unique talents. With flexible remote options, diverse projects, and access to development resources, joining Ness means building a career that’s meaningful and impactful.




What to Expect Next

We believe great experiences start with transparency—and that includes our hiring process. Here’s what you can typically expect after you hit "Apply":

1. HR Interview – A conversation to get to know you better and align on expectations

2. Technical Interview – A chance to showcase your skills and experience

3. Client Interview – Ensuring mutual fit between you and the client team

4. Offer Stage – If everything aligns, we’ll be happy to make it official

While many of our roles involve just 2–3 steps, some client processes may include additional conversations. Regardless of the path, we aim to keep every step transparent and respectful of your time.
