title: Data Scientist
description:
Job description

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Data Scientist with strong expertise in Python, statistical modeling, and machine learning to develop, deploy, and scale data science solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience across the complete machine learning lifecycle, including data preprocessing, model development, deployment, MLOps, and model monitoring on AWS.

Experience in Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) is highly preferred. Candidates with relevant experience in MarTech, AdTech, e-commerce, forecasting, optimization, or other modeling-intensive domains are also encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, deploy, and optimize Marketing Mix Models to measure marketing channel effectiveness, ROI, and incrementality.
Build forecasting, simulation, and budget optimization models to support marketing strategy and scenario planning.
Develop Python-based data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, deduplication, validation, preprocessing, and feature engineering.
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), assess data quality, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights.
Build APIs and dashboards to present ROI, marginal ROI (MROI), channel contribution curves, and budget optimization recommendations.
Deploy, monitor, and maintain machine learning solutions on AWS.
Implement reproducible code, unit and integration testing, documentation, version control, and deployment best practices.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines integrating large-scale media, sales, and business datasets.
Collaborate with engineering, marketing, product, and leadership teams to translate model outputs into business recommendations.

Required Technical Skills

1. Python & Data Science

Strong Python programming for backend and data science applications.
Hands-on expertise in Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn.
Data visualization using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly.
Proficiency with Jupyter Notebooks.

2. Statistical Modeling & Machine Learning

Experience developing statistical and machine learning models.
Knowledge of regression, Bayesian modeling, hierarchical modeling, and forecasting.
Experience with model evaluation, optimization, and performance improvement.
Ability to work with complex datasets and derive actionable insights.

3. Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)

Understanding of marketing effectiveness, channel contribution, ROI, and incrementality.
Knowledge of adstock, carryover effects, nonlinear response curves, and marketing budget optimization is highly desirable.

4. SQL & Data Engineering

Strong SQL skills, including DDL/DML, complex queries, and query optimization.
Experience with PostgreSQL and cloud-hosted databases.
Hands-on experience designing and maintaining ETL pipelines and integrating data from multiple sources.

5. AWS & MLOps

Hands-on experience with AWS SageMaker, EC2, S3, Lambda, and related cloud services.
Experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining machine learning models.
Understanding of MLOps practices, CI/CD, and model observability.
Familiarity with Azure Functions is an advantage.

6. Development & Collaboration Tools

Git/GitHub workflows, branching, pull requests, code reviews, and source-control-based deployments.
Ability to write robust unit and integration tests.
Strong analytical thinking, communication, collaboration, and delivery skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

Practical experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).
Deep learning exposure using TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face.
Exposure to agentic AI frameworks and advanced AI platforms.
Experience with enterprise data pipelines and MLOps best practices.
Full-stack exposure, including API development, UI integration, and data science platform integration.

Education

B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science preferred.
BCA / MCA candidates with strong relevant technical experience may also be considered.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A hands-on Data Scientist capable of converting complex datasets into reliable machine learning solutions, statistical insights, and clear business recommendations. Strong modeling fundamentals and end-to-end ML deployment experience are essential. Direct MMM experience is a significant advantage, while candidates from adjacent modeling-intensive domains are also welcome.

Recruiter Note: Candidates should demonstrate practical Python, SQL, statistical modeling, machine learning, and AWS experience. Please highlight any direct MMM experience, including adstock, channel contribution, ROI measurement, and budget optimization, when submitting profiles.

Why Join 7-Eleven Global Solution Center?

When you join us, you'll embrace ownership as teams within specific product areas take responsibility for end-to-end solution delivery, supporting local teams and integrating new digital assets. Challenge yourself by contributing to products deployed across our extensive network of convenience stores, processing over a billion transactions annually. Build solutions for scale, addressing the diverse needs of our 84,000+ stores in 19 countries. Experience growth through cross-functional learning, encouraged and applauded at 7-Eleven GSC. With our size, stability, and resources, you can navigate a rewarding career. Embody leadership and service as 7-Eleven GSC remains dedicated to meeting the needs of customers and communities.

Why We Exist, Our Purpose and Our Transformation?

7-Eleven is dedicated to being a customer-centric, digitally empowered organization that seamlessly integrates our physical stores with digital offerings. Our goal is to redefine convenience by consistently providing top-notch customer experiences and solutions in a rapidly evolving consumer landscape. Anticipating customer preferences, we create and implement platforms that empower customers to shop, pay, and access products and services according to their preferences. To achieve success, we are driving a cultural shift anchored in leadership principles, supported by the realignment of organizational resources and processes.

At 7-Eleven we are guided by our Leadership Principles. Each principle has a defined set of behaviours which help guide the 7-Eleven GSC team to Serve Customers and Support Stores.

1. Be Customer Obsessed

2. Be Courageous with Your Point of View

3. Challenge the Status Quo

4. Act Like an Entrepreneur

5. Have an “It Can Be Done” Attitude

6. Do the Right Thing

7. Be Accountable

Work-Life Balance: Encouraging employees to unwind, recharge, and find balance, we offer flexible and hybrid work schedules along with diverse leave options. Supplementary allowances and compensatory days off are provided for specific work demands.

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
Job description

Full Stack Developer (Intermediate Senior)




Kolkata, West Bengal, India | On-site, 5 days per week | 5+ years | Full-time, permanent




About the Company

Our client is a global technology consulting and engineering firm with delivery hubs in Canada and India, working as one globally local team. They partner with organizations across finance, insurance, utilities, technology, and the not-for-profit sector on cloud modernization, custom application development, data engineering, applied AI, and managed services.

They are a Certified Great Place to Work. Every engagement is led end to end by senior architects and technical leads, and the India engineering team works directly with the Canadian team rather than at arm’s length.

About the Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer (Intermediate – Senior) to design and build cloud-native applications and integrations that sit at the centre of client digital ecosystems.

You will join a team of five in Kolkata and work across the stack, using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React and Angular on the front end, Node.js and PHP services on the back end, relational and NoSQL data stores underneath, and APIs and serverless technologies to connect applications with CRM, marketing technology, content management, and other business platforms.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real technical ownership. You will translate business requirements into resilient technical solutions, write production-grade code, deploy through automated pipelines, and mentor less experienced engineers along the way.

On a team this size, your work is visible. You will work with a high degree of independence in a fast-paced agile setting and be expected to raise the bar on quality and maintainability across the full software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full stack web applications using technologies such as React, Angular, Node.js, Next.js, NestJS, PHP, serverless functions, CRM and marketing technology platforms, and WordPress.
Build and consume secure, well-documented RESTful APIs and lead integrations between custom applications and third-party platforms.
Develop and support integrations with CRM, marketing automation, customer communications, and other business platforms. This may include HubSpot or comparable platforms, using APIs, webhooks, workflows, custom objects, serverless functions, and other integration patterns to connect customer and marketing data with business applications.
Design and build serverless and event-driven solutions to support application workflows, integrations, automation, and data movement between systems.
Model, query, and optimize data across relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server and NoSQL stores such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, and Cosmos DB, including schema design, indexing, and migrations.
Architect and deploy cloud-native solutions, with a strong preference for Microsoft Azure and services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Blob Storage, managed databases, and containerized workloads.
Own CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable tools, containerize services with Docker, and contribute to infrastructure automation and environment management.
Work with product managers, designers, architects, and QA engineers to turn requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into technical designs and delivery estimates.
Write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and uphold engineering standards for security, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues and contribute to monitoring, logging, and observability practices that reduce mean time to resolution.
Participate in all agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
Mentor less experienced developers and contribute to engineering standards and continuous improvement across the team.

Required Skills & Experience

Minimum 5 years of hands-on professional full stack development experience, including ownership of features from design through production release.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field from an accredited university.
Strong knowledge of Linux and Ubuntu environments. This is a working requirement of the role, and a Windows-only background will not be a fit.

description:
Job description

Job Description: Accessibility QA Analyst

Experience Level: 5 to 10 Years

Department: Quality Engineering & Accessibility


Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Accessibility QA Analyst with 4 to 5 years of expertise to join our quality engineering team. While a core focus of this role will revolve around rigorous document accessibility testing and remediation compliance, you will also play a pivotal role in ensuring our broader digital products, web applications, and software interfaces meet global accessibility standards.

You will work closely with product, design, content, and development teams to embed inclusive design principles and accessibility compliance (WCAG, Section 508, PDF/UA) throughout the software and document development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities


Document Accessibility & Compliance:

Perform comprehensive accessibility evaluations on complex enterprise and banking documents (PDFs, forms, reports) to ensure full compliance with WCAG and PDF/UA standards.

Generate and analyze PDF Accessibility Checker (PAC) reports and guide remediation workflows to resolve tagging, reading order, and contrast issues.


Digital & Web Accessibility Testing:

Conduct manual and automated accessibility audits for web applications, user interfaces, and digital workflows.

Perform rigorous screen reader testing using tools like JAWS and NVDA across standard browsers and virtual environments (e.g., VDI).

Validate keyboard navigation, focus management, semantic HTML structures, and ARIA attributes.


Standards & Audit Management:
Evaluate products against Section 508 and WCAG 2.1/2.2 (Level AA/AAA) guidelines.

Document defects clearly in bug-tracking tools (such as Jira) with actionable remediation steps for engineering and content teams.

Assist in creating and maintaining VPAT (Voluntary Product Accessibility Template) documentation and compliance audit trails.


Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 4 to 5 years of professional software/QA testing experience with a specialized focus on digital and document accessibility.

Standards Expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 guidelines, Section 508 compliance, and PDF/UA specifications.


Tool Proficiency:

Proficiency with document testing and remediation tools, including PAC (PDF Accessibility Checker), Adobe Acrobat Pro (Accessibility Checker/Tagging panel), and Office accessibility checkers.

Strong working knowledge of screen readers such as JAWS and NVDA.

Familiarity with automated accessibility testing tools (e.g., Axe, Lighthouse, ARC Toolkit).

Technical Acumen: Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS, semantic markup, and ARIA roles.




Preferred Qualifications

Industry-recognized accessibility certifications (e.g., DHS Trusted Tester, IAAP CPACC, or WAS).

Experience working within highly regulated industries (such as Banking, FinTech, or Healthcare) where document compliance is critical.

Background in developing internal training guidelines or advocating for accessibility best practices across teams.

As a Senior ML Engineer, you will work across a broad set of machine learning areas. This includes building retrieval-driven AI agents that ground LLM outputs in trusted SP data, as well as developing and operating production-grade machine learning systems that power our essential AI toolkits.

What We Are Looking For
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of significant, hands-on industry experience with machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), and information retrieval systems, including designing, shipping, and maintaining production systems.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience reading and understanding SQL databases and writing queries for specific access patterns.
Proven experience building ML pipelines for data processing, training, inference, maintenance, evaluation, versioning, and experimentation.
Demonstrated effective coding, documentation, collaboration, and communication habits.
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
Experience working with machine learning libraries/frameworks for Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, such as LangChain.
(Preferred) Experience working with RAG based system
Ideal for
Enjoy building robust, production-grade ML systems end to end
Have strong ML fundamentals, with a practical understanding of the backend and deployment work needed to run these systems in production
Want to work across data, retrieval, modeling, and system design
What You'll Do
Develop Advanced ML Systems: Create, refine, and deploy machine learning systems that solve complex business problems and power Kensho products.
Build Retrieval-Driven AI Agents: Design AI agents that fetch, validate, and structure data from SP datasets, ensuring answers produced by LLMs are grounded in SP's data universe.
Evaluate LLM-based Agents: Identify and resolve performance gaps in both online and offline settings, addressing issues such as performance, latency, memory usage, compute efficiency, and feature consistency.
Work With Domain Specific Data: Leverage proprietary structured and unstructured datasets, deep dive to have domain understanding, work with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
Scale ML Applications: Optimize and scale ML systems to support high demand, efficient resource utilization, and reliable production behavior.
Reduce Technical Debt: Proactively identify areas of the stack that can be improved, and propose solutions that strengthen reliability and maintainability.
Taking Initiative: Scope, plan, and execute ML initiatives that develop core capabilities across Kensho products.
Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with Data, Product, Design, and Engineering teams to ensure smooth operations and contribute to long-term product vision.
Improve User Experiences: Partner with Product and Design to develop ML-driven functionality that enhances user workflows and aligns with business needs.
Drive the ML Lifecycle: Engage in all phases of the ML lifecycle, from problem framing and data exploration to model deployment and production monitoring, ensuring continuous improvement.

Traditional ML: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM
ML/Deep Learning: PyTorch, Transformers, HuggingFace, LangChain

Tools/Toolkits: DVC, MosaicML, NVIDIA NeMo, LabelBox

Job Title: DevSecOps Engineer

Experience: 7-9 years
Category: Full Time
Shift: General
Main location: Chennai
Position ID: J1026-0489
Employment Type: Full time
Education Qualification: Engineering Graduate/MCA or equivalent

Position Description:
We are seeking an experienced DevSecOps Engineer with strong expertise in Docker image security, containerization, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps practices. The primary objective of this role is to ensure the security, production readiness, maintainability, and compliance of functional, technical, and editor Docker images.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for securing container images throughout their lifecycle, implementing automated security checks, identifying and remediating vulnerabilities, and integrating security practices into CI/CD pipelines. The candidate will work closely with development, infrastructure, platform, and security teams to ensure that container images meet organizational security standards and are reliable for production deployment.



Your future duties and responsibilities:

Manage the security lifecycle of Docker images, including creation, scanning, validation, maintenance, and deployment readiness.
Ensure the production readiness, maintainability, and security compliance of functional, technical, and editor Docker images.
Perform regular vulnerability scanning and security assessments of Docker images to identify operating system, application dependency, and package vulnerabilities.
Analyze vulnerability reports, assess risks, prioritize remediation, and coordinate corrective actions with development and platform teams.
Build, harden, optimize, and maintain secure Docker images by following container security best practices.
Implement and maintain security controls within CI/CD pipelines to automate image scanning and compliance checks.
Establish and enforce Docker image standards, including the use of trusted base images, minimal image layers, non-root users, and secure configurations.
Manage Docker image repositories and registries, including access controls, image tagging, versioning, and lifecycle management.
Ensure compliance with organizational security policies, industry standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Monitor security advisories and CVEs, and proactively update or rebuild affected images.
Implement image signing, provenance verification, and software supply chain security controls where applicable.
Collaborate with development, DevOps, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams to resolve container security issues.
Automate security checks, image validation, and remediation workflows using scripting and DevSecOps tools.
Maintain technical documentation, security assessment reports, remediation records, and compliance evidence.
Support production deployments, incident investigations, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of container security practices.


Required qualifications to be successful in this role:

Must-Have Skills:
Docker and Containerization: Strong experience building, managing, securing, and maintaining Docker images and containers.
Docker Image Security: Hands-on experience with image vulnerability scanning, remediation, hardening, and security compliance.
Vulnerability Management: Knowledge of CVEs, CVSS scoring, vulnerability prioritization, patching, and remediation processes.
Container Image Hardening: Experience with secure base images, minimal image footprints, non-root execution, secrets management, and least-privilege principles.
CI/CD Pipelines: Experience integrating security scanning and compliance gates into automated build and deployment pipelines.
Container Registries: Familiarity with Docker Hub, Harbor, Amazon ECR, Azure Container Registry, or similar image repositories.
Linux Administration: Strong understanding of Linux operating systems, package management, permissions, and system security.
Scripting and Automation: Experience with Shell/Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages.
Security Best Practices: Understanding of container security, access control, secure configuration, and software supply chain security.
Troubleshooting: Strong analytical skills to investigate security findings, resolve image build issues, and support production readiness.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Experience with container security tools such as Trivy, Snyk, Grype, Clair, Anchore, or Prisma Cloud.
Knowledge of Kubernetes security, container orchestration, and workload protection.
Experience with image signing and verification tools such as Cosign and policy enforcement using admission controls.
Familiarity with Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), SPDX, CycloneDX, and software supply chain security.
Knowledge of DevSecOps frameworks and security standards such as CIS Docker Benchmarks, NIST guidance, and OWASP practices.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
Familiarity with Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar automation platforms.
Experience with private registries, artifact management, image lifecycle policies, and automated image promotion.
Knowledge of cloud security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Familiarity with Open Policy Agent (OPA), Kyverno, or other policy-as-code solutions.
Experience with vulnerability dashboards, compliance reporting, audit preparation, and security metrics.
Relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud security, Docker, or DevSecOps.

title: AI, Data Science & Edge Systems Engineering
description:
Job description

Data Science & Edge Systems Engineering Reports To Head of Digital Innovation / Experience 10+ years total; 5+ years in production AI/ML or industrial AI systems Domain Automotive Safety Manufacturing ABOUT THE ROLE is seeking a Senior Industrial AI Engineer / Edge AI Technical Lead to serve as the primary technical authority for the Global AI Operations (GAIO) programme. This senior individual-contributor and technical leadership role combines deep, hands-on expertise in computer vision, machine learning, and MLOps with the architectural breadth required to guide end-to-end deployments across manufacturing sites worldwide. The position builds on our established Data Science and AI Engineer profile, with broader accountability for industrial edge systems and multi-site technical leadership. The role requires 10+ years of progressive experience. The successful candidate will operate as an Industrial Edge AI Technical Leader, combining deep AI and MLOps expertise with hands-on edge system and network diagnostics. The candidate must also have sufficient fluency in OT, Kubernetes, security, and infrastructure to lead deployments and engage specialists effectively. The role bridges advanced computer vision research and industrial-grade production systems, with ownership of the full lifecyclefrom proof of concept to scalable, mission-critical, real-time quality inspection on the manufacturing floor. Required Competency Profile This role demands a specific depth profile across four competency layers: AI / MLOps / CV Deep Mastery Linux + K8s + KubeEdge Working Mastery Networking + OT Leadership + Rollout Working Mastery KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Master Autoliv | Human Resources | SENIOR-AI-2026 Page 1 AUTOLIV | Job Description October 2026 1. Computer Vision & Deep Learning Technical Leadership Lead the design, training, fine-tuning, and evaluation of state-of-the-art computer vision models for industrial quality inspection, including object detection, segmentation, anomaly detection, feature alignment, and OCR. Own the full model lifecycle, from dataset strategy, labeling tools, and class-imbalance management to training pipeline design, hyperparameter optimization, and production performance governance. Apply deep learning architectures (YOLO, Detectron2, SAM, and CLIP) and classical image processing techniques (OpenCV, spatial transformations, color-space manipulation, and morphological filtering) to solve manufacturing inspection challenges. ¢ Define model performance KPIsincluding precision, recall, F1 score, mAP, cycle-time SLAs, and false-positive budgetsand enforce model governance policies across all GAIO sites. ¢ Lead transfer learning, few-shot learning, and synthetic data-augmentation strategies to reduce reliance on large, manually labeled datasets in new manufacturing contexts. ¢ Integrate industrial camera protocols (GigE Vision, GenICam, RTSP, and ONVIF), and validate camera hardware, exposure and gain settings, and acquisition pipelines on Linux. 2. Edge AI Infrastructure & GPU Optimization ¢ Architect and maintain edge AI deployment infrastructure, including GPU-equipped industrial PCs, NVIDIA Jetson platforms, and containerized inference services on the production floor. ¢ Optimize neural network inference for constrained edge hardware using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, and OpenVINO, including FP16/INT8 quantization, model pruning, and hardware specific profiling. ¢ Design GPU resource-management strategies for centralized inference servers that support multiple production lines simultaneously, including VRAM allocation, multi-tenancy, and scheduling. ¢ Define, document, and enforce edge-node provisioning standards, including OS image hardening, package manifests, TLS certificate management, and KubeEdge node-registration procedures. 3. MLOps Platform & Lifecycle Governance ¢ Own and operate the GAIO MLOps platform, including experiment tracking, model registry and versioning, CI/CD for model artifacts, staging environments, and automated production rollback procedures. ¢ Implement automated model-retraining triggers based on production data drift, quality-metric degradation, and manufacturing process changes. ¢ Establish data-versioning (DVC, Delta Lake) and feature-store strategies to ensure reproducibility, traceability, and regulatory auditability for production model decisions. ¢ Define and enforce model-inference availability SLAs of 99.9% or higher, establish on-call runbooks, and lead incident response for AI system failures across GAIO sites. ¢ Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions and GitLab CI) for model packaging, edge deployment, and system-health monitoring, including model drift, inference latency, GPU utilization, and node health. 4. Full-Stack AI Application Development ¢ Develop and maintain RESTful APIs, gRPC APIs, and WebSocket services using FastAPI to serve ML models in real time across high-throughput, multi-camera inspection stations. ¢ Build scalable inference pipelines that handle concurrent streams from multiple GigE cameras at production-line throughput. Autoliv | Human Resources | SENIOR-AI-2026 Page 2 AUTOLIV | Job Description October 2026 ¢ Design and develop responsive, web-based operational dashboards using React or Vue.js with TypeScript, providing real-time quality inspection results, line KPIs, model-health metrics, and shift reports for plant operators and quality managers. ¢ Integrate AI inference results with plant MES, ERP, and SCADA systems through OPC UA, MQTT, and REST-based patterns, including PLC trigger, result, and heartbeat-cycle management. ¢ Design and implement message-broker architectures (RabbitMQ, Celery, and Kafka) for asynchronous multi-camera stream processing and result queuing. 5. Linux Systems & Container Orchestration ¢ Administer Linux-based edge nodes and central servers (Ubuntu/RHEL) running AI inference workloads, including system-service management, SSH hardening, process monitoring, storage management, and DNS/NTP configuration. ¢ Containerize AI models and full-stack services using Docker, and manage Kubernetes deployments with Helm and KubeEdge to support edge-native orchestration and disconnected plant operations. ¢ Perform systematic Linux-level diagnostics across CPU, memory, disk, and network layers, and produce structured evidence for specialist escalation when issues fall outside the roles scope. ¢ Manage OS image hardening, patching, security-baseline configuration, and TLS certificate rotation across GAIO edge nodes. ¢ Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Ansible, Bash, and Python. 6. Industrial AI Rollout & Multi-Site Technical Leadership ¢ Lead end-to-end GAIO site deployments, coordinating with IT, Industrial Engineering, Quality, PLC/Controls, Procurement, and plant management to move AI inspection solutions from approved models to stable production. ¢ Define and own site-readiness gates, RACI matrices, technical risk reviews, acceptance-test protocols, and hypercare periods for each deployment. ¢ Create and maintain reusable deployment runbooks, troubleshooting trees covering device, OS, network, orchestration, application, model, camera, and PLC fault domains, and handover documentation. ¢ Mentor junior AI engineers and site leads in ML/MLOps practices, Linux diagnostics, network troubleshooting, and structured incident-evidence collection. ¢ Serve as the primary technical escalation point between plant sites and central AI/IT teams, translating plant-floor issues into precise, actionable technical tickets for specialist resolution. 7. Security, Identity & Observability ¢ Lead security reviews for GAIO deployments, covering SSO/AD group configuration, TLS/mTLS certificate management, RBAC policies, image-vulnerability scanning, and Microsoft Defender telemetry. ¢ Design and maintain centralized observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or equivalent) for 20+ GAIO edge nodes across multiple plants, including node health, model-performance metrics, alerting, and runbook integration. ¢ Ensure secure remote-access architecture using VPNs, jump hosts, and zero-trust principles in distributed plant environments with mixed OT/IT network topologies. Autoliv | Human Resources | SENIOR-AI-2026 Page 3 AUTOLIV | Job Description October 2026 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Education ¢ Bachelors or masters degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Mechatronics, or a closely related STEM discipline. ¢ Equivalent industry experience, supported by a demonstrable portfolio of production AI system deployments, will also be considered. Total Experience 10+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in software engineering and AI/ML systems, including at least 5 years in production-grade computer vision or industrial AI deployments. ¢ At least 3 years of experience in a senior, principal, or technical lead role, with responsibility for architecture decisions, junior-engineer mentoring, and multi-team deployment coordination. ¢ Demonstrated experience delivering AI systems in manufacturing, automotive, logistics, or similarly constrained industrial environments. Soft Skills & Leadership ¢ Demonstrated ability to lead multi-team, multi-site technology deployments using formal readiness gates, clear RACI ownership, and structured risk management. ¢ Strong communication skills, with the ability to write precise technical specifications for specialist teams and explain AI system concepts to plant operations, quality, and executive audiences. ¢ Proven mentorship experience, including coaching junior engineers in ML practices, Linux diagnostics, structured troubleshooting, and incident documentation. ¢ A strong bias toward independent diagnosis and evidence-based escalation, with the ability to operate effectively in complex, ambiguous plant environments without constant managerial direction. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS ¢ Experience with PLC communication and integration across Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Omron, or Mitsubishi systems, including tag and state-machine concepts, trigger/heartbeat/result patterns, and protocol drivers. ¢ OT integration experience, including OPC UA, MQTT broker configuration, SCADA/MES connectivity, and plant-historian integration. ¢ Advanced Linux expertise, including network-proxy configuration, performance profiling with GCC/GDB, kernel-parameter tuning, and NUMA-aware memory management for GPU workloads. ¢ Security expertise in TLS/mTLS certificate lifecycle management, managed identity and RBAC in Azure or an equivalent cloud platform, SIEM integration, and OT cybersecurity practices aligned with NIST SP 800-82. ¢ Relevant certifications, such as NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute (Inference Optimization), CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), RHCSA/RHCE, AWS or Azure AI/ML specialist certifications, or CompTIA Security+. ¢ Experience with digital-twin platforms or simulation-based synthetic data generation for pre training vision models in new manufacturing contexts.

title: Software Developer
description:
Job description

WE'RE HIRING

Full Stack Developer

Join a team turning data and technology into real growth for our clients, help us safeguard quality across every system we build.

POSITION : Full Stack Developer




EXPERIENCE : 3 - 6 Years




LOCATION : Hyderabad




TYPE: Full-time




About Us

Warrous believes in harnessing the power of Data and Technology to target new growth opportunities. We wanted to create a compelling, authentic experience that reflects our capabilities. Transforming Intelligently with our technology expertise and our team of industry-leading consultants, we can help you achieve every goal on your roadmap. We believe in providing our customers with a level of service and personal care, making the customer happy is in our DNA. Our talented, dynamic and experienced professionals efficiently use their technical expertise to enable high end solutions for Web and Software Development to that end, our specialists are always looking for new ways to solve our clients issues quickly, easily and economically. Improve the efficiency and effectiveness of your Business and processing operations.




Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with expertise in .NET, Angular, and MSSQL to join our dynamic development team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in designing and implementing scalable web applications and a proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions.

Additionally, the candidate should have exposure to AI/ML technologies, with the ability to integrate intelligent features such as chatbots, predictive analytics, or recommendation systems into applications. Experience in leveraging cloud-based AI/ML services (e.g., Azure AI, AWS ML) and working with APIs to incorporate machine learning capabilities into web solutions will be an added advantage.




Key Responsibilities

Development & Architecture: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable web applications using .NET technologies on the back end and Angular for the front end.

Database Management: Design and optimize database schemas and write complex SQL queries to interact with MSSQL databases, ensuring data integrity and performance.

API Integration: Create and consume RESTful APIs, ensuring seamless interaction between front-end and back-end systems.

Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including UI/UX designers, product managers, and other developers to deliver high-quality software.

Unit Testing: Implement best practices in coding, perform code reviews, and ensure testing of applications to enhance performance and security.




Agile Methodologies: Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.

Exposure to AI/ML concepts including supervised learning, model training, and data preprocessing.
Integrated intelligent features into applications using third-party AI APIs.
Strong interest in applying AI/ML techniques to enhance modern web applications.



Required Skills & Qualifications

.NET Framework: Proficiency in .NET technologies (e.g., ASP.NET, .NET Core) with a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle.

Angular: Extensive experience in building responsive and dynamic single-page applications using Angular 2+.

MSSQL: Strong knowledge of MSSQL, including database design, performance tuning, and writing stored procedures and triggers.

Version Control: Familiarity with version control systems such as Git for efficient code management and collaboration.

Strong understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms
• Experience with Micro-frontend architecture is an added advantage

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Job description

AI Developer (Python) Experience 4-8 years’ experience

Skills and attributes for success

Candidate must possess proficiency in the following technologies:
Core AI Engineering & LLM Frameworks:
Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Auto Gen, Google Agent SDK, Model Context Protocol, Skills-based agent frameworks.
GenAI / Agentic AI Systems:
LLM application development, agentic AI architectures, multi-agent workflows, prompt engineering, AI system design, tool/function calling, enterprise AI integration.
RAG, Embeddings & Vector Search:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines, embeddings, semantic search, context retrieval strategies, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, Redis Vector, pgvector.
Backend & API Engineering:
Python, Fast API, REST API design, scalable API platforms, event-driven systems, microservices architecture, third-party system integration.
Cloud, Infrastructure & Containers:
Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, cloud-native application development, containerized deployments.
Databases & Data Platforms:
SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, Redis, ClickHouse, database design, performance optimization, data accuracy and integrity.
AI Model Engineering:
Model fine-tuning, LoRA, BERT, LLM architecture understanding, evaluation techniques, AI performance monitoring.
AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI:
PII protection, data privacy, AI security, compliance, responsible AI practices, governance controls, monitoring and observability frameworks.
DevOps & Engineering Practices:
GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, production deployment practices, observability and monitoring.
Preferred Technologies:
Rust, Go, Kubernetes, OpenShift, advanced vector database platforms, enterprise-scale LLM deployment patterns.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Minimum of 4+ years of professional engineering experience, with hands-on experience in backend/platform engineering and GenAI/LLM systems.
Bachelor’s degree B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or related engineering discipline.
Strong hands-on proficiency in Python for AI application development, backend services, and platform engineering.
Demonstrable experience building LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, and enterprise AI integrations.
Hands-on expertise with LangChain and LangGraph, with exposure to frameworks such as AutoGen, Google Agent SDK, Model Context Protocol, or Skills-based agent frameworks.
Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, Redis Vector, or pgvector.
Strong understanding of embeddings, semantic search, context retrieval strategies, chunking approaches, ranking, and retrieval optimization.
Proficiency in building scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven architecture.
Experience working with Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Services for enterprise-grade AI solution development.
Strong understanding of Docker and containerized deployments, with exposure to Kubernetes or OpenShift preferred.
Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar DevOps tooling.
Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL database design, query optimization, and scalable data interaction patterns.
Familiarity with AI evaluation, observability, monitoring, and production support for LLM-based systems.
Strong understanding of PII protection, data privacy, AI security, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including AI engineers, data engineers, cloud/platform teams, security teams, product owners, and business stakeholders.
Experience in banking or financial services domain is preferred, especially exposure to regulatory, security, and compliance requirements.
Ability to troubleshoot and debug issues across AI pipelines, backend services, APIs, vector stores, cloud services, and production environments.
Commitment to engineering quality, including maintainable code, automated testing, reusable components, documentation, and scalable design practices.

What we looking  for

Provides intermediate to senior-level system analysis, architecture design, development, and implementation of AI platforms, backend services, APIs, and enterprise AI systems.
Designs and develops scalable GenAI applications using LLM frameworks, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and cloud-native backend services.
Translates business and technical requirements into robust AI engineering solutions, including APIs, agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, integrations, and data processing components.
Builds, tests, and deploys AI-powered backend services using Python, FastAPI, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, vector databases, and modern DevOps practices.
Develops and maintains RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings generation, vector indexing, retrieval optimization, and response grounding.
Implements agentic AI architectures using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Google Agent SDK, or Model Context Protocol-based integration patterns.
Integrates AI solutions with enterprise systems, third-party applications, APIs, data platforms, and workflow tools.
Elevates code into development, test, staging, and production environments following established CI/CD, change control, and release management processes.
Provides production support for AI applications, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance tuning, issue resolution, and root cause analysis.
Participates in design reviews, code reviews, testing reviews, and architecture discussions to ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable AI systems.
Applies software development methodology and follows architecture, information security, and responsible AI standards.
Contributes to AI observability and evaluation practices by monitoring model behavior, retrieval quality, latency, accuracy, hallucination risks, and system performance.
Supports implementation of AI governance controls including PII protection, data privacy, access control, compliance, responsible AI guardrails, and auditability.
Understands client business functions, technology needs, and enterprise constraints, especially in regulated banking and financial services environments.
Contributes to optimizing system performance through efficient API design, database optimization, vector search tuning, caching strategies, and scalable infrastructure patterns.
Supports the integration and maintenance of data pipelines between enterprise systems, vector databases, APIs, and backend AI services, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Maintains and updates technical documentation for AI platforms, backend components, architecture, deployment flows, data pipelines, and operational procedures.
Applies intermediate to strong knowledge of backend security, AI security, data protection, and cloud-native engineering best practices during solution development.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- Design and develop robust, scalable backend services and RESTful / GraphQL APIs

- Drive engineering best practices across the team — testing strategy, API design, and code quality
Technical Skills Required
Backend Development
- Proficiency — Java 17
Strong experience with modern spring boot
- RESTful API design — versioning, contract-first approach, backward compatibility
- Asynchronous messaging and event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or equivalent)
- Authentication and authorization — OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC/ABAC patterns
- Caching strategies — Redis, Memcached, HTTP caching, cache invalidation patterns


Frontend Development
- Proficiency in React with TypeScript
- Strong understanding of browser fundamentals — DOM, event loop, rendering pipeline, Web APIs
- State management patterns — Redux, Context API, or equivalent
- Component-driven development and design system integration
- Performance optimization — lazy loading, code splitting, bundle analysis, Core Web Vitals
- Accessibility (WCAG) and responsive design principles
Microservices & Distributed Systems
- Designing services around bounded context and single responsibility
- Synchronous (REST/gRPC) and asynchronous (event-driven) inter-service communication


- Service discovery, API gateway patterns, and BFF (Backend for Frontend)


- Distributed transaction handling and eventual consistency


- Resilience patterns — circuit breaker, retry, bulkhead, timeout (Resilience4j, Hystrix, or equivalent)


- API versioning and backward-compatible contract evolution


Active-Active & High Availability Architecture


- Multi-region / multi-zone active-active deployment design


- Stateless service design for horizontal scalability


- Distributed session management and cache replication


- Data consistency strategies across active nodes — conflict resolution, quorum reads/writes


- Load balancing, traffic shaping, and automated failover


- RPO/RTO planning and disaster recovery design


- Understanding of CAP theorem trade-offs in production systems


Observability


- Structured logging with correlation IDs across service boundaries


- Distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry — trace propagation, sampling, span management


- Metrics instrumentation — Micrometer, Prometheus, StatsD, or equivalent


- Dashboarding and alerting with Grafana


- SLO / SLA definition and error budget management


- Health check design, runbook authoring, and on-call readiness


Database & Storage


- Relational databases — PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle: schema design, indexing, query optimization


- Database migration tooling — Liquibase, Flyway


- ORM frameworks and understanding of their performance implications


- Read/write splitting, connection pooling, and sharding concepts


Cloud & Infrastructure


- Hands-on experience with GCP — compute, storage, networking, managed services


- Container orchestration — Kubernetes: deployments, services, config management, resource tuning


- Docker — multi-stage builds, image optimization, registry management


- Infrastructure-as-code — Terraform


- CI/CD pipeline design — GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Cloud Build, or equivalent


Security


- Secure coding practices and OWASP Top 10 awareness


- TLS/mTLS, certificate management, and secret rotation


- Role-based and attribute-based access control implementation


- Static analysis, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management in CI pipelines


- Data encryption at rest and in transit


Testing


- Unit, integration, and end-to-end testing strategy


- Test-driven development (TDD) and behaviour-driven development (BDD)


- Contract testing (Pact or equivalent) for microservice boundaries


- Performance and load testing — JMeter, Gatling, k6, or equivalent

As an AI Native Software Engineer, your day revolves around creating and delivering software solutions where artificial intelligence is deeply integrated into every stage of development. -Design and implement multi-agent orchestration pipelines using LangGraph state machines with conditional routing, self-healing loops, and sub-agent
hierarchies

embeddings

Backend & AI

- Sentence-transformers or equivalent embedding models

Frontend
- React 18 + TypeScript + Vite - component architecture, hooks, lazy loading
- Server-Sent Events (SSE) or WebSocket - real-time streaming UIs
- ReactFlow / XYFlow - interactive node-based graph editors
- State management (Zustand or Redux) + server-state (TanStack Query)

- vLLM or TGI - on-prem LLM model serving and optimization
- mem0 or similar - persistent agent memory systems
- A2A / MCP / AG-UI - emerging agentic interoperability protocols
- GraphQL - schema design, client integration
- OAuth2 / SAML / OIDC - enterprise SSO integration
- Ontology modeling - entity taxonomies, relationship schemas for engineering domains
- Pytest - async test patterns, fixture-based testing

Qualifications
- 4+ years professional software engineering experience
- 2+ years working with LLMs, agent frameworks, or ML systems in production
- Strong async Python and modern React/TypeScript skills
- Experience with graph databases or knowledge graph systems
- Comfortable owning features across the full stack - API to UI to deployment

- This position is based at our Bengaluru office.

title: Control & Protection Design Engineer
description:
Job description

The opportunity:Design authority for Control & Protection engineering tasks of low to medium complexity. Work on projects, ensuring the work is completed cost-effectively and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety guidelines. Based on customer technical specifications and inputs from the Europe Engineering team, Prepare Control & Protection schematics up to 400 kV, along with the Bill of Materials, engineering hour estimates, and technical risk and opportunity assessments. Coordinate closely with Engineering Leads to ensure smooth and accurate project execution.

How you'll make an impact:

Prepare Key Line Diagrams, Protection Interface Diagrams, Feeder Block Diagrams & Trip Matrix, signal lists and interlocks in line with customer technical specifications.
Prepare schematics for Control & Relay Panel schematics for new and existing setups, especially for retrofit projects.
Prepare Cable Block Diagrams, relay ordering information, Cable Schedules and create lists for wiring, termination, and labelling for panel manufacturing.
Essential knowledge of Primary Equipment, Bay Controller Units, SCADA, RTU, and Tele protection.
Interface between AC Panels, DC Panels, Auxiliary Transformers, Battery, ACDC Cable Sizing, AIS & GIS secondary designs and work with various departments for design progress and completion.
Conduct technical risk and opportunity assessments and estimate engineering hours and validate inputs.
Collaboration with the team, take responsibility for assigned tasks, and ensure timely delivery with high-quality results.
You will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background:

Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering.
Should have 4 to 8 years in commissioning and Engineering for Voltage level above 66kV.
Proficiency in CAD design tools like Zuken E3, AutoCAD, Elecdes or equivalent.
Experience in Secondary Control and Protection Schematic Design, Relays/IEDs configuration.
High technical experience with strong coordination skills.
Know how in PCM, Micom, Digsi IED configuration tools.
Knowledge on test kits such as Omicron (CMC 356 & 256), Doble & other test kit.
Proficiency in spoken and written English.

description:
Job description

Role: Embedded Design Engineer




Company Overview:

For over 75 years, Forbes Marshall has been a leader in delivering innovative products and services that help industries worldwide enhance their manufacturing processes and achieve superior energy efficiency. As global industries face the challenges of the climate crisis, the emphasis on sustainable growth with reduced carbon emissions has never been more vital. Drawing on decades of engineering expertise, Forbes Marshall provides practical, long-term solutions that empower businesses to operate more responsibly, cut down energy usage, and improve overall process efficiency.

Our commitment to sustainability is reflected in the impact we make we help our customers reduce fuel expenses by up to 1.5% annually, significantly transforming their energy footprint, and cutting down 122,000 tonnes of CO2 emissions each year. We also contribute to water conservation by saving ten million liters per hour and ensure operational uptime that surpasses industry standards. At the heart of our mission is a dedication to customer partnerships, high ethical standards, and community support through initiatives in healthcare, education, and women's empowerment.




Role Overview:

Department / Division

R&D




Product Line

FMPL




Position with Organisation:

Location: KSR

Organisation Structure: Report to Design Manager




Purpose of the Role:

Embedded Software development for FM Products.




Roles and Responsibilities:

Understand requirement specifications of the product and take the same into
consideration while making the design - electrical/electronics/Embedded
firmware/communication protocols/environmental/EMC/safety/Industrial
design/performance/reliability and other requirements in accordance with
applicable standards.
Development of embedded firmware which include and Interface to:
a. Sensors of various types (e.g. temperature/pressure/pH/conductivity/DO
/piezoelectric/optical/Hall/Ultrasonic/piezoresistive/magnetic/current/voltage/fr
equency/displacement etc.)
b. Input and output signals of various
voltages/current/frequencies/bandwidths/dynamic ranges/etc. analog and
digital
c. Various communication protocol physical layers (e.g.
UART/RS232/RS485/I2C/SPI/HART/PROFIBUS/FIELDBUS/Wireless-
Bluetooth, LORA, WiFI, HART and GSM)
d. Display devices and keypad devices (UI)
e. Various microcontrollers/ADCs/DACs/Display chips and various other
special function chips
f. Power divers and Actuators (e.g. motors/relays/SSDR/piezo valves/etc.
Are suitable for:
a. 2-wire transmitters, actuators, indicators, convertors and sensors (4-
20mA), IEPE vibration sensors.
b. Battery powered sensors and wireless devices
Design various analog signal processing and control functions like scaling -
voltage, current, transconductance, transimpedance amplification/filtering -linear
Or switching/integration/differentiation/multiplying/compression/clipping/clamping/lin
earising/isolation/ON-OFF/PID/etc.
Test the implemented design and prove all the requirements with in-house lab
tests/external lab tests/field site tests/etc.

1. BE Electronics, ;TC, Computer Science.
2. Experience 5+Years
3. Excellent in Embedded C language programming and Good in C++ language programming
4. Excellent knowledge of Microcontroller / Microprocessor architect and hardware.
5. Be able to operate and use various test and measurement labs. instruments like
DMM, DSO, Function Generator, Signal Generator, Pulse generator, Counter
timer, Spectrum analyser, LCR meter, HV tester, Network analyser, etc.

At Forbes Marshall, every member is empowered to contribute to meaningful solutions, grow professionally, and be part of a mission that goes beyond business success to prioritise sustainability and operational excellence.

Personal and Professional Growth

At Forbes Marshall, we focus on the growth and development of our members. You will gain valuable experience through engaging projects, exposure to advanced industry practices, and access to training and skill development opportunities. Our culture promotes continuous learning, collaboration, and innovation, allowing members to reach their full potential and enhance their expertise. Your work will be recognised, and your professional skills will grow in line with industry standards.

A Commitment to Sustainability and Purpose

Forbes Marshall is dedicated to helping industries operate more efficiently and responsibly providing benefits. As a member of our team, you will contribute to projects that support energy efficiency and sustainability, helping customers reduce their carbon footprint and improve their operational practices. This role offers an opportunity to align your professional journey with a purpose-driven mission, contributing to the larger goal of creating a more sustainable future.

A Culture of Collaboration

Collaboration is at the heart of our work environment. Members work together with teams across functions, fostering an atmosphere where knowledge sharing and teamwork drive success. You will join a team of dedicated professionals who value each other’s contributions and are committed to achieving excellence together.

Values We Wish for You to Experience

title: Full Stack React Application Developer
description:
Job description

We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack React Application Developer to build production-grade, data-rich web applications, APIs, and interactive dashboards. You will own the full application lifecycle from designing component architectures and building performant React frontends to creating robust backend APIs and integrating with data platforms.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will build applications used by senior leadership, operations teams, and business users. The ideal candidate combines deep React expertise with strong API development skills and enough data fluency to work effectively with data engineering teams.

Responsibilities
React Frontend Development (Primary Focus)
Architect, build, and maintain complex React applications dashboards, analytics platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products
Develop responsive, mobile-first UIs optimized for tablet (iPad) and desktop with pixel-perfect execution
Build rich data visualizations using D3.js, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG/Canvas components
Implement advanced state management patterns using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, or Context API
Create reusable, well-documented component libraries with design system integration (Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules)
Optimise frontend performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, virtual scrolling, bundle analysis
Write comprehensive tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress for E2E testing
Implement real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling strategies
API Design & Backend Development
Design and build RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI/Flask) following OpenAPI specifications
Develop GraphQL APIs where appropriate for complex data querying needs
Implement authentication and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC) for secure API access
Build middleware for logging, rate limiting, caching, error handling, and request validation
Design database schemas and write efficient queries (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar)
Implement API versioning, pagination, filtering, and search capabilities
Build and maintain microservices or serverless functions (Azure Functions / AWS Lambda)
Create API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI and maintain developer-facing docs
Integration & Data Layer
Integrate frontend applications with data platforms (Databricks, data warehouses, data lakes) through API layers
Build data ingestion endpoints that accept, validate, transform, and store incoming data
Work with data engineers to consume curated datasets and serve them through optimised APIs
Implement caching strategies (Redis, CDN, browser cache) for high-performance data delivery
Connect to third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, CRM, loyalty platforms, analytics tools)
AI / LLM Integration
Build conversational AI interfaces (chatbots, knowledge agents) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for document Q&A and contextual search
Create prompt engineering frameworks and manage AI response streaming in React UIs
DevOps & Delivery
Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
Containerize applications with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes or cloud-managed services
Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (Datadog, New Relic, or Application Insights)
Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive engineering best practices
Requirements
Must-Have Skills
5-7 years of professional full stack development experience in a product engineering environment
Expert-level React.js (4+ years): hooks, context, suspense, server components, performance patterns
Strong TypeScript proficiency type-safe component development, generics, utility types
Production experience building and consuming REST APIs (Node.js with Express/Fastify or Python with FastAPI)
Solid database skills: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimisation) and/or MongoDB
Experience with modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components for scalable styling
Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, PR workflows, and collaborative development
Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) or AWS app hosting, serverless, storage, CDN
Strong understanding of web security: CORS, XSS, CSRF, CSP, authentication flows
Experience with Docker containerisation and basic Kubernetes or cloud-managed container services
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and working in cross-functional, distributed teams
Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR, API routes) or Remix
GraphQL development experience (Apollo Server/Client or similar)
Data visualisation expertise: D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, custom charting
Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs and building AI-powered features
Knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake/warehouse concepts
Experience with real-time systems: WebSockets, Kafka consumers, event-driven architecture
Familiarity with design tools (Figma) and design-to-code workflows
Understanding of retail / e-commerce domain (POS, loyalty, customer analytics)
Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual testing
Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and internationalisation (i18n)
Education
Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
Relevant certifications are a plus: AWS/Azure Developer, Meta React Certification, or similar

title: Growth Engineer
description:
Job description

Job Title: Growth Engineer

Department: Engineering

Reports To: Technical Manager

Location: Bengaluru

Employment Type: Full-time role




Role Summary




AliveCor is hiring a Growth Engineer to own the measurement layer and the front end it measures, sitting between marketing and engineering. About 60% of the role covers the Google ecosystem GA4, Google Tag Manager, technical SEO, Merchant Center feeds and conversion tracking. The other 40% is shipping changes on our Next.js websites and ecommerce, including code-level tracking.

You will make sure every market's data is accurate, every page is fast and indexable, and every CRO experiment ships without waiting on a dev queue. The ideal candidate is fluent across analytics and front-end code and uses AI tools daily to move faster while keeping output reviewed and compliant.




Core Responsibilities




Analytics & Tracking (core)

Own end-to-end GA4 implementation: data layer design, event schema, custom dimensions, ecommerce tracking, and cross-domain and multi-property setups across geos
Build and govern GTM containers (web and server-side), including tag hygiene, versioning, QA and Consent Mode v2
Set up and validate conversion tracking, value-based bidding, offline conversion imports and server-side / Meta CAPI signals
Design reporting pipelines (GA4 BigQuery Looker Studio) covering blended ROAS, CAC and channel contribution by market
Maintain UTM and campaign taxonomy across all channels and markets



SEO (core)



Own technical SEO on a Next.js stack: rendering strategy (SSR / SSG / ISR), crawlability, indexation, sitemaps, robots, canonicals and hreflang across markets
Implement and maintain structured data Product, FAQ, Article, Organization and Review
Drive Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) through image optimisation, bundle size, font loading and third-party script cost
Run keyword research and content gap analysis; brief and optimise landing pages and content
Manage Search Console across properties coverage, enhancements, manual actions and query performance
Fix internal linking, redirects and site architecture as the site evolves



Paid Search & Feeds



Manage Google Merchant Center product feeds, multi-country and multi-currency configs, feed rules, disapprovals and Shopping reporting



Web Development



Build and modify Next.js / React pages and components landing pages, PDPs, campaign pages and A/B variants
Write clean JavaScript / TypeScript, Tailwind or equivalent CSS, and responsive layouts
Implement tracking at the source: data layer pushes, event wiring and server-side endpoints where needed
Work with Git branches, pull requests, reviews and staging deploys (Vercel or similar)
Consume APIs and headless CMS content; handle basic Node / API-route work
Ship CRO experiments yourself instead of waiting on a dev queue



AI-Enhanced Responsibilities




Key AI Toolstack & Workflows:



Development & Front-End: Uses AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to build Next.js pages, CRO variants, and Core Web Vitals fixes 3050% faster.
Analytics & Tracking: Leverages Claude and Gemini for GA4 event schema design, tracking plans, and GTM debugging (custom JS variables, triggers, regex) to prevent tracking breaks after releases.
SEO & Content Optimization: Uses Claude Code and Gemini for technical SEO audits, generating structured data at scale (JSON-LD, hreflang, canonicals), keyword clustering, and drafting content briefs.
Reporting & Feed Management: Utilizes Gemini in BigQuery and Claude to write SQL queries for ROAS/CAC reports and optimize Google Merchant Center feeds (title/description rewrites and country-level disapproval triage).



Required Qualifications



3 to 6 years in an engineering role supporting digital analytics, SEO and paid media channels in Ecommerce, DTC or B2B
Deep hands-on GA4 experience implementation and debugging, not just reporting
Strong GTM skills: custom JS variables, triggers and server-side containers
Demonstrable technical SEO ownership on a real site, ideally built on a JavaScript framework
Merchant Center feed management across more than one country
Working proficiency in JavaScript and React / Next.js able to pick up a ticket, build the component and open a PR
Solid HTML, CSS selectors, JSON, regex and Git
SQL for GA4 exports in BigQuery; dashboards in Looker Studio
CRO tooling experience: Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Optimizely or VWO
Comfortable owning budget, ROAS and CAC targets in front of non-analysts
Fluent with AI coding tools as part of your normal workflow



Preferred Qualifications



Hands-on Google Ads: Search, Shopping and Performance Max building and scaling live spend
TypeScript, Tailwind and Vercel deployment experience
Headless commerce or Shopify Hydrogen
Python for reporting and bid automation
Google Ads Editor and scripts for bulk changes
Bing / Microsoft Ads, Meta or Amazon Ads
Segment or another CDP; Klaviyo or Braze
Attribution modelling or MMM exposure
Regulated-industry or medical-device advertising experience
Google Ads / Google Analytics certification



AI Competency Expectations



AI Tool Proficiency (Intermediate to Advanced): Hands-on daily usage of tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to ship working, human-reviewed Next.js code, GTM logic, and SQL.
Prompt Engineering (Intermediate): Skilled at writing context-rich prompts for code generation, tracking specs, SQL queries, structured data, and SEO briefs.
AI Output Evaluation (Intermediate): Ability to rigorously validate AI-generated code, tags, queries, and schema using Tag Assistant, GA Debugger, BigQuery, and Search Console prior to production deployment.
AI Ethics & Data Privacy (Intermediate): Strict adherence to data privacy by keeping customer data, PHI, and PII out of AI prompts (including GA4 and BigQuery exports). Ensures full compliance with Consent Mode, GDPR, and CCPA, and routes any AI-generated product or health claims through regulatory review before publishing.



Perks and benefits




We strive to make your life outside work as smooth as possible while you're at work, and we offer a long list of benefits to make that happen.

Hybrid working model
Flexible and generous vacation policy
Maternity / Paternity Leave/ Adoption/ Commissioning leave
Generous Medical Benefits Above market family floater medical insurance coverage including both parents
Metro connectivity from office
Complimentary lunch is provided in the office
A supportive, collaborative group of people who understand that success depends on the team

description:
Job description


Project Role :Technology Platform Engineer


Project Role Description :Creates production and non-production cloud environments using the proper software tools such as a platform for a project or product. Deploys the automation pipeline and automates environment creation and configuration.
Must have skills :Linux Architecture

Good to have skills :Machine Learning (ML), Cloud Technology Architecture, Docker Kubernetes Administration, Edge Computing, Microsoft Agentic AI Architecture

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Key Responsibilities:
1)Design and implement HPC and AI infrastructure solutions, aligning system architecture and deployment roadmaps to industry-specific performance and scalability needs
2)Deploy, configure, and manage XPU-based clusters (CPU/GPU/accelerators) using schedulers, VM/K8s orchestration platforms, Slurm, and containerized platforms in scalable designs to provide Metal as a Service (MaaS), GPUaaS, AIaaS, and other offerings
3)Optimize cluster performance, scalability, energy, and cost efficiency across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments
4)Integrate AI and HPC platforms with existing IT systems, data pipelines, and security frameworks
5)Monitor, troubleshoot, and tune infrastructure to ensure high availability, low-latency networking, and workload resiliency
6)Develop and maintain documentation including architecture diagrams, configuration baselines, and operational runbooks
7)Provide Provide technical guidance and support to users, enabling efficient execution of HPC/AI workloads, large-scale models, and simulations

Required Skills and
Qualifications:
1)Experience in enterprise-wide HPC strategy and architecting next-gen supercomputing environments across the full stack.
2)Primary Skills:Linux Administrator/Architect, Advanced CUDA/GPU on H100/A100, HPC cluster design (SLURM/PBS Pro)
3)Secondary Skills:Parallel programming:MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, SYCL, NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD & BCM, InfiniBand NDR 400Gb/s & RoCEv2 design, MLOps & HPC integration (Kubeflow), Containerization:Singularity, Kubernetes, DevOps:Ansible, Terraform for HPC, UFM management, RunAI, Azure ML integration:distributed training, MLflow, Terraform / Bicep IaC for Azure HPC, FinOps:Reserved Instances, Spot VM strategies, Hybrid cloud HPC:on-prem to Azure/AWS burst
4)Proven hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing HPC and AI infrastructure across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments in 2 or more segments:hyperscaler, neocloud, large Enterprise, Telco/Mobile, supporting key industries such as Financial Services, Life Sciences, Manufacturing, and Retail
5)Deep knowledge of accelerated computing architectures (GPUs, XPUs, DPUs), high-performance fabrics (InfiniBand, Ethernet), SONiC, networking, and modern storage/data platforms (e.g. NVMe-oF, Lustre, GPFS, BeeGFS, VAST, DDN, Weka) to build robust solutions
6)Proficiency with cluster management and orchestration (e.g. Slurm, Run:ai, Kubernetes, Docker), real-time performance monitoring, and observability frameworks
7)Hands-on experience with cloud and virtualization platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP, VMware, Nutanix) and expertise in automation and optimization using scripting (Python, AI tools) with foundational Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible.

Preferred Skills and
Qualifications:
1)Experience managing the deployment of 1,000+ GPU clusters for HPC and AI workloads with various infrastructure services enabled
2)Experience with GPU computing libraries and accelerators (e.g., NVIDIA CUDA, Dynamo, AMD ROCm).
3)Experience with AI and HPC Networking (e.g., RoCE, InfiniBand, muti-planar/multi-rail designs, platform buffer architectures)
4)Knowledge of Machine Learning and AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX), Jupyter notebooks / Google Colab environments
5)Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform) for infrastructure automation
6)Experience with AgenticAI and associated technologies to leverage and build agents for workflow automation and observability
7)Industry certifications in NVIDIA infrastructure, public cloud providers, Data Science, etc. are a plus
8)Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performance infrastructure solutions in fast-paced, dynamic environments that reward technical talent

•      Design REST APIs, event-driven services, asynchronous communication, and low-latency signaling or session capabilities.

•      Own technical design discussions and contribute to architecture reviews, platform standards, and technology roadmaps.

description:
Job description

Role & responsibilities

Execute Astro Runtime upgrade from 12.x to 13.8.0 across multiple deployments.
Perform DAG and application validation, smoke testing, and operational verification after each upgrade step.
Identify, validate, and run the Airflow metadata cleanup DAG; work with application teams to define data retention windows.
Conduct a detailed compatibility assessment of all DAGs, custom plugins, operators, hooks, APIs, and integrations against Airflow 3 requirements.
Remediate deprecated features and breaking changes identified during the Airflow 3 compatibility review.
Execute the migration to Deployment Version 3.2-5 (Airflow 3.x) with rollback planning at each stage.
Coordinate testing (unit/integration/regression) with application teams prior to production cutover.
Document upgrade steps, issues encountered, and resolutions for audit/knowledge transfer.
Support go/no-go decisions and production readiness checks.

Tech Stack

Orchestration: Apache Airflow (2.x & 3.x), Astronomer / Astro (CLI, Runtime, Deployments)
OS: Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) command line, shell scripting, service/process management
Cloud: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS/Postgres, IAM, CloudWatch — as applicable to the environment)
Database: PostgreSQL (Airflow metadata DB — cleanup, retention, performance)
Languages: Python (DAGs, plugins, hooks, operators), Bash
Version Control: Git/GitHub or equivalent

Required Skills & Experience

Hands-on experience upgrading/administering Apache Airflow (2.x, ideally exposure to 3.x) — DAG authoring, scheduler internals, operators/hooks/plugins.
Direct experience with Astronomer / Astro platform — Astro CLI, Runtime version upgrades, Deployment management.
Genuine, working-level Linux command-line proficiency — most upgrade, validation, rollback, and troubleshooting steps (log inspection, service checks, file/permission management, process management) happen at the shell, so this should not be assumed as a byproduct of other skills.
Comfortable operating in AWS-hosted environments (compute, storage, networking basics relevant to where Astro/Airflow is deployed).
Experience troubleshooting and deploying via Kubernetes (pods, deployments, logs) since Astro runs on K8s under the hood.
Solid Python for reviewing and remediating DAG, plugin, and hook code.
Working knowledge of PostgreSQL for Airflow metadata cleanup, retention strategy, and performance.
Familiarity with Airflow 2 3 migration specifics (breaking changes, deprecated APIs, DAG serialization changes, executor changes) — reference: Apache Airflow's official "Upgrading to Airflow 3" guide.
Strong testing/validation discipline — smoke testing, regression testing, rollback procedures.
Ability to work with distributed application teams to assess DAG-level impact.

Job description

We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack React Application Developer to build production-grade, data-rich web applications, APIs, and interactive dashboards. You will own the full application lifecycle from designing component architectures and building performant React frontends to creating robust backend APIs and integrating with data platforms.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will build applications used by senior leadership, operations teams, and business users. The ideal candidate combines deep React expertise with strong API development skills and enough data fluency to work effectively with data engineering teams.

Responsibilities
React Frontend Development (Primary Focus)
Architect, build, and maintain complex React applications dashboards, analytics platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products

Build rich data visualizations using D3.js, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG/Canvas components
Implement advanced state management patterns using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, or Context API

Optimise frontend performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, virtual scrolling, bundle analysis
Write comprehensive tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress for E2E testing
Implement real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling strategies
API Design & Backend Development
