Implement API versioning, pagination, filtering, and search capabilities
Build and maintain microservices or serverless functions (Azure Functions / AWS Lambda)
Create API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI and maintain developer-facing docs
Integration & Data Layer
Integrate frontend applications with data platforms (Databricks, data warehouses, data lakes) through API layers
Build data ingestion endpoints that accept, validate, transform, and store incoming data
Work with data engineers to consume curated datasets and serve them through optimised APIs
Implement caching strategies (Redis, CDN, browser cache) for high-performance data delivery
Connect to third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, CRM, loyalty platforms, analytics tools)
AI / LLM Integration
Build conversational AI interfaces (chatbots, knowledge agents) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for document Q&A and contextual search
Create prompt engineering frameworks and manage AI response streaming in React UIs
DevOps & Delivery
Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
Containerize applications with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes or cloud-managed services
Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (Datadog, New Relic, or Application Insights)
Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive engineering best practices
Requirements
Must-Have Skills
5-7 years of professional full stack development experience in a product engineering environment
Expert-level React.js (4+ years): hooks, context, suspense, server components, performance patterns
Strong TypeScript proficiency type-safe component development, generics, utility types
Production experience building and consuming REST APIs (Node.js with Express/Fastify or Python with FastAPI)
Solid database skills: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimisation) and/or MongoDB
Experience with modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components for scalable styling
Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, PR workflows, and collaborative development
Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) or AWS app hosting, serverless, storage, CDN
Strong understanding of web security: CORS, XSS, CSRF, CSP, authentication flows
Experience with Docker containerisation and basic Kubernetes or cloud-managed container services
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and working in cross-functional, distributed teams
Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR, API routes) or Remix
GraphQL development experience (Apollo Server/Client or similar)
Data visualisation expertise: D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, custom charting
Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs and building AI-powered features
Knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake/warehouse concepts
Experience with real-time systems: WebSockets, Kafka consumers, event-driven architecture
Familiarity with design tools (Figma) and design-to-code workflows
Understanding of retail / e-commerce domain (POS, loyalty, customer analytics)
Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual testing
Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and internationalisation (i18n)

Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
Relevant certifications are a plus: AWS/Azure Developer, Meta React Certification, or similar

description:
Job description

Senior Database Engineer

Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

With 36 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies.

BPT is enabled by global engineering teams working on next-generation applications and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). As a Senior Software Engineer with specialized knowledge in Azure Cosmos DB and MongoDB, you will be a crucial part of our delivery team, ensuring the product features are completely automated and reducing the idea to live time to Business. This is a database-focused engineering role, ideal for someone who excels at designing, managing, and optimizing document-based, distributed databases in large-scale, cloud-native systems. As a technology leader, BPT wants to give you the opportunity not just to accept new challenges and opportunities but to impress with your ingenuity, focus, attention to detail and collaboration with a global team of professionals.

This role reports to a Manager.

Required Experience and Skills

Experience:

58 years in database engineering, architecture, or backend data systems.
3+ years of hands-on experience managing Azure Cosmos DB and MongoDB in production.
Deep understanding of:
Cosmos DB: Partition key design, RU/s provisioning, indexing, consistency models, TTL, and multi-region replication.
MongoDB: Replica sets, sharding, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, schema optimization, and tuning.
Proven ability to design for high concurrency, low latency, and multi-tenant SaaS systems.
Experience with query profiling, performance benchmarking, and monitoring dashboards.

Specific skills required

Design & Architecture:
Architect and implement distributed data models using Cosmos DB (Core SQL or Mongo API) and MongoDB to support large-scale, high-throughput applications.
Define partitioning, indexing, and data distribution strategies for optimal scalability and performance.
Performance Engineering:
Conduct deep query analysis, index optimization, and RU/cost optimization in Cosmos DB.
Implement profiling, query tuning, and aggregation optimization in MongoDB.
Automation & Operations:
Build automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for deployment, monitoring, and scaling.
Integrate database monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor, MongoDB Ops Manager, or similar tools.
Data Lifecycle Management:
Implement and optimize backup/restore, TTL policies, and Change Feed or CDC pipelines.
Design and validate disaster recovery, replication, and geo-distribution strategies.
Collaboration:
Partner with development and DevOps teams to design data access layers, API integrations, and IaC templates (Terraform, Bicep, ARM).
Contribute to performance reviews, code walkthroughs, and system design discussions.

Desirable Experience

Experience with data migrations (e.g., Oracle/SQL MongoDB or Cosmos DB).
Knowledge of event-driven architectures, microservices, and API-based integrations.
Familiarity with data security and compliance (encryption, GDPR, HIPAA).
Exposure to Azure infrastructure, Terraform, or CI/CD data pipelines.
Awareness of frontend and application integration points (understanding how data models serve APIs/UI layers, Angular).

Additional Skills (Preferred)

Strong SQL foundation; ability to work with RDBMS systems (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and evaluate relational vs. document model trade-offs.
Familiarity with backend stacks (.NET, Java, Node.js) for integration and troubleshooting.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates).
Scripting proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash for automation.
Certifications (preferred):
Microsoft Certified: Azure Cosmos DB Developer Associate
MongoDB Certified Developer/DBA
Exposure to data lakes, analytical processing, or data warehousing concepts is a plus.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.
Demonstrated experience with Cosmos DB and/or MongoDB at scale
Strong foundation in distributed systems, NoSQL principles, and data architecture

Additional Information

Personal Skills:

Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to articulate and present different points-of-views on various topics related to project and otherwise.
Eager to learn and continuously develop personal and technical capabilities.

Required Qualifications:

MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.

Maximum NP: Immediate to 25 Days

Min Exp 4+ Years
Mandatory: MongoDB/CouchDB, Database Designing, Performance Tuning, Optimization, Complex Query Writing, Advance Indexing, Strong understanding database issues. This role is completely individual contributor.

Job Title: Technical Writer @ Innominds

Experience: 5-10 Years

Job Description Technical Writer, Canopy Applications

Position

Technical Writer Canopy Applications / AI & Automation Platform

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Technical Writer to own and drive technical documentation for Canopy, a cloud-native AI and automation platform supporting multiple applications and customer deployments.

The role will work closely with Architecture, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, DevOps, Product Owners, QA and Operations teams to convert complex technical information into clear, accurate and reusable documentation.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with cloud-native applications, APIs, microservices, data platforms, AI/ML and automation technologies, and should be able to independently engage with engineering teams to extract and structure technical knowledge.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application & Product Documentation

Create and maintain technical documentation for Canopy applications such as SATH, WFM, PM and related platform capabilities.
Document application architecture, components, dependencies, workflows and integrations.
Develop application-specific Technical Design Documents, Solution Design Documents and System Architecture documentation.
Maintain documentation for application releases, features and major architectural changes.

2. API & Integration Documentation

Document REST APIs, events, interfaces, data flows and system integrations.
Create API specifications, request/response examples and integration guides.
Document integrations with systems such as ITSM, Inventory, Kafka, databases and external/customer platforms.
Work with developers to ensure API and interface documentation remains synchronized with the actual implementation.

3. Deployment & Operations Documentation

Create and maintain:
Deployment guides
Installation/configuration guides
Environment readiness documentation
Upgrade and migration procedures
Troubleshooting guides
Runbooks and operational procedures
Disaster recovery and backup procedures
Document deployment differences across development, QA, UAT and production environments.
Capture operational dependencies, prerequisites and known issues.

4. Architecture & Platform Documentation

Work with Canopy architects to document the overall Canopy architecture, architectural principles and common platform capabilities.
Maintain architecture diagrams, data-flow diagrams, sequence diagrams and system interaction diagrams.
Document common capabilities such as authentication, RBAC, observability, messaging, data ingestion, AI/ML and agentic capabilities.
Ensure application-specific documentation aligns with the overall Canopy architecture.

5. AI / Automation Documentation

Document AI/ML and automation capabilities in a manner understandable to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Create documentation for AI agents, tools, MCP/server integrations, prompts, workflows and guardrails where applicable.
Explain AI-enabled use cases, system flows, dependencies and operational considerations.

6. Documentation Governance

Establish and maintain a consistent documentation structure and standards across Canopy applications.
Create documentation templates and Definition-of-Done criteria for technical documentation.
Establish version control and documentation lifecycle management.
Identify documentation gaps and proactively drive closure with engineering teams.
Ensure documentation is updated as part of every major application release.

Key Deliverables

The Technical Writer will be accountable for building and maintaining:

Canopy Architecture Documentation
Application Technical Design Documents
Application Architecture & Component Documentation
API & Integration Documentation
Data Flow & Interface Documentation
Deployment & Configuration Guides
Environment Readiness Documentation
Operations Runbooks
Troubleshooting & Known Issues Guides
Release Notes
Upgrade & Migration Guides
User/Admin Guides
AI/Agent/MCP Technical Documentation
Architecture diagrams and technical workflows
Documentation repository and standards

Required Skills & Experience

5+ years of experience in technical writing for software products/platforms.
Experience working directly with software engineering and architecture teams.
Strong understanding of:
Cloud-native applications
Microservices
REST APIs
Kubernetes/containers
Event-driven architecture
Databases and data pipelines
CI/CD and DevOps
Ability to understand and document complex technical architectures.
Experience creating architecture and process diagrams using tools such as Confluence, Draw.io, Lucidchart or equivalent.
Strong knowledge of Markdown and documentation-as-code practices.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub/GitLab and version-controlled documentation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to independently interview engineers and architects and convert discussions into high-quality documentation.

Good to Have

Experience with AI/ML, Generative AI or Agentic AI.
Understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI tool integrations.
Experience with Kafka, NiFi, MongoDB, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Azure/AWS/GCP or similar technologies.
Experience in telecom, OSS/BSS, network automation or managed services.
Experience documenting enterprise platforms deployed across multiple customers/environments.
Familiarity with API documentation tools such as Swagger/OpenAPI.
Experience with technical documentation automation using LLMs/Copilot or similar tools.

Working Model

The Technical Writer will operate as part of the Canopy Architecture & Engineering organisation and will work horizontally across:

Architecture Engineering Data/DevOps QA Product Operations

The role is expected to be hands-on and engineering-facing, rather than limited to proofreading or formatting existing content.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

100% documentation coverage for critical Canopy applications and platform capabilities.
Documentation updated as part of the release lifecycle.
Reduction in dependency on individual engineers for application knowledge.
Faster onboarding of engineering, QA and operations resources.
Clear and reusable deployment and troubleshooting procedures.
Consistency of technical documentation across Canopy applications.
Improved customer/SI/GDC understanding of Canopy architecture and operational processes.
Creation of a single, reliable source of technical knowledge for Canopy.

The Front-End Web Developer will support the Marketing organization by developing and maintaining the front-end user experience, component library, design system, page templates, and client-side functionality that power the global marketing website and related digital properties. This role will be part of the U.S.-led Web Operations team and will partner closely with the Director of Digital Experience Web Strategy, back-end development, web operations resources, IT, SEO, analytics, UX/design partners, and business stakeholders.
The ideal candidate should bring strong front-end development fundamentals, design system experience, component-driven architecture skills, and comfort working across modern, scalable, API-first, AI-enabled digital experience environments. This is not intended to be a basic website maintenance role it is focused on building polished, accessible, performant, and future-ready user experiences on a modern headless CMS platform.
This role will help ensure the website delivers a best-in-class user experience that supports structured content rendering, component reuse, personalization, intelligent search, forms, analytics, SEO/AEO/GEO requirements, global/multilingual presentation needs, accessibility compliance, and future AI-forward digital experiences.
Develop, enhance, and maintain front-end website functionality, React components, page templates, design system elements, and user experiences across the global marketing website and related digital properties.
Build and maintain the component library using React, shadcn/ui (Radix UI primitives), Tailwind CSS, and Storybook, ensuring consistency, reusability, accessibility, and alignment with the design system and brand standards.
Implement front-end page templates and layouts within the Next.js framework, including client components, dynamic routing, client-side interactivity, and responsive design across devices and browsers.
Translate UX/design specifications from Figma into production-ready, pixel-accurate components that follow the token-driven design system (CSS variables, Tailwind config, design tokens).
Partner with the back-end developer to consume Sanity CMS content models, GROQ queries, and APIs, ensuring front-end components properly render structured content and support self-service publishing workflows for the marketing team.
Experience working in agile/scrum workflows with 23 week sprint cycles, including the ability to participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives within a small, self-managing development team.
Implement analytics tracking (GA4 events, GTM tags, conversion tracking, click tracking) and ensure accurate data capture across user interactions and marketing funnels.
Own accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA) across the website, including semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, focus management, ARIA attributes, and color contrast.
Optimize client-side performance, including Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), bundle size optimization, lazy loading, image optimization, code splitting, and efficient rendering patterns.
Implement front-end behaviors for personalization (Optimizely), A/B testing, chatbot/conversational UI (Qualified), consent management, and intent-driven experiences (6sense) in coordination with the back-end developer.
Build and maintain forms, including form UI, client-side validation, error handling, progressive disclosure, and UX partnering with the back-end developer on submission logic, CRM/MAP integration, and server-side validation.
Support front-end implementation of SEO, AEO/GEO requirements, including semantic HTML, heading hierarchy, meta tags, Open Graph/social sharing markup, and rendered output optimization for search engines and AI answer engines.
Implement localization/multilingual front-end patterns, including language switching UI, locale-aware rendering, and layout adaptation for global audiences, in coordination with the back-end developer and Smartling integration.
Participate in visual regression testing, cross-browser/cross-device QA, component testing, UAT, troubleshooting, issue resolution, and production support for website enhancements and launches.
Document component library standards, design system patterns, front-end architecture decisions, and development guidelines that enable the Web Operations team to scale.
Work within Git, version control, code review, CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and agile delivery processes to ensure high-quality and controlled releases.
Use AI-enabled coding tools and modern development practices to improve speed, quality, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement while maintaining strong development judgment.
Required Skills and Experience
5+ years of professional front-end web development experience.
3+ years of advanced experience with React, including hooks, context, component composition patterns, state management, and performance optimization.
2+ years of experience with Next.js, including App Router, client/server components, dynamic routing, SSR/SSG, and image optimization.
2+ years of experience with Tailwind CSS, including custom configuration, design tokens, responsive utilities, and utility-first architecture at scale.
Strong experience building and maintaining a component library/design system in a production environment including component APIs, variant patterns, composition, and documentation.
Experience with Storybook for component development, documentation, and visual testing.
Proficiency translating Figma designs into production-ready, responsive, pixel-accurate front-end code.
Strong understanding of web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), including semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, and focus management.
Experience optimizing client-side web performance, including Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), bundle analysis, lazy loading, code splitting, and image optimization.
Experience consuming APIs and structured content from a headless CMS to render dynamic, content-driven pages.
Experience implementing analytics and event tracking (GA4, GTM, or similar) across complex web applications.
Strong experience with cross-browser and cross-device testing, ensuring consistent experiences across modern browsers, screen sizes, and input methods.
Experience working with Git, version control, code review, CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and agile development workflows.
Familiarity with AI-enabled development tools, copilots, automated testing, debugging, or workflow automation is preferred.
Experience with B2B, SaaS, global, multilingual, or enterprise marketing websites is required.
Strong attention to detail, visual precision, problem-solving skills, and ability to partner effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-have Skills
Experience with shadcn/ui (Radix UI primitives) specifically.
Experience with Sanity CMS, including basic GROQ queries and understanding of structured content models.
Experience with A/B testing and personalization platforms (Optimizely or similar), implementing front-end test variants and conditional rendering.

Experience with animation and interaction design (Framer Motion, CSS animations, micro-interactions).

source_title: Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist at Mass Markets — San Fernando, Ilocos Region, Philippines | LinkedIn Jobs
description:
Position Overview

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled businesses services companies in the US, delivering Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and technology solutions across multiple industries and countries worldwide. Our team use people, technology and innovation to help organizations improve customer experience and business performance.

As a Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of products, services, or processes within the organization. Your role will involve designing, implementing, and executing quality assurance procedures, conducting tests, analyzing results, and identifying areas for improvement. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to uphold quality standards, enhance customer satisfaction, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

Key Responsibilities

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES


Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance policies, procedures, and standards to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
Define quality metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and benchmarks to measure and monitor the effectiveness of quality assurance processes.
Plan, design, and execute quality assurance tests and inspections to evaluate products, services, or processes for defects, deviations, or non-conformities.
Conduct functional testing, regression testing, performance testing, and usability testing to identify issues and ensure product reliability and usability.
Document test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test results to provide comprehensive documentation of quality assurance activities and findings.
Prepare and communicate quality assurance reports, metrics, and analysis to stakeholders, management, and project teams.
Identify and report quality issues, deviations, and non-compliance incidents through systematic testing, analysis, and investigation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate root causes, implement corrective actions, and prevent recurrence of quality issues.
Analyze quality assurance data, trends, and feedback to identify opportunities for process improvement, efficiency gains, and cost reduction.
Implement continuous improvement initiatives, quality control measures, and corrective/preventive actions to enhance product quality and customer satisfaction.
Provide training, guidance, and support to team members and stakeholders on quality assurance principles, methodologies, and tools.
Promote a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.


Candidate Qualifications

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?

All Positive, And Driven Applicants Are Encouraged To Apply. The Ideal Candidates For This Position Are Highly Motivated And Dedicated And Should Possess The Below Qualities


Associate degree, Certification or Equivalent combination of Training and Experience
Proven experience in quality assurance, testing, or quality control roles, preferably in a related industry or domain.
Strong understanding of quality management principles, methodologies, and tools
Proficiency in quality assurance techniques, testing methodologies, and software testing tools.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify issues, analyze data, and implement effective solutions.
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and thoroughness in quality assurance processes and documentation.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate quality-related concepts to stakeholders at all levels.
Knowledge of regulatory requirements, compliance standards, and industry best practices related to quality assurance and product/service quality.
Certification in quality assurance (e.g., Certified Quality Engineer, Certified Quality Auditor) is a plus.


Physical Requirements

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee will be regularly required to operate a computer and other office equipment, including a phone, copier, and printer. The employee may occasionally be required to move about the office to accomplish tasks; reach in any direction; raise or lower objects, move objects from place to place, hold onto objects, and move or exert force up to forty (40) pounds.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

All MCI Locations


Must be authorized to work in the country where the job is based.


Subject to the program and location of the position


Must be willing to submit up to a LEVEL II background and/or security investigation with a fingerprint. Job offers are contingent on background/security investigation results.
Must be willing to submit to drug screening. Job offers are contingent on drug screening results. (Does not apply in Canada)


REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), it is the policy of MCI and its affiliates to provide reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability unless such accommodations would cause undue hardship. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of employment. If reasonable accommodations are needed, please contact Human Resources.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At MCI and its subsidiaries, we embrace differences and believe diversity is a benefit to our employees, our company, our customers, and our community. All aspects of employment at MCI are based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. MCI maintains a work environment free from discrimination, one where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling MCI's commitment to a diverse and equal opportunity work environment.

MCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. MCI will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

MCI will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits , social and recreational programs, and discipline . In addition, it is the policy of MCI to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where an employee works.

About Mci (parent Company)

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services.

In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa’s Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI’s subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines.

Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.

QA Engineer 2 - Operations

JOB CODE

PHL5246

JOB PROFILE NAME (Title)

QA Engineer 2 - Operations

MANAGEMENT LEVEL

39 Senior Professional

DISCIPLINE

Quality Assurance

REPORTS TO

FSLA CLASSIFICATION

Exempt; Pay Rate Type: Salary

The QA Engineer 2 - Operations ensures operational quality across releases and environments. This role designs and executes test plans, validates defect fixes, and monitors production health to protect customer experience. The position collaborates with development, product, and support teams to streamline release readiness and drive continuous improvement. The engineer builds automated checks, maintains test data, and improves observability for rapid issue detection. Success is measured by defect leakage reduction, test coverage growth, and stable, predictable deployments.

Understands the principles of parts, product and service quality evaluation and control and can relate to the organization's goal that aims to minimize the costs of reworking or waste and maximize customer satisfactions through products innovation and breakthroughs.

QA Engineer 2 is responsible for creating parts qualification, test methodology and metrology, and new model failure analysis to ensure that parts conform and are comparable to OEM and product warranty. He / She enhances the capability of failure and reliability testing to sustain an effective and cost-efficient approach to new parts, product and process qualification and development.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Researches and provides input to determine equivalent Industry-wide used metrology on identifying relationships between the various structures and types of materials.
Creates parts qualification and reliability process, system, test plan, and test methodology that is appropriate, effective, and efficient for a given commodity based on the existing procedure.
Generates and continuously improves current method and test equipment/jigs to have a robust process and test time efficiency through innovations.
Validates analysis of parts failure and formulate a hypothesis for a possible solution. Generates new methods and test equipment/jigs to have a robust process and test time efficiency through innovations.
Participates in the development of product specifications, acceptance criteria, and disposition from handling of the non-conformances, and new business programs. Conducts material analysis and product / parts characterization.
Reviews reports for complex failure analysis, new material, and new technology and provide feedback for continuous improvement.
Leads discussion with requestors and reviews reports for simple and existing process changes validation and provides feedback for continuous improvement.
Acts as liaison officer in identifying risk, creation of mitigating measures, and communication to risk committee.
Leads projects which drive continuous improvement and quality of test methodologies.
Leads the overall part qualification and reliability team on behalf of the supervisor.
Executes, contributes to, and participates in 5S activities within assigned station/area.
Adheres to Asurion Handbook and the Rules of Corrective Discipline.
Performs other duties as maybe assigned by immediate superior.


Required Education and Experience:


Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (preferably BS in Material Science and Engineering, BS in Applied Physics, BS in Chemical Engineering, BS in Materials Engineering)
Minimum of 4 years of experience in laboratory and reliability testing
Preferably with 4 years’ experience in failure analysis and metrology such as but not limited to SEM-EDS, 3D X-ray Imaging, CMM, etc.

source_title: AI Deployment Strategist at FDE Times — San Mateo, Calabarzon, Philippines | LinkedIn Jobs
description:
Job Description

About Us

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About The Role

Fireworks AI is looking for an AI Deployment Strategist to be the technical backbone of our relationship with customers building on our fast inference platform. You'll be the connective tissue between customer engineering teams and Fireworks' product, engineering, and applied AI teams — driving successful onboarding, deep technical adoption, and long-term account health for companies running production AI workloads at scale.

This is a hybrid technical/commercial role. You'll need enough depth to debug a customer's inference pipeline, discuss quantization tradeoffs, or advise on model routing and fine-tuning strategy — and enough business judgment to run a QBR, spot expansion opportunity, and manage renewal risk before it becomes a problem. Think of it as "product manager for the customer's problem": you own the why and the what — scoping the business case, defining success criteria, and managing the relationship end-to-end. You're embedded with your accounts from early technical evaluation through production and beyond.

What You'll Do

Deployment Strategy & Value Scoping


Partner with Sales during late-stage deals and early post-sale to map the customer's technical and organizational landscape — who the real stakeholders are, what "success" looks like, and where the risk sits
Quantify the business case for the deployment (cost-to-serve, latency/quality targets, ROI vs. the customer's current approach) and define a scoped pilot with clear milestones and exit criteria
Author the internal scoping brief that AI Field Engineering builds against — you own the "why" and "what," they own the "how"


Onboarding & Technical Deployment


Own the post-sale technical relationship from kickoff through go-live, including model deployment, integration architecture, SSO/security configuration, and performance benchmarking
Partner with AI Field Engineering to deliver the successful transition from PoC to production
Build and execute joint success plans with clear milestones, ownership, and timelines


Trusted Advisor & Adoption


Serve as the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of strategic accounts, building deep relationships with engineering leaders, ML/platform teams, and power users
Advise customers on model selection, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, latency/cost optimization, and agent architecture as their usage matures
Drive usage against business objectives — not just technical enablement, but measurable outcomes (latency SLAs, cost per token, model quality, uptime)


Troubleshooting & Escalation Management


Act as the technical escalation point for production issues, coordinating with Engineering and Support to drive resolution
Maintain runbooks and playbooks that reduce time-to-resolution across the account portfolio


Voice of the Customer


Synthesize patterns across your accounts and feed them into product and engineering roadmaps
Represent customer priorities in internal planning, particularly around model support, tooling gaps, and platform reliability
Track a tight feedback loop between what customers are building and what Fireworks ships next


Expansion, Renewal & Business Reviews


Own the technical narrative for quarterly/executive business reviews (QBRs/EBRs), including adoption trends, ROI, and roadmap alignment
Partner with the Account Executive on renewal strategy and identify expansion opportunities tied to new use cases, teams, or workloads
Forecast and proactively flag account health risks before they threaten retention


What We're Looking For


Bachelor's degree required
4+ years in a technical, customer-facing role: Deployment Strategy, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Forward-Deployed Engineering, or Technical Customer Success at an enterprise software or AI/ML company
Strong technical foundation: comfortable with APIs, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), and enough hands-on coding ability to debug integrations, not just describe them
Direct experience with LLMs in production — understanding of probabilistic model behavior, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, and/or agent architectures
Track record of managing enterprise relationships end-to-end: technical delivery, executive communication, and commercial outcomes (renewal/expansion)
Excellent written and verbal communication — able to translate between ML engineers and business stakeholders fluently
Comfortable owning ambiguity in a fast-moving, early-stage function; you'll be shaping the playbook for this role at Fireworks, not just following one
Experience scoping high-value engagements — value-based/TCO-ROI framing, defining pilot success criteria, writing scoping docs or PRDs — gained in a Deployment Strategist, Forward-Deployed Engineer, or similar "product manager for the field" capacity is a strong plus
Bonus: experience with inference optimization, model serving infrastructure, or open-source model ecosystems (Llama, Mixtral, DeepSeek, etc.)


Why Fireworks?


Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.
Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.
Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.
Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.


Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

description:
About The Company

We are a rapidly growing U.S.-based tax strategy firm serving high-income professionals and business owners. Our clients typically already have a capable accountant. What they lack is someone proactively designing how their income is taxed, and that is the gap we fill.

Our work goes well beyond filing. We analyze a client's returns, income and investments, calculate what their liability should be, and design the entity and investment structures that legally reduce it year after year. We then monitor each client as their income and the tax code change, and every return is reviewed twice before it is filed.

Our founder approaches the tax code the way an engineer approaches a system: predictable inputs, optimizable outputs. That mindset runs through the firm, and it is why we are now investing in someone who can apply the same thinking to how we work internally.

About The Role

Our work is high-value and detail-heavy: reading returns, pulling figures from client documents, modeling strategies and tracking each client year-round. As our client base and advisory team grow, too much of that still runs on manual effort. This role exists to take that load off our advisors so their time goes to strategy, not data handling.

You will be our first dedicated technical hire, and the role has two halves. First, you sit with our founder and advisors, learn how the work actually gets done, and find where time is being lost. Second, you build the fix, using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to ship practical internal tools quickly.

The measure of success is simple: tools our team uses every day, and hours given back to client work. The right person cares more about solving the right problem than building the most impressive thing.

Key Responsibilities

Workflow Discovery & Prioritization


Interview the founder and each advisor to map how client work flows from intake through strategy, filing and ongoing monitoring
Identify where time is lost to manual steps, rework or scattered information, and estimate the hours each fix would save

Build and ship internal tools using AI-assisted development (Claude Code and similar), moving from working prototype to daily use quickly
Automate client intake and document collection so files arrive organized and complete

Build tracking views that show where every client stands across the year

AI & Automation


Design LLM-powered workflows using APIs such as Anthropic's Claude, including prompt design and output testing
Build in human review wherever accuracy matters, since tax figures must be correct before they reach a client or a return
Connect the firm's existing systems, such as CRM, document storage, email, calendar and spreadsheets, through APIs or automation platforms


Security & Data Handling


Handle client financial and personal data with care: least-privilege access, no client data in unapproved tools, and clear records of what each tool touches
Support the firm's information security practices as new tools are introduced


Adoption, Documentation & Support


Train the team on each new tool and gather feedback in the first weeks of use
Document how each tool works so it can be maintained and extended
Fix issues promptly and improve tools as workflows and tax rules change


Required Qualifications


3+ years of professional software development, with full-stack applications shipped to real users (Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript)
Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot, with examples of what you have built using them
At least one real project built on an LLM API, such as Anthropic or OpenAI

Ideal Candidate Profile

You Are

Comfortable owning a tool end to end, from the first conversation through daily use and maintenance.

description:
Company Description

WHY EVISMART

EviSmart operates across 28 countries, and our Manila team plays a direct role in building and delivering the platform globally.

You'll work alongside engineering, product, operations, and in-house AI teams on systems that are already in production and continuing to scale.

We offer competitive compensation, HMO coverage, 13th-month pay, government-mandated benefits, and opportunities for growth based on demonstrated capability and results.

But the biggest opportunity is the work itself.

You won't be measured by how experienced you sound. You'll be measured by what you can understand, build, solve, and deliver.

If that's the kind of engineer you are, we'd like to hear from you.

Job Description

FULL-STACK DEVELOPER — C#/.NET + ReactJS

BGC, Taguig | 100% Onsite | Full-Time

We're not looking for developers who simply know how to code. We're looking for engineers who know how to figure out what needs to be built, why it matters, and how to make it work.

You can have 5, 10, or 15 years of experience with C#, .NET, React, and SQL. That's great. But experience alone won't qualify you for this role.

What matters is what you can independently do with it.

What We're Building

EviSmart is building a dental Autopilot platform operating across 28 countries, supporting thousands of dental labs and dentists worldwide.

Our Manila engineering team builds and ships the systems that make this possible, including the application layer supporting our in-house AI development.

These are real products, serving real customers, with real operational consequences when something doesn't work.

We're Hiring Engineers Who Can Take Responsibility For That.

WHAT WE ACTUALLY EXPECT YOU TO DO


Figure out the problem before writing code.


You won't always receive perfectly documented requirements or detailed instructions.

You need to be comfortable talking to stakeholders, understanding how the business works, identifying what's actually broken, and translating that into a technical solution.

That means doing business analysis when necessary.

Not because you're replacing a Business Analyst, but because you cannot build the right solution if you don't understand the problem.


Build it yourself. From the ground up.


We need engineers who can personally develop substantial features across:


C# / .NET Core
ReactJS / JavaScript
SQL Server
REST APIs and system integrations


You should be capable of working across the frontend, backend, and database without depending on another developer to figure out the difficult parts for you.

We're not hiring someone whose primary contribution is researching technologies, recommending frameworks, or delegating the actual development.

You need to be able to execute.


Challenge requirements when they don't make sense.


A requirement isn't automatically the right solution.

If you see a better approach, explain it. If something creates unnecessary complexity, challenge it. If a proposed solution solves the wrong problem, say so.

We expect you to understand trade-offs, ask difficult questions, and propose alternatives.

We value engineers who think, not just engineers who agree.


Solve problems without waiting to be told every step.


You'll encounter unfamiliar systems, incomplete information, technical constraints, and things that don't work the first time.

Your responsibility is to investigate, understand, experiment, and find a way forward.

Ask for help when necessary. Collaborate with the team. Escalate genuine risks early.

But don't confuse collaboration with waiting for someone else to solve the problem.


Own what happens after you build it.


Writing code isn't the finish line.

You need to test your work, validate business requirements, investigate failures, and ensure the feature is actually ready for production.

If it breaks, you help fix it.

If it doesn't solve the original problem, you're not done.

If there's a risk to delivery, you raise it early.

Your responsibility isn't just to complete a ticket. It's to deliver something that works.

Qualifications

THE TECHNICAL FOUNDATION

You should already have substantial hands-on experience with:


C# / ASP.NET Core / .NET — building production backend services and business logic
ReactJS — personally developing production web applications, not just listing it on your CV
SQL Server — designing schemas, writing queries, investigating performance, and understanding data integrity
REST APIs — designing, building, integrating, and troubleshooting services
End-to-end delivery — taking features from problem discovery through development, testing, and production readiness


Experience with Azure, CI/CD, automated testing, and AI-assisted development tools is valuable.

But tools don't replace engineering judgment.

Who Will Struggle Here

This role is probably not for you if:


You prefer receiving detailed tickets and implementing exactly what's written.
You need someone else to define the technical solution before you can begin.
Your experience is primarily coordinating developers rather than personally building software.
You avoid questioning requirements, even when you see a problem.
You consider a feature finished once the code compiles or the ticket is closed.
You expect seniority, years of experience, or job titles to speak for your capability.
Your main priority is securing a higher salary without taking on the accountability that comes with it.


There's nothing wrong with preferring a more structured development environment.

This just isn't that environment.

Who Will Thrive Here

You'll likely enjoy this role if you:


Get curious about the business problem before discussing technology.
Enjoy building systems from scratch and figuring things out independently.
Can move comfortably between frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
Take pride in solving problems other people haven't figured out yet.
Speak up when you disagree and can explain why.
Care whether your solution actually improves something.
Want your compensation and career growth to reflect the value you consistently deliver.


We don't expect you to know everything.

We expect you to know how to figure things out — and have the ability to execute once you do.

What We Build

We build intelligent, cloud-based SaaS solutions that turn complex operations into smarter, more sustainable performance. Powered by AI, data and deep industry expertise, our technology helps customers optimise routes, manage recycling, improve compliance, unlock insight and move faster toward a more efficient, circular future.

Why Join AMCS

Join AMCS and be part of a global team where purpose meets performance. Here, you can grow your career, challenge what’s possible and work on technology that makes a measurable difference — for our customers, our communities and the planet.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Platform Engineer to deliver the engineering, operation, and administration of AMCS's Azure Databricks platform and its supporting Azure infrastructure — ensuring it is secure, reliable, and available by design, and that platform capability is delivered as code so teams can build and run data and AI workloads safely on top of it.

What You'll Work On


Provision and maintain Databricks workspaces (dev/test/prod) via the Infrastructure-as-Code — networking, cluster policies, SQL warehouses.
Administer Unity Catalog: catalogs/schemas/external locations, access control, and data lineage across the platform.
Build and maintain the CI/CD pipeline for databricks-workspace, structured as a Databricks Asset Bundle (notebooks, job/pipeline definitions, cluster policies), deployed via databricks bundle deploy per environment.
Configure and enforce security: Entra ID SSO, secret scopes/Key Vault integration, network isolation.
Monitor and optimize platform cost: DBU consumption, cluster autoscaling/termination policies, job vs. all-purpose cluster usage.
Partner with the data engineering & analytics team building the dbt project — you're the escalation point when a job fails, a cluster misbehaves, or access/governance needs change.


Must-have

What we're looking for


Hands-on experience administering Databricks workspaces in production — cluster policies, SQL warehouses, workspace-level security.
Experience with Unity Catalog governance (or an equivalent data catalog/governance layer).
Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform and/or Bicep) provisioning cloud data platform resources.
Experience with Databricks Workflows/Lakeflow Jobs, including multi-task job dependency design.
Familiarity with Git-based CI/CD and deploying Databricks Asset Bundles.
Solid grasp of cloud security fundamentals: identity federation (Entra ID/Azure AD), secrets management, network isolation.
Comfortable working from cost/usage data to right-size compute rather than over-provisioning by default.


What We Offer


Hybrid working that keeps you flexible and connected.
Day 1 healthcare for you and up to three dependents.
25 days annual leave.
Company shuttle service.
Free onsite meals and unlimited coffee.
Competitive allowances and wellbeing benefits.
Global collaboration with teams across our locations.
Continuous learning to grow your career.
Build innovative SaaS and AI solutions for a more sustainable future.


Ready to Make an Impact?

At AMCS, your work helps organisations operate more efficiently while contributing to a more sustainable future. If you're passionate about cloud platforms, Azure Databricks, and building secure, scalable technology foundations, we'd love to hear from you.

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Every agent on this platform runs inside its own isolated environment, and someone has to make sure that environment actually behaves the way it's supposed to under real load, not just in a clean test run. As a Senior Agent Runtime Engineer, you'll own the health of the systems agents run on: keeping sessions isolated from each other, catching the failure modes that only show up under real concurrency, and making sure a slow or expensive agent gets caught before it becomes everyone's problem. You'll work closely with the engineers building the agents themselves, since you're often the first call when something behaves strangely in a real environment but not in a test one. If you like being the person who understands a system well enough to know exactly why it's misbehaving, this is that job.

Skills and competencies:


Own the health of the agent execution environment day to day — session isolation, resource limits, and catching the failure modes that only appear once real concurrency and real traffic patterns show up, not just in a clean test run.
Investigate and resolve cases where an agent behaves differently in production than it did in testing, working directly with the Agent Engineer or Quality Engineer who built it to figure out whether the problem is the agent's design or the environment it's running in.
Tune cold-start and concurrency settings for the platform's critical-path functions, and review them on a regular cadence as usage patterns shift rather than setting them once and forgetting them.
Understand the platform's session isolation model well enough to reason about its limits — where isolation is guaranteed by the underlying compute layer, and where the platform has to add its own controls because that guarantee doesn't fully hold.
Build and maintain the observability that lets someone answer "is this agent actually working correctly," not just "is it technically up" — tracing, behavioral drift detection, and quality signals sitting alongside the usual metrics and logs.
Track per-agent and per-session cost and efficiency, and flag agents that are burning more tokens, calling more tools, or running longer than the task should reasonably require.
Deploy and manage runtime-layer infrastructure resources through existing CI/CD pipelines as needed — provisioned concurrency settings, runtime-specific IAM roles, observability configurations, etc.
Run and improve the tests that validate isolation actually holds — for example, confirming that one agent's session genuinely can't reach or affect another's, not just assuming it because the platform is supposed to guarantee it.


Must-Have:


At least 5 years in a platform, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role, with real production experience running serverless or containerized workloads on AWS (Lambda, Fargate, Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent) at meaningful scale.
Hands-on experience with AWS observability tooling (CloudWatch, X-Ray, or a comparable distributed tracing stack) — able to go from "something's wrong" to a root cause using traces and logs, not just dashboards.
Real experience deploying and managing infrastructure through CI/CD independently — comfortable owning IaC changes (Terraform, CDK, or similar) end to end rather than handing them off to someone else.
Working understanding of compute isolation concepts (containers, microVMs, or similar sandboxing models) and where their guarantees actually stop, since a lot of this role is reasoning about the edges of what a platform promises versus what it might not fully cover on its own.
Comfort investigating cost and performance problems at a granular level — able to trace an unexpectedly expensive or slow workload back to a specific cause, not just flag that costs went up.
Strong incident response instincts: staying calm and methodical while root-causing a live production issue, and following through with an actual fix rather than a workaround.


Strong Advantage:


Direct experience with AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, or any managed AI/agent runtime platform.
Experience with cold-start or concurrency tuning specifically (Lambda provisioned concurrency, container warm pools, or similar).
Exposure to a security-conscious or regulated environment where infrastructure changes go through a formal review or approval process.
Familiarity with LLM-specific cost drivers (token pricing, tool-call volume, model tiering) even if it wasn't the primary focus of a past role.

Moving AI agents from a playground demo to production requires serious software engineering discipline. We are looking for an AI Agent Engineer who knows how to build scalable, secure, and fully auditable agentic systems.

In this role, you won't just tweak prompts until they "feel right." You will build spec-driven orchestrator and sub-agent architectures, manage sensitive data classifications, integrate tool gateways, and establish comprehensive test cases. You’ll work closely with Product, Security, and Cloud Architecture to ensure every agent operates strictly within its designated guardrails and risk tiers.

Skills and Competencies:


Write full agent specifications — purpose, capabilities, input/output contracts, guardrails, and tool boundaries — to the same level of rigor a safety-critical system would get, not a quick README.
Design and build orchestrator agents that hand work off to specialized sub-agents, and hold the line on a simple rule: the orchestrator coordinates, it doesn't do the work itself.
Write and test system prompts, and design tool schemas that stay accurate even when an agent has to choose between fifteen or twenty different tools — not just three.
Work with the Data Steward to classify how sensitive each agent's data is, and with the Product Owner/Architect to set its risk tier, before anything goes up for registration.
For each capability an agent has, decide whether it should be deterministic logic or model judgment, and build test cases that prove it actually meets that bar.
Build every agent against the platform's tool gateway, so nothing an agent does falls outside what it's registered and approved to touch.
Design for scale from day one — sessions that stay isolated from each other, failures that are predictable, and no assumptions that only hold up in a single test run.
Prepare the evidence a reviewer needs before approving an agent for production: test results, guardrail coverage, and behavioral results, laid out clearly enough that someone outside your head can follow the reasoning.


Must-Have:


At least 4 years building production software, with 1–2 of those years specifically spent building LLM-powered agents — not chatbots, not RAG pipelines, agents that make tool-use decisions on their own.
Real hands-on time with at least one agent orchestration framework — LangGraph, Bedrock AgentCore, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar — enough to explain why you'd pick one over another for a given problem.
Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol: building or integrating MCP servers and clients, and understanding where tool-selection tends to break down.
A real prompt engineering practice — versioning changes, testing them against a set of cases before shipping — not just iterating in a playground until it feels right.
Comfort writing precise specs: boundaries, failure modes, test criteria. This team documents everything and peer-reviews it, so this isn't optional.
Enough AWS familiarity (Lambda, IAM roles, Bedrock) to understand how your agents actually run, even though infrastructure itself belongs to the Cloud Engineers.


Strong Advantage:


Experience designing systems where one agent does something and a different agent checks it — separation of duties built into the architecture, not just documented afterward.
Any exposure to red-teaming or adversarial testing of AI systems, even if it wasn't your main role.
Time spent in a regulated environment (SOX, SOC2, GDPR, ISO27001), where "it works" was never the whole bar.
Some familiarity with how agent memory works — short-term session memory versus something more durable — and what each choice costs you in auditability.

description:

Seth Leis
Seth Leis
We’re Hiring! Let’s connect!

As a Senior AX Developer, you are outgoing, dedicated and responsible. You take the initiative, take ownership of your work, and communicate technical information clearly at every level, from fellow developers to business stakeholders. Your approach is analytical, proactive and pragmatic, and you apply your problem-solving skills in line with ITIL processes.




You have in-depth knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics AX 2009 (ERP) development and customization, and turn it into pragmatic, sustainable, high-quality solutions that meet customer requirements. Just as importantly, you are a technical decision-maker: you set the technical direction for your work, weigh options and risks, and help the team and our customers make the right calls. You also contribute to assessments, estimates and recommendations for prioritizing change requests and defect fixes.




Our everyday work is characterized by an open and honest atmosphere, and we put emphasis on a challenging yet fun working environment. We pay significant attention to job satisfaction and to personal and professional development.




Your responsibilities:




Design and delivery

Translate customer requirements into quality technical designs and solutions.
Implement medium-to-complex maintenance and development tasks, involving other team members as needed.
Develop software according to clean-code principles and industry best practices.
Write and review code, documentation and other project deliverables.
Fix bugs promptly and troubleshoot complex ERP problems through to root cause, including AOS, AIF and database issues.
Plan, package and carry out deployments and releases across development, test and production environments, including rollback planning.
Define development timelines, time estimates and implementation plans.




Technical leadership and decision-making

Own the technical vision for your projects: keep it up to date as requirements change and make sure every team member understands it.
Make and document key technical and architectural decisions and be accountable for their outcome.
Evaluate new tools, technologies and approaches through proof-of-concept prototypes and recommend whether to adopt them.
Review the code and designs of other developers and coach them to grow, including making sure technical decisions are made well at every level of the team.
Identify and communicate technical risk and technical debt and recommend how to mitigate it.




Consulting

Advise stakeholders on the cost, benefit and risk of project and design decisions.
Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including in cross-border and multicultural teams.




Quality and governance

Develop standards, policies, procedures and systems that ensure software development and implementation are consistently high in quality and conform to industry-recognized standards.
Audit projects to ensure adherence to company standards.




Technical decision-making competencies:




As a senior member of the team, we expect you to demonstrate the following:




Architectural judgement: Chooses between configuration and customisation; places changes in the right layer, keeps SYS-layer changes to a minimum, and isolates and documents customisations so solutions stay upgradable and maintainable rather than quick fixes.
Trade-off analysis: Weighs build vs. buy vs. reuse (standard features, ISV solutions), and performance, cost, risk and time-to-deliver, and can explain the reasoning behind the choice.
Decision-making under uncertainty: Decides with incomplete information, validates assumptions with proof-of-concepts, and knows when to escalate or seek a second opinion.
Integration and data design: Selects the right integration pattern (real-time vs. batch; AIF document services, web services, file or message-based; middleware such as BizTalk or Azure Service Bus) with attention to error handling, volumes, security and monitoring.
Performance and quality ownership: Diagnoses complex performance and data issues, sets technical standards, and holds code reviews and quality gates to them, including making the call to refactor, defer or reject.
Risk and technical-debt management: Identifies, quantifies and communicates technical risk and debt to the team and customer, and recommends when to pay it down.
Customer-facing advice: Presents options with cost, benefit and risk in business language, and recommends a course of action the customer can approve with confidence.
Accountability and influence: Owns the outcome of technical decisions, documents them (e.g. decision records), aligns the team behind them, and revisits them openly when facts change.
Mentoring and enabling others: Coaches’ developers so that sound technical decisions are made at every level of the team, not only by the senior.




Technical competencies:




Beyond general development skills, we expect hands-on depth in the following areas of Dynamics AX 2009:




AX development and customization

Customizing and extending AX in MorphX across the application object tree (AOT): tables, forms, classes, queries, views, maps, enums, EDTs, menus, reports and workflows.
Strong X++ development using the standard frameworks (RunBase, batch jobs, number sequences, query framework, SysTableLookup, and the Dialog and Args classes).
Layer-based development (SYS, GLS, VAR, CUS, USR and their patch layers): knowing which layer to customize, how to keep customizations isolated, and how to resolve conflicts using compare tools.
Data import and export, data migration and data cleansing using the standard AX tools, Excel integration and custom X++ or SQL scripts.
Workflow and alerts, and security design with user groups, security keys, configuration keys and record-level security.
Enterprise Portal and role center customization using ASP.NET, C# and Visual Studio.




AOS and environment management

Installing, configuring and troubleshooting Application Object Servers (AOS), including AOS clusters, load balancing, batch server configuration and service accounts.
Monitoring and tuning AOS health: tracing, the Windows event log and performance counters, client/server calls and memory usage, and caching behavior.
Managing the AX client and configuration utility, .NET Business Connector, Enterprise Portal and related components across environments.




AIF and integration

Designing and supporting Application Integration Framework (AIF) integrations: inbound and outbound ports, document services, endpoints, schemas and transformations.
Working with AIF adapters and transport (file system, MSMQ, HTTP/web services via IIS and the BizTalk adapter), and managing the AIF queue, exceptions and error handling.
Consuming and exposing web services, and working with XML, XSD and XSLT.
Using the .NET Business Connector and COM/.NET interop to integrate AX with external applications.




Deployment and release management

Moving customizations between environments using XPO exports and imports and application object (AOD) layer files, with label files and proper object ID/layer handling.
Managing full application compiles, database synchronization and AOS restarts so that deployments are repeatable and low risk.
Applying kernel and application hotfixes, rollups and service packs, and performing code upgrades and data upgrades between AX versions.
Deploying reports, workflows and Enterprise Portal components, with a documented release checklist and a rollback plan.
Version control and work-item tracking: MorphX version control integrated with source control, and Azure DevOps (or equivalent) for builds, work items and release tracking.




Database, performance and reporting

SQL Server: query tuning, indexing, execution plans, locking and blocking analysis, TempDB, and maintenance jobs; experience with Azure-hosted environments is welcome.
Performance diagnosis using the AX code profiler and SQL tracing tools, finding and fixing the root cause.
Report development and deployment with MorphX reports and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).




Minimum requirements

Relevant Bachelor’s degree or higher, or equivalent practical experience, with at least 5 years of software development experience in Microsoft-based ERP, including Dynamics AX 2009.
At least 3 years of hands-on design, development and maintenance using X++ and MorphX, including proven customization of standard AX modules (forms, tables, classes, reports and workflows) in a layered environment.
Hands-on experience with AOS installation, configuration and troubleshooting, and with AIF integrations (ports, services and adapters).
Hands-on experience deploying and releasing AX customizations across environments (XPOs, layer files, compiles, hotfix and rollup application).
Proven experience making or leading technical and design decisions on ERP projects and explaining them to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge and experience in the .NET framework and C#.
Experience in database management and performance tuning with SQL Server, including Azure-hosted environments.
Experience with debugging and troubleshooting complex ERP problems, including performance analysis.
Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable source control and work-item tracking and working knowledge of the ERP development lifecycle: branching, code review and testing practices.
Working knowledge of Agile project management methodologies.
Strong consulting skills: able to advise customers on the cost, benefit and risk of project decisions.
Practical experience with offshoring and cross-border cooperation, including negotiating and resolving issues in a multicultural environment.
Excellent written and spoken English, plus strong communication, documentation and organizational skills.
Strong analytical skills and keen eye for detail; innovative and proactive in solving problems and improving processes and tools.
Self-motivated, responsible and flexible, with a positive work attitude.




Advantages (a plus)

Experience with BizTalk Server integration (orchestrations, adapters, mapping and monitoring), particularly in integrating with Dynamics AX through AIF and the BizTalk adapter.
Experience with AX upgrade or migration projects (for example AX 2009 to AX 2012 or Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations), and familiarity with AX 2012 or Dynamics 365.
Experience with Azure integration services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, Azure Functions, API Management) and with modernizing legacy integrations.
Experience in a technical lead, mentoring or team-lead capacity.
Microsoft Dynamics AX or Azure certification.




Others:

Only those applicants who already have the right to live and work in the Philippines are eligible to apply for this role.




Work Schedule




Employees will be expected to adhere to a flexible hybrid work schedule, with a required presence in the office for 2 day per week, allowing for customization of work hours within a specified morning or mid-shift time frame.




Candidate Experience




At Aeven, we value every job applicant and prioritize our candidate experience. Here is an overview of our standard recruitment process: After application, please expect feedback within 5 working days.




Three interview rounds:




First round: Interview with SMEs and potentially a colleague. Feedback within 1 week.

Second Round: Interview with Hiring Manager. Feedback within 1 week.

Potential Third Round: Interview with Global (Denmark) Manager. Feedback within 1 week.




Successful candidates will receive feedback and job offers directly from Human Resources.




Company Overview




Our business was born at 28 years old. We earned our experience as part of Denmark’s foremost IT infrastructure specialist. Now we’re ready to take the next step with you




Aeven is a new company formed from part of NNIT. That means that even before we opened our doors, we’d clocked up three decades of experience serving critical industries such as life science & healthcare, the public sector, finance, energy & utilities, industrial goods & manufacturing, and retail & consumer goods.




At Aeven, we’re on a quest to keep digital infrastructure critical to the lives of millions, safe, secure, and productive. And to do this, we employ sharp minds, capable hands, and most importantly, positive personalities that are eager to collaborate, contribute, develop their skills, and make a difference.




We’re here to provide digital infrastructure that helps companies and institutions steer a straight course. “With Aeven, wherever you’re going, we’re here – with you all the way. Locally anchored in Denmark but with a global reach, we have three decades of experience helping businesses and institutions on which the health, wealth, and security of millions depends, navigate uncertainty, and thrive”. - Henrik Bodskov, CEO




Read more about AEVEN: www.aevengroup.com




If you possess the requisite qualifications and experience and are eager to embrace this challenge, please submit a personal message outlining your suitability for the position, along with your CV/resume, to our HR Senior Specialist, Seth Leis (SCZL@aevengroup.com), who welcomes any inquiries you may have.
