Role Overview

We are seeking a forward-thinking AI Engineer with hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying intelligent AI agents capable of executing complex, multi-step tasks. This role focuses on developing modern agentic systems that combine large language models (LLMs), specialized agent skills, context management, and workflow orchestration to create reliable, scalable AI-powered solutions.

The ideal candidate understands how to move beyond traditional, step-by-step automation to build adaptive AI systems that can reason through tasks, select and use tools, maintain relevant context, and execute workflows with minimal human intervention. This position requires strong software engineering fundamentals, practical hands-on experience with AI agent architectures, and the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into production-ready applications using technologies such as TypeScript, React, and n8n.




Key Responsibilities

AI Agent Development: Design, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents capable of handling multi-step tasks, making context-aware decisions, using tools, and adapting their execution based on intermediate results.
Agent Skills & Tool Integration: Develop reusable agent skills, tools, and capabilities that enable agents to perform specialized tasks, interact with external systems, and execute complex workflows efficiently.
Context & Memory Management: Implement effective context engineering strategies, including context retrieval, memory management, conversation state, relevant information injection, and context-window optimization to improve agent performance and reliability.
Agent Orchestration: Build systems that coordinate multiple tools, workflows, and agent capabilities while managing task decomposition, execution sequences, dependencies, error handling, and escalation when necessary.
AI Workflow Automation: Use n8n and other appropriate technologies to design, connect, and optimize automation workflows that integrate AI models, APIs, business logic, and external applications.
Full-Stack Development: Use TypeScript and React to develop and integrate AI-powered features into software applications, building reliable interfaces and backend integrations that support agent execution.
LLM & API Integration: Integrate leading large language models and third-party APIs, selecting appropriate models and implementation approaches based on task complexity, performance, reliability, and cost.
Evaluation & Optimization: Test and evaluate agent behavior using representative tasks, structured test cases, and measurable performance criteria. Identify failure patterns and continuously improve accuracy, consistency, latency, and execution quality.
Production Deployment & Monitoring: Deploy AI solutions into production environments, monitor their behavior, troubleshoot failures, and implement safeguards to maintain dependable operation.
Version Control & Collaboration: Use GitHub and established software development practices to maintain code quality, manage changes, document implementations, and collaborate effectively with the engineering team.
Continuous Improvement: Stay current with evolving agent frameworks, model capabilities, tool-calling patterns, and context engineering techniques, applying relevant advancements to improve existing solutions.




Requirements & Qualifications

Professional Experience: 3–5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development of AI-powered applications or intelligent automation systems.
AI Agent Engineering: Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents beyond basic chatbot implementations or purely linear, rule-based automation workflows, and ability to articulate and walk clients and users through the ai agent development process.
Agent Skills & Tool Use: Practical understanding of how to define, implement, and reuse agent skills, tool integrations, and specialized capabilities to support complex task execution.
Context Engineering: Experience managing context, memory, state, and information retrieval to help agents maintain relevant information and perform reliably across multi-step tasks.
LLM Integration: Experience working with large language models, API integrations, structured outputs, tool calling, and prompt design in real-world applications.
Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript and solid experience with React. Ability to write maintainable code, debug complex issues, and integrate AI capabilities into production software.
Workflow Automation: Hands-on experience with n8n or comparable workflow automation and orchestration platforms.
Agent Architecture: Understanding of modern agentic design patterns, including task planning, tool selection, execution loops, state management, error recovery, and human-in-the-loop controls where appropriate.
Software Engineering Practices: Familiarity with Git, GitHub, API design, testing, debugging, and collaborative development workflows.
Production Readiness: Ability to take an AI solution from concept and prototyping through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate different technical approaches, make sound implementation decisions, and balance development speed with maintainability and reliability.
Ownership & Autonomy: Self-directed and comfortable working in a remote environment, managing priorities, and delivering technical projects with limited supervision.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AI agent frameworks, SDKs, or orchestration libraries such as LangGraph, LangChain, or comparable technologies.
Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and integrating agents with external tools and services.
Experience with Python or other programming languages commonly used in AI and backend development.
Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval.
Experience implementing agent evaluation frameworks, observability, tracing, guardrails, and automated testing for AI systems.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.
Understanding of MLOps, CI/CD, application security, and scalable deployment practices for AI-powered applications.

Performance-based scheduled rate increases.
Minimum 5 paid days off annually, plus holidays, subject to applicable contract terms.
Annual cost-of-living adjustments at the one-year anniversary, subject to contract terms.

description:
About Workstreet

At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.

Get to know the Security Services Team

We are the team that turns complex security requirements and compliance frameworks into infrastructure and services that actually work. Moving fast and taking true end-to-end ownership, our team spans three core functions: Cloud Security Engineering, where we design hardened AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, write Terraform baselines, and fix failing controls to meet frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, and FedRAMP; Penetration Testing, where we run disciplined offensive assessments across networks, apps, cloud, and AI/LLM systems to catch vulnerabilities before adversaries do; and Vulnerability Management, where we continuously prioritize, patch, and validate risk reduction across the client footprint. We do not hide behind process or just point out gaps. We step in, build solutions, and deliver real security posture improvements with minimal disruption.

What makes this team special isn't just our technical depth; it is how we back each other up. Our strongest engineers and assessors are the ones building reusable modules, writing custom tools, jumping into channels to unblock teammates, and mentoring without being asked. From early-stage startups to regulated enterprises, you will work directly with clients, take on real ownership early, and be surrounded by people who want to see you get good. If you enjoy solving tough security problems and want to be part of a team that is scrappy enough to move fast but seasoned enough to get it right, you will be in good company here.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Penetration Tester to join our growing cybersecurity team. In this role, you will assess the security of applications, networks, and systems through structured penetration testing and vulnerability assessments. You will help identify weaknesses, document findings, and provide actionable recommendations to strengthen clients’ security defenses.

What You'll Do


Execute comprehensive penetration tests across web, mobile, network, and system environments to uncover, exploit, and validate critical infrastructure and application vulnerabilities.
Produce high-fidelity technical reports mapping out exploit impact and proof-of-concept chains, translating complex risk metrics into actionable remediation roadmaps for clients.
Partner directly with client engineering teams to guide post-assessment remediation, troubleshoot implementation blocks, and systematically verify the integrity of deployed fixes.
Engineer custom testing scripts, automation tools, and offensive methodologies to continuously expand vulnerability discovery coverage and testing precision.
Deploy tactical social engineering simulations, including targeted phishing and pretexting campaigns, to rigorously audit human security awareness and organizational defenses.
Support active incident response loops by providing offensive technical expertise, investigating compromise vectors, and accelerating threat containment pipelines.
Own the supporting client experience by maintaining transparent communications, gathering environmental prerequisites, and breaking down testing footprints into clear, business-friendly milestones.
Track the evolving threat landscape to continuously integrate cutting-edge exploit techniques, active vector changes, and defensive counter-measures into live assessment playbooks.


Who You Are


Active offensive security operator - Command a proven history of executing structured penetration tests, vector mapping, and threat validation across complex application, network, and system environments.
Master of offensive frameworks - Deployed industry-standard testing platforms, exploitation architectures, and reporting frameworks to uncover hidden systemic security vulnerabilities.
Surgical exploit and validation engineer - Exploited, classified, and cataloged multi-tier security vulnerabilities, providing clear remediation roadmaps to client engineering teams to securely validate system fixes.
Precision technical author - Formulated high-fidelity assessment documentation, exploit chain proofs, and detailed impact reports that translate complex threat data into highly structured, actionable guidance.
High-impact security diplomat - Articulated tactical risk scenarios, testing footprints, and remediation expectations with professional clarity to both deep technical infrastructure teams and executive client stakeholders.
Social engineering and automation developer - Engineered custom testing scripts, targeted phishing simulations, and pretexting campaigns to audit human security awareness and expand overall assessment coverage.
Autonomous remote operator - Command an advanced local testing station fully optimized for heavy virtual machine deployment, maintaining peak operational velocity during standard US Eastern Time working hours.
Validated offensive security specialist - Hold or actively pursue high-value technical designations such as OSCP, CEH, or equivalent credentials that demonstrate a rigorous commitment to offensive security practices.


What Help You Succeed


Advanced cloud security auditing - Direct execution of cloud infrastructure penetration tests, container security evaluations, and environment configuration audits within AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Integration of GRC compliance frameworks - Practical alignment of technical vulnerability data to satisfy the automated audit and evidence requirements of SOC 2, GDPR, or HIPAA.
Commercial tenure in high-velocity startups - Years spent scaling offensive security workflows, handling rapid client delivery timelines, and adapting to shifting priorities within fast-growth tech environments.
Incident containment and threat training - Direct support of active incident response containment loops, or the design and execution of technical employee threat awareness initiatives.


What We Offer


Career Development: Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities.
Role-Related Training: Reimbursement for the successful completion of approved training and certification courses relevant to your current role.
Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit-based appraisals and bonus opportunities.
Growth Opportunity: Early-stage company with significant room for career advancement.
Remote-First Culture: Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.


What You'll Need To Thrive


Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with candidates, hiring managers, and business leaders across global teams.
A reliable, high-speed internet connection and a professional home office environment that supports confidential conversations, virtual interviews, and uninterrupted collaboration.
Commitment to working a standard schedule of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET) to effectively collaborate with team members, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners while ensuring timely communication and support.
Willingness and ability to travel locally for occasional onsite meetings, team gatherings, or business activities as needed.


Hiring and Selection Process


Candidates must participate in live video interviews throughout the hiring process with camera on (non-negotiable) and be prepared to verify their identity during recruitment and onboarding.
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of identity verification and background screening, where permitted by law.
Selected candidates will participate in structured interviews with hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to assess role fit, experience, and alignment with Workstreet’s operating principles.
Candidates will receive prompt updates and consistent communication throughout the interview process, ensuring a transparent, smooth, and engaging experience at every step.

• Develop and implement data quality validation frameworks, reconciliation processes, and exception handling mechanisms to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness of enterprise data.

• Design and implement batch and real-time data ingestion solutions using event-driven and streaming architectures where required by business use cases.

Performance Optimization and Tuning

title: Data Engineer
source_title: Data Engineer at Digital Room — Mandaluyong, National Capital Region, Philippines | LinkedIn Jobs
description:
Position Summary

The Data Engineer 2 builds and operates the pipelines and datasets that the business runs on. This is a hands-on delivery role: the engineer owns pipelines end to end (ingestion, transformation, publishing, monitoring, and support) and is expected to contribute to design decisions above the level of an individual job, particularly in orchestration, data lineage, and how curated data is modeled and exposed to downstream consumers.

Beyond conventional ETL, this role builds the curated, well-described datasets that analytics tools and AI systems consume. A successful candidate can explain not only how to move data, but why a given storage format, partition layout, or table design is the right one, and what breaks downstream when it is wrong.




Responsibilities




Hands-on AWS data services: S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift, plus at least one of DMS, Kinesis, EMR, Step Functions, or Athena.
Build and maintain batch, incremental, and near-real-time pipelines that extract from transactional databases, SaaS and internal APIs, file feeds, and event streams, and load to databases, data lakes, and data warehouses.
Implement change data capture (CDC) on high-volume source tables, handling schema drift, late-arriving and out-of-order records, soft deletes, and replays.
Write idempotent, restartable jobs: re-running a pipeline for a given partition or window produces the same result without duplicating or losing rows.
Apply the correct load pattern for the volume and business need, whether full refresh, watermark-based incremental, merge/upsert, or slowly changing dimension (Type 1 and Type 2), and justify the choice.
Write and tune complex SQL: window functions, multi-CTE transformations, set operations. Read the query plan and address the actual cause of slowness (scan volume, distribution skew, spill to disk, poor join order) rather than adding hardware.
Apply business rules and integration logic in a testable, documented layer rather than embedded in ad-hoc scripts.
Designing the orchestration layer, task dependencies, and observability. Responsibilities include implementing backfill mechanisms, managing failure strategies, and creating thorough documentation.
Modeling data for consumption with clear definitions of grain, keys, and measures, alongside an understanding of columnar storage mechanics like Parquet and ORC. Responsibilities include applying physical design principles for columnar warehouses, managing file layouts in object storage, and working with non-transactional stores while evaluating and defending the appropriate storage solution for various workloads.
Designing automated lineage capture at table and column levels, ensuring that documentation stays current with orchestration and transformation changes. Responsibilities include maintaining dataset catalogs with essential details, performing impact analysis before schema changes, and implementing data quality gates to prevent erroneous data from being published. Additionally, focuses on supporting auditability and reproducibility while applying least-privilege access and data retention rules.
Thorough testing before code promotion, including unit tests and validation against source counts, along with ensuring the target environment is ready for initial data loads. Providing production support for pipelines, managing failures with a focus on root causes, participating in an on-call rotation for incidents, and working within a Git-based workflow with peer reviews. Additionally, comprehensive documentation is essential to ensure that datasets and pipelines can be operated by others without assistance.
Translating business questions from various stakeholders into clear data requirements while suggesting alternative solutions when appropriate. Responsibilities include participating in design and code reviews to address concerns regarding maintainability, cost, and data accuracy, as well as mentoring Level 1 engineers in SQL, pipeline patterns, and debugging techniques.
Provide production support for the pipelines you own: triage and root-cause failures, communicate impact and ETA to affected consumers, then eliminate the class of failure rather than only the instance.




Required Qualifications




Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
At least 3 years building and operating production data pipelines (not solely analytics or reporting work).
Strong Python at production quality: modular code, error handling, logging, configuration, and tests, well beyond one-off scripts.
Advanced SQL, including window functions, multi-step CTE transformations, and set operations; able to read an execution plan and explain why a query is slow and what to change.
Hands-on AWS data services: S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift, plus at least one of DMS, Kinesis, EMR, Step Functions, or Athena.
Demonstrable understanding of columnar storage and columnar analytical databases: file formats, encoding and compression, partitioning and pruning, and their effect on query cost.
Experience loading and querying non-transactional stores, including a data lake on object storage; able to explain how lake and warehouse workloads differ.
Production experience with at least one orchestration framework, and the ability to reason about workflow design, dependencies, idempotency, retries, and backfills rather than only clicking through a UI.
Data modeling ability: dimensional and/or wide-table designs, grain and key definition, and slowly changing dimensions.
Data quality as routine practice: automated tests and reconciliation as part of delivery, not an afterthought.
Experience with Git branching, pull requests, and CI-based deployment.
Clear written and verbal communication. Able to document a dataset so that someone who did not build it can use it correctly, and able to explain a data issue to a non-technical stakeholder.
Ability to analyze broad, ambiguous data needs and decompose them into deliverable work.




Preferred Qualifications




Open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Hudi) and lakehouse architecture in production.
A transformation framework with built-in testing, documentation, and lineage, such as dbt.
Asset-based or flow-based orchestration (Dagster, Prefect) in addition to AWS-native workflow services.
Lineage and catalog tooling: AWS Glue Data Catalog, OpenLineage/Marquez, DataHub, OpenMetadata, Amundsen, Collibra, or Alation.
Streaming and CDC at scale: Kinesis, Kafka/MSK, Debezium, or equivalent, including exactly-once and ordering concerns.
Distributed query and processing engine tuning: Spark, Trino, or Athena.
Exposure to serving data to LLMs or AI agents, such as MCP servers, semantic layers, text-to-SQL, or retrieval and vector stores, plus awareness of the failure modes (ambiguous columns, unbounded scans, leaked sensitive fields, stale context).
Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK) and containerized workloads.
Cost awareness and optimization: attributing and reducing storage, scan, and compute cost.
Familiarity with the downstream BI layer and how modeling decisions constrain it.
Domain exposure to e-commerce, print or custom manufacturing, or high-volume order data: orders, SKUs and product configuration, pricing, fulfillment, and marketing attribution.

description:
Integration Developer work at J4RVIS means you’re not waiting for an architect to hand you a design. You’ll shape the solution, make the technical calls and own the outcome across complex enterprise environments. We’re looking for a .NET Integration Developer with strong C# and .NET experience who has delivered real system-to-system integrations and can point to their impact. You’ll build APIs, Azure Functions, and event-driven services that are reliable, scalable, and built for production. You’ll work closely with clients, architects, and engineers across Australia and the Philippines, so strong communication, proactivity, and the right attitude matter. If you’re ready to move beyond execution and take real ownership, this is the role.

About J4RVIS

J4RVIS brings humans and technology together - for businesses built on relationships. We're a consulting business at our core, guiding enterprises through transformation by listening first, then building technology that makes people more capable, not redundant.

Since launching in 2020, we've grown to a team of 110+ people across Australia and the Philippines. We hold Salesforce Summit Partner status alongside partnerships with Anthropic, ElevenLabs, Snowflake, and AWS - spanning business systems, data and integration, conversational AI, and agentic automation. We've been recognised as a Deloitte Fast 50 “Rising Star”, CRN Fast 50, and Great Place to Work in both countries. But the awards describe where we've been, not where we're going.

We go deep in the industries we serve: media, financial services, energy and utilities, because domain expertise is what makes the technology work. We measure success by three business outcomes: customer experience transformation, operational efficiency, and revenue generation. Not hours billed.

AI is central to what we do. We deploy Agentforce at scale, build conversational AI, and develop intelligent automation already running in production. Every team is augmented by AI, and every consultant is developing toward advisory, not just delivery.

We're on a growth spurt to further scale with an APAC expansion underway and a strategy that's locked in. If you want to be part of a firm that's building something that endures, where the culture is real and the ambition is high then this is an exciting time to join.

We're still early in our journey, and that's what makes this an exciting time to join.

Why This Role Exists

Our Data & Integration practice builds the layer that connects enterprise systems and makes data usable. Most of that work runs on MuleSoft today. Clients are increasingly asking us to build and integrate custom services on the Microsoft stack, and this role exists to meet that demand.

You will build .NET services that move data between systems: Web APIs, Azure Functions, and event-driven components that have to be correct under load and easy to operate at 2am. This is backend integration engineering. It is not front-end or full-stack product work, and the APIs you build are consumed by other systems rather than by a user interface.

You will work in a nearshore delivery team alongside architects and engineers in Australia and the Philippines, under one set of standards and one governance framework. The Philippines team is not a support function here. It delivers across every service line we run

What You'll Be Doing


Build and maintain .NET Web APIs that integrate enterprise systems, including contract design, versioning, and error handling.
Design and implement event-driven services on Azure Service Bus or a comparable broker: queues, topics, subscriptions, dead-letter handling, and retry strategy.
Develop, deploy, and tune Azure Functions for event-triggered and scheduled processing.
Turn integration requirements into technical designs, covering interface contracts, sequencing, failure modes, and non-functional requirements.
Write unit tests in xUnit to an agreed coverage level, and integration tests where the risk warrants them.
Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines for build, test, and deployment across environments.
Support system testing, user acceptance testing, deployment, and the hypercare period after go-live.
Contribute to estimates, statements of work, and technical documentation.
Review your teammates' code and hold the team to a consistent standard.


What We're Looking For

At least 4-5 minimum years or more building production software in C# and .NET. We care much more about depth in the essentials below than about a long list of platforms.

Essential


C#: strong working command of the language, including async and await, LINQ, dependency injection, and the task-based patterns that integration code lives on.
.NET Web APIs on .NET 8 or later: REST, JSON, versioning, and API security using OAuth 2.0, JWT, and TLS. You can explain the choices you made, not only the code you wrote.


Strongly Preferred


Azure Functions on .NET 8 or later, isolated worker model, with a working understanding of triggers, bindings, hosting plans, and cold start behaviour.
Message brokers in production, ideally Azure Service Bus. Solid Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Amazon SQS and SNS experience transfers if you can talk through the trade-offs.
Event-driven architecture in practice: idempotency, message ordering, at-least-once delivery, poison messages,and eventual consistency. We are looking for people who have handled these problems in production.
System-to-system integration: connecting CRM, ERP, finance, or line-of-business platforms, rather than building APIs to serve a front end.


Nice-to-have


xUnit, with mocking and a genuine testing habit.
Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, or equivalent CI and CD on GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
Git branching and pull request discipline.
Agile delivery, and comfort working directly with client teams.
Azure certification such as AZ-204 or AZ-305.
Exposure to MuleSoft, Salesforce, or Snowflake, given the environments our clients run.


Why Join J4RVIS

Do meaningful work: help shape real transformation for ambitious organisations

Accelerate your growth: work alongside senior operators and ecosystem leaders

Own your impact: high-trust environment with real autonomy

Be part of something early: join a Summit Partner still in high-growth mode

Healthcare Benefit (Includes 2 Dependents)

Work with Salesforce, MuleSoft, AI, and Data experts
Clear career growth opportunities within a rapidly transforming AI native consultancy

About The Job

The FactSet Engineering team is composed of highly talented and motivated individuals primarily selected from top-tier technical programs around the world. We believe this approach fosters the continual introduction of new technologies and ideas, which has been critical to our success. Our engineers believe that a key to their, and FactSet's, success is creating a loose team environment in which everyone can contribute individually, yet at the same time cultivate a community where engineers can depend on each other for help, learning, and development.

The Software Engineering group is focused on creating and maintaining financial applications and database systems as well as building the backend support that allows our systems to run effectively. As part of the team, you will work closely with other departments within the company to ensure that FactSet's products and technologies are responsive to the changing needs of the investment community.

Symbology Direct Feeds – Group Description

Symbology Direct Feeds maintains update systems for various content sets at FactSet. The team processes feed files that are translated into symbols used to gather information such as corporate actions, listing availability, and name changes. The primary areas of focus include products such as FactSet ID, Fixed Income, Options, and Futures. Data produced by the team is consumed across different FactSet applications including Workstation, FactSet Web, and Excel via APIs. The team also develops and maintains Symbology Editors that internal teams use to view and manage data through a comprehensive GUI.

As the financial technology landscape continues to evolve rapidly — particularly with the growing influence of AI-driven workflows and tooling — our team is equally committed to staying ahead of these changes. We are looking for engineers who are not only strong in our core technical stack but are also curious, adaptable, and eager to explore and integrate emerging technologies into our day-to-day engineering practices.

Role Overview

FactSet is searching for Software Engineers with strong programming skills and a solid understanding of object-oriented concepts. The engineer will focus on creating and maintaining efficient data update processes in the form of ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines, as well as producing timely reports reflecting data changes from update processes. They will collaborate with various stakeholders — including product developers, internal teams, and clients — to deliver accurate, transformed data loaded from data feed acquisitions. Responsibilities also include developing web tools that uphold the integrity of the data we manage. Candidates will work alongside other Symbology teams based in the US and London on product integration and enhancements.

Work Schedule & On-Call Responsibilities

Given the global nature of our operations, this role requires a degree of schedule flexibility to ensure effective collaboration with our counterparts in the US and London. The following working arrangements apply:


Shift Hours: The engineer will be required to start their shift between 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM Philippine Standard Time (PST). This shift structure is designed to create meaningful overlap with our teams abroad and ensure continuity of communication and collaboration across time zones.
Work Arrangement: This role follows a Hybrid setup, requiring engineers to be onsite at the Manila office 2 days per week, with the remaining 3 days worked remotely.
Specific onsite days will be coordinated with the team and may be adjusted based on business needs, sprint ceremonies, or key project milestones.
Candidates must have a reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment for their work-from-home days to ensure uninterrupted productivity and availability during on-call rotations.
On-Call Coverage: The engineer will participate in an on-call rotation on a daily basis, covering Manila business hours from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM PHT. During on-call shifts, the engineer is expected to monitor systems, respond to alerts, and triage any data or pipeline issues that may arise in a timely manner.


Candidates who are comfortable working in a globally distributed team environment and can manage their time effectively across overlapping time zones will thrive in this role.

Core Job Requirements


Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
3–5 years of industry experience (for experienced hires)
Advanced proficiency in Perl and Python — these are the primary languages used by the team and are considered non-negotiable requirements
Strong working knowledge of SQL Server for database design, querying, and performance optimization
Solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns
Experience leading or contributing to large-scale projects and products
Proven ability to work effectively in an Agile environment
Strong communication skills — written and verbal
A collaborative team-player mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving
Comfortable with on-call responsibilities and able to respond promptly and calmly under pressure during system incidents or data anomalies


Nice-to-Have Skills & Emerging Technology Competencies

We recognize that the technology landscape is shifting quickly, especially with the rise of AI-assisted development and cloud-native architectures. While not required, the following competencies are highly desirable and will set strong candidates apart:


Web Development
Experience building or consuming REST APIs (e.g., Flask, FastAPI, or similar frameworks)
Frontend development experience (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js) is a welcomed bonus, particularly for candidates interested in contributing to our internal GUI tools
Cybersecurity Awareness
Familiarity with secure coding practices and principles (e.g., OWASP guidelines)
Understanding of data security, access control, and compliance considerations within financial data environments
Experience with vulnerability scanning tools or security-aware CI/CD pipelines
AWS Cloud Services
Hands-on experience with AWS products such as Lambda, S3, RDS, EC2, or similar services
Familiarity with cloud-native development patterns and infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform)
AI-Assisted Development & Tooling
Demonstrated experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI code completion tools to improve development efficiency
Practical experience using Anthropic Claude or similar large language model (LLM) tools for tasks such as code review, documentation, data analysis, or rapid prototyping
General comfort working in AI-augmented workflows — we expect this to become an increasingly important part of how our team operates, and we value engineers who embrace this shift thoughtfully and responsibly

Why Join Us

FactSet continues to invest in its people and technology. Joining the Symbology Direct Feeds team means you will be working on data that powers real financial decisions across the globe, while being given the opportunity to grow your skill set in a rapidly evolving technical environment. Whether your strengths lie in building robust data pipelines, designing secure APIs, or leveraging AI tools to work smarter — there is a place for you here.

FactSet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment.

Company Overview

FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

description:
Direct message the job poster from Maya

Michelle G.
Michelle G.
Keep shining. Join us today!



CORE PROFILE




We are looking for a Level 4 Software Engineer for Partner Marketing Solutions (PMS), which builds mobile client experiences and SDK components for partner advertising, campaigns, inventory, audience tags, and ad delivery across Maya apps.




At Level 4, you independently lead entire projects—not only implementation but also technical direction, cross-team coordination, and delivery accountability. You navigate dependencies across PMS squads, BFF/data platforms, and ad-network integrations, and collaborate with Product, QE, SRE, and peer engineering teams.




You bring deep expertise in Flutter on Android and iOS, complemented by native mobile development on at least one platform (Android or iOS), applied to solutioning, design, architecture, and code review.










NATURE OF WORK




In this role, you will:




Lead mobile delivery end to end — Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, release, and production support; own solutioning, architecture, and code review for Flutter and native features in partner marketing and ad surfaces.
Build with Flutter & native platforms — Ship Flutter on Android/iOS (widgets, state management, platform channels, plugins, SDK integrations) and native Android or iOS where depth is required (expert proficiency in either platform).
Integrate product & ad requirements — Partner with Product to refine stories and estimates; implement campaign, inventory, targeting, and ad-format needs with Google Mobile Ads / Google Ad Manager and internal BFF/services.
Quality, delivery & cross-team design — Code reviews, SOLID/clean architecture, unit and automated tests, static analysis, and security tooling; coordinate with Experience/Core Platform, Consumer/Business apps, and data platforms; CI/CD and store releases (Play Store, App Store, TestFlight) with SRE support.
Modernize & mentor — Refactor complex codebases, SDK release governance, multi-platform parity, and
continuous improvement of Flutter/native practices and test coverage.







DISPLAYED SKILL MASTERY




Mobile engineering (Flutter & native) — Dart/Flutter (BLoC/Cubit, MVVM/MVP/Clean Architecture,
MethodChannel); expert Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift); mobile CI/CD with unit/UI tests, static analysis, coverage, and security testing.
Design & architecture — Independent architectural decisions; UML or written design when needed; balances product, performance, privacy, and compliance for audience/user-tag data.
Project leadership — Leads whole projects, sequences cross-team dependencies, and delivers outcomes beyond individual coding tasks.
Code review, ownership & collaboration — TDD-minded, constructive reviews, store-ready releases; clear communication with Product, UX, backend, and mesh partners; mentors peers.
Nice to have — Add-to-app Flutter, custom plugins, Fastlane/GitLab CI/CD, Firebase, Google Mobile Ads/ad-tech, REST/BFF integrations; fluency with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, OpenAI) is a plus.







REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS




Experience & Education — 8+ years professional software engineering with strong mobile focus; Bachelor's in CS, IT, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
Flutter Expertise — 4+ years production Flutter; strong Dart (async/await, streams, isolates), plugins, and MethodChannel/platform integration.
Native platform expertise — Expert-level native Android or native iOS (one required at expert depth; working knowledge of both for cross-platform shipping).
Architecture & fundamentals — SOLID, OOP, MVVM/MVP/Clean Architecture, reactive patterns as applicable, TDD, and UML documentation.
Languages — Strong Dart plus Kotlin, Java, Swift, or equivalent type-safe mobile languages.
Quality & ways of working — Unit/mobile automated testing; app distribution (Google Play, App Store, TestFlight, Firebase Distribution); Agile/Scrum and Git.
CI/CD — Mobile CI/CD (e.g., GitLab CI/CD, Fastlane), static analysis, and security testing in the delivery path.
Domain & nice to have — Advertising/ad monetization familiarity, Google Mobile Ads, backend or API integration experience; fluency with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, OpenAI) is a plus.

title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
source_title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity) at AIOS — Philippines | LinkedIn Jobs
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:


The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.
The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.


Our master plan:


Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.
Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.
Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.
Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.
Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.


In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.


Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.
High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.
Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.
Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.
Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.
AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.
Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.
Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.


Need to have


Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.
User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.
Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.
Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.
AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.
Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.
Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.
Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.


Nice to have


CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.
Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.
Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.
Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.
Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.
Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.
SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.


Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:


Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.
Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.
Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.
If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.
Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.
A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.
Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.
Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.
Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.
The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.


Compensation: $75k-$150k/yr including equity


Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.


Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).
Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.
Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.
Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.
GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.
Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.
Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.
Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.
What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.


How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:


your resume and portfolio
2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion
a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

About Us

Chevron is a leading multinational energy company with operations in over 180 countries. Founded in 1879, Chevron has a rich history of innovation and growth, making significant contributions to the global energy landscape.

Chevron markets Caltex® fuels, lubricants and other petroleum products in the Philippines. Our network of service stations, terminals and sales offices forms the backbone of our presence in the Philippines.

In March 2020, Chevron sold its 45% non-operated interest in the Malampaya natural gas field. This was the first natural gas development and largest industrial project in the Philippines.

From the Philippines, we provide operational support for Chevron offices on five continents. The workforce supplies transactional, processing and consulting services in areas ranging from finance to information technology.

Chevron operates through two subsidiaries in the Philippines. Our Downstream company is Chevron Philippines Inc. We also operate a business processes support organization through Chevron Holdings Inc.

There are two Chevron companies operating in the Philippines: Chevron Holdings Incorporated (CHI) and Chevron Philippines Incorporated (CPI).

CHI is a shared services center providing transactional, processing, and consulting services in the areas of finance and accounting, information technology, supply chain management, human resources, downstream customer service and marketing. Established in 1998, CHI serves Chevron affiliates in six continents around the world. Over the years, it has grown to be one of the leading members of the shared services industry in the Philippines.

CHI has received various recognitions as a top employer: the 2022 Diversity Company of the Year; 2021 Asia’s Best Employer Brand Award; 2021 Global Best Employer Brand Award; 2020 HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia; 2019 Circle of Excellence, Top Employer Category at Asia CEO Awards, and the 2018 Wellness Company of the Year at the same Asia CEO Awards.

At Chevron, we believe humanity can solve any challenge – including meeting the world’s energy needs of today, while advancing a cleaner energy tomorrow.

Use broad full-stack knowledge and experience for proactive incident prevention by baselining against expected service performance, process improvement from application of lessons learned, and utilization of data analytics to proactively identify problem areas and operational gaps.

Measure and optimize system performance, continuously seeking innovation and improvement to meet customer needs. Align, collaborate, and build relationships with peers, company leadership, subject matter experts and users to improve knowledge of end-to-end DevOps / Site Reliability Engineering best practices.

Knowledge, Skills, And Experience


Hands-on experience as an IT professional with Computer Science/ Management Information Systems (MIS) degree or related field equivalent experience.
Demonstrated experience in on-prem and cloud architecture, Azure cloud, Windows and Linux OS, performance monitoring & management, troubleshooting (application and database), change management, API integration, and process automation.
Analytical, troubleshooting, RCA (Root Cause Analysis) or postmortem skillset; knowledgeable with ITSM processes, especially Incident Management.
Strong facilitation skills and ability to summarize complex information into succinct messages for non-technical audiences, remaining calm under pressure.
Knowledge or experience with KQL, CI/CD pipeline with Ansible, PowerShell, and Shell scripting.
Knowledge in Agile (SAFe) PI Planning, value stream mapping, scrum ceremonies.


Preferred Qualifications


T-shaped/full stack infrastructure & software engineering skills to deliver end-to-end solution via best practices and team collaboration.
Communication and Teamwork - Ability to communicate in a clear and concise manner, consider the views and concerns of others, achieve objectives through teamwork, and deliver consistently on commitments.
Critical and Analytical Thinking skills - Ability to lead technical discussions, including Major Incident and problem resolution calls. Solve problems of a complex nature. Leverage knowledge and best practices of Site Reliability Engineering such as SLO, SLI, and SLA definitions, eliminating toil via automation, error budgets, emergency response (triage, postmortem, retrospective), demand forecast and cost-effective capacity planning to inspire others in supporting Chevron’s Agile/DevOps transformation.
Preferred training/certifications: Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400), Network (CCNA, JNCIA), Security (PCNSA, CISSP), Linux/Unix Administration.

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical issues to various stakeholders, from junior engineers to business teams.
A proven ability to take ownership of critical issues, manage incidents, and see problems through to resolution, including performing thorough root cause analyses.
A collaborative and proactive approach: Comfortable working cross-functionally to solve problems, improve processes, and share knowledge.

Build what matters. Grow where it counts.

At AMCS, sustainability means business — and careers that create impact. From our roots in Ireland to our teams across Europe, North America and Australasia, we are bringing together ambitious people to help reshape the industries that sustain our world.

Why Join AMCS

Join AMCS and be part of a global team where purpose meets performance. Here, you can grow your career, challenge what’s possible and work on technology that makes a measurable difference — for our customers, our communities and the planet.

Data Engineer

Location: Cebu — onsite or hybrid

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Data Engineer to join our analytics team. We're building a Unified data platform that brings together data from our core business systems — CRM, ERP, and internal engineering tools — into a governed, layered data lake. This is an opportunity to contribute to the design and build out of our Data platform using the latest technology advancements and methodologies.

What You'll Work On


Design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines ELT processes using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Streaming Solutions, and other Azure services.
Build and maintain a layered transformation project — raw data through cleaned staging models into a dimensional model — following standard dimensional modelling practices, including history-tracking techniques applied selectively where business need calls for it.
Migrate a set of legacy reports' existing transformation logic into the new framework, validating each against current output before cutover.
Build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that land raw data from our business systems into the data lake — extraction logic, incremental/CDC handling, schema drift, and retries — using either managed connectors or custom code.
Build and maintain orchestration workflows that sequence data extraction from multiple business systems through cleaning and modelling layers.
Work within our Azure DevOps CI/CD setup: repositories, branch policies, pipelines, and environment promotion.
Partner with the BI/analytics team on how curated data feeds dashboards and reports, and help track which reports depend on which models.
Apply data quality tests and keep model documentation and grain definitions current.
Watch for performance issues on the underlying platform and flag them early.


What We're Looking For

Must-have


5+ years hands-on experience with a SQL-based transformation framework (e.g. dbt or similar) building layered models (staging → marts).
Strong SQL — comfortable with CTEs, window functions, and dimensional modeling patterns (facts, dimensions, surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions).
Experience building data ingestion/extraction pipelines from APIs or databases (custom code, managed connectors, or CDC tooling).
Experience with a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse platform like Databricks, Microsoft Fabric.
Experience with a workflow orchestration tool.
Comfortable working in a Git-based CI/CD workflow.
Understanding of layered/medallion data architecture and why cleaning logic belongs in one shared layer, not duplicated per downstream consumer.


Nice-to-have


Experience with a BI/visualization tool from the data-provider side.
Exposure to CRM or ERP systems as data sources.
Python, for orchestration/ingestion code beyond SQL.
Experience migrating legacy ETL (stored procedures, scripts, or manual processes) into a modern transformation framework.

Career development and learning opportunities
Global collaboration and exposure

The opportunity to help build a more sustainable future

Job Description


The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.

The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.

This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.

Core areas of impact include:

Workload Development: Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
Quality Evaluation: Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
Knowledge Curation: Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
Operational Support: Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
Production Readiness: Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

Limitless Growth & Learning: We believe in continuous development. Whether through rotational programs or high-impact projects, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise and grow your career.
A Place for Everyone: Our commitment to inclusion ensures that all employee’s unique strengths and perspectives are valued. Your voice matters, your growth is prioritized, and your success is celebrated.


Role Overview

The Analyst II | Application and Product Security is responsible for conducting security pen testing, monitoring, and auditing within a dynamic global organization. The products under test will have the coverage of embedded devices and cloud services. The Senior Pen Tester should have exposure to embedded devices as well as cloud services (AWS/Azure). Some of the products will be white box tests while others will be total black box engagements. A successful Senior Pen Tester will be able to take the product and evaluate the weak points in the design and implementation and focus in on those weaknesses to find security gaps. All the findings by the Senior Pen Tester will need to be clearly documented and relayed to the design team for mitigation. The Senior Pen Tester will need to be very versatile in their attack vectors and their knowledge of exploits. The ideal candidate will be well experienced in a broad range of attack vectors across a wide spectrum of devices from small, embedded devices to wide and complex cloud ecosystems.

They will be responsible for interfacing with engineering teams to conduct security testing, auditing and should be able to explain the findings. They will be responsible for ensuring that engineering teams stay in compliance with the security expectations of the global organization. The Senior Pen Tester will be expected to stay current with the latest security threats and attack vectors that can be deployed against the product portfolio. They should also have experience in communicating clearly and concisely the findings of these activities to an audience.

The testing activity and methodology deployed to confirm compliance is guided but expected to be enhanced by the Senior Pen Tester. The Senior Pen Tester will be expected to use their knowledge and experience to further develop internal testing processes and procedures.

Job Responsibilities

In addition to performing internal application and product security assessments the Analyst II | Application and Product Security will be expected to support response to possible breaches of security based on newly disclosed information. Other key duties include:


Conduct security evaluation and threat assessments of embedded systems, mobile applications, web applications
Conduct research for the purposes of finding new vulnerabilities and enhancing existing capabilities
Circumventing security protection methods and techniques
Performing data bus monitoring (snooping) and data injection
Conduct communications protocol analysis in the embedded products, and applications
Conduct wireless communications channel snooping, and data injection
Reverse engineering complex systems and protocols
Create detailed technical reports and proof of concept code to document findings

Are you as excited as we are when we talk about the storage and distribution of bulk liquids at our state-of-the-art tank containers and terminals in key markets? Join us as a Senior Business Application Consultant (Technical).

In this role, you will take ownership of the most complex and cross-application technical incidents across Stolt Tankers’ business applications, ensuring they are resolved effectively and sustainably. You will lead root cause analyses, manage vendor and SLA performance for key applications, and act as the primary technical escalation point for the Technical Business Application Consultant team. Alongside incident resolution, you will drive the technical workstreams of implementations, upgrades, migrations, cutovers, and decommissioning projects while providing subject-matter-expert input into solution architecture and technical design decisions.

Stolt Tankers, a division of Stolt-Nielsen Limited (SNL), is a specialist in transporting bulk liquids: chemicals, clean petroleum products, vegetable oils, biofuels, and oleochemicals. We are building a winning culture that is characterized by a safe, sustainable, and continuous improvement mindset. As part of this, we are rolling out continuous improvement training for all our shore-based and seagoing colleagues.

What You Will Be Doing

You will be the senior technical expert for key business applications, taking ownership of complex incidents that span multiple systems and require deep technical investigation. You will liaise closely with business stakeholders and end users to understand issues, gather detailed technical information, and provide clear updates on solution progress while managing multiple open support tickets. You will work with other Technical Business Application Consultants, infrastructure teams, and third-party vendors to troubleshoot issues from simple user problems to major cross-application incidents, leading root cause analysis and ensuring permanent fixes are implemented. A significant part of your work will involve defining and maintaining test strategies for the application portfolio, reviewing and signing off test plans and results, and validating patches and upgrades before they are released into production. You will lead the technical workstream of projects such as application implementations, upgrades, cutover planning, migration validation, and end-of-life phase-outs, providing SME input into solution architecture and technical design decisions. In addition, you will mentor and coach junior Technical Business Application Consultants, oversee technical risk and compliance aspects such as patching cadence, access reviews, audit evidence, and vulnerability checks, and help manage the Stolt Tankers Business Technology and Innovation (BTI) landscape infrastructure. Throughout, you will operate in a collaborative, project-oriented environment where you coordinate delivery with BT SNL and infrastructure teams, using tools and technologies such as SQL, Office 365, Azure integration, automation workflows, and SharePoint to support reliable and secure application operations.

Liaise with key business stakeholders to maintain an open dialogue on issues and solution progress
Provide support of applications by addressing tickets, prioritizing and managing multiple open cases at one time
Troubleshoot simple to complex issues reported by end users, investigating and capturing relevant information so tickets can be resolved

Lead root cause analysis on recurring or major incidents and drive structural fixes with vendors and development teams
Own the SLA and delivery relationship for specific 3rd-party applications in relation to Infra, by reviewing vendor-delivered patches and upgrades before release
Mentor and coach junior Technical Business Application Consultants, and own technical risk/compliance elements of the application portfolio (patching cadence, infra access reviews, audit evidence, and vulnerability checks) with the 3rd Party Application Project Lead and Infra Lead
Manage the Stolt Tankers Business Technology and Innovation (BTI) infrastructure landscape, and lead technical delivery of projects assigned by BT SNL (Stolt-Nielsen Limited)
No direct reports; mentors junior Technical Business Application Consultants



Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience
Substantial experience in enterprise application support, technical consulting, or application administration, including resolving complex incidents across interconnected systems
Strong understanding of application architecture, databases, integrations, operating systems, networking, and access management relevant to the supported environment
Demonstrated experience handling senior technical escalations, leading root cause investigations, and implementing permanent corrective actions
Proven experience leading technical activities for application implementations, upgrades, migrations, cutovers, and decommissioning
Experience defining test strategies, reviewing test evidence, validating vendor patches, and assessing release readiness
Experience monitoring SLAs, managing technical escalations, and coordinating delivery with third-party vendors and infrastructure teams
Practical experience with vulnerability checks, patch schedules, access reviews, and preparing audit evidence
Ability to mentor junior consultants, coordinate technical teams, and explain complex issues to nontechnical stakeholders
Technical skills: knowledge in SQL, Office 365, Azure Integration, automation workflows, and SharePoint
Certifications such as ITIL Foundation, relevant platform or infrastructure certifications, and software testing certifications could be preferred
Familiarity with shipping or tanker operations would also be useful given the Stolt Tankers context



What We Offer


Competitive compensation package aligned with your seniority and technical expertise in enterprise applications and infrastructure
Opportunities to lead high-impact technical projects across implementations, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning within a complex, global logistics environment
A collaborative environment where you work closely with business stakeholders, BTI, infrastructure teams, and third-party vendors, with real influence on solution architecture and technical design decisions
Strong focus on professional development, including support for relevant certifications (e.g., ITIL, platform, infrastructure, and testing certifications) and continuous learning in cloud, integration, and automation technologies
Exposure to a unique combination of maritime, logistics, and technology domains, allowing you to deepen your experience in critical, business-driven applications and infrastructure
The chance to mentor junior consultants and shape best practices in incident management, testing, release management, and technical governance across the application portfolio
A culture that values safety, reliability, and continuous improvement, giving you the space to drive root cause analysis, structural fixes, and long-term technical enhancements rather than just quick fixes
Flexible and supportive work arrangements that recognize the need to balance travel, project delivery, and personal commitments where business requirements allow
Inclusion in a global organization with clear values and a long-term outlook, offering future career pathways within Stolt Tankers and across the wider Stolt-Nielsen group
